<file path="css/INDEX.md">
 1: # css/ — Stylesheet Index
 2: 
 3: > See parent: [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md)
 4: 
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: ## FILE MAP
 8: 
 9: | File | Responsibility |
10: |------|---------------|
11: | `variables.css` | **Design tokens** — all CSS custom properties. Edit here to retheme. |
12: | `base.css` | Global reset, body/html defaults, font-face declarations |
13: | `styles.css` | **Main stylesheet** — game layout, HUD, panels, modals, tutorial system, auth screen, gamification UI, scroll deck, stone cards, CRT overlay, emoji system, responsive rules |
14: | `layout.css` | Lobby wrapper layout, game layout grid (3-col), panel collapse transitions |
15: | `board.css` | SVG board elements: hex tile fills/strokes, stone circles, player pawn markers, shrine markers, snap indicators |
16: | `components.css` | Buttons, inputs, modals, dropdowns, cards, status text, common UI primitives |
17: | `responsive.css` | Media queries for tablet (≤1024px) and mobile (≤768px) |
18: 
19: > **Note:** `styles.css` has grown to absorb most rules. When adding new features, default to `styles.css` unless the rule is clearly board-SVG (`board.css`) or a layout grid change (`layout.css`).
20: 
21: ---
22: 
23: ## variables.css — Token Reference
24: 
25: ```css
26: /* Colors */
27: --bg-dark: #0d0d0d
28: --bg-panel: #181818
29: --bg-card: #222
30: --bg-elevated: #2a2a2a
31: --accent-gold: #e6c79c        ← primary accent; used for borders, highlights
32: --accent-orange: #c05500
33: --text-muted: (implicit ~#666)
34: --border-subtle: (implicit)
35: 
36: /* Spacing */
37: --hud-height, --action-bar-height, --panel-width (used in grid template)
38: 
39: /* Typography */
40: --font-terminal: (VT323 or monospace fallback)
41: --font-pixel: (Press Start 2P)
42: 
43: /* Radius */
44: --radius-lg: 4px
45: ```
46: 
47: ---
48: 
49: ## Z-Index Stack (styles.css)
50: 
51: From lowest to highest. Anything not listed here is `auto` (stacking context order).
52: 
53: | z-index | Element |
54: |---------|---------|
55: | 2000 | `.scroll-browse-content` overlay |
56: | 3000 | `.stone-info-overlay` (stone ability popup) |
57: | 8500 | Gamification toast / notification |
58: | 8600 | `.tutorial-blocking-overlay` (spotlight dim layer) |
59: | 8610 | `.tutorial-modal` (center modals) |
60: | 8620 | `.tutorial-spotlight` (highlighted element) |
61: | 8640 | `.tutorial-modal.tutorial-corner` (corner modals) |
62: | 9000 | `.gami-overlay` (gamification panel) |
63: | 9999 | Various top-level overlays (emoji shop, badge panel) |
64: | 10000 | `.retro-dlg-overlay` (confirm dialogs) |
65: 
66: > Tutorial z-indices were raised from ~2500 to ~8600 to clear the stone info overlay at 3000.
67: 
68: ---
69: 
70: ## Tutorial CSS Classes
71: 
72: All prefixed `tmode-` (new interactive tutorial) or `tutorial-` (shared/legacy):
73: 
74: | Class | Purpose |
75: |-------|---------|
76: | `.tutorial-modal` | Full-screen overlay wrapper (center or corner) |
77: | `.tutorial-modal.tutorial-corner` | Corner-positioned modal variant (no dim bg) |
78: | `.tutorial-modal.tutorial-visible` | opacity:1 (added via rAF after append) |
79: | `.tutorial-modal.tutorial-fade-out` | opacity:0 for exit animation |
80: | `.tutorial-content` | The card box inside the modal |
81: | `.tutorial-blocking-overlay` | Full-screen click-eater for spotlight steps |
82: | `.tutorial-spotlight` | Applied to target element — gold pulse glow, z-index:8620 |
83: | `.tutorial-highlight-ring` | SVG circle on board with pulse animation |
84: | `.tmode-next` | "Continue" / "Got it" button inside tutorial modal |
85: | `.tmode-exit` | ✕ exit button — top-right of every modal |
86: | `.auth-btn-tutorial` | Tutorial entry button on auth screen |
87: | `.auth-tutorial-divider` | "or" divider above tutorial button |
</file>

<file path="js/cosmetics-system.js">
  1: // ============================================================
  2: // COSMETICS SYSTEM  (js/cosmetics-system.js)
  3: // Currently: name colours only.  No XP impact.
  4: //
  5: // Public API: window.cosmeticsSystem
  6: // ============================================================
  7: 
  8: (function () {
  9:     'use strict';
 10: 
 11:     const NAME_COLORS = [
 12:         { id: 'name_gold',    name: 'Gold',         cost: 50,  value: '#FFD700' },
 13:         { id: 'name_crimson', name: 'Crimson',       cost: 50,  value: '#ff3355' },
 14:         { id: 'name_blue',    name: 'Electric Blue', cost: 50,  value: '#00aaff' },
 15:         { id: 'name_emerald', name: 'Emerald',       cost: 50,  value: '#00ee88' },
 16:         { id: 'name_purple',  name: 'Royal Purple',  cost: 75,  value: '#cc44ff' },
 17:         { id: 'name_rainbow', name: 'Rainbow',       cost: 200, value: 'rainbow' },
 18:     ];
 19: 
 20:     // ── Storage ───────────────────────────────────────────────
 21: 
 22:     function getUserId() { return window.gami?.userId || null; }
 23: 
 24:     function storageKey() {
 25:         const uid = getUserId();
 26:         return uid ? `godaigo_cosmetics_${uid}` : null;
 27:     }
 28: 
 29:     function loadData() {
 30:         const key = storageKey();
 31:         if (!key) return { owned: [], equipped: {} };
 32:         try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || '{"owned":[],"equipped":{}}'); }
 33:         catch { return { owned: [], equipped: {} }; }
 34:     }
 35: 
 36:     function saveData(data) {
 37:         const key = storageKey();
 38:         if (key) localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(data));
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     function getEquipped(catKey) { return loadData().equipped[catKey] || null; }
 42:     function getEquippedAll()    { return loadData().equipped || {}; }
 43: 
 44:     // ── Purchase / equip ──────────────────────────────────────
 45: 
 46:     async function purchaseItem(id) {
 47:         const item = NAME_COLORS.find(i => i.id === id);
 48:         if (!item) return { ok: false, msg: 'Item not found' };
 49: 
 50:         const data = loadData();
 51:         if (data.owned.includes(id)) return { ok: false, msg: 'Already owned' };
 52: 
 53:         const userId = getUserId();
 54:         if (!userId) return { ok: false, msg: 'Not logged in' };
 55: 
 56:         const gold = window.gami?.profile?.gold || 0;
 57:         if (gold < item.cost) return { ok: false, msg: `Need ${item.cost}g (you have ${gold}g)` };
 58: 
 59:         const { error } = await supabase.rpc('award_gold', {
 60:             p_user_id:     userId,
 61:             p_gold_amount: -item.cost,
 62:             p_description: `Name colour: ${item.name}`
 63:         });
 64:         if (error) return { ok: false, msg: 'Purchase failed' };
 65: 
 66:         if (window.gami?.profile) window.gami.profile.gold -= item.cost;
 67:         data.owned.push(id);
 68:         saveData(data);
 69:         return { ok: true };
 70:     }
 71: 
 72:     function equipItem(id) {
 73:         const data = loadData();
 74:         if (!data.owned.includes(id)) return;
 75:         data.equipped.namecolor = (data.equipped.namecolor === id) ? null : id;
 76:         if (!data.equipped.namecolor) delete data.equipped.namecolor;
 77:         saveData(data);
 78:     }
 79: 
 80:     // ── Name color helper ─────────────────────────────────────
 81: 
 82:     function getNameColorStyle(equippedId) {
 83:         const nc   = equippedId || getEquipped('namecolor');
 84:         const item = NAME_COLORS.find(i => i.id === nc);
 85:         if (!item) return '';
 86:         if (item.value === 'rainbow') {
 87:             return [
 88:                 'background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f00,#f70,#ff0,#0f0,#00f,#80f,#f00)',
 89:                 'background-size:200%',
 90:                 '-webkit-background-clip:text',
 91:                 '-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent',
 92:                 'background-clip:text',
 93:                 'animation:nameRainbow 3s linear infinite',
 94:             ].join(';') + ';';
 95:         }
 96:         return `color:${item.value};`;
 97:     }
 98: 
 99:     // ── Panel UI ──────────────────────────────────────────────
100: 
101:     let panelEl = null;
102:     let isPanelOpen = false;
103: 
104:     function buildPanel() {
105:         if (panelEl) return;
106:         panelEl = document.createElement('div');
107:         panelEl.id = 'cosmetics-panel';
108:         panelEl.innerHTML = `
109:             <div class="cos-header">
110:                 <span class="cos-title">Name Colours</span>
111:                 <button class="cos-close" onclick="window.cosmeticsSystem.closePanel()">✕</button>
112:             </div>
113:             <div class="cos-gold-bar"><span id="cos-gold-amt">—</span>g</div>
114:             <div class="cos-body" id="cos-body"></div>
115:         `;
116:         document.body.appendChild(panelEl);
117:     }
118: 
119:     function renderPanel() {
120:         const data     = loadData();
121:         const equipped = data.equipped.namecolor;
122:         const gold     = window.gami?.profile?.gold || 0;
123: 
124:         const goldEl = document.getElementById('cos-gold-amt');
125:         if (goldEl) goldEl.textContent = window.gami?.profile?.gold ?? '—';
126: 
127:         const body = document.getElementById('cos-body');
128:         if (!body) return;
129: 
130:         body.innerHTML = NAME_COLORS.map(item => {
131:             const owned      = data.owned.includes(item.id);
132:             const isEquipped = equipped === item.id;
133:             const canAfford  = gold >= item.cost;
134: 
135:             const previewStyle = item.value === 'rainbow'
136:                 ? 'background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f00,#f70,#ff0,#0f0,#00f,#80f);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;background-size:200%;animation:nameRainbow 3s linear infinite;'
137:                 : `color:${item.value};`;
138: 
139:             let actionHTML;
140:             if (owned) {
141:                 actionHTML = `<button class="cos-btn ${isEquipped ? 'cos-equipped-btn' : 'cos-equip-btn'}"
142:                     onclick="window.cosmeticsSystem.handleEquip('${item.id}')">
143:                     ${isEquipped ? '✓ On' : 'Equip'}
144:                 </button>`;
145:             } else {
146:                 actionHTML = `<button class="cos-btn cos-buy-btn ${canAfford ? '' : 'cos-cant-afford'}"
147:                     onclick="window.cosmeticsSystem.handleBuy('${item.id}')">
148:                     ${item.cost}g
149:                 </button>`;
150:             }
151: 
152:             return `
153:                 <div class="cos-item ${isEquipped ? 'cos-item-equipped' : ''}">
154:                     <div class="cos-preview">
155:                         <span style="${previewStyle}font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;line-height:36px;">Aa</span>
156:                     </div>
157:                     <div class="cos-info">
158:                         <div class="cos-name">${item.name}</div>
159:                     </div>
160:                     <div class="cos-action">${actionHTML}</div>
161:                 </div>
162:             `;
163:         }).join('');
164:     }
165: 
166:     // ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────
167: 
168:     window.cosmeticsSystem = {
169:         togglePanel() { isPanelOpen ? this.closePanel() : this.openPanel(); },
170: 
171:         openPanel() {
172:             buildPanel();
173:             renderPanel();
174:             panelEl.classList.add('open');
175:             isPanelOpen = true;
176:         },
177: 
178:         closePanel() {
179:             panelEl?.classList.remove('open');
180:             isPanelOpen = false;
181:         },
182: 
183:         async handleBuy(id) {
184:             const result = await purchaseItem(id);
185:             renderPanel();
186:             window.gami?.notify(result.ok ? 'Purchased!' : result.msg, 0, 'gold');
187:         },
188: 
189:         handleEquip(id) {
190:             equipItem(id);
191:             renderPanel();
192:         },
193: 
194:         getEquippedAll,
195:         getEquipped,
196:         getNameColorStyle,
197:         getItems() { return NAME_COLORS; },
198:         getData:    loadData,
199:     };
200: 
201: })();
</file>

168:         if (panel) panel.classList.add('open');
169:         const btn = document.getElementById('emoji-panel-btn');
170:         if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');

176:         isPanelOpen = false;
177:         const panel = document.getElementById('emoji-panel');
178:         if (panel) panel.classList.remove('open');

180:         if (btn) btn.classList.remove('active');

202:         const owned = EMOJI_ITEMS.filter(e => emojiInventoryIds.has(e.id));
203:         const inGame = isInGame();
204: 
205:         if (owned.length === 0) {
206:             container.innerHTML = `

208:                 <div style="font-size:42px;margin-bottom:10px;"></div>
209:                 <div style="color:#ccc;font-weight:bold;">No emojis yet!</div>
210:                 <div style="font-size:12px;color:#888;margin-top:6px;">Head to the Shop tab to get started.</div>
211:               </div>`;
212:             return;
213:         }
214: 
215:         let html = '<div class="emoji-grid">';
216:         for (const item of owned) {
217:             const isText = item.isText;
218:             const cls = 'emoji-btn' + (isText ? ' text-emoji' : '');
219:             if (inGame) {

221:             } else {
222:                 html += `<div class="${cls} emoji-btn-inactive" title="${_esc(item.name)} (join a game to use)">${_esc(item.display)}</div>`;
223:             }
224:         }
225:         html += '</div>';
226: 
227:         if (!inGame) {
228:             html += '<p class="emoji-no-game-note">Join a game to use emojis</p>';
229:         }

264:                         <div class="owned-badge">✓ Owned</div>

272:                       </div>`;

286:     async function purchaseEmoji(emojiId) {
287:         const item = EMOJI_ITEMS.find(e => e.id === emojiId);
288:         if (!item) return;
289:         if (emojiInventoryIds.has(emojiId)) return; // already owned
290: 
291:         if (!window.gami?.userId) {
292:             alert('Please sign in to purchase emojis.');
293:             return;
294:         }
295: 
296:         // Refresh gold from cache
297:         const profile = window.gami.profile;
298:         const currentGold = profile?.gold ?? 0;
299: 
300:         if (currentGold < item.cost) {
301:             if (window.gami.notify) {
302:                 window.gami.notify(`Need ${item.cost}g — you have ${currentGold}g`, null, 'gold');
303:             } else {
304:                 alert(`Not enough gold! Need ${item.cost}g but you have ${currentGold}g.`);
305:             }
306:             return;
307:         }
308: 
309:         const confirmed = await new Promise(resolve => {
310:             const overlay = document.createElement('div');
311:             overlay.className = 'retro-dlg-overlay';
312:             overlay.innerHTML = `
313:               <div class="retro-dlg-box">
314:                 <div class="retro-dlg-title">Confirm Purchase</div>
315:                 <div class="retro-dlg-body">
316:                   <div class="retro-dlg-line">${item.display}  ${item.name}</div>
317:                   <div class="retro-dlg-line">Cost: ${item.cost}g</div>
318:                 </div>
319:                 <div class="retro-dlg-btns">
320:                   <button class="retro-dlg-btn ok" id="rdlg-ok">Buy</button>
321:                   <button class="retro-dlg-btn cancel" id="rdlg-cancel">Cancel</button>
322:                 </div>
323:               </div>`;
324:             document.body.appendChild(overlay);
325:             overlay.querySelector('#rdlg-ok').onclick = () => { overlay.remove(); resolve(true); };
326:             overlay.querySelector('#rdlg-cancel').onclick = () => { overlay.remove(); resolve(false); };
327:         });
328:         if (!confirmed) return;
329: 
330:         try {
331:             // Deduct gold atomically via the existing RPC
332:             const { error } = await supabase.rpc('award_gold', {
333:                 p_user_id:    window.gami.userId,
334:                 p_gold_amount: -item.cost,
335:                 p_description: 'Emoji purchase: ' + item.name
336:             });
337: 
338:             if (error) throw error;
339: 
340:             // Optimistically update local cache
341:             if (window.gami.profile) {
342:                 window.gami.profile.gold = Math.max(0, (window.gami.profile.gold || 0) - item.cost);
343:             }
344: 
345:             // Persist to inventory
346:             emojiInventoryIds.add(emojiId);
347:             saveInventory();
348: 
349:             // Toast notification
350:             if (window.gami.notify) {
351:                 window.gami.notify(`${item.display}  ${item.name} unlocked!`, item.cost, 'gold');
352:             }
353: 
354:             // Re-render to reflect new state
355:             renderCurrentView();
356: 
357:         } catch (err) {
358:             console.error('Emoji purchase failed:', err);
359:             alert('Purchase failed: ' + (err.message || 'Unknown error'));
360:         }
361:     }

363:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
364:     // USE EMOJI — show locally + broadcast to other players
365:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
366: 
367:     function useEmoji(emojiId) {
368:         if (!isInGame()) return;
369: 
370:         const item = EMOJI_ITEMS.find(e => e.id === emojiId);
371:         if (!item) return;
372: 
373:         // Per-user cooldown to prevent spam (2 s)
374:         if (emojiCooldown) return;
375:         emojiCooldown = true;
376:         clearTimeout(emojiCooldownTimer);
377:         emojiCooldownTimer = setTimeout(() => { emojiCooldown = false; }, 2000);
378: 
379:         const myIdx = (typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined') ? myPlayerIndex : 0;
380: 
381:         // Show over my own pawn
382:         showEmojiOverPawn(myIdx, item.display, item.isText);
383: 
384:         // Broadcast to all other players
385:         if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer &&
386:             typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
387:             broadcastGameAction('emoji', {
388:                 playerIndex: myIdx,
389:                 display: item.display,
390:                 isText: !!item.isText
391:             });
392:         }
393: 
394:         // Close panel for clean UX
395:         closePanel();
396:     }
397: 
398:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
399:     // SHOW EMOJI OVER PAWN  (called locally + by broadcast receiver)
400:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
401: 
402:     function showEmojiOverPawn(playerIndex, display, isText) {
403:         if (typeof playerPositions === 'undefined') return;
404:         const player = playerPositions[playerIndex];
405:         if (!player?.element) return;
406: 
407:         const rect = player.element.getBoundingClientRect();
408:         if (!rect || (rect.width === 0 && rect.height === 0)) return;
409: 
410:         // Centre horizontally on pawn, anchor just above it
411:         const cx = rect.left + rect.width  / 2;
412:         const cy = rect.top  + rect.height / 2;
413: 
414:         const el = document.createElement('div');
415:         el.className = 'emoji-float' + (isText ? ' emoji-float-text' : '');
416:         el.textContent = display;
417:         el.style.left = cx + 'px';
418:         el.style.top  = cy + 'px';
419: 
420:         document.body.appendChild(el);
421: 
422:         // Remove once CSS animation finishes (5.5 s to let fade complete)
423:         setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 5500);
424:     }

438:             .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
439:             .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
440:             .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
441:     }

<file path="js/gamification.js">
  1: // ============================================================
  2: // GAMIFICATION SERVICE  (js/gamification.js)
  3: // Adapted from Gamify/gamification_service.js for Godaigo.
  4: //
  5: // Uses the global `supabase` client (config.js).
  6: // Exposes window.gami for lobby.js / game-core.js to call.
  7: //
  8: // XP rewards:
  9: //   game_complete     : 20 + (numPlayers-1)×10  (loss)
 10: //   game_win          : 75 + (numPlayers-1)×25  (win)
 11: //
 12: // Gold rewards (no leaderboard impact):
 13: //   daily_login       : +20 gold (once per calendar day)
 14: //   level_up          : +50 gold per level (handled in DB function)
 15: // ============================================================
 16: 
 17: window.gami = (function () {
 18: 
 19:     // ── Internal state ────────────────────────────────────────
 20:     let _userId  = null;
 21:     let _profile = null;   // cached user_profiles row
 22: 
 23:     // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────
 24: 
 25:     function _log(...args) {
 26:         console.log('[gami]', ...args);
 27:     }
 28: 
 29:     /** Fire-and-forget INSERT into user_activities */
 30:     function _logActivity(activityType, xpAwarded, goldAwarded, description, metadata) {
 31:         if (!_userId) return;
 32:         supabase.from('user_activities').insert({
 33:             user_id:       _userId,
 34:             activity_type: activityType,
 35:             xp_awarded:    xpAwarded    || 0,
 36:             gold_awarded:  goldAwarded  || 0,
 37:             description:   description  || activityType,
 38:             metadata:      metadata     || {}
 39:         }).then(({ error }) => {
 40:             if (error) console.error('[gami] activity log error:', error);
 41:         });
 42:     }
 43: 
 44:     /** Update a subset of profile.stats in the DB (fire-and-forget) */
 45:     function _patchStats(patch) {
 46:         if (!_userId || !_profile) return;
 47:         const stats = Object.assign({}, _profile.stats || {}, patch);
 48:         _profile.stats = stats;
 49:         supabase.from('user_profiles')
 50:             .update({ stats, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
 51:             .eq('user_id', _userId)
 52:             .then(({ error }) => {
 53:                 if (error) console.error('[gami] stats patch error:', error);
 54:             });
 55:     }
 56: 
 57:     // ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────
 58: 
 59:     const api = {
 60: 
 61:         // Expose userId for UI (read-only intent)
 62:         get userId() { return _userId; },
 63:         get profile() { return _profile; },
 64: 
 65:         /**
 66:          * init(userId, displayName)
 67:          * Called from onAuthSuccess in lobby.js.
 68:          * Gets or creates the user_profiles row.
 69:          */
 70:         async init(userId, displayName) {
 71:             _userId = userId;
 72: 
 73:             let { data: profile, error } = await supabase
 74:                 .from('user_profiles')
 75:                 .select('*')
 76:                 .eq('user_id', userId)
 77:                 .single();
 78: 
 79:             if (error && error.code === 'PGRST116') {
 80:                 // Profile doesn't exist yet — create it
 81:                 const { data: newProfile, error: createErr } = await supabase
 82:                     .from('user_profiles')
 83:                     .insert({
 84:                         user_id:      userId,
 85:                         display_name: displayName || 'Player',
 86:                         total_xp:     0,
 87:                         current_level: 1,
 88:                         gold:         0,
 89:                         badges_earned: [],
 90:                         inventory:    [],
 91:                         stats: {
 92:                             games_played:      0,
 93:                             games_won:         0,
 94:                             scrolls_cast:      0,
 95:                             elements_activated: 0,
 96:                             streak:            0,
 97:                             last_active:       null
 98:                         }
 99:                     })
100:                     .select()
101:                     .single();
102: 
103:                 if (createErr) {
104:                     console.error('[gami] profile create error:', createErr);
105:                     return;
106:                 }
107:                 profile = newProfile;
108:                 _log('new profile created for', displayName);
109:             } else if (error) {
110:                 console.error('[gami] profile fetch error:', error);
111:                 return;
112:             }
113: 
114:             _profile = profile;
115:             _log('init complete — level', profile.current_level, 'xp', profile.total_xp);
116:         },
117: 
118:         /**
119:          * onDailyLogin()
120:          * Awards 20 gold once per calendar day.
121:          * Does NOT award XP (login is not a meaningful game action).
122:          */
123:         async onDailyLogin() {
124:             if (!_userId || !_profile) return;
125: 
126:             const today     = new Date().toDateString();
127:             const lastActive = _profile.stats?.last_active;
128:             if (lastActive === today) return; // Already collected today
129: 
130:             const { error } = await supabase.rpc('award_gold', {
131:                 p_user_id:     _userId,
132:                 p_gold_amount: 20,
133:                 p_description: 'Daily login reward'
134:             });
135:             if (error) { console.error('[gami] daily login gold error:', error); return; }
136: 
137:             // Log a daily_login activity so the "Dedicated" badge can count it
138:             _logActivity('daily_login', 0, 20, 'Daily login');
139: 
140:             // Update streak and last_active in stats
141:             const yesterday = new Date(Date.now() - 86_400_000).toDateString();
142:             const streak    = (lastActive === yesterday)
143:                 ? (_profile.stats?.streak || 0) + 1
144:                 : 1;
145: 
146:             _patchStats({ last_active: today, streak });
147:             if (_profile) _profile.gold = (_profile.gold || 0) + 20;
148: 
149:             api.notify('Daily reward! +20', 20, 'gold');
150:             _log('daily login gold awarded');
151:         },
152: 
153:         /**
154:          * onScrollCast(scrollName, element)
155:          * Called via window.logScrollEvent (already fired from game-core.js).
156:          * Tracks count for badge purposes only — no XP.
157:          */
158:         onScrollCast(scrollName, element) {
159:             if (!_userId) return;
160:             // Fire-and-forget
161:             _logActivity('scroll_cast', 0, 0, `Cast ${scrollName || element || 'scroll'}`);
162:             _patchStats({ scrolls_cast: (_profile?.stats?.scrolls_cast || 0) + 1 });
163:         },
164: 
165:         /**
166:          * onElementActivated(element, allActivated)
167:          * Tracks activations for badge purposes only — no XP.
168:          */
169:         onElementActivated(element, allActivated) {
170:             if (!_userId) return;
171:             _logActivity('element_activated', 0, 0, `Activated ${element}`, { element });
172:             _patchStats({ elements_activated: (_profile?.stats?.elements_activated || 0) + 1 });
173:         },
174: 
175:         /**
176:          * onGameComplete(isWinner, numPlayers)
177:          * XP scales with player count:
178:          *   Loss: 20 + (n-1)*10   →  2p=30, 3p=40, 4p=50, 5p=60
179:          *   Win:  75 + (n-1)*25   →  2p=100, 3p=125, 4p=150, 5p=175
180:          */
181:         async onGameComplete(isWinner, numPlayers) {
182:             _log(`onGameComplete called — userId=${_userId}, isWinner=${isWinner}, numPlayers=${numPlayers}`);
183:             if (!_userId) { console.warn('[gami] onGameComplete: no userId, XP skipped'); return; }
184:             if (!isWinner) { _log('no XP awarded — only winners earn XP'); return; }
185:             const n   = Math.max(2, numPlayers || 2);
186:             const xp  = 75 + (n - 1) * 25;
187: 
188:             _log(`awarding ${xp} XP (isWinner=${isWinner}, n=${n})`);
189:             try {
190:                 // Award XP
191:                 const { data: xpData, error: xpErr } = await supabase.rpc('update_user_xp', {
192:                     p_user_id:     _userId,
193:                     p_xp_points:   xp,
194:                     p_description: isWinner
195:                         ? `Game win (${n} players)`
196:                         : `Game complete — ${n} players`
197:                 });
198:                 if (xpErr) { console.error('[gami] update_user_xp RPC error:', xpErr); return; }
199:                 _log('update_user_xp success, result:', xpData);
200: 
201:                 // Log game_complete (badge: First Steps, Veteran)
202:                 _logActivity('game_complete', xp, 0,
203:                     `Completed game with ${n} players`, { num_players: n, won: isWinner });
204: 
205:                 // Log game_win (badge: First Victory, Champion, Master)
206:                 if (isWinner) {
207:                     _logActivity('game_win', 0, 0,
208:                         `Won game with ${n} players`, { num_players: n });
209:                 }
210: 
211:                 // Update stats
212:                 const stats = Object.assign({}, _profile?.stats || {});
213:                 stats.games_played = (stats.games_played || 0) + 1;
214:                 if (isWinner) stats.games_won = (stats.games_won || 0) + 1;
215:                 _patchStats(stats);
216:                 if (_profile) _profile.total_xp = (_profile.total_xp || 0) + xp;
217: 
218:                 const msg = `Victory! +${xp} XP`;
219:                 api.notify(msg, xp, 'xp');
220:                 _log('game complete —', msg);
221:             } catch (err) {
222:                 console.error('[gami] onGameComplete error:', err);
223:             }
224:         },
225: 
226:         /** Fetch a fresh profile from the DB */
227:         async getProfile() {
228:             if (!_userId) return null;
229:             const { data, error } = await supabase
230:                 .from('user_profiles')
231:                 .select('*')
232:                 .eq('user_id', _userId)
233:                 .single();
234:             if (error) { console.error('[gami] getProfile error:', error); return _profile; }
235:             _profile = data;
236:             return data;
237:         },
238: 
239:         /** Top N players ordered by total XP */
240:         async getLeaderboard(limit) {
241:             const { data, error } = await supabase
242:                 .from('user_profiles')
243:                 .select('display_name, total_xp, current_level, user_id')
244:                 .order('total_xp', { ascending: false })
245:                 .limit(limit || 10);
246:             if (error) { console.error('[gami] leaderboard error:', error); return []; }
247:             return data || [];
248:         },
249: 
250:         /** All badges merged with the current user's earned status */
251:         async getBadgesWithStatus() {
252:             const { data: badges, error } = await supabase
253:                 .from('badges')
254:                 .select('*')
255:                 .eq('is_active', true)
256:                 .order('xp_reward', { ascending: true });
257:             if (error) { console.error('[gami] badges error:', error); return []; }
258: 
259:             const earnedIds = _profile?.badges_earned || [];
260:             return (badges || []).map(b => ({
261:                 ...b,
262:                 earned: earnedIds.includes(b.id)
263:             }));
264:         },
265: 
266:         /**
267:          * Show a slide-in toast at the bottom-right.
268:          * type: 'xp' | 'gold'
269:          */
270:         notify(message, amount, type) {
271:             const toast = document.createElement('div');
272:             toast.className = 'gami-toast';
273:             toast.innerHTML =
274:                 `<span class="gami-toast-icon">${type === 'gold' ? '[G]' : '[XP]'}</span>${message}`;
275:             document.body.appendChild(toast);
276: 
277:             requestAnimationFrame(() => toast.classList.add('gami-toast-show'));
278: 
279:             setTimeout(() => {
280:                 toast.classList.remove('gami-toast-show');
281:                 setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 400);
282:             }, 3000);
283:         }
284:     };
285: 
286:     return api;
287: })();
288:

290: // This intercepts scroll casts with zero changes to game-core.js.
291: window.logScrollEvent = function (eventType, data) {
292:     if (eventType === 'cast_execute' && window.gami?.userId) {
293:         window.gami.onScrollCast(data?.scrollName, data?.element);
294:     }
295: };

<file path="js/scrolls/INDEX.md">
  1: # js/scrolls/ — Scroll System Index
  2: 
  3: > See parent: [js/INDEX.md](../INDEX.md) → [CLAUDE.md](../../CLAUDE.md)
  4: 
  5: ---
  6: 
  7: ## FILE MAP
  8: 
  9: | File | Responsibility |
 10: |------|---------------|
 11: | `scroll-definitions.js` | Static data: all 31 scroll names, levels, elements, stone patterns, and effect descriptions. Exposes `window.SCROLL_DEFINITIONS` and `window.SCROLL_DECKS`. |
 12: | `response-window.js` | `ResponseWindowSystem` class: detects which players can respond to a cast, manages 15s countdown, validates counter/reaction scrolls, resolves the stack. |
 13: | `effects/scroll-effects.js` | `ScrollEffects` namespace: `execute(scrollId, playerIndex, spellSystem)` for all 31 scrolls, active buff tracking, selection modes (sacrifice, tile-flip, etc.). |
 14: 
 15: ---
 16: 
 17: ## SCROLL SYSTEM FLOW
 18: 
 19: ```
 20: Player clicks "Cast Spell"
 21:     │
 22:     ▼
 23: spellSystem.activateScroll(scrollId, playerIndex)   [game-core.js]
 24:     │  validates: pattern on board, 2 AP, scroll in active/common area
 25:     │
 26:     ▼
 27: applyScrollEffects(scrollId, playerIndex, result)   [game-core.js]
 28:     │  calls ScrollEffects.execute()
 29:     │  checks result.cancelled before tracking win condition
 30:     │
 31:     ▼
 32: ScrollEffects.execute(scrollId, playerIndex, ss)    [scroll-effects.js]
 33:     │  returns { success, requiresSelection, cancelled, message }
 34:     │
 35:     ▼
 36: ResponseWindowSystem.openWindow(castData)           [response-window.js]
 37:     │  15s for other players to respond
 38:     │  on response: re-enters execute() for the counter scroll
 39:     │
 40:     ▼
 41: Win condition tracked in spellSystem.activated Set
 42: ```
 43: 
 44: ---
 45: 
 46: ## scroll-definitions.js — Deep Notes
 47: 
 48: ### Data structures
 49: ```js
 50: SCROLL_DEFINITIONS = {
 51:   EARTH_SCROLL_1: {
 52:     id: 'EARTH_SCROLL_1',
 53:     name: 'Tremor',
 54:     element: 'earth',
 55:     level: 1,
 56:     isResponse: true,       // level 1 scrolls are always response-only
 57:     patterns: [[...], [...]], // array of rotation variants
 58:     description: '...'
 59:   },
 60:   ...
 61: }
 62: 
 63: SCROLL_DECKS = {
 64:   earth: ['EARTH_SCROLL_1', ..., 'EARTH_SCROLL_5'],
 65:   water: [...],
 66:   fire:  [...],
 67:   wind:  [...],
 68:   void:  [...],
 69:   catacomb: ['CATACOMB_SCROLL_1', ..., 'CATACOMB_SCROLL_6']
 70: }
 71: ```
 72: 
 73: ### Patterns
 74: - Each pattern is a list of `{q, r, type}` relative offsets from the player's hex
 75: - Multiple variants per scroll = rotation equivalents (the system checks all)
 76: - `type` matches stone type strings: `'earth'`, `'water'`, `'fire'`, `'wind'`, `'void'`
 77: 
 78: ### Catacomb scrolls
 79: - 6 scrolls, dual-type (count toward 2 win conditions)
 80: - Drawn when revealing a catacomb tile
 81: - Stored in `SCROLL_DECKS.catacomb`
 82: 
 83: ---
 84: 
 85: ## scroll-effects.js — Deep Notes
 86: 
 87: ### execute() return contract
 88: ```js
 89: {
 90:   success: bool,            // did the effect fire?
 91:   requiresSelection: bool,  // is the system waiting for player input?
 92:   cancelled: bool,          // if true, applyScrollEffects() skips win tracking
 93:   message: string           // status bar text
 94: }
 95: ```
 96: 
 97: ### cancelled: true
 98: Used when an execute() call cannot proceed (e.g., Sacrificial Pyre with empty hand).
 99: `applyScrollEffects()` in game-core.js checks `result.cancelled` and returns before
100: tracking the element in the win condition set. Critical: the element tracking block
101: runs even if `success=false`, so `cancelled` is the only safe escape hatch.
102: 
103: ### Active buffs
104: Stored in `ScrollEffects.activeBuffs{}`. Keyed by effect name. Cleared on turn end.
105: Examples: `callToAdventure` (draw stones on tile flip), `respirate` (wind return on turn end).
106: 
107: ### Selection modes
108: Some scrolls pause normal gameplay to collect player input:
109: - `enterScrollSacrificeMode()` — player picks a scroll from hand to discard (Sacrificial Pyre)
110: - `tileMoveMode` on `window` — player picks tiles to move (Telekinesis)
111: - `takeFlightState` on `window` — player picks pawn to move (Take Flight / Breath of Power)
112: 
113: ### Scroll-specific gotchas
114: - **Sacrificial Pyre (FIRE_SCROLL_3)**: checks hand size before entering sacrifice mode. Returns `cancelled:true` if hand is empty. Previously granted fire win-con on empty hand — fixed.
115: - **Heavy Stomp (EARTH_SCROLL_3)**: calls `performTileFlip()` in scroll-effects.js (NOT `revealTile()`). Remote flips use `flipTileVisually()`. Only `revealTile()` grants +1 AP for catacomb tiles and fires tutorial hooks.
116: - **Wandering River (WATER_SCROLL_X)**: uses `getEffectiveTileElement(tile)` to override shrine type for scroll drawing. Check this before assuming `tile.shrineType` is canonical.
117: 
118: ---
119: 
120: ## response-window.js — Deep Notes
121: 
122: ### Response eligibility
123: A player can respond if:
124: 1. They have a level-1 scroll of ANY element in active area
125: 2. They have ≥ 2 AP remaining
126: 3. The response window is open (15s after cast)
127: 
128: ### Conflict resolution
129: If two players respond simultaneously, higher-rank element wins:
130: `Void > Wind > Fire > Water > Earth`
131: Same rule applies to stone conflict on the board.
132: 
133: ### Stack resolution
134: - Response resolves BEFORE the original cast takes effect
135: - A response cannot itself be responded to (no counter-counter)
</file>

<file path="js/crt-overlay.js">
  1: // ============================================================
  2: // CRT OVERLAY  (js/crt-overlay.js)
  3: //
  4: // Canvas-based CRT effects drawn over the entire page.
  5: // Effects: scanlines, vignette, film grain, flicker.
  6: // All effects are on by default and individually togglable.
  7: //
  8: // Storage key: godaigo_crt_${userId}  (or godaigo_crt_guest)
  9: // Public API:  window.crtOverlay.init()
 10: //              window.crtOverlay.setOption(key, bool)
 11: //              window.crtOverlay.getOptions()
 12: //              window.crtOverlay.loadForUser(userId)
 13: //              window.crtOverlay.saveForUser(userId)
 14: // ============================================================
 15: 
 16: window.crtOverlay = (function () {
 17: 
 18:     // ── Internal state ────────────────────────────────────────
 19:     let _canvas = null;
 20:     let _ctx    = null;
 21:     let _raf    = null;
 22: 
 23:     const DEFAULTS = { scanlines: true, vignette: true, grain: true, flicker: true };
 24:     let _opts = { ...DEFAULTS };
 25: 
 26:     // Vignette gradient — rebuilt on resize, reused every frame
 27:     let _vignetteGrad = null;
 28: 
 29:     // Scanline pattern — rebuilt on resize, reused every frame
 30:     let _scanPattern = null;
 31: 
 32:     // Offscreen grain canvas (256×256, tiled)
 33:     let _grainCanvas  = null;
 34:     let _grainCtx     = null;
 35:     let _grainPattern = null;
 36:     let _grainFrame   = 0;
 37: 
 38:     // Flicker state
 39:     let _flickerAlpha = 0;
 40: 
 41:     // ── Storage ───────────────────────────────────────────────
 42: 
 43:     function _key(userId) {
 44:         return userId ? `godaigo_crt_${userId}` : 'godaigo_crt_guest';
 45:     }
 46: 
 47:     function loadForUser(userId) {
 48:         try {
 49:             const raw = localStorage.getItem(_key(userId));
 50:             if (raw) {
 51:                 const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
 52:                 Object.keys(DEFAULTS).forEach(k => {
 53:                     if (typeof parsed[k] === 'boolean') _opts[k] = parsed[k];
 54:                 });
 55:             } else {
 56:                 // No saved prefs — use defaults
 57:                 _opts = { ...DEFAULTS };
 58:             }
 59:         } catch (e) {
 60:             console.warn('[crt-overlay] failed to load settings:', e);
 61:             _opts = { ...DEFAULTS };
 62:         }
 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     function saveForUser(userId) {
 66:         try {
 67:             localStorage.setItem(_key(userId), JSON.stringify(_opts));
 68:         } catch (e) {
 69:             console.warn('[crt-overlay] failed to save settings:', e);
 70:         }
 71:     }
 72: 
 73:     // ── Canvas setup ──────────────────────────────────────────
 74: 
 75:     function init() {
 76:         if (_raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(_raf); _raf = null; }
 77:         if (document.getElementById('crt-canvas')) {
 78:             // Already exists — just restart the loop
 79:             _canvas = document.getElementById('crt-canvas');
 80:             _ctx    = _canvas.getContext('2d');
 81:             _onResize();
 82:             _loop();
 83:             return;
 84:         }
 85: 
 86:         _canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
 87:         _canvas.id = 'crt-canvas';
 88:         _canvas.style.cssText = [
 89:             'position:fixed',
 90:             'inset:0',
 91:             'width:100%',
 92:             'height:100%',
 93:             'z-index:9999',
 94:             'pointer-events:none',
 95:             'display:block'
 96:         ].join(';');
 97:         document.body.appendChild(_canvas);
 98:         _ctx = _canvas.getContext('2d');
 99: 
100:         // Grain offscreen canvas
101:         _grainCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
102:         _grainCanvas.width  = 256;
103:         _grainCanvas.height = 256;
104:         _grainCtx = _grainCanvas.getContext('2d');
105: 
106:         window.addEventListener('resize', _onResize);
107:         // Defer resize to next frame so the canvas is fully laid out
108:         requestAnimationFrame(() => { _onResize(); _loop(); });
109:     }
110: 
111:     function _onResize() {
112:         const w = window.innerWidth;
113:         const h = window.innerHeight;
114:         _canvas.width  = w;
115:         _canvas.height = h;
116:         _vignetteGrad  = _buildVignetteGrad(w, h);
117:         _scanPattern   = _buildScanPattern();
118:         // Grain pattern rebuilt next grain frame
119:         _grainPattern  = null;
120:     }
121: 
122:     // ── Effect builders ───────────────────────────────────────
123: 
124:     function _buildVignetteGrad(w, h) {
125:         const grad = _ctx.createRadialGradient(
126:             w / 2, h / 2, 0,
127:             w / 2, h / 2, Math.max(w, h) * 0.72
128:         );
129:         grad.addColorStop(0,    'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
130:         grad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
131:         grad.addColorStop(1.0,  'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)');
132:         return grad;
133:     }
134: 
135:     function _buildScanPattern() {
136:         // Realistic CRT phosphor scanlines: 4px period with soft gradient falloff.
137:         // Real CRTs have a dark inter-line gap that feathers into the bright phosphor
138:         // area rather than a hard edge. Four opacity steps simulate this:
139:         //   y=0  gap (darkest)   → y=1  soft shadow   → y=2  barely visible
140:         //   → y=3  clear (phosphor active — full brightness)
141:         // Max opacity (0.09) is half the old flat-line value (0.18).
142:         const sc = document.createElement('canvas');
143:         sc.width  = 1;
144:         sc.height = 4;
145:         const c = sc.getContext('2d');
146:         c.clearRect(0, 0, 1, 4);
147:         c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.09)';  // inter-line gap — darkest
148:         c.fillRect(0, 0, 1, 1);
149:         c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.04)';  // soft shadow
150:         c.fillRect(0, 1, 1, 1);
151:         c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.01)';  // barely visible transition
152:         c.fillRect(0, 2, 1, 1);
153:         // y=3: left transparent — phosphor center at full brightness
154:         return _ctx.createPattern(sc, 'repeat');
155:     }
156: 
157:     function _updateGrain() {
158:         const iw = _grainCanvas.width;
159:         const ih = _grainCanvas.height;
160:         const imageData = _grainCtx.createImageData(iw, ih);
161:         const data = imageData.data;
162:         for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
163:             const v = (Math.random() * 40) | 0;
164:             data[i]     = v;
165:             data[i + 1] = v;
166:             data[i + 2] = v;
167:             data[i + 3] = Math.random() < 0.45 ? 22 : 0;
168:         }
169:         _grainCtx.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0);
170:         _grainPattern = _ctx.createPattern(_grainCanvas, 'repeat');
171:     }
172: 
173:     // ── Render loop ───────────────────────────────────────────
174: 
175:     function _loop() {
176:         const ctx = _ctx;
177:         const w   = _canvas.width;
178:         const h   = _canvas.height;
179: 
180:         ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
181: 
182:         if (_opts.flicker)   _drawFlicker(ctx, w, h);
183:         if (_opts.vignette)  _drawVignette(ctx, w, h);
184:         if (_opts.grain)     _drawGrain(ctx, w, h);
185:         if (_opts.scanlines) _drawScanlines(ctx, w, h);
186: 
187:         _raf = requestAnimationFrame(_loop);
188:     }
189: 
190:     function _drawFlicker(ctx, w, h) {
191:         _flickerAlpha += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.012;
192:         _flickerAlpha  = Math.max(0, Math.min(0.045, _flickerAlpha));
193:         if (_flickerAlpha > 0.001) {
194:             ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${_flickerAlpha.toFixed(3)})`;
195:             ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
196:         }
197:     }
198: 
199:     function _drawVignette(ctx, w, h) {
200:         if (!_vignetteGrad) _vignetteGrad = _buildVignetteGrad(w, h);
201:         ctx.fillStyle = _vignetteGrad;
202:         ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
203:     }
204: 
205:     function _drawGrain(ctx, w, h) {
206:         // Update grain tile every 2nd frame
207:         _grainFrame++;
208:         if (_grainFrame % 2 === 0 || !_grainPattern) {
209:             _updateGrain();
210:         }
211:         if (_grainPattern) {
212:             ctx.fillStyle = _grainPattern;
213:             ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
214:         }
215:     }
216: 
217:     function _drawScanlines(ctx, w, h) {
218:         if (!_scanPattern) _scanPattern = _buildScanPattern();
219:         ctx.fillStyle = _scanPattern;
220:         ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
221:     }
222: 
223:     // ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────
224: 
225:     function setOption(key, value) {
226:         if (!(key in DEFAULTS)) return;
227:         _opts[key] = !!value;
228:     }
229: 
230:     function getOptions() {
231:         return { ..._opts };
232:     }
233: 
234:     return { init, setOption, getOptions, loadForUser, saveForUser };
235: 
236: })();
237: 
238: // Auto-init on page load (guest defaults until user signs in)
239: (function () {
240:     function _start() {
241:         window.crtOverlay.loadForUser(null);
242:         window.crtOverlay.init();
243:     }
244:     if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
245:         document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', _start);
246:     } else {
247:         _start();
248:     }
249: })();
</file>

<file path="js/joytone-bridge.js">
  1: (function () {
  2:     'use strict';
  3: 
  4:     // ── Joytone Bridge ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  5:     // Embeds the Joytone generative-music app (joytone/index.html) in a
  6:     // hidden same-origin iframe and drives it through its window.JoytoneAPI:
  7:     //   • Game start  → boot: Five-Elements theme auto-plays, Grow + Drummer ON
  8:     //   • Tile reveal → appends a seeded riff of that tile's element to the
  9:     //     playlist (seed = gameId + tileId, so every client independently
 10:     //     grows the SAME sequence — no extra network traffic). Each element
 11:     //     variation can only ever be added once.
 12:     //   • Shift+J+T   → toggles the full sequencer UI as a popup
 13:     //   • Mute/volume → per-player, from the Settings tab (localStorage)
 14: 
 15:     const IFRAME_SRC = 'joytone/index.html';
 16: 
 17:     let iframe = null;
 18:     let popup = null;
 19:     let popupVisible = false;
 20:     let gameActive = false;
 21:     const handledTiles = new Set();   // tileIds already sent to joytone this game
 22: 
 23:     // Per-player audio prefs (never synced)
 24:     let muted  = localStorage.getItem('godaigo_joytone_muted') === 'true';
 25:     let volume = parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('godaigo_joytone_volume'));
 26:     if (!(volume >= 0 && volume <= 1)) volume = 1;
 27: 
 28:     function api() {
 29:         return iframe?.contentWindow?.JoytoneAPI || null;
 30:     }
 31: 
 32:     // ── Iframe + popup shell ─────────────────────────────────────────────
 33:     function buildDom() {
 34:         popup = document.createElement('div');
 35:         popup.id = 'joytone-popup';
 36:         popup.style.cssText = [
 37:             'display:none', 'position:fixed', 'inset:4vh 4vw', 'z-index:10050',
 38:             'background:#0d0d11', 'border:1px solid #5566cc', 'border-radius:10px',
 39:             'box-shadow:0 12px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.75)', 'overflow:hidden',
 40:         ].join(';');
 41: 
 42:         const bar = document.createElement('div');
 43:         bar.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;' +
 44:             'padding:6px 12px;background:#16161d;border-bottom:1px solid #2a2a35;' +
 45:             'font:600 12px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#9fa8da';
 46:         bar.innerHTML = '<span>🎹 Joytone — adaptive music (Shift+J+T to close)</span>';
 47:         const closeBtn = document.createElement('button');
 48:         closeBtn.textContent = '✕';
 49:         closeBtn.style.cssText = 'background:none;border:1px solid #444;border-radius:5px;' +
 50:             'color:#ccc;cursor:pointer;padding:2px 9px;font-size:12px';
 51:         closeBtn.addEventListener('click', hidePopup);
 52:         bar.appendChild(closeBtn);
 53: 
 54:         iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
 55:         iframe.id = 'joytone-frame';
 56:         iframe.src = IFRAME_SRC;
 57:         iframe.setAttribute('title', 'Joytone sequencer');
 58:         iframe.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:calc(100% - 31px);border:0;display:block;background:#111';
 59: 
 60:         popup.appendChild(bar);
 61:         popup.appendChild(iframe);
 62:         document.body.appendChild(popup);
 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     function showPopup() {
 66:         if (!popup) return;
 67:         popup.style.display = 'block';
 68:         popupVisible = true;
 69:         api()?.onShown();
 70:     }
 71: 
 72:     function hidePopup() {
 73:         if (!popup) return;
 74:         popup.style.display = 'none';
 75:         popupVisible = false;
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     function togglePopup() {
 79:         popupVisible ? hidePopup() : showPopup();
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     // ── Game lifecycle ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
 83:     async function startForGame() {
 84:         if (gameActive) return;
 85:         gameActive = true;
 86:         handledTiles.clear();
 87:         const a = api();
 88:         if (!a) return;
 89:         a.setMute(muted);

150:         const k = e.key?.toLowerCase();

157:                 // pass the triggering scroll context

160:

162:                     // The caster's client resolves the stack but shouldn't modify another player's pools.
163:                     // Non-caster/non-responder clients receive the effect via the 'response-resolved' broadcast.
164:                     const isLocalPlayer = !isMultiplayer || (typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' && myPlayerIndex === entry.casterIndex);

168:                         if (effect) {

104:     function buildParallax(boardArea) {
105:         if (boardArea.querySelector('#parallax-bg')) return; // Already injected
106: 
107:         // Ensure the board-area is a positioning context
108:         const computed = getComputedStyle(boardArea).position;
109:         if (computed === 'static') boardArea.style.position = 'relative';
110: 
111:         const bg = document.createElement('div');
112:         bg.id = 'parallax-bg';
113: 
114:         // Layer 1: static base
115:         const base = document.createElement('div');
116:         base.className = 'parallax-base';
117:         bg.appendChild(base);
118: 
119:         // Layer 2: slow-drifting space layer
120:         const space = document.createElement('img');
121:         space.className = 'parallax-space';
122:         space.src = BASE + 'secondlayermuchbiggerthantrue.png';
123:         space.alt = '';
124:         space.style.animationDelay = '-40s'; // start mid-drift so it's already moving
125:         bg.appendChild(space);
126: 
127:         // Layer 3–6: clouds
128:         CLOUDS.forEach(c => {
129:             const img = document.createElement('img');
130:             img.className = 'parallax-cloud';
131:             img.src = c.src;
132:             img.alt = '';
133:             img.style.cssText += c.style + `animation:${c.anim};animation-delay:${c.delay};`;
134:             bg.appendChild(img);
135:         });
136: 
137:         // Insert before everything else in the board-area
138:         boardArea.insertBefore(bg, boardArea.firstChild);
139: 
140:         // Ensure board content sits above the parallax layer
141:         boardArea.querySelectorAll(':scope > :not(#parallax-bg)').forEach(el => {
142:             if (getComputedStyle(el).position === 'static') el.style.position = 'relative';
143:             el.style.zIndex = '1';
144:         });
145:     }
146: 
147:     // Run on DOMContentLoaded (or immediately if DOM is already ready)
148:     function run() {
149:         document.querySelectorAll('.board-area').forEach(buildParallax);
150:         // Also inject into the lobby/login screen
151:         const lobbyWrapper = document.getElementById('lobby-wrapper');
152:         if (lobbyWrapper) buildParallax(lobbyWrapper);
153:     }
154: 
155:     if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
156:         document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', run);
157:     } else {
158:         run();
159:     }
160: })();
</file>

 358:     function start() {
 359:         window.isTutorialMode       = true;
 360:         window.tutorialDeckOverride = [...TUTORIAL_DECK];
 361:         earthRevealed = false;
 362:         currentStep   = -1;
 363: 
 364:         const sg = window.startGame || (typeof startGame !== 'undefined' ? startGame : null);
 365:         if (typeof sg === 'function') {
 366:             try { sg(1); } catch(e) { console.error('TutorialMode: startGame() threw:', e); }
 367:         } else {
 368:             console.error('TutorialMode: startGame() not found — cannot launch tutorial.');
 369:         }
 370:         // Give the game a moment to finish rendering before showing step 0
 371:         setTimeout(setupBoard, 400);
 372:     }
 373: 
 374:     function setupBoard() {
 375:         try {
 376:             // Prime earth deck so the player always draws Earth V from the earth shrine
 377:             primeEarthDeck(window.spellSystem);
 378:             if (typeof fitBoardToView === 'function') fitBoardToView();
 379:         } catch (err) {
 380:             console.error('TutorialMode: board setup error (non-fatal):', err);
 381:         }
 382:         // Ensure End Turn button is visible — it starts as display:none in HTML
 383:         // and may have been re-hidden by lobby reset flows before the tutorial launched.
 384:         const etBtn = document.getElementById('end-turn');
 385:         if (etBtn) etBtn.style.display = '';
 386:         showExitButton();
 387:         showStep(0);
 388:     }
 389: 
 390:     function showExitButton() {
 391:         if (exitBtnEl) return;
 392:         const btn = document.createElement('button');
 393:         btn.className = 'tmode-exit-persistent';
 394:         btn.textContent = 'Exit Tutorial';
 395:         btn.addEventListener('click', finish);
 396:         document.body.appendChild(btn);
 397:         exitBtnEl = btn;
 398:     }
 399: 
 400:     function hideExitButton() {
 401:         if (exitBtnEl) { exitBtnEl.remove(); exitBtnEl = null; }
 402:     }
 403: 
 404:     /** Called from game-core.js placeTile() when the local player drops their tile. */
 405:     function onPlayerTilePlaced() {
 406:         if (currentStep !== 1) return;   // step 1 = 'tile-placed'
 407:         setTimeout(() => showStep(2), 600);
 408:     }
 409: 
 410:     function primeEarthDeck(ss) {
 411:         if (!ss?.scrollDecks?.earth) return;
 412:         const deck = ss.scrollDecks.earth;
 413:         const idx  = deck.indexOf('EARTH_SCROLL_5');
 414:         if (idx > 0)  deck.splice(idx, 1);
 415:         if (deck[0] !== 'EARTH_SCROLL_5') deck.unshift('EARTH_SCROLL_5');
 416:     }
 417: 
 418:     // ── Spotlight system ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 419: 
 420:     /**
 421:      * Highlight a UI element.
 422:      * blocking=true  → also add a full-screen dim overlay that eats all clicks
 423:      *                  (use for action:'click' steps so only the target is interactive)
 424:      * blocking=false → just glow the element; board + pawns stay fully interactive
 425:      *                  (use for action:'move' and action:'place-tile' steps)
 426:      */
 427:     function showSpotlight(selector, blocking) {
 428:         clearSpotlight();
 429:         const el = selector ? document.querySelector(selector) : null;
 430:         if (!el) return;
 431: 
 432:         if (blocking) {
 433:             // The overlay sits at z-index 8600 at the document root.
 434:             // If the spotlit element lives inside a positioned ancestor that has its
 435:             // own stacking context (e.g. .dock-bar at z-index 50), the element's own
 436:             // z-index:8620 is scoped inside that context and stays visually beneath
 437:             // the overlay.  Fix: walk up the ancestor chain and temporarily lift any
 438:             // stacking-context ancestor above the overlay.
 439:             liftedAncestors = [];
 440:             let node = el.parentElement;
 441:             while (node && node !== document.body) {
 442:                 const zi = window.getComputedStyle(node).zIndex;
 443:                 if (zi !== 'auto' && parseInt(zi, 10) < 8650) {
 444:                     liftedAncestors.push({ node, original: node.style.zIndex });
 445:                     node.style.zIndex = '8650';
 446:                 }
 447:                 node = node.parentElement;
 448:             }
 449: 
 450:             const ov = document.createElement('div');
 451:             ov.id        = 'tutorial-blocking-overlay';
 452:             ov.className = 'tutorial-blocking-overlay';
 453:             ov.addEventListener('click', () => {
 454:                 if (typeof updateStatus === 'function')
 455:                     updateStatus('Click the highlighted element to continue the tutorial.');
 456:             });
 457:             document.body.appendChild(ov);
 458:             overlayEl = ov;
 459:         }
 460: 
 461:         el.classList.add('tutorial-spotlight');
 462:         spotlightEl = el;
 463:     }
 464: 
 465:     function clearSpotlight() {
 466:         if (spotlightEl) {
 467:             spotlightEl.classList.remove('tutorial-spotlight');
 468:             spotlightEl = null;
 469:         }
 470:         if (overlayEl) { overlayEl.remove(); overlayEl = null; }
 471: 
 472:         // Restore any ancestors whose z-index was temporarily raised
 473:         liftedAncestors.forEach(({ node, original }) => { node.style.zIndex = original; });
 474:         liftedAncestors = [];
 475: 
 476:         // Remove any leftover click listener
 477:         if (spotlightHandler) {
 478:             spotlightHandler.el.removeEventListener('click', spotlightHandler.fn);
 479:             spotlightHandler = null;
 480:         }
 481:     }
 482: 
 483:     function attachClickAdvance(selector) {
 484:         const el = selector ? document.querySelector(selector) : null;
 485:         if (!el) return;
 486:         const fn = () => { advance(); };
 487:         el.addEventListener('click', fn, { once: true });
 488:         spotlightHandler = { el, fn };
 489:     }
 490: 
 491:     // ── Board ring ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 492: 
 493:     function showBoardRing(x, y) {
 494:         removeBoardRing();
 495:         const svg = document.getElementById('board');
 496:         if (!svg) return;
 497:         const vp = svg.querySelector('#viewport') || svg;
 498: 
 499:         const c = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
 500:         c.setAttribute('cx', x);
 501:         c.setAttribute('cy', y);
 502:         c.setAttribute('r',  58);
 503:         c.setAttribute('fill',         'none');
 504:         c.setAttribute('stroke',       '#69d83a');
 505:         c.setAttribute('stroke-width', '4');
 506:         c.setAttribute('class',        'tutorial-highlight-ring');
 507:         c.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
 508:         vp.appendChild(c);
 509:         boardRingEl = c;
 510:     }
 511: 
 512:     function removeBoardRing() {
 513:         if (boardRingEl) { boardRingEl.remove(); boardRingEl = null; }
 514:     }
