 516:     // ── Modal ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 517: 
 518:     function showModal(step) {
 519:         closeModal();
 520: 
 521:         const isCorner  = step.modalPos === 'corner';
 522:         const posStyle  = isCorner
 523:             ? 'align-items:flex-end; justify-content:flex-end; padding:16px; background:none; pointer-events:none;'
 524:             : '';
 525:         const boxStyle  = isCorner
 526:             ? 'pointer-events:all; max-width:380px; border:2px solid var(--accent-gold,#d9b08c);'
 527:             : 'max-width:460px;';
 528: 
 529:         const actionHints = {
 530:             'move':          'Drag your pawn to the glowing tile to continue…',
 531:             'explore':       'Drag your pawn onto any face-down tile to flip it…',
 532:             'click':         'Click the highlighted element to continue…',
 533:             'place-tile':    'Drag your player tile onto the board to continue…',
 534:             'end-turn':      'Walk to the glowing shrine center, then click End Turn…',
 535:             'scroll-moved':  'Open your Hand panel and click "Move to Active Area" on the Avalanche scroll…',
 536:             'stone-placed':  'Drag an Earth stone from the stone pool and drop it adjacent to your pawn…',
 537:             'pattern-built': 'Build the Avalanche pattern (4 Earth stones) around your pawn — see the scroll card for the layout…',
 538:             'spell-cast':    'Click "Cast Spell" in the dock (or the Cast ✦ button on the scroll card) to cast Avalanche…',
 539:             'stone-broken':  'Right-click an Earth stone to break it (costs 5 AP)…',
 540:             'wind-shrine':       'Explore the board, find a Wind shrine, walk to its center and click End Turn…',
 541:             'wind-move':         'Drag a Wind stone, drop it on any hex, then move your pawn through or past it…',
 542:             'stone-placed-fire': 'Drag a Fire stone (red) from the pool and place it adjacent to an Earth stone…',
 543:             'scripted-ai':       'Watch the opponent\'s move…',
 544:         };
 545:         const footerHTML = (step.nextLabel && !actionHints[step.action])
 546:             ? `<button class="tmode-next">${step.nextLabel}</button>`
 547:             : step.action in actionHints
 548:                 ? `<span style="color:#bbb;font-size:17px;font-style:italic;">${actionHints[step.action]}</span>`
 549:                 : `<span style="color:#bbb;font-size:17px;font-style:italic;">Complete the action above to continue…</span>`;
 550: 
 551:         const overlay = document.createElement('div');
 552:         overlay.className = `tutorial-modal tutorial-tmode${isCorner ? ' tutorial-corner' : ''}`;
 553:         if (isCorner) overlay.style.cssText = posStyle;
 554: 
 555:         overlay.innerHTML = `
 556:             <div class="tutorial-content" style="${boxStyle}">
 557:                 <div class="tutorial-header">
 558:                     <span class="tutorial-step-label">Step ${currentStep + 1} of ${STEPS.length}</span>
 559:                     <h3 class="tutorial-title">${step.title}</h3>
 560:                 </div>
 561:                 <div class="tutorial-body">${step.content}</div>
 562:                 <div class="tutorial-footer"
 563:                      style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:14px;gap:8px;">
 564:                     ${footerHTML}
 565:                 </div>
 566:             </div>`;
 567: 
 568:         document.body.appendChild(overlay);
 569:         modalEl = overlay;
 570:         // Force opacity to 1 immediately; also add the class for the CSS transition
 571:         overlay.style.opacity = '1';
 572:         requestAnimationFrame(() => overlay.classList.add('tutorial-visible'));
 573: 
 574:         const btn = overlay.querySelector('.tmode-next');
 575:         if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', advance);
 576:     }
 577: 
 578:     function closeModal() {
 579:         if (!modalEl) return;
 580:         modalEl.classList.add('tutorial-fade-out');
 581:         const el = modalEl;
 582:         setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 220);
 583:         modalEl = null;
 584:     }
 585: 
 586:     // ── Step machine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 587: 
 588:     /**
 589:      * Per-step resource grants for the trap sequence. Called from showStep BEFORE
 590:      * the modal renders so the modal text is accurate when the player reads it.
 591:      */
 592:     function prepareStepEntry(stepId) {
 593:         const ss = window.spellSystem;
 594:         if (stepId === 'open-scrolls') {
 595:             // If the Hand panel is already open (player opened it during free exploration),
 596:             // force-close it so the spotlight click action opens it fresh as intended.
 597:             document.querySelectorAll('.fsp-close-btn').forEach(btn => btn.click());
 598:         } else if (stepId === 'cast-avalanche') {
 599:             // Guarantee at least 2 AP so the player can cast without having to End Turn.
 600:             if (ss && ss.actionPoints < 2) {
 601:                 ss.actionPoints = 2;
 602:                 if (typeof updateHUD === 'function') updateHUD();
 603:             }
 604:             // Keep at least 1 earth stone in the pool as a spare in case a pattern stone
 605:             // gets broken and needs to be replaced before casting.
 606:             const pool = window.playerPool;
 607:             if (pool && (pool.earth || 0) < 1) {
 608:                 pool.earth = 1;
 609:                 if (typeof updateStonePoolDisplay === 'function') updateStonePoolDisplay();
 610:             }
 611:         } else if (stepId === 'break-trap') {
 612:             // Set AP to exactly 5 so player can afford one Earth break (cost 5).
 613:             if (ss) { ss.actionPoints = 5; if (typeof updateHUD === 'function') updateHUD(); }
 614:             // Safety net: ensure at least one earth stone is on the board to break.
 615:             const hasEarth = Array.isArray(window.placedStones)
 616:                 && window.placedStones.some(s => s.type === 'earth');
 617:             if (!hasEarth && typeof window.placeStoneVisually === 'function') {
 618:                 const { x: nx, y: ny } = hp(3, 0);
 619:                 window.placeStoneVisually(nx, ny, 'earth');
 620:             }
 621:         } else if (stepId === 'fire-counter') {
 622:             const pool = window.playerPool;
 623:             if (pool && (pool.fire || 0) < 1) {
 624:                 pool.fire = (pool.fire || 0) + 2;
 625:                 if (typeof updateHUD === 'function') updateHUD();
 626:                 if (typeof updateStonePoolDisplay === 'function') updateStonePoolDisplay();
 627:             }
 628:             // Safety net: ensure at least one earth stone remains on board
 629:             const hasEarth = Array.isArray(window.placedStones)
 630:                 && window.placedStones.some(s => s.type === 'earth');
 631:             if (!hasEarth && typeof window.placeStoneVisually === 'function' && window.playerPosition) {
 632:                 // Place an earth stone east of the player at hp(3, 0) to avoid pixel-grid issues
 633:                 const { x: nx, y: ny } = hp(3, 0);
 634:                 window.placeStoneVisually(nx, ny, 'earth');
 635:             }
 636:         }
 637:     }
 638: 
 639:     /** Returns 'hand' | 'active' | 'common' based on where Avalanche is.
 640:      *  Uses the spellSystem data model (not DOM) so closed panels don't fool it.
 641:      *  Anything not in hand or active is treated as 'common' — the deck case is
 642:      *  not a concern since the tutorial no longer generates a second Earth tile. */
 643:     function getAvalancheLocation() {
 644:         const ss = window.spellSystem;
 645:         if (ss && typeof ss.getPlayerScrolls === 'function') {
 646:             const scrolls = ss.getPlayerScrolls(false);
 647:             if (scrolls?.hand?.has('EARTH_SCROLL_5'))   return 'hand';
 648:             if (scrolls?.active?.has('EARTH_SCROLL_5')) return 'active';
 649:         }
 650:         return 'common';
 651:     }
 652: 
 653:     function showStep(index) {
 654:         const step = STEPS[index];
 655:         if (!step) return;
 656:         currentStep = index;
 657:         console.log('[Tutorial] showStep', index, '→', step.id, '| action:', step.action);
 658:         prepareStepEntry(step.id);
 659: 
 660:         // If a scroll is already in active, skip the 'scroll-moved' gate automatically
 661:         if (step.action === 'scroll-moved') {
 662:             const ss = window.spellSystem;
 663:             if (ss && typeof ss.getPlayerScrolls === 'function') {
 664:                 const scrolls = ss.getPlayerScrolls(false);
 665:                 if (scrolls && scrolls.active && scrolls.active.size > 0) {
 666:                     setTimeout(advance, 400);
 667:                     return;
 668:                 }
 669:             }
 670:         }
 671: 
 672:         // Clear previous decorations
 673:         clearSpotlight();
 674:         clearPatternPoll();
 675:         clearHintTimer();
 676:         removeOpponentSpeechBubble();
 677:         removeBoardRing();
 678:         window.tutorialAllowedHexes = null;
 679: 
 680:         // Board ring on move step. freeMove:true shows the ring without
 681:         // restricting the pawn — used for the shrine step where the player
 682:         // may need to navigate back from wherever they ended up.
 683:         if (step.boardRing) {
 684:             const _ringTarget = step.boardRingTarget || EARTH_POS;
 685:             showBoardRing(_ringTarget.x, _ringTarget.y);
 686:             if (!step.freeMove) {
 687:                 window.tutorialAllowedHexes = new Set([
 688:                     `${Math.round(EARTH_POS.x)},${Math.round(EARTH_POS.y)}`
 689:                 ]);
 690:             }
 691:         }
 692: 
 693:         // Spotlight an HTML element.
 694:         // Only block all other interaction for 'click' steps — move/place-tile steps
 695:         // need the board to stay interactive so the player can drag pawns/tiles.
 696:         if (step.spotlight) {
 697:             const blocking = (step.action === 'click');
 698:             showSpotlight(step.spotlight, blocking);
 699:             if (step.action === 'click') {
 700:                 attachClickAdvance(step.spotlight);
 701:             }
 702:         }
 703: 
 704:         // For how-to-win, check Avalanche location and modify what we show BEFORE rendering.
 705:         let stepToShow = step;
 706:         if (step.id === 'how-to-win') {
 707:             const loc = getAvalancheLocation();
 708:             console.log('[Tutorial] how-to-win entry — Avalanche location:', loc);
 709:             if (loc === 'common') {
 710:                 const notice = `<div style="margin-bottom:12px;padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(148,88,244,0.15);border-left:3px solid #9458f4;border-radius:4px;font-size:17px;">Normally we'd show you how to move <strong>Avalanche</strong> from your Hand to your <strong>Active Area</strong> — but you moved it to the <strong>Common Area</strong>, where anyone can play it unless it gets replaced by a scroll of the same type.</div>`;
 711:                 stepToShow = { ...step, content: notice + step.content };
 712:             }
 713:         }
 714:         showModal(stepToShow);
 715: 
 716:         // Start pattern polling for 'pattern-built' steps
 717:         if (step.action === 'pattern-built') {
 718:             patternPollInterval = setInterval(() => {
 719:                 const ss = window.spellSystem;
 720:                 if (ss && typeof ss.checkPattern === 'function' && ss.checkPattern('EARTH_SCROLL_5')) {
 721:                     clearPatternPoll();
 722:                     clearHintTimer();
 723:                     advance();
 724:                 }
 725:             }, 500);
 726:             startHintTimer('Build the Avalanche pattern (4 Earth stones) around your pawn — see the scroll card for the layout…');
 727:         }
 728:         // During cast step, monitor for a broken pattern so the player gets actionable feedback.
 729:         if (step.action === 'spell-cast') {
 730:             patternPollInterval = setInterval(() => {
 731:                 const ss = window.spellSystem;
 732:                 if (ss && typeof ss.checkPattern === 'function' && !ss.checkPattern('EARTH_SCROLL_5')) {
 733:                     if (typeof updateStatus === 'function')
 734:                         updateStatus('Pattern broken — replace the Earth stone, then Cast Spell.');
 735:                 }
 736:             }, 1000);
 737:         }
 738:         // Start hint timers for other action-gated steps
 739:         const hintMessages = {
 740:             'scroll-moved':  'Open your Hand panel and click "Move to Active Area" on the Avalanche scroll…',
 741:             'stone-placed':  'Drag an Earth stone from the stone pool and drop it adjacent to your pawn…',
 742:             'spell-cast':    'Click "Cast Spell" in the dock after placing the pattern…',
 743:             'stone-broken':  'Right-click an Earth stone to break it (costs 5 AP)…',
 744:             'wind-shrine':       'Explore the board, find a Wind shrine, walk to its center and click End Turn…',
 745:             'wind-move':         'Drag a Wind stone from the pool, drop it on any hex, then move your pawn through or past it…',
 746:             'stone-placed-fire': 'Drag a Fire stone from the pool adjacent to an Earth stone…',
 747:         };
 748:         if (hintMessages[step.action]) {
 749:             startHintTimer(hintMessages[step.action]);
 750:         }
 751: 
 752:         // Scripted AI trigger for trap steps
 753:         if (step.action === 'scripted-ai') {
 754:             const pos = window.playerPosition || PLAYER_POS;
 755:             if (step.id === 'opponent-trap') {
 756:                 showOpponentSpeechBubble('Hah! Trapped!');
 757:                 setTimeout(() => {
 758:                     runScriptedOpponentTrap(pos.x, pos.y, () => {
 759:                         setTimeout(advance, 800);
 760:                     });
 761:                 }, 1200);   // delay so player sees the modal before stones drop
 762:             }
 763:         }
 764:     }
 765: 
 766:     function advance() {
 767:         const nextIdx = currentStep + 1;
 768:         if (nextIdx < STEPS.length) {
 769:             showStep(nextIdx);
 770:         } else {
 771:             finish();
 772:         }
 773:     }
 774: 
 775:     function finish() {
 776:         closeModal();
 777:         clearSpotlight();
 778:         removeBoardRing();
 779:         hideExitButton();
 780:         window.isTutorialMode       = false;
 781:         window.tutorialAllowedHexes = null;
 782:         // Reload returns the player to the auth/lobby screen cleanly.
 783:         // The tutorial dirtied the game state so there's nothing to preserve.
 784:         window.location.reload();
 785:     }
 786: 
 787:     // ── Hooks called from game code ───────────────────────────────────────────
 788: 
 789:     /**
 790:      * Called from game-core.js BEFORE tile visuals are built.
 791:      * We can override tile.shrineType here and the visual + scroll will both reflect it.
 792:      */
 793:     function onTilePreReveal(tile) {
 794:         if (currentStep !== 3 || earthRevealed) return;
 795:         // Force the first tile the player steps on to be Earth — regardless of
 796:         // where they placed their player tile or which direction they moved.
 797:         tile.shrineType = 'earth';
 798:         primeEarthDeck(window.spellSystem);
 799:     }
 800: 
 801:     /**
 802:      * Called from game-core.js AFTER tile visuals are built and the scroll is drawn.
 803:      * We advance the tutorial here so the scroll is already in the player's hand.
 804:      */
 805:     function onTileRevealed(tile, spellSystem) {
 806:         if (currentStep !== 3 || earthRevealed) return;
 807:         earthRevealed = true;
 808:         setTimeout(() => showStep(4), 900); // let the flip animation finish
 809:     }
 810: 
 811:     /** Called from game-ui.js after a successful pawn move. */
 812:     function onPlayerMoved(toX, toY) {
 813:         const step = STEPS[currentStep];
 814:         if (!step) return;
 815: 
 816:         // Earth-shrine: hint when player reaches shrine center.
 817:         const SHRINE_STEP = STEPS.findIndex(s => s.id === 'earth-shrine');
 818:         if (currentStep === SHRINE_STEP) {
 819:             const atShrine = Math.round(toX) === Math.round(EARTH_POS.x) &&
 820:                              Math.round(toY) === Math.round(EARTH_POS.y);
 821:             if (atShrine && typeof updateStatus === 'function') {
 822:                 updateStatus("You're at the Earth shrine center! Click End Turn to collect 5 stones.");
 823:             }
 824:         }
 825:     }
 826: 
 827:     /**
 828:      * Called from game-ui.js when any step in the player's path had cost 0
 829:      * (i.e. the player moved through or past a wind stone).
 830:      */
 831:     function onWindStoneUsed() {
 832:         const step = STEPS[currentStep];
 833:         if (!step || step.action !== 'wind-move') return;
 834:         clearHintTimer();
 835:         setTimeout(advance, 400);
 836:     }
 837: 
 838:     /**
 839:      * Called from game-ui.js after shrine stone replenishment when the player
 840:      * clicks End Turn. pos is the player's current {x, y} position.
 841:      */
 842:     function onEndTurn(pos) {
 843:         const step = STEPS[currentStep];
 844:         if (!step) return;
 845: 
 846:         // ── Earth shrine gate ────────────────────────────────────────────────
 847:         if (step.id === 'earth-shrine') {
 848:             const dist = pos
 849:                 ? Math.sqrt(Math.pow(pos.x - EARTH_POS.x, 2) + Math.pow(pos.y - EARTH_POS.y, 2))
 850:                 : Infinity;
 851:             if (dist < 20) {
 852:                 setTimeout(() => showStep(currentStep + 1), 900);
 853:             } else {
 854:                 if (typeof updateStatus === 'function')
 855:                     updateStatus('Walk to the glowing Earth shrine center first, then click End Turn.');
 856:             }
 857:             return;
 858:         }
 859: 
 860:         // ── Wind shrine gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
 861:         // Fires after shrine replenishment, so playerPool.wind is already updated.
 862:         if (step.action === 'wind-shrine') {
 863:             const windNow = window.playerPool?.wind || 0;
 864:             if (windNow > 0) {
 865:                 clearHintTimer();
 866:                 setTimeout(() => showStep(currentStep + 1), 900);
 867:             } else {
 868:                 if (typeof updateStatus === 'function')
 869:                     updateStatus('End your turn on the Wind shrine center to collect Wind stones.');
 870:             }
 871:         }
 872:     }
 873: 
 874:     /** Called from game-ui.js when tutorial blocks an out-of-bounds drop. */
 875:     function showMovementHint() {
 876:         if (typeof updateStatus === 'function')
 877:             updateStatus('Tutorial: drag your pawn onto a face-down tile to continue!');
 878:     }
 879: 
 880:     function clearHintTimer() {
 881:         if (hintTimer) { clearTimeout(hintTimer); hintTimer = null; }
 882:     }
 883: 
 884:     function startHintTimer(message) {
 885:         clearHintTimer();
 886:         hintTimer = setTimeout(() => {
 887:             if (typeof updateStatus === 'function') updateStatus(message);
 888:         }, 15000);
 889:     }
 890: 
 891:     function clearPatternPoll() {
 892:         if (patternPollInterval) { clearInterval(patternPollInterval); patternPollInterval = null; }
 893:     }
 894: 
 895:     /** Called from game-core.js after a stone is placed on the board. */
 896:     function onStonePlaced(stoneType, x, y) {
 897:         const step = STEPS[currentStep];
 898:         if (!step) return;
 899:         if (step.action === 'stone-placed' && (!step.stoneType || step.stoneType === stoneType)) {
 900:             clearHintTimer();
 901:             clearPatternPoll();
 902:             setTimeout(advance, 400);
 903:         } else if (step.action === 'wind-move' && stoneType === 'wind') {
 904:             // Stone placed — update hint to tell player to move through it.
 905:             clearHintTimer();
 906:             if (typeof updateStatus === 'function')
 907:                 updateStatus('Wind stone placed! Now move your pawn through or past it to feel the free movement.');
 908:         } else if (step.action === 'stone-placed-fire' && stoneType === 'fire') {
 909:             clearHintTimer();
 910:             setTimeout(advance, 400);
 911:         }
 912:     }
 913: 
 914:     /** Called from game-core.js after a stone is broken/removed from the board. */
 915:     function onStoneBroken(stoneType, x, y) {
 916:         const step = STEPS[currentStep];
 917:         if (!step) return;
 918:         if (step.action === 'stone-broken') {
 919:             clearHintTimer();
 920:             clearPatternPoll();
 921:             setTimeout(advance, 400);
 922:         }
 923:     }
 924: 
 925:     /** Called from scroll-panels.js when player moves a scroll between areas. */
 926:     function onScrollMoved(scrollName, fromArea, toArea) {
 927:         const step = STEPS[currentStep];
 928:         console.log('[Tutorial] onScrollMoved', scrollName, fromArea, '→', toArea, '| step:', step?.id, 'action:', step?.action);
 929:         if (!step) return;
 930:         if (step.action === 'scroll-moved') {
 931:             if (toArea === 'active') {
 932:                 clearHintTimer();
 933:                 setTimeout(advance, 400);
 934:             } else if (toArea === 'common') {
 935:                 clearHintTimer();
 936:                 // Mutate the existing modal in place — avoids close/reopen race with the
 937:                 // panel's own 60ms refresh setTimeout.
 938:                 if (modalEl) {
 939:                     const titleEl  = modalEl.querySelector('.tutorial-title');
 940:                     const bodyEl   = modalEl.querySelector('.tutorial-body');
 941:                     const footerEl = modalEl.querySelector('.tutorial-footer');
 942:                     if (titleEl)  titleEl.textContent = 'Common Area';
 943:                     if (bodyEl)   bodyEl.innerHTML = `Normally we'd show you how to move <strong>Avalanche</strong> from your Hand to your <strong>Active Area</strong> — but you moved it to the <strong>Common Area</strong>, where anyone can play it unless it gets replaced by a scroll of the same type.`;
 944:                     if (footerEl) {
 945:                         footerEl.innerHTML = `<button class="tmode-next">Ok!</button>`;
 946:                         footerEl.querySelector('.tmode-next').addEventListener('click', advance);
 947:                     }
 948:                 }
 949:             }
 950:         }
 951:     }
 952: 
 953:     /** Called from game-core.js when a spell is successfully cast. */
 954:     function onSpellCast(scrollName) {
 955:         const step = STEPS[currentStep];
 956:         if (!step) return;
 957:         if (step.action === 'spell-cast') {
 958:             clearHintTimer();
 959:             clearPatternPoll();
 960:             setTimeout(advance, 600);
 961:         }
 962:     }
 963: 
 964:     // ── Scripted opponent AI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
 965: 
 966:     /**
 967:      * Scripted opponent trap — narrative pause, then auto-advance.
 968:      * Stone placement removed: coordinate-scale mismatch (S=80 vs TILE_SIZE=20)
 969:      * caused stones to land far off-board. Player's own Avalanche stones serve
 970:      * as the earth stones to break in the break-trap step.
 971:      */
 972:     function runScriptedOpponentTrap(centerX, centerY, callback) {
 973:         // Scripted stone placement removed — coordinate-scale mismatch between
 974:         // tutorial's S=80 pixel grid and game's TILE_SIZE=20 grid means computed
 975:         // positions land far off-board. The player's own Avalanche stones already
 976:         // provide earth stones to break in the break-trap step.
 977:         // Just pause briefly (opponent "thinking") then call callback.
 978:         setTimeout(callback, 1200);
 979:     }
 980: 
 981:     /**
 982:      * Show a speech bubble SVG text element above ENEMY_POS.
 983:      * Removes any existing bubble first.
 984:      * text: the string to display.
 985:      */
 986:     function showOpponentSpeechBubble(text) {
 987:         removeOpponentSpeechBubble();
 988:         const svg = document.getElementById('board');
 989:         if (!svg) return;
 990:         const vp = svg.querySelector('#viewport') || svg;
 991: 
 992:         const g = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
 993:         g.id = 'tutorial-opponent-bubble';
 994:         g.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${ENEMY_POS.x}, ${ENEMY_POS.y - 55})`);
 995: 
 996:         const rect = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'rect');
 997:         rect.setAttribute('x', '-60');
 998:         rect.setAttribute('y', '-22');
 999:         rect.setAttribute('width', '120');
1000:         rect.setAttribute('height', '26');
1001:         rect.setAttribute('rx', '6');
1002:         rect.setAttribute('fill', '#2c1a3e');
1003:         rect.setAttribute('stroke', '#ed1b43');
1004:         rect.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.5');
1005:         rect.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
1006: 
1007:         const t = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
1008:         t.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
1009:         t.setAttribute('dominant-baseline', 'middle');
1010:         t.setAttribute('fill', '#f3ecd8');
1011:         t.setAttribute('font-size', '11');
1012:         t.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
1013:         t.textContent = text;
1014: 
1015:         g.appendChild(rect);
1016:         g.appendChild(t);
1017:         vp.appendChild(g);
1018:     }
1019:

1021:         const el = document.getElementById('tutorial-opponent-bubble');
1022:         if (el) el.remove();
1023:     }
1024:

1026:     return {
1027:         start, advance, finish,
1028:         onTilePreReveal, onTileRevealed, onPlayerMoved, onWindStoneUsed, onPlayerTilePlaced, onEndTurn, showMovementHint,
1029:         onStonePlaced, onStoneBroken, onScrollMoved, onSpellCast,
1030:         get currentStep() { return currentStep; }
1031:     };
1032: })();

<file path="js/bot-state.js">
  1: // ============================================================
  2: // bot-state.js — Stage 0 of docs/bot-roadmap.md
  3: // ============================================================
  4: // Observation + actuation layer for the bot. Contains NO strategy.
  5: //   BotState.snapshot()      → pure-JSON game state (hidden info masked)
  6: //   BotState.legalActions()  → canonical action list for the active player
  7: //   BotState.applyAction(a)  → execute one action via the game's own functions
  8: //   BotState.hexGrid()       → cached board hex positions
  9: //   BotState.findPath(...)   → Dijkstra cheapest path between two hexes
 10: //
 11: // GOTCHA (see roadmap § KEY FACTS): game-core state (placedTiles,
 12: // activePlayerIndex, getTotalAP, …) lives in the shared global LEXICAL scope,
 13: // not on window — reference it as bare identifiers only.
 14: //
 15: // LOAD ORDER: after lobby.js, before bot.js.
 16: // ============================================================
 17: 
 18: (function () {
 19:     'use strict';
 20: 
 21:     const ELEMENTS = ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void'];
 22:     const HEX_NEAR = 5;   // px — "same hex" threshold (matches game-core usage)
 23:     const HEX_STEP = 40;  // px — "adjacent hex" threshold
 24: 
 25:     function log(...args) { console.log('🧠 [BotState]', ...args); }
 26: 
 27:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 28:     // Snapshot — pure JSON, safe to serialize / diff / feed to a learner.
 29:     // Hidden information is masked: unrevealed tiles report shrineType null,
 30:     // and opponents' hands are reported as counts only.
 31:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 32:     function snapshot() {
 33:         const my = (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer &&
 34:                     typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' && myPlayerIndex !== null)
 35:                    ? myPlayerIndex : activePlayerIndex;
 36: 
 37:         const players = playerPositions.map((p, i) => {
 38:             if (!p) return null;
 39:             const scrolls = window.spellSystem?.playerScrolls?.[i];
 40:             const isSelf  = (i === activePlayerIndex);
 41:             return {
 42:                 index: i,
 43:                 x: +p.x.toFixed(1), y: +p.y.toFixed(1),
 44:                 color: p.color,
 45:                 pool: { ...(playerPools[i] || { earth:0, water:0, fire:0, wind:0, void:0 }) },
 46:                 hand:       isSelf && scrolls ? [...scrolls.hand]   : null, // opponents' hands hidden
 47:                 handCount:  scrolls ? scrolls.hand.size   : 0,
 48:                 active:     scrolls ? [...scrolls.active] : [],             // active area is public
 49:                 activeCount: scrolls ? scrolls.active.size : 0,
 50:                 activated:  scrolls ? [...scrolls.activated] : [],
 51:             };
 52:         });
 53: 
 54:         return {
 55:             version: 1,
 56:             turn: {
 57:                 activePlayerIndex,
 58:                 myPlayerIndex: my,
 59:                 isMultiplayer: (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined') ? !!isMultiplayer : false,
 60:                 ap: getTotalAP(),
 61:             },
 62:             sourcePool: { ...window.stonePools },
 63:             tiles: placedTiles.map(t => ({
 64:                 id: t.id,
 65:                 x: +t.x.toFixed(1), y: +t.y.toFixed(1),
 66:                 revealed: !t.flipped,
 67:                 isPlayerTile: !!t.isPlayerTile,
 68:                 // MASKED when face-down — reading it would be cheating
 69:                 shrineType: t.flipped ? null : t.shrineType,
 70:             })),
 71:             stones: placedStones.map(s => ({ x: +s.x.toFixed(1), y: +s.y.toFixed(1), type: s.type })),
 72:             players,
 73:         };
 74:     }
 75: 
 76:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 77:     // Hex grid + Dijkstra cheapest path (stone terrain changes step costs).
 78:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 79:     let _grid = null, _gridAt = 0;
 80:     function hexGrid() {
 81:         // getAllHexagonPositions() is moderately expensive; cache briefly
 82:         const now = Date.now();
 83:         if (!_grid || now - _gridAt > 1500) { _grid = getAllHexagonPositions(); _gridAt = now; }
 84:         return _grid;
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     function nearestHex(x, y) {
 88:         let best = null, bd = Infinity;
 89:         for (const h of hexGrid()) {
 90:             const d = Math.hypot(h.x - x, h.y - y);
 91:             if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = h; }
 92:         }
 93:         return bd < HEX_NEAR ? best : null;
 94:     }
 95: 
 96:     // Dijkstra from (sx,sy) to (tx,ty). Step cost = canPlayerMoveToHex(dest).cost.
 97:     // Returns [{x, y, cost}] (excluding start) or null when unreachable.
 98:     function findPath(sx, sy, tx, ty) {
 99:         const grid = hexGrid();
100:         const start = nearestHex(sx, sy), end = nearestHex(tx, ty);
101:         if (!start || !end) return null;
102:         if (start.key === end.key) return [];
103: 
104:         const dist = { [start.key]: 0 };
105:         const prev = {};
106:         const done = new Set();
107:         // board is small (≤ a few hundred hexes) — array scan beats a heap here
108:         const frontier = [start];
109: 
110:         while (frontier.length) {
111:             let bi = 0;
112:             for (let i = 1; i < frontier.length; i++)
113:                 if (dist[frontier[i].key] < dist[frontier[bi].key]) bi = i;
114:             const cur = frontier.splice(bi, 1)[0];
115:             if (done.has(cur.key)) continue;
116:             done.add(cur.key);
117:             if (cur.key === end.key) break;
118: 
119:             for (const nb of grid) {
120:                 if (done.has(nb.key)) continue;
121:                 const d = Math.hypot(nb.x - cur.x, nb.y - cur.y);
122:                 if (d <= HEX_NEAR || d >= HEX_STEP) continue; // not adjacent
123:                 const mv = canPlayerMoveToHex(nb.x, nb.y, false);
124:                 if (!mv.canMove) continue;
125:                 const nd = dist[cur.key] + (mv.cost ?? 1);
126:                 if (nd < (dist[nb.key] ?? Infinity)) {
127:                     dist[nb.key] = nd;
128:                     prev[nb.key] = cur;
129:                     frontier.push(nb);
130:                 }
131:             }
132:         }
133: 
134:         if (!(end.key in dist)) return null;
135:         const path = [];
136:         let cur = end;
137:         while (cur.key !== start.key) {
138:             const mv = canPlayerMoveToHex(cur.x, cur.y, false);
139:             path.unshift({ x: cur.x, y: cur.y, cost: mv.cost ?? 1 });
140:             cur = prev[cur.key];
141:         }
142:         return path;
143:     }
144: 
145:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
146:     // Legal action enumeration for the ACTIVE player.
147:     // Canonical forms — the only vocabulary bot strategy may use:
148:     //   {type:'cast', scroll}
149:     //   {type:'placeStone', x, y, stoneType, scroll, progress}
150:     //   {type:'move', x, y, cost}
151:     //   {type:'endTurn'}
152:     // NOT yet enumerated (Stage 2+): catacomb teleports, scroll-effect
153:     // sub-choices, hand→common moves.
154:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
155:     function legalActions() {
156:         const actions = [];
157:         const player = playerPositions[activePlayerIndex];
158:         if (!player) return actions;
159:         const ap = getTotalAP();
160:         const pool = playerPools[activePlayerIndex] || {};
161:         const scrolls = window.spellSystem?.getPlayerScrolls?.(false);
162: 
163:         // ── cast: any hand/active scroll whose pattern is satisfied now ──
164:         // Casting costs 2 AP (activateScroll validates it — don't offer casts
165:         // the game will reject).
166:         if (scrolls && ap >= 2) {
167:             for (const name of [...scrolls.active, ...scrolls.hand]) {
168:                 const def = window.SCROLL_DEFINITIONS?.[name];
169:                 if (!def || def.level === 1) continue; // level 1 = response-only
170:                 if (window.spellSystem.checkPattern(name)) {
171:                     actions.push({ type: 'cast', scroll: name });
172:                 }
173:             }
174:         }
175: 
176:         // ── placeStone: every missing stone of every VIABLE pattern variant ──
177:         // A variant is viable when each of its cells is on the board and either
178:         // empty or already holding the right-type stone.
179:         if (scrolls) {
180:             const pHex = pixelToHex(player.x, player.y, TILE_SIZE);
181:             const grid = hexGrid();
182:             const seen = new Set(); // dedupe identical placements across scrolls
183:             for (const name of scrolls.hand) {
184:                 const def = window.SCROLL_DEFINITIONS?.[name];
185:                 if (!def || def.level === 1 || !Array.isArray(def.patterns)) continue;
186:                 for (const variant of def.patterns) {
187:                     const cells = variant.map(req => {
188:                         const px = hexToPixel(pHex.q + req.q, pHex.r + req.r, TILE_SIZE);
189:                         return { x: px.x, y: px.y, type: req.type };
190:                     });
191:                     if (!cells.every(c => grid.some(h => Math.hypot(h.x - c.x, h.y - c.y) < HEX_NEAR))) continue;
192: 
193:                     let placed = 0, blocked = false;
194:                     const missing = [];
195:                     for (const c of cells) {
196:                         const here = placedStones.find(s => Math.hypot(s.x - c.x, s.y - c.y) < HEX_NEAR);
197:                         if (here && here.type === c.type) placed++;
198:                         else if (here) { blocked = true; break; } // wrong stone occupies the cell
199:                         else missing.push(c);
200:                     }
201:                     if (blocked) continue;
202:                     for (const c of missing) {
203:                         if ((pool[c.type] || 0) <= 0) continue;
204:                         // Same placement-range rule the drag-drop UI enforces —
205:                         // out-of-range placements would desync other clients
206:                         if (typeof isInPlacementRange === 'function' &&
207:                             !isInPlacementRange(c.x, c.y, c.type)) continue;
208:                         const key = `${c.x.toFixed(1)},${c.y.toFixed(1)},${c.type}`;
209:                         if (seen.has(key)) continue;
210:                         seen.add(key);
211:                         actions.push({
212:                             type: 'placeStone', x: c.x, y: c.y, stoneType: c.type,
213:                             scroll: name,
214:                             progress: (placed + 1) / cells.length,
215:                         });
216:                     }
217:                 }
218:             }
219:         }
220: 
221:         // ── move: each affordable adjacent hex ──
222:         if (ap > 0) {
223:             for (const h of hexGrid()) {
224:                 const d = Math.hypot(h.x - player.x, h.y - player.y);
225:                 if (d <= HEX_NEAR || d >= HEX_STEP) continue;
226:                 const mv = canPlayerMoveToHex(h.x, h.y, false);
227:                 if (!mv.canMove) continue;
228:                 const cost = mv.cost ?? 1;
229:                 if (cost <= ap) actions.push({ type: 'move', x: h.x, y: h.y, cost });
230:             }
231:         }
232: 
233:         // ── endTurn: always available while the button is live ──
234:         const btn = document.getElementById('end-turn');
235:         if (btn && !btn.disabled) actions.push({ type: 'endTurn' });
236: 
237:         return actions;
238:     }
239: 
240:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
241:     // Apply one canonical action through the game's own code paths.
242:     // Returns {ok, reason?}. NEVER add rules knowledge here.
243:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
244:     function applyAction(a) {
245:         if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer &&
246:             typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' && activePlayerIndex !== myPlayerIndex) {
247:             return { ok: false, reason: 'not this client\'s turn (multiplayer guard)' };
248:         }
249: 
250:         switch (a?.type) {
251:             case 'cast': {
252:                 const scrolls = window.spellSystem.getPlayerScrolls(false);
253:                 if (scrolls.hand.has(a.scroll)) window.spellSystem.moveToActive(a.scroll);
254:                 window.spellSystem.castSpell();
255:                 return { ok: true };
256:             }
257:             case 'placeStone': {
258:                 const pool = playerPools[activePlayerIndex] || {};
259:                 if ((pool[a.stoneType] || 0) <= 0) return { ok: false, reason: `no ${a.stoneType} stones` };
260:                 placeStone(a.x, a.y, a.stoneType);
261:                 pool[a.stoneType]--;
262:                 if (typeof updateStoneCount === 'function') updateStoneCount(a.stoneType);
263:                 if (typeof syncPlayerState === 'function') syncPlayerState();
264:                 return { ok: true };
265:             }
266:             case 'move': {
267:                 const player = playerPositions[activePlayerIndex];
268:                 if (!player) return { ok: false, reason: 'pawn not found' };
269:                 if (getTotalAP() < a.cost) return { ok: false, reason: 'not enough AP' };
270:                 player.x = a.x;
271:                 player.y = a.y;
272:                 player.element.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${a.x}, ${a.y})`);
273:                 spendAP(a.cost);
274:                 if (typeof handlePlayerLanding === 'function') handlePlayerLanding(a.x, a.y);
275:                 if (typeof broadcastPlayerMovement === 'function') {
276:                     broadcastPlayerMovement(activePlayerIndex, a.x, a.y, a.cost);
277:                 }
278:                 return { ok: true };
279:             }
280:             case 'endTurn': {
281:                 const btn = document.getElementById('end-turn');
282:                 if (!btn || btn.disabled) return { ok: false, reason: 'end-turn button unavailable' };
283:                 btn.click();
284:                 return { ok: true };
285:             }
286:             default:
287:                 return { ok: false, reason: `unknown action type: ${a?.type}` };
288:         }
289:     }
290: 
291:     window.BotState = { snapshot, legalActions, applyAction, hexGrid, findPath };
292:     log('Loaded — window.BotState ready (snapshot / legalActions / applyAction)');
293: })();
</file>

<file path="js/effects-system.js">
  1: window.effectsSystem = (() => {
  2:     const EFFECTS = {
  3:         fire_effect: {
  4:             frames: 30,
  5:             fps: 18,
  6:             filter: 'none',
  7:             svgDiameter: 70,
  8:             baseFrameSize: 128,
  9:         },
 10:         ring_fire: {
 11:             frames: 30,
 12:             fps: 13,
 13:             srcId: 'fire_effect',
 14:             filter: 'hue-rotate(342deg) brightness(0.95) saturate(1.75)',
 15:             svgDiameter: 70,
 16:             baseFrameSize: 128,
 17:         }
 18:     };
 19: 
 20:     const loaded = {};
 21:     const active = [];
 22: 
 23:     const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
 24:     canvas.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:500;';
 25:     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
 26: 
 27:     function resize() {
 28:         canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
 29:         canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
 30:     }
 31:     window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
 32: 
 33:     function attachCanvas() {
 34:         if (document.body) { document.body.appendChild(canvas); resize(); }
 35:         else requestAnimationFrame(attachCanvas);
 36:     }
 37:     attachCanvas();
 38: 
 39:     function preload(effectId) {
 40:         const cfg = EFFECTS[effectId];
 41:         if (!cfg || loaded[effectId]) return;
 42:         loaded[effectId] = [];
 43:         for (let i = 1; i <= cfg.frames; i++) {
 44:             const img = new Image();
 45:             img.src = `images/effects/${cfg.srcId || effectId}/${String(i).padStart(4, '0')}.png`;
 46:             loaded[effectId].push(img);
 47:         }
 48:     }
 49: 
 50:     function tileToScreen(svgX, svgY) {
 51:         const boardSvg = document.getElementById('boardSvg');
 52:         const viewport = document.getElementById('viewport');
 53:         if (!boardSvg || !viewport) return null;
 54:         const pt = boardSvg.createSVGPoint();
 55:         pt.x = svgX;
 56:         pt.y = svgY;
 57:         const ctm = viewport.getCTM();
 58:         const screenPt = pt.matrixTransform(ctm);
 59:         const svgRect = boardSvg.getBoundingClientRect();
 60:         return {
 61:             x: svgRect.left + screenPt.x,
 62:             y: svgRect.top + screenPt.y,
 63:             boardScale: Math.sqrt(ctm.a * ctm.a + ctm.b * ctm.b),
 64:         };
 65:     }
 66: 
 67:     let rafRunning = false;
 68: 
 69:     function loop() {
 70:         ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 71:         const now = Date.now();
 72:         for (let i = active.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
 73:             const anim = active[i];
 74:             const cfg = EFFECTS[anim.effectId];
 75:             const frames = loaded[anim.effectId];
 76:             if (!frames) continue;
 77:             const frameIdx = Math.floor((now - anim.startTime) / (1000 / cfg.fps));
 78:             if (frameIdx >= cfg.frames) { active.splice(i, 1); continue; }
 79:             const img = frames[frameIdx];
 80:             if (!img.complete) continue;
 81:             const pos = tileToScreen(anim.svgX, anim.svgY);
 82:             if (!pos) continue;
 83:             const drawSize = cfg.svgDiameter * pos.boardScale;
 84:             ctx.save();
 85:             ctx.filter = cfg.filter;
 86:             ctx.drawImage(img, pos.x - drawSize / 2, pos.y - drawSize / 2, drawSize, drawSize);
 87:             ctx.restore();
 88:         }
 89:         if (active.length > 0) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 90:         else rafRunning = false;
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     Object.keys(EFFECTS).forEach(preload);
 94: 
 95:     return {
 96:         play(effectId, svgX, svgY) {
 97:             if (!EFFECTS[effectId]) return;
 98:             active.push({ effectId, svgX, svgY, startTime: Date.now() });
 99:             if (!rafRunning) { rafRunning = true; requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
100:         }
101:     };
102: })();

<file path="js/bot-driver.js">
  1: // ============================================================
  2: // bot-driver.js — lets the HOST's browser drive bot players
  3: // ============================================================
  4: // A "bot player" is an ordinary `players` table row whose username starts
  5: // with BOT_USERNAME_PREFIX (added from the lobby via the host-only
  6: // "🤖 Add Bot" button — see toggleBotPlayer() in lobby.js). It counts as a
  7: // player everywhere: player count, color/index assignment, turn order.
  8: //
  9: // Since the bot has no client, the host's browser acts as its client:
 10: // a watcher notices when it's a bot's turn and briefly IMPERSONATES the bot
 11: // (swaps the shared `myPlayerIndex` / `playerColor` lexical bindings) so
 12: // every existing isMyTurn()/canTakeAction()/broadcast path treats this
 13: // client as the bot. Actions run through window.BotSystem (strategy) and
 14: // window.BotState (actuation) exactly like a human-driven game.
 15: //
 16: // KNOWN v1 LIMITS (fine to ship, documented for future agents):
 17: //   - If the bot's hand overflows at end of turn, the resolve modal appears
 18: //     on the host's screen — the host resolves it on the bot's behalf.
 19: //   - The bot never plays response (level 1) scrolls.
 20: //   - While the bot is acting, the host's HUD temporarily reflects the bot.
 21: //
 22: // LOAD ORDER: after bot.js (last game script).
 23: // ============================================================
 24: 
 25: (function () {
 26:     'use strict';
 27: 
 28:     function log(...args) { console.log('🕹️ [BotDriver]', ...args); }
 29: 
 30:     // Shared with lobby.js (bot row creation, heartbeat, disconnect sweep)
 31:     const PREFIX = '🤖';
 32:     window.BOT_USERNAME_PREFIX = PREFIX;
 33:     window.isBotUsername = (u) => typeof u === 'string' && u.startsWith(PREFIX);
 34: 
 35:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 36:     // Which player indices are bots (from the DB rows all clients hold)
 37:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 38:     function botIndexSet() {
 39:         const set = new Set();
 40:         if (typeof allPlayersData !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(allPlayersData)) {
 41:             for (const p of allPlayersData) {
 42:                 if (window.isBotUsername(p.username) && p.player_index != null) set.add(p.player_index);
 43:             }
 44:         }
 45:         return set;
 46:     }
 47: 
 48:     function gameActive() {
 49:         return document.getElementById('game-layout')?.classList.contains('active');
 50:     }
 51: 
 52:     function iAmDriver() {
 53:         return typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer &&
 54:                typeof isHost !== 'undefined' && isHost;
 55:     }
 56: 
 57:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 58:     // Impersonation: temporarily become the bot so every existing
 59:     // myPlayerIndex-based gate and broadcast identifies as the bot.
 60:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 61:     async function asBot(botIndex, fn) {
 62:         const realIndex = myPlayerIndex;
 63:         const realColor = playerColor;
 64:         myPlayerIndex = botIndex;
 65:         const row = (typeof allPlayersData !== 'undefined')
 66:             ? allPlayersData.find(p => p.player_index === botIndex) : null;
 67:         if (row && row.color) playerColor = row.color;
 68:         if (typeof updateEndTurnButtonVisibility === 'function') updateEndTurnButtonVisibility();
 69:         try {
 70:             await fn();
 71:         } finally {
 72:             myPlayerIndex = realIndex;
 73:             playerColor = realColor;
 74:             if (typeof updateEndTurnButtonVisibility === 'function') updateEndTurnButtonVisibility();
 75:             if (typeof updateTurnDisplay === 'function') updateTurnDisplay();
 76:         }
 77:     }
 78: 
 79:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 80:     // Placement phase: put the bot's player tile on a free hex adjacent
 81:     // to the existing cluster (closest to the board centroid = compact).
 82:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 83:     function pickBotTilePosition() {
 84:         const S = TILE_SIZE * 4; // large tile hex size
 85:         if (!placedTiles.length) return null;
 86:         const cx = placedTiles.reduce((s, t) => s + t.x, 0) / placedTiles.length;
 87:         const cy = placedTiles.reduce((s, t) => s + t.y, 0) / placedTiles.length;
 88:         const candidates = [];
 89:         for (const t of placedTiles) {
 90:             const h = pixelToHex(t.x, t.y, S);
 91:             for (const [dq, dr] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1], [1, -1], [-1, 1]]) {
 92:                 const p = hexToPixel(h.q + dq, h.r + dr, S);
 93:                 if (placedTiles.some(o => Math.hypot(o.x - p.x, o.y - p.y) < 40)) continue; // occupied
 94:                 if (candidates.some(c => Math.hypot(c.x - p.x, c.y - p.y) < 40)) continue;  // dupe
 95:                 candidates.push(p);
 96:             }
 97:         }
 98:         if (!candidates.length) return null;
 99:         candidates.sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - cx, a.y - cy) - Math.hypot(b.x - cx, b.y - cy));
100:         return candidates[0];
101:     }
102: 
103:     async function placeBotTile(botIndex) {
104:         const pos = pickBotTilePosition();
105:         if (!pos) { log('No free position for bot tile!'); return; }
106:         log(`Placing bot ${botIndex}'s player tile at (${pos.x.toFixed(0)}, ${pos.y.toFixed(0)})`);
107:         await asBot(botIndex, async () => {
108:             // Same two steps as the human drag-drop path in game-ui.js:
109:             // placeTile handles pawn creation + placement bookkeeping/broadcasts,
110:             // and 'player-tile-place' shows the tile on the other clients.
111:             placeTile(pos.x, pos.y, 0, false, 'player');
112:             if (typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
113:                 broadcastGameAction('player-tile-place', {
114:                     x: pos.x, y: pos.y,
115:                     playerIndex: botIndex,
116:                     color: playerColor,
117:                     cosmetics: null
118:                 });
119:             }
120:         });
121:     }
122: 
123:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
124:     // Normal turns: reset the bot's AP (the turn-change handler only does
125:     // this for the local player), then let BotSystem play out the turn.
126:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
127:     let lastDrivenTurnKey = null;
128: 
129:     async function driveBotTurn(botIndex) {
130:         const turnNo = (typeof currentTurnNumber !== 'undefined') ? currentTurnNumber : 0;
131:         const key = `${turnNo}:${botIndex}`;
132:         if (lastDrivenTurnKey === key) return;
133:         lastDrivenTurnKey = key;
134: 
135:         log(`Driving turn for bot player ${botIndex} (turn #${turnNo})`);
136:         if (typeof updateStatus === 'function') updateStatus('🤖 Bot is thinking...');
137:         await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); // let turn-change effects settle
138: 
139:         await asBot(botIndex, async () => {
140:             currentAP = 5;
141:             const apEl = document.getElementById('ap-count');
142:             if (apEl) apEl.textContent = currentAP;
143:             if (typeof refreshVoidAP === 'function') refreshVoidAP();
144:             if (typeof syncPlayerState === 'function') syncPlayerState();
145: 
146:             await window.BotSystem.turn();
147: 
148:             // Safety net: never leave the game hanging on a stuck bot turn
149:             if (activePlayerIndex === botIndex) {
150:                 log('Bot turn did not end on its own — forcing end turn');
151:                 const btn = document.getElementById('end-turn');
152:                 if (btn && !btn.disabled) btn.click();
153:             }
154:         });
155: 
156:         // The bot spent from this client's shared currentAP counter, and the
157:         // end-turn flow's local AP reset is gated on
158:         // activePlayerIndex === myPlayerIndex — which compared against the
159:         // BOT's index while impersonated. So when the bot hands the turn to
160:         // THIS player, redo what the turn-change handler would have done:
161:         // full AP, pips, and void AP recomputed from MY pool (not the bot's).
162:         if (typeof activePlayerIndex !== 'undefined' && activePlayerIndex === myPlayerIndex) {
163:             currentAP = 5;
164:             const apEl = document.getElementById('ap-count');
165:             if (apEl) apEl.textContent = currentAP;
166:             if (typeof updateApPips === 'function') updateApPips(currentAP);
167:             if (typeof refreshVoidAP === 'function') refreshVoidAP();
168:             if (typeof syncPlayerState === 'function') syncPlayerState();
169:             if (typeof updateStatus === 'function') updateStatus('Your turn!');
170:         } else if (typeof refreshVoidAP === 'function') {
171:             // Not my turn next — still restore void AP to MY pool's baseline
172:             refreshVoidAP();
173:         }
174: 
175:         // While impersonated, the stone panel and scroll counts rendered the
176:         // BOT's resources — re-render them for the local player now.
177:         try {
178:             if (typeof playerPool !== 'undefined' && typeof updateStoneCount === 'function') {
179:                 Object.keys(playerPool).forEach(updateStoneCount);
180:             }
181:             window.spellSystem?.updateScrollCount?.();
182:         } catch (e) { /* cosmetic only */ }
183:     }
184: 
185:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
186:     // Watcher: fires the right driver action whenever a bot is the
187:     // active player on the host's client.
188:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
189:     let busy = false;
190:     const handledPlacement = new Set();
191: 
192:     setInterval(() => {
193:         if (busy) return;
194:         if (!gameActive()) { handledPlacement.clear(); lastDrivenTurnKey = null; return; }
195:         if (!iAmDriver()) return;
196: 
197:         const bots = botIndexSet();
198:         if (!bots.size || !bots.has(activePlayerIndex)) return;
199: 
200:         if (typeof isPlacementPhase !== 'undefined' && isPlacementPhase) {
201:             if (playerTilesPlaced.has(activePlayerIndex) || handledPlacement.has(activePlayerIndex)) return;
202:             handledPlacement.add(activePlayerIndex);
203:             busy = true;
204:             setTimeout(() => {
205:                 placeBotTile(activePlayerIndex)
206:                     .catch(e => log('Bot tile placement failed:', e))
207:                     .finally(() => { busy = false; });
208:             }, 800);
209:         } else {
210:             busy = true;
211:             driveBotTurn(activePlayerIndex)
212:                 .catch(e => log('Bot turn failed:', e))
213:                 .finally(() => { busy = false; });
214:         }
215:     }, 700);
216: 
217:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
218:     // Public API (console debugging + other modules)
219:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
220:     window.BotDriver = {
221:         isBot: (i) => botIndexSet().has(i),
222:         botIndices: botIndexSet,
223:         controlsActivePlayer: () => iAmDriver() && botIndexSet().has(activePlayerIndex),
224:         _placeBotTile: placeBotTile,
225:         _driveBotTurn: driveBotTurn,
226:     };
227: 
228:     log('Loaded — host lobbies get a 🤖 Add Bot button; host client drives bot turns');
229: })();
