<file path="js/bot.js">
  1: // ============================================================
  2: // bot.js — Stage 1 utility bot for Godaigo (docs/bot-roadmap.md)
  3: // ============================================================
  4: // HOW TO USE:
  5: //   Shift+R  → execute ONE bot action for the active player
  6: //   Shift+B  → play out the WHOLE turn (loops actions until end of turn)
  7: //   Console  → window.BotSystem.step() / .turn() / .rank() / .WEIGHTS
  8: //
  9: // HOW IT DECIDES (Stage 1 of the roadmap — no lookahead yet):
 10: //   1. BotState.legalActions() enumerates every legal action
 11: //   2. scoreAction() gives each a utility: Σ weight × feature
 12: //   3. argmax wins. All strategy knobs live in WEIGHTS — tune the table,
 13: //      not the code. Stage 3a evolution writes better weights to
 14: //      localStorage['godaigo_bot_weights'], loaded over defaults at startup.
 15: //
 16: // Observation/actuation is bot-state.js (window.BotState). This file must
 17: // never touch game internals directly except through BotState + snapshot.
 18: //
 19: // LOAD ORDER: after bot-state.js (which is after lobby.js)
 20: // ============================================================
 21: 
 22: (function () {
 23:     'use strict';
 24: 
 25:     function log(...args) { console.log('🤖 [Bot]', ...args); }
 26: 
 27:     const ELEMENTS = ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void'];
 28:     const POOL_CAP = 5;
 29: 
 30:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 31:     // WEIGHTS — the single tuning surface. Stage 3a evolves this table.
 32:     // Positive = more attractive. Rough scale: 100 ≈ "clearly best action".
 33:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 34:     const DEFAULT_WEIGHTS = {
 35:         // casting
 36:         castBase:          100,  // any satisfied pattern is usually worth firing
 37:         castUnactivated:    80,  // scroll element not yet activated (win progress!)
 38:         castDeadElement:   -60,  // source pool empty → effect fires but NO win credit
 39:         castLevel:           2,  // per scroll level — mild preference for big scrolls
 40: 
 41:         // stone placement toward a pattern
 42:         placeBase:          20,
 43:         placeProgress:      45,  // × fraction of the variant complete AFTER this stone
 44:         placeUnactivated:   25,  // building toward an unactivated element
 45:         placeDeadElement:  -30,  // building toward an element with an empty source pool
 46: 
 47:         // movement
 48:         moveBase:            2,
 49:         moveShrineValue:    30,  // × (target shrine value ÷ (1 + remaining path cost))
 50:         moveApPenalty:      -1,  // × step cost — cheap steps preferred
 51:         moveExplore:        18,  // step lands on an unrevealed tile (reveals it — draws a scroll)
 52:         moveExploreGradient: 0.15, // × px closed toward the nearest unrevealed tile
 53: 
 54:         // ending the turn
 55:         endTurnBase:         1,  // always a legal fallback, never attractive by itself
 56:         endTurnOnShrine:    55,  // standing on a collectible shrine centre: end = collect
 57:         endTurnLowAp:        6,  // + when AP ≤ 1 — nothing useful left to do
 58: 
 59:         // shrine valuation (used inside move/endTurn features)
 60:         shrineNeed:          1.0, // × (capacity − pool[element])
 61:         shrineUnactivated:   2.5, // element not yet activated
 62:         shrineDeadSource:  -3.0,  // source pool empty — collection yields nothing
 63:     };
 64: 
 65:     // Evolved weights (Stage 3a) override defaults without code edits
 66:     let WEIGHTS = { ...DEFAULT_WEIGHTS };
 67:     try {
 68:         const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('godaigo_bot_weights') || 'null');
 69:         if (saved && typeof saved === 'object') {
 70:             WEIGHTS = { ...DEFAULT_WEIGHTS, ...saved };
 71:             log('Loaded evolved weights from localStorage');
 72:         }
 73:     } catch (e) { /* corrupt save — keep defaults */ }
 74: 
 75:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 76:     // Derived state helpers (read ONLY from the snapshot — never from
 77:     // game internals, and never from hidden information)
 78:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
 79:     function me(snap) { return snap.players[snap.turn.activePlayerIndex]; }
 80: 
 81:     function scrollElement(name) {
 82:         return window.SCROLL_DEFINITIONS?.[name]?.element || null;
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     // Worth of collecting at a shrine of this element right now
 86:     function shrineValue(snap, element) {
 87:         const self = me(snap);
 88:         if (!self) return 0;
 89:         const need = Math.max(0, POOL_CAP - (self.pool[element] || 0));
 90:         if (need === 0) return 0;                       // pool already full
 91:         let v = WEIGHTS.shrineNeed * need;
 92:         if (!self.activated.includes(element)) v += WEIGHTS.shrineUnactivated * need;
 93:         if ((snap.sourcePool[element] || 0) <= 0) v += WEIGHTS.shrineDeadSource * need;
 94:         return Math.max(0, v);
 95:     }
 96: 
 97:     // Collectible shrine tiles: revealed, elemental, and worth something
 98:     function collectibleShrines(snap) {
 99:         return snap.tiles.filter(t =>
100:             t.revealed && !t.isPlayerTile &&
101:             ELEMENTS.includes(t.shrineType) &&
102:             shrineValue(snap, t.shrineType) > 0);
103:     }
104: 
105:     function shrineUnderfoot(snap) {
106:         const self = me(snap);
107:         if (!self) return null;
108:         return collectibleShrines(snap).find(t => Math.hypot(t.x - self.x, t.y - self.y) < 5) || null;
109:     }
110: 
111:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
112:     // scoreAction — the Stage-1 utility function. Tune WEIGHTS, not this.
113:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
114:     function scoreAction(a, snap, ctx) {
115:         const self = me(snap);
116:         switch (a.type) {
117: 
118:             case 'cast': {
119:                 const el = scrollElement(a.scroll);
120:                 const def = window.SCROLL_DEFINITIONS?.[a.scroll];
121:                 let s = WEIGHTS.castBase + WEIGHTS.castLevel * (def?.level || 0);
122:                 if (el && ELEMENTS.includes(el)) {
123:                     const dead = (snap.sourcePool[el] || 0) <= 0;
124:                     if (dead) s += WEIGHTS.castDeadElement;          // no win credit
125:                     else if (!self.activated.includes(el)) s += WEIGHTS.castUnactivated;
126:                 }
127:                 return s;
128:             }
129: 
130:             case 'placeStone': {
131:                 const el = scrollElement(a.scroll);
132:                 let s = WEIGHTS.placeBase + WEIGHTS.placeProgress * (a.progress || 0);
133:                 if (el && ELEMENTS.includes(el)) {
134:                     if ((snap.sourcePool[el] || 0) <= 0) s += WEIGHTS.placeDeadElement;
135:                     else if (!self.activated.includes(el)) s += WEIGHTS.placeUnactivated;
136:                 }
137:                 return s;
138:             }
139: 
140:             case 'move': {
141:                 // Value = best shrine reachable via this step: worth ÷ remaining cost.
142:                 // ctx.paths caches Dijkstra results per target for this decision.
143:                 let best = 0;
144:                 for (const t of ctx.shrines) {
145:                     const path = ctx.paths.get(t.id);
146:                     if (!path || !path.length) continue;
147:                     const first = path[0];
148:                     if (Math.hypot(first.x - a.x, first.y - a.y) >= 5) continue; // step isn't on this path
149:                     const remaining = path.reduce((c, p) => c + p.cost, 0);
150:                     const v = shrineValue(snap, t.shrineType) / (1 + remaining);
151:                     if (v > best) best = v;
152:                 }
153:                 // Exploration: landing on an unrevealed tile flips it (scroll draw!);
154:                 // otherwise reward closing distance to the nearest hidden tile.
155:                 let explore = 0;
156:                 if (ctx.hiddenTiles.length) {
157:                     const onHidden = ctx.hiddenTiles.some(t => Math.hypot(t.x - a.x, t.y - a.y) < 70);
158:                     if (onHidden) explore += WEIGHTS.moveExplore;
159:                     else {
160:                         const distFrom = p => Math.min(...ctx.hiddenTiles.map(t => Math.hypot(t.x - p.x, t.y - p.y)));
161:                         explore += WEIGHTS.moveExploreGradient * (distFrom(self) - distFrom(a));
162:                     }
163:                 }
164:                 return WEIGHTS.moveBase + WEIGHTS.moveShrineValue * best
165:                      + WEIGHTS.moveApPenalty * a.cost + explore;
166:             }
167: 
168:             case 'endTurn': {
169:                 let s = WEIGHTS.endTurnBase;
170:                 if (ctx.onShrine) {
171:                     s += WEIGHTS.endTurnOnShrine
172:                        + shrineValue(snap, ctx.onShrine.shrineType);
173:                 }
174:                 if (snap.turn.ap <= 1) s += WEIGHTS.endTurnLowAp;
175:                 return s;
176:             }
177: 
178:             default: return -Infinity;
179:         }
180:     }
181: 
182:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
183:     // Pattern plan (Stage 1.75): scroll patterns anchor to the hex the
184:     // caster STANDS ON when casting, and stones may only be placed
185:     // adjacent to the pawn — so multi-hex patterns need a plan: fix an
186:     // anchor (the casting spot), walk around placing each cell, return
187:     // to the anchor, cast. Without this the anchor drifts as the pawn
188:     // moves and the bot scatters stones that never complete anything.
189:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
190:     let _plan = null; // { scroll, anchor:{q,r}, cells:[{q,r,x,y,type}] }
191: 
192:     function makePlan(snap) {
193:         const self = me(snap);
194:         if (!self || !self.hand) return null;
195:         const pHex = pixelToHex(self.x, self.y, TILE_SIZE);
196:         const grid = window.BotState.hexGrid();
197:         let best = null;
198:         for (const name of self.hand) {
199:             const def = window.SCROLL_DEFINITIONS?.[name];
200:             if (!def || def.level === 1 || !Array.isArray(def.patterns)) continue;
201:             const el = def.element;
202:             for (const variant of def.patterns) {
203:                 const cells = variant.map(req => {
204:                     const px = hexToPixel(pHex.q + req.q, pHex.r + req.r, TILE_SIZE);
205:                     return { q: pHex.q + req.q, r: pHex.r + req.r, x: px.x, y: px.y, type: req.type };
206:                 });
207:                 if (!cells.every(c => grid.some(h => Math.hypot(h.x - c.x, h.y - c.y) < 5))) continue;
208:                 let placed = 0, blocked = false;
209:                 const need = {};
210:                 for (const c of cells) {
211:                     const s = placedStones.find(st => Math.hypot(st.x - c.x, st.y - c.y) < 5);
212:                     if (s && s.type === c.type) placed++;
213:                     else if (s) { blocked = true; break; }
214:                     else need[c.type] = (need[c.type] || 0) + 1;
215:                 }
216:                 if (blocked) continue;
217:                 // The pool must cover every missing stone NOW — half-built
218:                 // shapes the bot can't finish are worse than nothing
219:                 if (Object.entries(need).some(([t, n]) => (self.pool[t] || 0) < n)) continue;
220:                 let score = placed * 10;
221:                 if (!self.activated.includes(el) && (snap.sourcePool[el] || 0) > 0) score += 20;
222:                 if ((snap.sourcePool[el] || 0) <= 0) score -= 50; // no win credit
223:                 if (!best || score > best.score) best = { score, scroll: name, anchor: pHex, cells };
224:             }
225:         }
226:         return best ? { scroll: best.scroll, anchor: best.anchor, cells: best.cells } : null;
227:     }
228: 
229:     function planValid(snap) {
230:         if (!_plan) return false;
231:         const self = me(snap);
232:         if (!self) return false;
233:         const holding = (self.hand || []).includes(_plan.scroll) || self.active.includes(_plan.scroll);
234:         if (!holding) return false;
235:         for (const c of _plan.cells) {
236:             const s = placedStones.find(st => Math.hypot(st.x - c.x, st.y - c.y) < 5);
237:             if (s && s.type !== c.type) return false;                       // cell corrupted
238:             if (!s && (self.pool[c.type] || 0) <= 0) return false;          // can't supply anymore
239:         }
240:         return true;
241:     }
242: 
243:     // One walkable step toward any hex adjacent to `cell` (avoiding standing
244:     // on cells the plan still needs to fill). Returns a move action or null.
245:     function stepTowardCell(self, cell, missing, ap) {
246:         const grid = window.BotState.hexGrid();
247:         let bestPath = null;
248:         for (const h of grid) {
249:             const d = Math.hypot(h.x - cell.x, h.y - cell.y);
250:             if (d <= 5 || d >= 40) continue;                                 // must be adjacent to the cell
251:             if (missing.some(m => Math.hypot(m.x - h.x, m.y - h.y) < 5)) continue; // don't stand on an unfilled cell
252:             const path = window.BotState.findPath(self.x, self.y, h.x, h.y);
253:             if (!path || !path.length) continue;
254:             const cost = path.reduce((c, p) => c + p.cost, 0);
255:             if (!bestPath || cost < bestPath.cost) bestPath = { cost, step: path[0] };
256:         }
257:         if (bestPath && bestPath.step.cost <= ap) {
258:             return { type: 'move', x: bestPath.step.x, y: bestPath.step.y, cost: bestPath.step.cost };
259:         }
260:         return null;
261:     }
262: 
263:     // The next concrete action the plan dictates, or null (fall back to scoring)
264:     function planNextAction(snap) {
265:         if (!_plan || !planValid(snap)) { _plan = null; return null; }
266:         const self = me(snap);
267:         const missing = _plan.cells.filter(c =>
268:             !placedStones.some(st => st.type === c.type && Math.hypot(st.x - c.x, st.y - c.y) < 5));
269: 
270:         if (missing.length) {
271:             for (const c of missing) {
272:                 if (typeof isInPlacementRange === 'function' && isInPlacementRange(c.x, c.y, c.type)) {
273:                     return { type: 'placeStone', x: c.x, y: c.y, stoneType: c.type, scroll: _plan.scroll,
274:                              progress: (_plan.cells.length - missing.length + 1) / _plan.cells.length };
275:                 }
276:             }
277:             if (snap.turn.ap > 0) {
278:                 // fill the farthest-from-anchor cells first so placed stones
279:                 // (earth blocks movement!) don't wall off the rest of the shape
280:                 const aPx = hexToPixel(_plan.anchor.q, _plan.anchor.r, TILE_SIZE);
281:                 const ordered = [...missing].sort((a, b) =>
282:                     Math.hypot(b.x - aPx.x, b.y - aPx.y) - Math.hypot(a.x - aPx.x, a.y - aPx.y));
283:                 for (const c of ordered) {
284:                     const mv = stepTowardCell(self, c, missing, snap.turn.ap);
285:                     if (mv) return mv;
286:                 }
287:             }
288:             return null; // out of AP / unreachable — generic scoring takes over
289:         }
290: 
291:         // Shape complete → return to the anchor and cast
292:         const aPx = hexToPixel(_plan.anchor.q, _plan.anchor.r, TILE_SIZE);
293:         if (Math.hypot(self.x - aPx.x, self.y - aPx.y) >= 5) {
294:             if (snap.turn.ap > 0) {
295:                 const path = window.BotState.findPath(self.x, self.y, aPx.x, aPx.y);
296:                 if (path && path.length && path[0].cost <= snap.turn.ap) {
297:                     return { type: 'move', x: path[0].x, y: path[0].y, cost: path[0].cost };
298:                 }
299:             }
300:             return null;
301:         }
302:         if (snap.turn.ap >= 2 && window.spellSystem.checkPattern(_plan.scroll)) {
303:             return { type: 'cast', scroll: _plan.scroll };
304:         }
305:         return null;
306:     }
307: 
308:     // Rank all legal actions for the current position (debug + decision core)
309:     function rankActions() {
310:         const snap = window.BotState.snapshot();
311:         const self = me(snap);
312:         if (!self) return [];
313: 
314:         const ctx = {
315:             shrines: collectibleShrines(snap),
316:             onShrine: shrineUnderfoot(snap),
317:             hiddenTiles: snap.tiles.filter(t => !t.revealed && !t.isPlayerTile),
318:             paths: new Map(),
319:         };
320:         for (const t of ctx.shrines) {
321:             ctx.paths.set(t.id, window.BotState.findPath(self.x, self.y, t.x, t.y));
322:         }
323: 
324:         return window.BotState.legalActions()
325:             .map(a => ({ action: a, score: scoreAction(a, snap, ctx) }))
326:             .sort((x, y) => y.score - x.score);
327:     }
328: 
329:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
330:     // One bot step: pick argmax, apply it. Returns the applied action or null.
331:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
332:     function botAct() {
333:         if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer &&
334:             typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' && activePlayerIndex !== myPlayerIndex) {
335:             log('Not this client\'s turn — refusing to act (multiplayer guard)');
336:             return null;
337:         }
338: 
339:         // The pattern plan takes priority: it's the only way multi-hex
340:         // patterns ever complete under the adjacent-only placement rule
341:         const snap = window.BotState.snapshot();
342:         if (!_plan || !planValid(snap)) {
343:             _plan = makePlan(snap);
344:             if (_plan) log(`New plan: build ${_plan.scroll} anchored at hex (${_plan.anchor.q},${_plan.anchor.r})`);
345:         }
346:         const planAction = _plan ? planNextAction(snap) : null;
347:         if (planAction) {
348:             const label = planAction.type === 'cast' ? `cast ${planAction.scroll}`
349:                         : planAction.type === 'placeStone' ? `place ${planAction.stoneType} for ${planAction.scroll}`
350:                         : `move to (${planAction.x.toFixed(0)},${planAction.y.toFixed(0)})`;
351:             log(`Plan action: ${label}`);
352:             const r = window.BotState.applyAction(planAction);
353:             if (r.ok) {
354:                 if (planAction.type === 'cast') _plan = null; // plan fulfilled
355:                 return planAction;
356:             }
357:             log(`Plan action failed (${r.reason}) — falling back to scoring`);
358:             _plan = null;
359:         }
360: 
361:         const ranked = rankActions();
362:         if (!ranked.length) { log('No legal actions found'); return null; }
363: 
364:         const { action, score } = ranked[0];
365:         const label = action.type === 'cast'       ? `cast ${action.scroll}`
366:                     : action.type === 'placeStone' ? `place ${action.stoneType} for ${action.scroll} (${Math.round((action.progress||0)*100)}%)`
367:                     : action.type === 'move'       ? `move to (${action.x.toFixed(0)},${action.y.toFixed(0)}) cost ${action.cost}`
368:                     : 'end turn';
369:         log(`Best action [${score.toFixed(1)}]: ${label}  (of ${ranked.length} candidates)`);
370: 
371:         const res = window.BotState.applyAction(action);
372:         if (!res.ok) { log(`Action failed: ${res.reason}`); return null; }
373:         return action;
374:     }
375: 
376:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
377:     // Quiescence: after a cast, multiplayer opens a ~15s response window;
378:     // some scroll effects enter selection modes or cascade prompts that
379:     // wait for input. The bot must NOT take its next action (or end its
380:     // turn) until this machinery settles — otherwise the stack resolves
381:     // after the turn has passed, attributed to the wrong player.
382:     // Resolves what it can (cascade prompt), cancels what it can't drive
383:     // (selection modes), and waits out the rest.
384:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
385:     const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
386: 
387:     async function waitForQuiescence() {
388:         const deadline = Date.now() + 25000;
389:         while (Date.now() < deadline) {
390:             // Cascade prompt (scroll drawn onto a full hand): choose like a
391:             // player would — keep the new scroll usable if possible
392:             const cascade = document.getElementById('cascade-popup');
393:             if (cascade) {
394:                 const buttons = [...cascade.querySelectorAll('button')];
395:                 const pick = buttons.find(b => b.textContent === 'To Active') ||
396:                              buttons.find(b => b.textContent === 'To Common');
397:                 if (pick) { log(`Cascade prompt: choosing "${pick.textContent}"`); pick.click(); }
398:                 await sleep(250);
399:                 continue;
400:             }
401:             // Selection modes (Sacrificial Pyre, Telekinesis, Take Flight, …)
402:             // need input the bot can't give yet — cancel so the turn never wedges
403:             const se = window.spellSystem?.scrollEffects;
404:             if (se?.selectionMode || window.takeFlightState) {
405:                 log('Cancelling a selection mode the bot cannot drive');
406:                 se?.cancelSelectionMode?.();
407:                 if (window.takeFlightState) window.takeFlightState = null;
408:                 await sleep(250);
409:                 continue;
410:             }
411:             // Response window after a cast (multiplayer): wait the stack out
412:             if (window.spellSystem?.responseWindow?.isResponseWindowOpen) {
413:                 await sleep(400);
414:                 continue;
415:             }
416:             return; // quiet — safe to act again
417:         }
418:         log('waitForQuiescence timed out — proceeding anyway');
419:     }
420: 
421:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
422:     // Whole-turn autopilot: loop steps until the turn ends (or safety cap).
423:     // Async with a small delay so reveals/casts/HUD settle between actions.
424:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
425:     let _turnRunning = false;
426:     async function botTurn() {
427:         if (_turnRunning) { log('Turn already running'); return; }
428:         _turnRunning = true;
429:         const startingPlayer = activePlayerIndex;
430:         try {
431:             for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {                    // safety cap
432:                 if (activePlayerIndex !== startingPlayer) break; // turn passed
433:                 await waitForQuiescence();
434:                 if (activePlayerIndex !== startingPlayer) break;
435:                 const applied = botAct();
436:                 if (!applied) break;
437:                 if (applied.type === 'endTurn') break;
438:                 await sleep(350);
439:             }
440:         } finally {
441:             _turnRunning = false;
442:         }
443:         log('Turn autopilot finished');
444:     }
445: 
446:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
447:     // Keyboard: Shift+R = one step, Shift+B = whole turn.
448:     // Same guards as game-ui.js (no lobby, no text inputs).
449:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
450:     document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
451:         if (!e.shiftKey) return;
452:         const key = e.key.toUpperCase();
453:         if (key !== 'R' && key !== 'B') return;
454: 
455:         const tag = document.activeElement?.tagName;
456:         if (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA' || document.activeElement?.isContentEditable) return;
457:         if (!document.getElementById('game-layout')?.classList.contains('active')) return;
458: 
459:         e.preventDefault();
460:         if (key === 'R') { log('Shift+R — one bot step'); botAct(); }
461:         else             { log('Shift+B — bot plays out the turn'); botTurn(); }
462:     });
463: 
464:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
465:     // Public API (console debugging + Stage 2/3 hooks)
466:     // ----------------------------------------------------------------
467:     window.BotSystem = {
468:         step:  botAct,        // one action
469:         turn:  botTurn,       // play out the whole turn
470:         rank:  rankActions,   // scored candidate list (top = what step() would do)
471:         score: scoreAction,   // (action, snapshot, ctx) → utility
472:         waitForQuiescence,    // settle response windows / selection modes / cascades
473:         WEIGHTS,              // live tuning surface (Stage 3a evolves this)
474:         DEFAULT_WEIGHTS,
475:     };
476: 
477:     log('Loaded — Shift+R = one bot step, Shift+B = full bot turn');
478: })();
</file>

 32: 
 33: ## game-core.js — Deep Notes
 34: 
 35: ### SpellSystem class (instantiated as `spellSystem`, exposed as `window.spellSystem`)
 36: - `playerScrolls[]` — per-player inventory: `{hand: Set, active: Set, activated: Set}`
 37: - `scrollDecks{}` — draw piles per element; override via `window.tutorialDeckOverride` before `initializeDeck()`
 38: - `onTileRevealed(element)` — draws top scroll from element deck into active player's hand
 39: - `patternMatchesBoard(scroll, playerHex)` — checks if stone pattern exists around player position
 40: - `activateScroll(scrollId, playerIndex)` — validates pattern + 2 AP, fires effect, tracks win condition
 41: 
 42: ### Key standalone functions
 43: - `hexToPixel(q, r, size)` → `{x, y}` — flat-top hex math. `size=TILE_SIZE(20)` for stones, `size=TILE_SIZE*4(80)` for tiles
 44: - `pixelToHex(x, y, size)` → `{q, r}`
 45: - `placeTile(x, y, rotation, flipped, shrineType, isPlayerTile, skipMP, forcedId)` — creates SVG tile group, assigns color, calls `placePlayer()` for player tiles. Fires `TutorialMode.onPlayerTilePlaced()` hook.
 46: - `revealTile(tileId)` — flips hidden tile: fires `onTilePreReveal` (before visual), builds SVG, fires `onTileRevealed` (after visual), draws scroll
 47: - `addAP(amount)` — respects max AP (5 + void bonus), updates HUD, calls `syncPlayerState()`
 48: - `initializeDeck(numPlayers, seed)` — checks `window.tutorialDeckOverride` first; if set, uses it and nulls the override
 49: - `generateSpiralPositions(n)` — returns world coords for n tiles in spiral order (defined in game-ui.js)
 50: 
 51: ### gotchas
 52: - `placedTiles[]` is the source of truth for board state. `tile.flipped=true` means hidden.
 53: - `activePlayerIndex` governs whose turn it is. In single-player/tutorial, it's always 0.
 54: - `playerPositions[]` entries hold `{x, y, element, color, index}`. Color is always stored as **hex** (`#9b59b6`), not name (`purple`). Bug was COLOR_RANK returning undefined when name stored instead of hex.
 55: - `tileDeck[]` is consumed sequentially (no reshuffle after init). Index tracked by `deckIndex`.
 56: - AP max is 5 by default; each void stone in player pool raises it by 1 (`updateVoidAP()`).
 57: - `skipMultiplayerLogic=true` bypasses broadcast and turn-advance. Used for tutorial cosmetic placements and visual-only syncs from remote broadcasts.
 58: 
 59: ---
 60: 
 61: ## game-ui.js — Deep Notes
 62: 
 63: ### Drag systems (3 independent state machines)
 64: 1. **Pawn drag** (`isDraggingPlayer`) — mousedown on `.player` SVG, constrained by AP and hex grid, calls `revealTile()` on unflipped destination
 65: 2. **Stone drag** (`isDraggingStone`) — mousedown on stone-card or placed stone SVG, drops onto hex grid
 66: 3. **Tile drag** (`isDraggingTile`) — mousedown on `.deck-tile` or placed tile (if `tileMoveMode`), snaps to valid positions
 67: 
 68: ### Tutorial integration in game-ui.js
 69: - Pawn drop handler checks `tutorialBlocked` (allowed hexes set) before accepting move
 70: - Calls `TutorialMode.onPlayerMoved(x, y)` after successful pawn placement
 71: - `startPlayerTileDrag()` is the entry for dragging player tiles from the deck
 72: 
 73: ### generateSpiralPositions(n) — spiral order
 74: Position 0 = `(0,0)` (center). For 1-player tutorial: 6 tiles, positions 0–5. Earth is always at position 0 when `tutorialDeckOverride` is active.
 75: 
 76: ---
 77: 
 78: ## lobby.js — Deep Notes
 79: 
 80: ### startGame(numPlayers) — local single-player launch
 81: 1. `clearBoard()` → reset all state
 82: 2. Hide `#lobby-wrapper`, show `#game-layout`
 83: 3. `initializeDeck(numPlayers)` — checks tutorialDeckOverride
 84: 4. `initializePlayerTiles(numPlayers)` — creates draggable SVG tiles in left panel
 85: 5. Places `numPlayers * 6` tiles via `generateSpiralPositions()` + `placeTile()`
 86: 6. Exposed as `window.startGame` explicitly at bottom of file
 87: 
 88: ### Auth flow
 89: - Page load → `checkAuthSession()` → if session exists, `onAuthSuccess()` immediately (skips auth screen)
 90: - Logged-in users go directly to `#multiplayer-lobby` → `#game-browser-panel`
 91: - Tutorial button lives on `#auth-screen` only — logged-in users never see it
 92: 
 93: ### Mobile UI
 94: - `syncMobileStoneDeck()` uses `stoneCounts[type]` and `stoneCapacity`. `shuffledDeck` reference was a bug (fixed: replaced with `/25`).
 95: - `updateIsMobile()` calls `initializeMobileUI()` which calls `syncMobileStoneDeck()` — triggered by `startGame()`.
 96: 
 97: ### Host ready system
 98: - Host is auto-marked ready in DB when creating room
 99: - `updateReadyButton()` hides ready button for host
100: - `updatePlayerList()` shows Start button when `totalCount >= 2` (no longer requires `hostIsReady`)
101: 
102: ---
103: 
104: ## tutorial-mode.js — Deep Notes
105: 
106: ### Module pattern
107: IIFE assigned to `const TutorialMode`, then `window.TutorialMode = TutorialMode`. Not a class.
108: 
109: ### Step machine
110: - `STEPS[]` array, 15 entries (index 0–14)
111: - `action` field: `'read'` (button), `'click'` (spotlit element), `'move'` (position gate), `'explore'` (tile reveal gate), `'place-tile'` (tile placement gate)
112: - Blocking overlay ONLY created for `action:'click'` — all other actions leave the board interactive
113: 
114: ### Tutorial hooks (called from game-core.js)
115: | Hook | Called from | When |
116: |------|------------|------|
117: | `onTilePreReveal(tile)` | `revealTile()`, before visual | Forces `tile.shrineType='earth'` on first flip in step 3 |
118: | `onTileRevealed(tile, ss)` | `revealTile()`, after visual | Advances step 3→4 after tile flip |
119: | `onPlayerTilePlaced()` | `placeTile()`, after pawn placed | Advances step 1→2 |
120: | `onPlayerMoved(x, y)` | game-ui.js, after pawn drop | Currently no-op |
121: 
122: ### Board geometry constants
123: ```js
124: const S = 80;  // largeHexSize = TILE_SIZE * 4
125: hp(q, r) = { x: S*√3*(q+r/2), y: S*1.5*r }  // matches hexToPixel(q,r,80)
126: EARTH_POS = hp(0,0) = {x:0, y:0}      // spiral position 0
127: PLAYER_POS = hp(1,0) = {x:138.6, y:0} // NOT used for auto-placement (removed)
128: ```
129: 
130: ### Deck override
131: Set `window.tutorialDeckOverride = ['earth','catacomb','water','fire','wind','void']` BEFORE `startGame()`. `initializeDeck()` checks this and returns early after applying it. The override is nulled after use.
132: 
133: ---

 43: // Helper to convert Roman numerals
 44: function toRoman(num) {
 45:     const romans = ['I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V'];
 46:     return romans[num - 1] || num.toString();
 47: }
 48: 
 49: // Helper function to rotate hex coordinate by 60 degrees
 50: function rotateHex(q, r, steps) {
 51:     let nq = q, nr = r;
 52:     for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
 53:         const tempQ = nq;
 54:         nq = -nr;
 55:         nr = -(-tempQ - nr);
 56:     }
 57:     return { q: nq, r: nr };
 58: }

119: // Generate elemental scroll definitions
120: function generateElementalScrolls() {
121:     const scrolls = {};
122:     const elementTypes = ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void'];
123:     const patternLevels = [LEVEL_1_PATTERNS, LEVEL_2_PATTERNS, LEVEL_3_PATTERNS, LEVEL_4_PATTERNS, LEVEL_5_PATTERNS];
124: 
125:     elementTypes.forEach(element => {
126:         patternLevels.forEach((patterns, level) => {
127:             const scrollName = `${element.toUpperCase()}_SCROLL_${level + 1}`;
128: 
129:             // Check for custom effect definitions
130:             let name, description, isCounter = false;
131:             const effectMaps = {
132:                 earth: EARTH_SCROLL_EFFECTS,
133:                 water: WATER_SCROLL_EFFECTS,
134:                 fire: FIRE_SCROLL_EFFECTS,
135:                 wind: WIND_SCROLL_EFFECTS,
136:                 void: VOID_SCROLL_EFFECTS
137:             };
138: 
139:             let isResponse = false;
140:             if (effectMaps[element] && effectMaps[element][level + 1]) {
141:                 const effect = effectMaps[element][level + 1];
142:                 name = effect.name;
143:                 description = effect.description;
144:                 isCounter = effect.isCounter || false;
145:                 isResponse = effect.isResponse || false;
146:             } else {
147:                 name = `${element.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + element.slice(1)} Scroll ${toRoman(level + 1)}`;
148:                 description = `Stand in pattern to gain +${level + 1} ${element} stones (2 AP)`;
149:             }
150: 
151:             scrolls[scrollName] = {
152:                 name: name,
153:                 description: description,
154:                 level: level + 1,
155:                 element: element,
156:                 patterns: patterns.map(pattern =>
157:                     pattern.map(pos => ({ ...pos, type: element }))
158:                 ),
159:                 // Earth I (Iron Stance) can counter any scroll
160:                 canCounter: isCounter ? 'any' : null,
161:                 // Fire I (Unbidden Lamplight) is a response scroll (shows in response window but doesn't cancel)
162:                 isResponse: isResponse,
163:                 hasEffect: !!(effectMaps[element] && effectMaps[element][level + 1]) // Flag to indicate this scroll has a special effect
164:             };
165:         });
166:     });
167: 
168:     return scrolls;
169: }

 10:         'step_cloth2.ogg',
 11:         'step_cloth3.ogg',
 12:         'step_cloth4.ogg',
 13:         'step_lth1.ogg',
 14:         'step_lth2.ogg',
 15:         'step_lth33.ogg',
 16:         'step_lth4.ogg',
 17:         'step_metal.ogg',
 18:         'step_metal (2).ogg',
 19:         'step_metal (3).ogg',
 20:         'step_metal (4).ogg',
 21:     ];
 22: 
 23:     const SOUNDS = {
 24:         click:          BASE + 'clicksounds.mp3',
 25:         zipclick:       BASE + 'zipclick.mp3',
 26:         error:          BASE + 'error.mp3',
 27:         activatescroll: BASE + 'activatescroll.mp3',
 28:         breakstone:     BASE + 'breakstone.mp3',
 29:         collectstones:  BASE + 'collectstones.mp3',
 30:         endturn:        BASE + 'endturn.mp3',
 31:         placeearthstone: BASE + 'placeearthstone.mp3',
 32:         placestone:      BASE + 'placestone.mp3',
 33:         placetile:      BASE + 'placetile.mp3',
 34:         scrollmove:     BASE + 'scrollmove.mp3',
 35:         tilereveal:     BASE + 'tilereveal.mp3',
 36:         wincondition:   BASE + 'wincondition.mp3',
 37:         fireactivates:  BASE + 'fireactivates.mp3',
 38:         wateractivates: BASE + 'wateractivates.mp3',
 39:         windactivates:  BASE + 'windactivates.mp3',
 40:         voidactivates:  BASE + 'voidactivates.mp3',
 41:     };
 42: 
 43:     // Element-specific win-condition sounds; earth and catacomb fall back to generic
 44:     const ELEMENT_WIN_SOUNDS = {
 45:         fire:     'fireactivates',
 46:         water:    'wateractivates',
 47:         wind:     'windactivates',
 48:         void:     'voidactivates',
 49:         earth:    'wincondition',
 50:         catacomb: 'wincondition',
 51:     };
 52: 
 53:     // Sounds that belong to the UI channel (settings → UI Sounds toggle)
 54:     // Everything else belongs to the game channel (settings → Game Sounds toggle)
 55:     const UI_SOUNDS = new Set(['click', 'zipclick', 'error']);
 56: 
 57:     let footstepIndex = 0;
 58:     let winConditionLastPlayed = 0; // debounce — prevent double-fire within same cast
 59: 
 60:     function _isEnabled(name) {
 61:         if (UI_SOUNDS.has(name)) return window.uiSoundEnabled !== false;
 62:         return window.gameSoundEnabled !== false;
 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     function play(name, volume = 1.0) {
 66:         if (!_isEnabled(name)) return;
 67:         const src = SOUNDS[name];
 68:         if (!src) { console.warn(`SoundSystem: unknown sound "${name}"`); return; }
 69:         const audio = new Audio(src);
 70:         audio.volume = volume;
 71:         audio.play().catch(() => {}); // silently ignore autoplay policy blocks
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     function playFootstep() {
 75:         if (window.gameSoundEnabled === false) return;
 76:         const file = FOOTSTEP_FILES[footstepIndex % FOOTSTEP_FILES.length];
 77:         footstepIndex++;
 78:         const audio = new Audio(FOOTSTEP_DIR + file);
 79:         audio.volume = 0.7;
 80:         audio.play().catch(() => {});
 81:     }
 82: 
 83:     // Plays the element-specific win-condition sound (debounced so multi-add calls in one cast only fire once)
 84:     function onWinCondition(element) {
 85:         if (window.gameSoundEnabled === false) return;
 86:         const now = Date.now();
 87:         if (now - winConditionLastPlayed < 300) return;
 88:         winConditionLastPlayed = now;
 89:         const soundName = ELEMENT_WIN_SOUNDS[element] || 'wincondition';
 90:         play(soundName);
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     window.SoundSystem = { play, playFootstep, onWinCondition };
 94: 
 95:     // ── Login screen music ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 96:     // Strategy: start the audio MUTED immediately (browsers allow muted autoplay
 97:     // without any user gesture), then unmute on the first interaction. This
 98:     // guarantees the track is already buffered and in-sync the moment it becomes
 99:     // audible — no waiting, no race conditions.
100:     (function initLoginMusic() {
101:         const MUSIC_SRC = 'sounds/music/LoginScreen.intropage.mp3';
102:         let _track          = null;
103:         let _cancelPending  = null; // cancels any pending gesture-start listener
104: 
105:         function _makeTrack() {
106:             const a = new Audio(MUSIC_SRC);
107:             a.loop   = true;
108:             a.volume = 0.45;
109:             return a;
110:         }
111: 
112:         // Cancel any gesture listener that hasn't fired yet (called before fade/stop)
113:         function _clearPending() {
114:             if (_cancelPending) { _cancelPending(); _cancelPending = null; }
115:         }
116: 
117:         // Unmute the track on the next user gesture (called after muted autoplay succeeds)
118:         function _waitForGestureToUnmute() {
119:             const unmute = () => {
120:                 document.removeEventListener('click',   unmute);
121:                 document.removeEventListener('keydown', unmute);
122:                 if (_track) _track.muted = false;
123:             };
124:             document.addEventListener('click',   unmute);
125:             document.addEventListener('keydown', unmute);
126:         }
127: 
128:         function startMusic() {
129:             if (window.musicEnabled === false) return;
130:             if (_track) return; // already running
131:             _clearPending();
132:             _track = _makeTrack();
133:             _track.muted = true; // start silent — no gesture required
134: 
135:             _track.play().then(() => {
136:                 // Muted autoplay succeeded: unmute on first interaction
137:                 _waitForGestureToUnmute();
138:             }).catch(() => {
139:                 // Even muted autoplay was blocked (rare) — start + unmute on gesture
140:                 _track = null;
141:                 const startOnGesture = () => {
142:                     _cancelPending = null;
143:                     document.removeEventListener('click',   startOnGesture);
144:                     document.removeEventListener('keydown', startOnGesture);
145:                     // Abort if lobby is gone or music was disabled while waiting
146:                     const lw = document.getElementById('lobby-wrapper');
147:                     if (!lw || lw.style.display === 'none') return;
148:                     if (window.musicEnabled === false) return;
149:                     _track = _makeTrack();
150:                     _track.play().catch(() => {});
151:                 };
152:                 // Store cancel fn so fadeOutMusic/stopMusic can clean this up
153:                 _cancelPending = () => {
154:                     document.removeEventListener('click',   startOnGesture);
155:                     document.removeEventListener('keydown', startOnGesture);
156:                 };
157:                 document.addEventListener('click',   startOnGesture);
158:                 document.addEventListener('keydown', startOnGesture);
159:             });
160:         }
161: 
162:         function stopMusic() {
163:             _clearPending();
164:             if (!_track) return;
165:             _track.pause();
166:             _track.currentTime = 0;
167:             _track = null;
168:         }
169: 
170:         // Smoothly fade the music out over `ms` milliseconds then stop it.
171:         // If the track is still muted (gesture never happened) just stop silently.
172:         function fadeOutMusic(ms = 1200) {
173:             _clearPending(); // always cancel pending start, even if no track
174:             if (!_track) return;
175:             if (_track.muted || _track.paused) { stopMusic(); return; }
176:             const dying = _track;
177:             _track = null;
178:             const startVol  = dying.volume;
179:             const startTime = performance.now();
180:             function step(now) {
181:                 const elapsed  = now - startTime;
182:                 const progress = Math.min(elapsed / ms, 1);
183:                 dying.volume   = startVol * (1 - progress);
184:                 if (progress < 1) {
185:                     requestAnimationFrame(step);
186:                 } else {
187:                     dying.pause();
188:                     dying.currentTime = 0;
189:                 }
190:             }
191:             requestAnimationFrame(step);
192:         }
193: 
194:         // Expose for external control
195:         window.SoundSystem.startLoginMusic   = startMusic;
196:         window.SoundSystem.stopLoginMusic    = stopMusic;
197:         window.SoundSystem.fadeOutLoginMusic = fadeOutMusic;
198: 
199:         // Watch the lobby-wrapper: fade out when game starts, restart on return
200:         function watchLobbyVisibility() {
201:             const lw = document.getElementById('lobby-wrapper');
202:             if (!lw) return;
203:             new MutationObserver(() => {
204:                 if (lw.style.display === 'none') {
205:                     fadeOutMusic();
206:                 } else {
207:                     startMusic();
208:                 }
209:             }).observe(lw, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] });
210:         }
211: 
212:         if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
213:             document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
214:                 startMusic();
215:                 watchLobbyVisibility();
216:             });
217:         } else {
218:             startMusic();
219:             watchLobbyVisibility();
220:         }
221:     })();
222: 
223:     console.log('🔊 SoundSystem loaded');
224: })();
</file>

  9: /** Toggle the profile panel open / closed */
 10: function gami_openPanel() {
 11:     const existing = document.getElementById('gami-panel');
 12:     if (existing) { existing.remove(); return; }
 13:     if (!window.gami?.userId) return;
 14: 
 15:     const overlay = document.createElement('div');
 16:     overlay.id        = 'gami-panel';
 17:     overlay.className = 'gami-overlay';
 18:     overlay.innerHTML = `
 19:         <div class="gami-modal" role="dialog" aria-label="Profile panel">
 20:             <div class="gami-header">
 21:                 <h2 class="gami-title">Profile</h2>
 22:                 <button class="gami-close" aria-label="Close" onclick="document.getElementById('gami-panel').remove()">×</button>
 23:             </div>
 24:             <div class="gami-tabs" role="tablist">
 25:                 <button class="gami-tab active" role="tab" onclick="gami_switchTab('profile')">Stats</button>
 26:                 <button class="gami-tab"        role="tab" onclick="gami_switchTab('cosmetics')">Colours</button>
 27:                 <button class="gami-tab"        role="tab" onclick="gami_switchTab('emojis')">Emojis</button>
 28:                 <button class="gami-tab"        role="tab" onclick="gami_switchTab('badges')">Badges</button>
 29:                 <button class="gami-tab"        role="tab" onclick="gami_switchTab('leaderboard')">Board</button>
 30:                 <button class="gami-tab"        role="tab" onclick="gami_switchTab('settings')">Settings</button>
 31:             </div>
 32:             <div id="gami-content" class="gami-content">
 33:                 <div class="gami-loading">Loading…</div>
 34:             </div>
 35:         </div>
 36:     `;
 37: 
 38:     overlay.addEventListener('click', e => {
 39:         if (e.target === overlay) overlay.remove();
 40:     });
 41: 
 42:     document.body.appendChild(overlay);
 43:     gami_switchTab('profile');
 44: }

 46: /** Open the panel directly on the Settings tab (usable from in-game HUD) */
 47: function gami_openSettings() {
 48:     const existing = document.getElementById('gami-panel');
 49:     if (existing) {
 50:         // Panel already open — if we're already on settings, close it; otherwise switch to it
 51:         const activeTab = existing.querySelector('.gami-tab.active');
 52:         if (activeTab && activeTab.textContent.trim() === 'Settings') {
 53:             existing.remove();
 54:         } else {
 55:             gami_switchTab('settings');
 56:         }
 57:         return;
 58:     }
 59:     // Open panel, but land on settings tab instead of profile
 60:     gami_openPanel();
 61:     // gami_openPanel ends on 'profile'; immediately switch to settings
 62:     gami_switchTab('settings');
 63: }

 65: /** Switch the active tab and load its content */
 66: async function gami_switchTab(tab) {
 67:     const panel = document.getElementById('gami-panel');
 68:     if (!panel) return;
 69: 
 70:     const tabs   = panel.querySelectorAll('.gami-tab');
 71:     const tabIdx = ['profile', 'cosmetics', 'emojis', 'badges', 'leaderboard', 'settings'].indexOf(tab);
 72:     tabs.forEach((btn, i) => btn.classList.toggle('active', i === tabIdx));
 73: 
 74:     const content = document.getElementById('gami-content');
 75:     content.innerHTML = '<div class="gami-loading">Loading…</div>';
 76: 
 77:     try {
 78:         if      (tab === 'profile')     await _renderProfile(content);
 79:         else if (tab === 'cosmetics')        _renderCosmetics(content);
 80:         else if (tab === 'emojis')           _renderEmojis(content);
 81:         else if (tab === 'badges')      await _renderBadges(content);
 82:         else if (tab === 'settings')         _renderSettings(content);
 83:         else                            await _renderLeaderboard(content);
 84:     } catch (err) {
 85:         console.error('[gami-ui] render error:', err);
 86:         content.innerHTML = '<div class="gami-loading">Failed to load. Please try again.</div>';
 87:     }
 88: }

 92: async function _renderProfile(content) {
 93:     const profile = await window.gami.getProfile();
 94:     if (!profile) {
 95:         content.innerHTML = '<div class="gami-loading">Could not load profile.</div>';
 96:         return;
 97:     }
 98: 
 99:     const xpIntoLevel = profile.total_xp % 1000;
100:     const xpPercent   = Math.round(xpIntoLevel / 10);
101:     const stats       = profile.stats || {};
102:     const winRate     = stats.games_played > 0
103:         ? Math.round((stats.games_won / stats.games_played) * 100)
104:         : 0;
105:     const earnedCount = (profile.badges_earned || []).length;
106: 
107:     content.innerHTML = `
108:         <div class="gami-profile-row">
109:             <div class="gami-level-badge">
110:                 <span class="gami-level-num">${profile.current_level}</span>
111:                 <span class="gami-level-label">Level</span>
112:             </div>
113:             <div class="gami-profile-info">
114:                 <div class="gami-display-name">${_esc(profile.display_name)}</div>
115:                 <div class="gami-xp-bar-wrap">
116:                     <div class="gami-xp-bar" style="width:${xpPercent}%"></div>
117:                 </div>
118:                 <div class="gami-xp-text">${xpIntoLevel.toLocaleString()} / 1,000 XP to next level</div>
119:             </div>
120:         </div>
121: 
122:         <div class="gami-stats-grid">
123:             <div class="gami-stat">
124:                 <span class="gami-stat-val">${(profile.total_xp || 0).toLocaleString()}</span>
125:                 <span class="gami-stat-lbl">Total XP</span>
126:             </div>
127:             <div class="gami-stat">
128:                 <span class="gami-stat-val">${(profile.gold || 0).toLocaleString()}</span>
129:                 <span class="gami-stat-lbl">Gold</span>
130:             </div>
131:             <div class="gami-stat">
132:                 <span class="gami-stat-val">${stats.games_played || 0}</span>
133:                 <span class="gami-stat-lbl">Games Played</span>

137:                 <span class="gami-stat-lbl">Games Won</span>

140:                 <span class="gami-stat-val">${winRate}%</span>

309:                 <span class="gami-lb-name">${_esc(row.display_name)}</span>
310:                 <span class="gami-lb-xp">${(row.total_xp || 0).toLocaleString()} XP</span>
311:                 <span class="gami-lb-level">Lv.${row.current_level}</span>
312:             </div>
313:         `;
314:     }).join('');
315: 
316:     content.innerHTML = `<div class="gami-leaderboard">${items}</div>`;
317: }

321: async function loadMainLeaderboard() {
322:     const el = document.getElementById('main-leaderboard-body');
323:     if (!el) return;
324:     el.innerHTML = '<div class="gami-loading">Loading…</div>';
325: 
326:     const raw = await window.gami?.getLeaderboard(20);
327:     const rows = (raw || []).filter(r => (r.total_xp || 0) > 0).slice(0, 10);
328:     if (!rows.length) {
329:         el.innerHTML = '<div class="gami-loading" style="padding:12px;">No ranked players yet.</div>';
330:         return;
331:     }
332: 
333:     const medals = ['#1', '#2', '#3'];
334:     el.innerHTML = rows.map((row, i) => {
335:         const isMe = row.user_id === window.gami.userId;
336:         const rank = medals[i] || `#${i + 1}`;
337:         return `
338:             <div class="gami-lb-row ${isMe ? 'gami-lb-me' : ''}">
339:                 <span class="gami-lb-rank">${rank}</span>
340:                 <span class="gami-lb-name">${_esc(row.display_name)}</span>
341:                 <span class="gami-lb-xp">${(row.total_xp || 0).toLocaleString()} XP</span>
342:                 <span class="gami-lb-level">Lv.${row.current_level}</span>
343:             </div>`;
344:     }).join('');
345: }

499: function _gami_toggleCrt(key, btn) {
500:     if (!window.crtOverlay) return;
501:     const newVal = !window.crtOverlay.getOptions()[key];
502:     window.crtOverlay.setOption(key, newVal);
503:     window.crtOverlay.saveForUser(window.gami?.userId || null);
504:     btn.textContent = newVal ? 'ON' : 'OFF';
505:     btn.className   = `gami-toggle ${newVal ? 'on' : 'off'}`;
506: }
507: 
508: function _gami_toggleJoytoneMute(btn) {
509:     const newMuted = !window.JoytoneBridge?.isMuted();
510:     window.JoytoneBridge?.setMuted(newMuted);
511:     btn.textContent = newMuted ? 'OFF' : 'ON';
512:     btn.className   = `gami-toggle ${newMuted ? 'off' : 'on'}`;
513: }
514: 
515: function _gami_joytoneVolume(input) {
516:     window.JoytoneBridge?.setVolume((+input.value || 0) / 100);
517: }
518: 
519: function _gami_toggleSetting(key, btn) {
520:     const current = localStorage.getItem(`godaigo_${key}`) !== 'false';
521:     const newVal  = !current;
522:     localStorage.setItem(`godaigo_${key}`, newVal ? 'true' : 'false');
523:     if (key === 'ui_sound')   window.uiSoundEnabled   = newVal;
524:     if (key === 'game_sound') window.gameSoundEnabled = newVal;
525:     if (key === 'music') {
526:         window.musicEnabled = newVal;
527:         if (!newVal) {
528:             window.SoundSystem?.fadeOutLoginMusic();
529:         } else {
530:             // Only restart if currently on the lobby/login screen
531:             const lw = document.getElementById('lobby-wrapper');
532:             if (lw && lw.style.display !== 'none') {
533:                 window.SoundSystem?.startLoginMusic();
534:             }
535:         }
536:     }
537:     btn.textContent = newVal ? 'ON' : 'OFF';
538:     btn.className   = `gami-toggle ${newVal ? 'on' : 'off'}`;
539: }

541: // ── Utility ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
542: 
543: function _esc(str) {
544:     if (!str) return '';
545:     return String(str)
546:         .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
547:         .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
548:         .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
549:         .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
550: }

<file path="js/scroll-panels.js">
  1: // ============================================
  2: // FLOATING SCROLL PANELS
  3: // ============================================
  4: // Three independently floating panels: Hand | Active | Common
  5: // Each is draggable, resizable, and collapsible.
  6: // Replaces spellSystem.showInventory() modal.
  7: // Triggered by #scroll-inventory dock button.
  8: // ============================================
  9: 
 10: const ScrollPanelSystem = (() => {
 11:     'use strict';
 12: 
 13:     // ---- Config ----
 14:     const CAPACITY    = { hand: 2, active: 2, common: 5 };
 15:     const STORAGE_KEY = 'godaigo_scroll_panels_v8';  // bumped — cards flex column, height 400, autofit on by default
 16:     const EL_COLORS   = {
 17:         earth: '#69d83a', water: '#5894f4', fire: '#ed1b43',
 18:         wind: '#ffce00', void: '#9458f4', catacomb: '#9b59b6'
 19:     };
 20: 
 21:     // Default positions — hand/active stacked left, common to the right
 22:     const DEFAULTS = {
 23:         hand:   { x: 20,  y: 100, w: 520, h: 420, collapsed: false, autofit: true },
 24:         active: { x: 20,  y: 540, w: 520, h: 420, collapsed: false, autofit: true },
 25:         common: { x: 560, y: 100, w: 760, h: 420, collapsed: false, autofit: true }
 26:     };
 27: 
 28:     const panels = {};      // { id → { el, state, open } }
 29:     let initialized = false;
 30: 
 31:     // ---- Persistence ----
 32:     function loadStored() {
 33:         try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)) || {}; } catch { return {}; }
 34:     }
 35:     function saveState() {
 36:         const out = {};
 37:         Object.keys(panels).forEach(id => { out[id] = { ...panels[id].state }; });
 38:         try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(out)); } catch {}
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     // ---- Panel creation ----
 42:     function createPanel(id, title) {
 43:         const stored = loadStored()[id] || {};
 44:         const state  = { ...DEFAULTS[id], ...stored };
 45:         panels[id]   = { el: null, state, open: false };
 46: 
 47:         const el = document.createElement('div');
 48:         el.className    = 'fsp';
 49:         el.id           = 'fsp-' + id;
 50:         el.dataset.panel = id;
 51:         el.style.cssText = `left:${state.x}px; top:${state.y}px; width:${state.w}px;`;
 52:         if (!state.collapsed) el.style.height = state.h + 'px';
 53: 
 54:         el.innerHTML = `
 55:             <div class="fsp-header" data-drag-handle>
 56:                 <span class="fsp-title">${title}</span>
 57:                 <span class="fsp-badge" id="fsp-badge-${id}">0/0</span>
 58:                 <button class="fsp-btn fsp-autofit-btn"  title="Auto-fit height to content">↕</button>
 59:                 <button class="fsp-btn fsp-collapse-btn" title="Collapse / expand">−</button>
 60:                 <button class="fsp-btn fsp-close-btn"    title="Close">✕</button>
 61:             </div>
 62:             <div class="fsp-body" id="fsp-body-${id}"></div>
 63:             <div class="fsp-resize-handle" title="Drag to resize"></div>
 64:         `;
 65: 
 66:         document.body.appendChild(el);
 67:         panels[id].el = el;
 68: 
 69:         // Apply saved collapsed state
 70:         if (state.collapsed) _applyCollapsed(id, true);
 71: 
 72:         // Wire buttons
 73:         el.querySelector('.fsp-close-btn').addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); closePanel(id); });
 74:         el.querySelector('.fsp-collapse-btn').addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleCollapse(id); });
 75: 
 76:         const autofitBtn = el.querySelector('.fsp-autofit-btn');
 77:         if (state.autofit !== false) autofitBtn.classList.add('fsp-autofit-active');
 78:         autofitBtn.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); setAutofit(id, !panels[id].state.autofit); });
 79: 
 80:         // Hide resize handle immediately if autofit is on and panel isn't collapsed
 81:         if (state.autofit !== false && !state.collapsed) {
 82:             const handle = el.querySelector('.fsp-resize-handle');
 83:             if (handle) handle.style.display = 'none';
 84:         }
 85: 
 86:         // Drag & resize
 87:         _makeDraggable(el, el.querySelector('[data-drag-handle]'), id);
 88:         _makeResizable(el, el.querySelector('.fsp-resize-handle'), id);
 89: 
 90:         return el;
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     // ---- Drag ----
 94:     function _makeDraggable(panel, handle, id) {
 95:         let ox, oy, ol, ot, active = false;
 96: 
 97:         handle.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
 98:             if (e.button !== 0) return;
 99:             if (e.target.classList.contains('fsp-btn')) return;
100:             active = true;
101:             ox = e.clientX; oy = e.clientY;
102:             ol = parseInt(panel.style.left) || 0;
103:             ot = parseInt(panel.style.top)  || 0;
104:             panel.style.transition = 'none';
105:             document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
106:             e.preventDefault();
107:         });
108: 
109:         const onMove = e => {
110:             if (!active) return;
111:             const nx = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerWidth  - 60, ol + (e.clientX - ox)));
112:             const ny = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 40, ot + (e.clientY - oy)));
113:             panel.style.left = nx + 'px';
114:             panel.style.top  = ny + 'px';
115:         };
116:         const onUp = () => {
117:             if (!active) return;
118:             active = false;
119:             document.body.style.userSelect = '';
120:             panels[id].state.x = parseInt(panel.style.left);
121:             panels[id].state.y = parseInt(panel.style.top);
122:             saveState();
123:         };
124: 
125:         document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
126:         document.addEventListener('mouseup',   onUp);
127:     }
128: 
129:     // ---- Resize ----
130:     function _makeResizable(panel, handle, id) {
131:         let sx, sy, sw, sh, active = false;
132: 
133:         handle.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
134:             e.stopPropagation();
135:             active = true;
136:             sx = e.clientX; sy = e.clientY;
137:             sw = panel.offsetWidth; sh = panel.offsetHeight;
138:             panel.style.transition = 'none';
139:             document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
140:             e.preventDefault();
141:         });
142: 
143:         const onMove = e => {
144:             if (!active) return;
145:             const w = Math.max(180, sw + (e.clientX - sx));
146:             const h = Math.max(100, sh + (e.clientY - sy));
147:             panel.style.width  = w + 'px';
148:             panel.style.height = h + 'px';
149:         };
150:         const onUp = () => {
151:             if (!active) return;
152:             active = false;
153:             document.body.style.userSelect = '';
154:             panels[id].state.w = panel.offsetWidth;
155:             panels[id].state.h = panel.offsetHeight;
156:             saveState();
157:         };
158: 
159:         document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
160:         document.addEventListener('mouseup',   onUp);
161:     }
162: 
163:     // ---- Collapse ----
164:     function _applyCollapsed(id, collapsed) {
165:         const { el, state } = panels[id];
166:         state.collapsed = collapsed;
167:         const body   = document.getElementById('fsp-body-' + id);
168:         const handle = el.querySelector('.fsp-resize-handle');
169:         const btn    = el.querySelector('.fsp-collapse-btn');
170:         if (collapsed) {
171:             if (body)   body.style.display   = 'none';
172:             if (handle) handle.style.display = 'none';
173:             if (btn)    btn.textContent       = '+';
174:             el.style.height = '';
175:         } else {
176:             if (body)   body.style.display   = '';
177:             if (handle) handle.style.display = (state.autofit !== false) ? 'none' : '';
178:             if (btn)    btn.textContent       = '−';
179:             if (state.h) el.style.height = state.h + 'px';
180:         }
181:     }
182:     function toggleCollapse(id) {
183:         _applyCollapsed(id, !panels[id].state.collapsed);
184:         saveState();
185:     }
186: 
187:     // ---- Open / close ----
188:     function openPanel(id) {
189:         const p = panels[id];
190:         if (!p) return;
191:         p.open = true;
192:         p.el.style.display = 'flex';
193:         renderPanel(id);
194:     }
195: 
196:     function closePanel(id) {
197:         const p = panels[id];
198:         if (!p) return;
199:         p.open = false;
200:         p.el.style.display = 'none';
201:     }
202: 
203:     function toggle() {
204:         const anyOpen = Object.values(panels).some(p => p.open);
205:         if (anyOpen) {
206:             Object.keys(panels).forEach(closePanel);
207:         } else {
208:             Object.keys(panels).forEach(openPanel);
209:         }
210:     }
211: 
212:     // ---- Capacity badge + glow ----
213:     function _updateBadge(id, current, max) {
214:         const badge = document.getElementById('fsp-badge-' + id);
215:         if (badge) badge.textContent = current + '/' + max;
216:         const header = panels[id]?.el?.querySelector('.fsp-header');
217:         if (header) header.classList.toggle('fsp-over-capacity', current > max);
218:     }
219: 
220:     // ---- Scroll card builder ----
221:     const ROMAN = ['', 'I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V'];
222: 
223:     function _buildCard(scrollName, area) {
224:         const sp = window.spellSystem;
225:         if (!sp) return null;
226: 
227:         const def = sp.patterns?.[scrollName] || window.SCROLL_DEFINITIONS?.[scrollName];
228:         if (!def) return null;
229: 
230:         const element  = typeof sp.getScrollElement === 'function'
231:             ? sp.getScrollElement(scrollName) : 'earth';
232:         const color    = EL_COLORS[element] || '#aaa';
233:         const iconSrc  = window.STONE_TYPES?.[element]?.img || '';
234:         const elLabel  = element ? element.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + element.slice(1) : '';
235:         const lvLabel  = def.level ? 'Lv. ' + (ROMAN[def.level] || def.level) : '';
236: 
237:         const canModify = (typeof isMultiplayer === 'undefined' || !isMultiplayer)
238:             || (typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' && typeof activePlayerIndex !== 'undefined'
239:                 && myPlayerIndex === activePlayerIndex);
240: 
241:         const card = document.createElement('div');
242:         card.className = 'fsp-card';
243:         card.dataset.scrollName = scrollName;
244:         card.dataset.area = area;

415:     // ---- Autofit ----
416:     // Width  = body_padding + n_cards × card_width + (n_cards−1) × gap
417:     // Height = header_height + card_height + body_padding
418:     // AUTOFIT_CARD_H must stay in sync with CSS `.fsp-card { height: 280px }`

420:     const AUTOFIT_CARD_H = 400;  // must match CSS .fsp-card { height: 400px }

424:     function fitPanel(id) {
425:         const p      = panels[id];
426:         if (!p || !p.el || p.state.collapsed || p.state.autofit === false) return;
427:         const body   = document.getElementById('fsp-body-' + id);
428:         const header = p.el.querySelector('.fsp-header');
429:         if (!body || !header) return;
430: 
431:         // Count rendered cards (empty → 1 child fsp-empty div → minimum 1-card width)
432:         const n = Math.max(1, body.children.length);
433:         const w = AUTOFIT_PAD + n * AUTOFIT_CARD_W + (n - 1) * AUTOFIT_GAP;
434:         const h = header.offsetHeight + AUTOFIT_CARD_H + AUTOFIT_PAD;
435: 
436:         p.el.style.width  = w + 'px';
437:         p.el.style.height = h + 'px';
438:         p.state.w = w;
439:         p.state.h = h;
440:     }

456:         const sp   = window.spellSystem;

458:         if (!body || !sp) return;
459:

467:             if (!scrolls.length) { empty = true; body.innerHTML = '<div class="fsp-empty">Hand is empty</div>'; }
468:             else scrolls.forEach(n => { const c = _buildCard(n, 'hand');   if (c) frag.appendChild(c); });
469: 
470:         } else if (id === 'active') {
471:             const scrolls = [...(sp.activeScrolls || [])];
472:             _updateBadge('active', scrolls.length, CAPACITY.active);
473:             if (!scrolls.length) { empty = true; body.innerHTML = '<div class="fsp-empty">No active scrolls</div>'; }
474:             else scrolls.forEach(n => { const c = _buildCard(n, 'active'); if (c) frag.appendChild(c); });
475: 
476:         } else if (id === 'common') {
477:             const scrolls = typeof sp.getCommonAreaScrolls === 'function' ? sp.getCommonAreaScrolls() : [];
478:             _updateBadge('common', scrolls.length, CAPACITY.common);
479:             if (!scrolls.length) { empty = true; body.innerHTML = '<div class="fsp-empty">Common area is empty</div>'; }
480:             else scrolls.forEach(n => { const c = _buildCard(n, 'common'); if (c) frag.appendChild(c); });
481:         }
482: 
483:         if (!empty) body.appendChild(frag);
484:

486:         if (panels[id]?.state?.autofit !== false) fitPanel(id);

512:     function animateCardMove(srcEl, destPanelEl) {

542:                 'opacity 0.25s ease',

546:             ghost.style.top       = (toRect.top  + 8)  + 'px';
547:             ghost.style.opacity   = '0';

550:         }));

614:     // ---- Hover preview panel ----
615:     function _initCardHoverPreview() {
616:         const preview = document.createElement('div');
617:         preview.className = 'fsp-card-preview';
618:         preview.style.display = 'none';
619:         document.body.appendChild(preview);
620: 
621:         let hideTimer = null;
622:         let showTimer = null;
623:         let throbberEl = null;
624:         let currentCard = null; // track which card we're hovering so child mouseover events don't restart the timer
625: 
626:         function clearThrobber() {
627:             if (throbberEl) { throbberEl.remove(); throbberEl = null; }
628:         }
629: 
630:         function showPreview(card) {
631:             if (card === currentCard) return; // already tracking this card — don't restart the timer
632:             currentCard = card;
633:             clearTimeout(hideTimer);
634:             clearTimeout(showTimer);
635:             clearThrobber();
636: 
637:             // Show a small spinner on the card for 500ms before the preview appears
638:             const elColor = card.style.getPropertyValue('--el-color') || '#888';
639:             const cardRect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
640:             const dot = document.createElement('div');
641:             dot.style.cssText = `
642:                 position: fixed;
643:                 left: ${cardRect.right - 18}px;
644:                 top: ${cardRect.top + 6}px;
645:                 width: 12px; height: 12px;
646:                 border: 2px solid ${elColor}55;
647:                 border-top-color: ${elColor};
648:                 border-radius: 50%;
649:                 animation: scroll-popup-spin 0.5s linear infinite;
650:                 pointer-events: none;
651:                 z-index: 9999;
652:             `;
653:             document.body.appendChild(dot);
654:             throbberEl = dot;
655: 
656:             showTimer = setTimeout(() => {
657:                 clearThrobber();
658: 
659:             // Clone the card DOM (fast) then replace the pattern with a fresh
660:             // animated instance — cloneNode gives a static snapshot, not live animation
661:             const clone = card.cloneNode(true);
662:             clone.style.height = 'auto';   // preview is not height-constrained
663:             clone.querySelector('.fsp-card-actions')?.remove();
664:             const elColor = card.style.getPropertyValue('--el-color');
665:             if (elColor) clone.style.setProperty('--el-color', elColor);
666: 
667:             // Rebuild pattern visual so cycling animations run properly
668:             const scrollName = card.dataset.scrollName;
669:             const sp = window.spellSystem;
670:             if (scrollName && sp) {
671:                 const def = sp.patterns?.[scrollName] || window.SCROLL_DEFINITIONS?.[scrollName];
672:                 const element = typeof sp.getScrollElement === 'function'
673:                     ? sp.getScrollElement(scrollName) : 'earth';
674:                 const patWrap = clone.querySelector('.fsp-card-pattern');
675:                 if (patWrap && def?.patterns && typeof sp.createPatternVisual === 'function') {
676:                     patWrap.innerHTML = '';
677:                     try {
678:                         const freshVisual = sp.createPatternVisual(def, element);
679:                         patWrap.appendChild(freshVisual);
680:                     } catch (e) {}
681:                 }
682:             }
683: 
684:             preview.innerHTML = '';
685:             preview.appendChild(clone);
686:             preview.style.display = 'block';
687:             preview.style.setProperty('--el-color', elColor || '#888');
688: 
689:             // Position: prefer to the right of the parent panel; fall back to left
690:             const cardRect  = card.getBoundingClientRect();
691:             const panelEl   = card.closest('.fsp');
692:             const panelRect = panelEl ? panelEl.getBoundingClientRect() : cardRect;
693: 
694:             const previewW = 480;
695:             const gap      = 14;
696:             let left = panelRect.right + gap;
697:             if (left + previewW > window.innerWidth - 8) {
698:                 left = panelRect.left - previewW - gap;
699:             }
700:             let top = cardRect.top;
701:             // Keep preview within viewport vertically
702:             const maxTop = window.innerHeight - preview.offsetHeight - 8;
703:             if (top > maxTop) top = Math.max(8, maxTop);
704: 
705:             preview.style.left = left + 'px';
706:             preview.style.top  = top  + 'px';
707:             }, 500); // 500ms hover delay
708:         }
709: 
710:         function hidePreview() {
711:             currentCard = null;
712:             clearTimeout(showTimer);
713:             clearThrobber();
714:             hideTimer = setTimeout(() => { preview.style.display = 'none'; }, 80);
715:         }
716: 
717:         // Delegation — works for dynamically rendered cards
718:         document.addEventListener('mouseover', e => {
719:             const card = e.target.closest('.fsp-card');
720:             if (card && card.closest('.fsp')) {   // only cards inside a panel (not the preview itself)
721:                 showPreview(card);
722:             }
723:         });
724:         document.addEventListener('mouseout', e => {
725:             const card = e.target.closest('.fsp-card');
726:             if (card && card.closest('.fsp')) {
727:                 // Only hide when the mouse truly leaves the card, not when moving between child elements
728:                 const related = e.relatedTarget;
729:                 if (!related || !card.contains(related)) {
730:                     hidePreview();
731:                 }
732:             }
733:         });
734:         // Keep preview alive while the mouse is over it
735:         preview.addEventListener('mouseover', () => clearTimeout(hideTimer));
736:         preview.addEventListener('mouseout',  hidePreview);
737:     }
738: 
739:     // Boot after DOM ready
740:     if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
741:         document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
742:     } else {
743:         // DOMContentLoaded already fired; wait a tick for game-ui.js to set onclick
744:         setTimeout(init, 0);
745:     }
746: 
747:     return { init, toggle, refresh, openPanel, closePanel, animateCardMove, animateCardToDeck };
748: })();
