<file path="js/scrolls/response-window.js">
   1: /**
   2:  * Response Window System for Godaigo
   3:  *
   4:  * When a player casts a scroll, a "response window" opens allowing ALL other players
   5:  * with valid response scrolls to respond simultaneously. After all eligible players
   6:  * have either responded or passed, the winner is determined by element rank:
   7:  *   Void (5) > Wind (4) > Fire (3) > Water (2) > Earth (1)
   8:  * Only the highest-ranked response executes. Ties are impossible because each scroll
   9:  * exists only once in the game.
  10:  *
  11:  * New rule: A response scroll that is in a player's HAND can be moved to their active
  12:  * area during the response window, but only if they have an open active slot. The
  13:  * response window includes these hand scrolls as clickable options with a badge.
  14:  *
  15:  * Rules:
  16:  * - Response costs normal 2 AP
  17:  * - Responder must have valid scroll (active, common, or hand+open-slot) AND valid pattern
  18:  * - Earth I (Iron Stance) / Void I (Psychic) are counter scrolls — they cancel the original
  19:  * - All other response scrolls execute alongside the original
  20:  * - All non-caster players submit (respond or pass) before resolution begins
  21:  */
  22: 
  23: // Element rank for response arbitration: higher = wins over lower
  24: const ELEMENT_RANK = { void: 5, wind: 4, fire: 3, water: 2, earth: 1 };
  25: 
  26: /**
  27:  * Get the element rank for a scroll name like 'WIND_SCROLL_1' → 4
  28:  */
  29: function getScrollElementRank(scrollName) {
  30:     const element = (scrollName || '').split('_')[0].toLowerCase();
  31:     return ELEMENT_RANK[element] ?? 0;
  32: }
  33: 
  34: class ResponseWindowSystem {
  35:     constructor(spellSystem) {
  36:         this.spellSystem = spellSystem;
  37:         this.isResponseWindowOpen = false;
  38:         this.responseStack = []; // Stack of pending scroll casts
  39:         this.currentCaster = null; // Player who initiated the current scroll
  40:         this.pendingScrollData = null; // Data about the scroll being responded to
  41:         this.respondingPlayers = new Set(); // Players who have passed or responded
  42:         this.responseTimeout = null;
  43:         this.RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000; // 15 seconds to respond
  44:         this.responseModalElement = null;
  45:     }
  46: 
  47:     /**
  48:      * Check if a player can respond to a scroll
  49:      * @param {number} playerIndex - The player to check
  50:      * @returns {object} { canRespond: boolean, validScrolls: array, reason: string }
  51:      */
  52:     canPlayerRespond(playerIndex) {
  53:         // Determine player's available AP (responses may be free with buffs)
  54:         const playerAP = this.getPlayerAP(playerIndex);
  55: 
  56:         // Get player's active scrolls and common area scrolls
  57:         const playerScrolls = this.spellSystem.playerScrolls[playerIndex];
  58:         if (!playerScrolls) {
  59:             return { canRespond: false, validScrolls: [], reason: 'No scrolls available' };
  60:         }
  61: 
  62:         const activeScrolls = Array.from(playerScrolls.active || []);
  63:         const commonScrolls = this.spellSystem.getCommonAreaScrolls();
  64:         const allCastableScrolls = [...activeScrolls, ...commonScrolls];
  65:         // Note: do NOT early-return here when allCastableScrolls is empty —
  66:         // the player may still have a response scroll in their hand (checked below).
  67: 
  68:         // Check which scrolls have valid patterns on the board
  69:         const validScrolls = [];
  70:         const playerPos = this.getPlayerPosition(playerIndex);
  71: 
  72:         if (!playerPos) {
  73:             return { canRespond: false, validScrolls: [], reason: 'Player position not found' };
  74:         }
  75: 
  76:         for (const scrollName of allCastableScrolls) {
  77:             const patternOk = this.checkPatternForPlayer(scrollName, playerIndex);
  78:             if (patternOk) {
  79:                 const scrollDef = this.spellSystem.patterns[scrollName];
  80:                 const isCounter = scrollDef?.canCounter === 'any';
  81:                 const isResponse = scrollDef?.isResponse === true;
  82: 
  83:                 // Only include scrolls that are counter scrolls OR response scrolls
  84:                 // Regular scrolls can't be cast as responses
  85:                 if (isCounter || isResponse) {
  86:                     const cost = this.spellSystem?.getSpellCost ? this.spellSystem.getSpellCost(scrollDef, playerIndex) : 2;
  87:                     if (playerAP < cost) {
  88:                         console.log(`  ↳ ${scrollName}: pattern OK, isResponse=${isResponse} but can't afford (AP=${playerAP}, cost=${cost})`);
  89:                         continue;
  90:                     }
  91:                     validScrolls.push({
  92:                         name: scrollName,
  93:                         definition: scrollDef,
  94:                         isCounter: isCounter,
  95:                         isResponse: isResponse,
  96:                         fromCommonArea: commonScrolls.includes(scrollName),
  97:                         cost: cost
  98:                     });
  99:                 } else {
 100:                     console.log(`  ↳ ${scrollName}: pattern OK but not a counter/response scroll`);
 101:                 }
 102:             } else {
 103:                 console.log(`  ↳ ${scrollName}: pattern NOT matched for player ${playerIndex}`);
 104:             }
 105:         }
 106: 
 107:         // Also check hand scrolls — usable if active area has an open slot
 108:         // (new rule: response scrolls in hand can be moved to active during the response window)
 109:         const hasOpenActiveSlot = (playerScrolls.active?.size ?? 0) < (this.spellSystem.MAX_ACTIVE_SIZE ?? 2);
 110:         if (hasOpenActiveSlot) {
 111:             for (const scrollName of (playerScrolls.hand || new Set())) {
 112:                 const patternOk = this.checkPatternForPlayer(scrollName, playerIndex);
 113:                 if (patternOk) {
 114:                     const scrollDef = this.spellSystem.patterns[scrollName];
 115:                     const isCounter = scrollDef?.canCounter === 'any';
 116:                     const isResponse = scrollDef?.isResponse === true;
 117:                     if (isCounter || isResponse) {
 118:                         const cost = this.spellSystem?.getSpellCost ? this.spellSystem.getSpellCost(scrollDef, playerIndex) : 2;
 119:                         if (playerAP < cost) {
 120:                             console.log(`  ↳ ${scrollName} (hand): pattern OK, isResponse=${isResponse} but can't afford (AP=${playerAP}, cost=${cost})`);
 121:                             continue;
 122:                         }
 123:                         validScrolls.push({
 124:                             name: scrollName,
 125:                             definition: scrollDef,
 126:                             isCounter,
 127:                             isResponse,
 128:                             fromCommonArea: false,
 129:                             fromHand: true,
 130:                             cost
 131:                         });
 132:                         console.log(`  ↳ ${scrollName} (hand): valid response — will move to active on use`);
 133:                     }
 134:                 }
 135:             }
 136:         }
 137: 
 138:         if (validScrolls.length === 0) {
 139:             return { canRespond: false, validScrolls: [], reason: `No valid responses you can afford (AP=${playerAP})` };
 140:         }
 141: 
 142:         return { canRespond: true, validScrolls, reason: null };
 143:     }
 144: 
 145:     /**
 146:      * Check whether a player qualifies for the bluff response window.
 147:      *
 148:      * A player can bluff when they have a hand scroll with a matching formation and
 149:      * enough AP to theoretically respond — even if their specific scroll is not a
 150:      * response or counter type. Showing the window lets them appear to consider a
 151:      * response without leaking that they actually cannot play one.
 152:      *
 153:      * Only meaningful in multiplayer (no hidden information in single-player).
 154:      *
 155:      * @param {number} playerIndex
 156:      * @returns {boolean}
 157:      */
 158:     canPlayerBluff(playerIndex) {
 159:         // Bluffing only matters in multiplayer — in single-player scroll contents are known
 160:         if (typeof isMultiplayer === 'undefined' || !isMultiplayer) return false;
 161: 
 162:         const playerAP = this.getPlayerAP(playerIndex);
 163:         if (playerAP < 2) return false;
 164: 
 165:         const playerScrolls = this.spellSystem.playerScrolls[playerIndex];
 166:         if (!playerScrolls) return false;
 167: 
 168:         const playerPos = this.getPlayerPosition(playerIndex);
 169:         if (!playerPos) return false;
 170: 
 171:         // Must have an open active slot (same condition as the hand-deploy rule, so
 172:         // the deception is plausible — they could theoretically move a scroll from hand)
 173:         const hasOpenActiveSlot = (playerScrolls.active?.size ?? 0) < (this.spellSystem.MAX_ACTIVE_SIZE ?? 2);
 174:         if (!hasOpenActiveSlot) return false;
 175: 
 176:         // Collect elements of scrolls in this player's hand
 177:         const handScrolls = [...(playerScrolls.hand || new Set())];
 178:         if (handScrolls.length === 0) return false;
 179: 
 180:         const handElements = new Set(
 181:             handScrolls.map(s => this.spellSystem.patterns?.[s]?.element).filter(Boolean)
 182:         );
 183: 
 184:         // The bluff is plausible when:
 185:         //   (a) the player has a hand scroll whose element matches a known response/counter scroll, AND
 186:         //   (b) that response/counter scroll's board pattern is currently formed for this player.
 187:         //
 188:         // Opponents see: "they have a [element] scroll in hand + that element's response formation is up."
 189:         // They cannot tell the specific scroll — hence the deception.
 190:         for (const [scrollName, scrollDef] of Object.entries(this.spellSystem.patterns || {})) {
 191:             const isCounter  = scrollDef?.canCounter === 'any';
 192:             const isResponse = scrollDef?.isResponse  === true;
 193:             if (!isCounter && !isResponse) continue;
 194:             if (!handElements.has(scrollDef.element)) continue;
 195:             if (this.checkPatternForPlayer(scrollName, playerIndex)) {
 196:                 return true;
 197:             }
 198:         }
 199:         return false;
 200:     }
 201: 
 202:     /**
 203:      * Check if any player can respond (used to skip response window)
 204:      * @param {number} excludePlayer - Player to exclude from check (the caster cannot respond to their own scroll)
 205:      * @returns {boolean}
 206:      */
 207:     canAnyPlayerRespond(excludePlayer = -1) {
 208:         const numPlayers = typeof playerPositions !== 'undefined' ? playerPositions.length : 0;
 209:         console.log(`Response window: checking ${numPlayers} players for valid responses (excluding player ${excludePlayer})`);
 210: 
 211:         for (let i = 0; i < numPlayers; i++) {
 212:             // Skip the caster - you cannot respond to your own scroll
 213:             if (i === excludePlayer) {
 214:                 console.log(`  Player ${i}: skipped (caster)`);
 215:                 continue;
 216:             }
 217:             const result = this.canPlayerRespond(i);
 218:             console.log(`  Player ${i}: canRespond=${result.canRespond}, reason=${result.reason || 'can respond'}, validScrolls=${result.validScrolls.length}`);
 219:             if (result.canRespond) {
 220:                 return true;
 221:             }
 222:         }
 223:         return false;
 224:     }
 225: 
 226:     /**
 227:      * Open response window after a scroll is cast
 228:      * @param {object} scrollData - Data about the cast scroll
 229:      * @param {number} casterIndex - Index of the player who cast the scroll
 230:      * @param {function} onComplete - Callback when response window closes
 231:      */
 232:     openResponseWindow(scrollData, casterIndex, onComplete) {
 233:         // Scroll definition opts out of response window entirely (e.g. Excavate)
 234:         const _castDef = this.spellSystem?.patterns?.[scrollData.name];
 235:         if (_castDef?.skipResponseWindow) {
 236:             console.log(`Response window skipped - ${scrollData.name} has skipResponseWindow`);
 237:             if (onComplete) onComplete({ skipped: true, responses: [] });
 238:             return;
 239:         }
 240: 
 241:         const numPlayers = typeof playerPositions !== 'undefined' ? playerPositions.length : 0;
 242:         const hasOtherPlayer = numPlayers > 1;
 243:         if (!hasOtherPlayer) {
 244:             console.log('Response window skipped - only one player');
 245:             if (onComplete) onComplete({ skipped: true, responses: [] });
 246:             return;
 247:         }
 248: 
 249:         // Quick check: can any non-caster player actually respond?
 250:         // In SINGLE-PLAYER we skip the response window when no one can respond.
 251:         // In MULTIPLAYER we do NOT skip here — this check runs on the caster's client
 252:         // using its local snapshot of opponent scroll state, which can lag behind due
 253:         // to in-flight `scroll-move` broadcasts. Skipping would block valid Iron Stance
 254:         // counters that arrived just before the winning scroll was cast.
 255:         // Each non-caster client already checks their own state locally inside
 256:         // showResponseModalForOtherPlayer() and auto-passes instantly if they can't
 257:         // respond, so no one is ever stuck waiting.
 258:         const _inMultiplayer = typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer;
 259:         if (!_inMultiplayer && !this.canAnyPlayerRespond(casterIndex)) {
 260:             console.log('Response window skipped - no player can respond (no valid counter/response scrolls)');
 261:             if (onComplete) onComplete({ skipped: true, responses: [] });
 262:             return;
 263:         }
 264: 
 265:         // Excavate: caster's scrolls cannot be responded to this turn
 266:         if (window.spellSystem?.scrollEffects?.hasExcavateNoResponse?.(casterIndex)) {
 267:             console.log('Response window skipped - caster has Excavate no-response buff');
 268:             if (onComplete) onComplete({ skipped: true, responses: [] });
 269:             return;
 270:         }
 271: 
 272:         this.isResponseWindowOpen = true;
 273:         this.currentCaster = casterIndex;
 274:         this.pendingScrollData = scrollData;
 275:         this.respondingPlayers.clear();
 276:         // The caster counts as already having "responded" (they cast the spell)
 277:         this.respondingPlayers.add(casterIndex);
 278:         this.responseStack = [{
 279:             scrollData,
 280:             casterIndex,
 281:             isOriginal: true
 282:         }];
 283: 
 284:         // Store callback
 285:         this.onCompleteCallback = onComplete;
 286: 
 287:         // Broadcast in multiplayer FIRST so other players see the window
 288:         if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer) {
 289:             this.broadcastResponseWindowOpened(scrollData, casterIndex);
 290:         }
 291: 
 292:         // For the caster, show "waiting for responses" instead of the response modal
 293:         const myIndex = typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' ? myPlayerIndex : activePlayerIndex;
 294:         if (myIndex === casterIndex) {
 295:             // Caster waits for others
 296:             this.showWaitingForResponses(scrollData);
 297:         } else {
 298:             // Non-caster sees the response modal
 299:             this.showResponseModal();
 300:         }
 301: 
 302:         // Start timeout timer
 303:         this.startResponseTimeout();
 304:     }

 578:     /**
 579:      * Create a scroll card for the response modal
 580:      */
 581:     createScrollCard(scrollInfo) {
 582:         const ROMAN = ['', 'I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V'];
 583:         const def = scrollInfo.definition;
 584:         const element = def?.element || 'earth';
 585:         const elementColor = this.getElementColor(element);
 586:         const iconSrc = window.STONE_TYPES?.[element]?.img || '';
 587:         const elLabel = element ? element.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + element.slice(1) : '';
 588:         const lvLabel = def?.level ? 'Lv. ' + (ROMAN[def.level] || def.level) : '';
 589:         const metaText = [elLabel, lvLabel].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
 590: 
 591:         // Determine border color based on scroll type
 592:         let borderColor = elementColor;
 593:         if (scrollInfo.isCounter) borderColor = '#e74c3c';
 594:         else if (scrollInfo.isResponse) borderColor = '#f39c12';
 595: 
 596:         const card = document.createElement('div');
 597:         Object.assign(card.style, {

 680:         const costDiv = document.createElement('div');

 691:     /**
 692:      * Handle player choosing to respond with a scroll.
 693:      * If the scroll is fromHand, it is moved to the active area first.
 694:      * Resolution is deferred until ALL eligible players have responded or passed.
 695:      */
 696:     playerResponds(scrollInfo) {
 697:         const myIndex = typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' ? myPlayerIndex : activePlayerIndex;
 698:         console.log(`playerResponds called: myIndex=${myIndex}, scroll=${scrollInfo.name}, fromHand=${scrollInfo.fromHand}`);
 699: 
 700:         // Double check they can still afford it
 701:         const myAP = this.getPlayerAP(myIndex);
 702:         const cost = (scrollInfo && typeof scrollInfo.cost === 'number')
 703:             ? scrollInfo.cost
 704:             : (this.spellSystem?.getSpellCost ? this.spellSystem.getSpellCost(scrollInfo.definition, myIndex) : 2);
 705:         console.log(`  Player AP: ${myAP}, cost=${cost}`);
 706:         if (myAP < cost) {
 707:             this.showResponseError(`Not enough AP! Need ${cost}, have ${myAP}`);
 708:             return;
 709:         }
 710: 
 711:         // If scroll is in hand, move it to active area now
 712:         if (scrollInfo.fromHand && this.spellSystem) {
 713:             const pScrolls = this.spellSystem.playerScrolls[myIndex];
 714:             if (pScrolls) {
 715:                 pScrolls.hand.delete(scrollInfo.name);
 716:                 pScrolls.active.add(scrollInfo.name);
 717:                 this.spellSystem.updateScrollCount();
 718:                 console.log(`  Moved ${scrollInfo.name} from hand to active area`);
 719:             }
 720:         }
 721: 
 722:         // Spend the AP for the response
 723:         this.spendPlayerAP(myIndex, cost);
 724:         console.log(`  Spent ${cost} AP for response`);
 725: 
 726:         // Add response to stack
 727:         this.responseStack.push({
 728:             scrollData: {
 729:                 name: scrollInfo.name,
 730:                 definition: scrollInfo.definition,
 731:                 fromCommonArea: scrollInfo.fromCommonArea || false
 732:             },
 733:             casterIndex: myIndex,
 734:             isCounter: scrollInfo.isCounter,
 735:             isResponse: scrollInfo.isResponse,
 736:             fromCommonArea: scrollInfo.fromCommonArea || false,
 737:             isOriginal: false
 738:         });
 739:         console.log(`  Added to response stack, stack size: ${this.responseStack.length}`);
 740: 
 741:         // Mark this player as submitted (same pool as passes)
 742:         this.respondingPlayers.add(myIndex);
 743: 
 744:         // Broadcast response in multiplayer (includes fromHand so receiver can sync state)
 745:         if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer) {
 746:             this.broadcastResponse(scrollInfo, myIndex);
 747:             console.log(`  Broadcasted response`);
 748:         }
 749: 
 750:         // Close the current modal and show "waiting" screen while others decide
 751:         this.closeResponseModal();
 752: 
 753:         const isCasterClient = !(typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer) || myIndex === this.currentCaster;
 754:         if (isCasterClient) {
 755:             // Wait for all other eligible players before arbitrating
 756:             console.log(`  Response submitted (caster client) — waiting for all players`);
 757:             this.checkAllPlayersResponded();
 758:         } else {
 759:             // Non-caster: sent our response, wait for caster to arbitrate and broadcast result
 760:             console.log(`  Response sent, waiting for caster to resolve`);
 761:             this.clearResponseTimeout();
 762:         }
 763:     }
 764: 
 765:     /**
 766:      * Handle player passing (no response)
 767:      */
 768:     playerPasses(playerIndex) {
 769:         this.respondingPlayers.add(playerIndex);
 770: 
 771:         // Broadcast pass in multiplayer
 772:         if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer) {
 773:             this.broadcastPass(playerIndex);
 774:         }
 775: 
 776:         const myIndex = typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' ? myPlayerIndex : null;
 777:         const isCasterClient = !isMultiplayer || myIndex === this.currentCaster;
 778: 
 779:         if (isCasterClient) {
 780:             // Caster's client: check if all non-casters have submitted
 781:             this.checkAllPlayersResponded();
 782:         } else {
 783:             // Non-caster's client: just close the modal and wait for
 784:             // the caster to resolve and broadcast 'response-resolved'
 785:             this.closeResponseModal();
 786:             this.clearResponseTimeout();
 787:         }
 788:     }

 922: 
 923:     /**
 924:      * Resolve the response stack (LIFO order)
 925:      * FIFO for resolution: responses resolve first, then original scroll
 926:      */
 927:     resolveResponseStack() {
 928:         this.clearResponseTimeout();
 929:         this.closeResponseModal();
 930: 
 931:         // Process stack - responses first, then original
 932:         const results = [];
 933:         let cancelled = false;
 934:         let originalScroll = null;
 935: 
 936:         // Separate responses from original
 937:         const responses = [];
 938:         while (this.responseStack.length > 0) {
 939:             const entry = this.responseStack.pop();
 940:             if (entry.isOriginal) {
 941:                 originalScroll = entry;
 942:             } else {
 943:                 responses.push(entry);
 944:             }
 945:         }
 946: 
 947:         // Process responses first (FIFO - they were added in order)
 948:         for (const entry of responses) {
 949:             const scrollDef = entry.scrollData?.definition || this.spellSystem?.patterns?.[entry.scrollData?.name];
 950: 
 951:             if (entry.isCounter) {
 952:                 // This is a counter - it cancels the original scroll
 953:                 cancelled = true;
 954:                 const counterEntry = {
 955:                     ...entry,
 956:                     result: 'countered-original'
 957:                 };
 958:                 results.push(counterEntry);
 959: 
 960:                 // AP was already spent when the counter was played (line ~439)
 961:                 // Do NOT spend again here — spendPlayerAP ignores playerIndex
 962:                 // and would charge the original caster's AP instead
 963: 
 964:                 if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.logScrollEvent) {
 965:                     window.logScrollEvent('response_counter', {
 966:                         casterIndex: entry.casterIndex,
 967:                         scrollName: entry.scrollData?.name,
 968:                         triggeringScroll: originalScroll?.scrollData?.name || null
 969:                     });
 970:                 }
 971: 
 972:                 // Execute the counter's effect (if any) — must pass counterEntry so
 973:                 // the scroll-resolved listener sees result === 'countered-original'
 974:                 this.executeScrollEffect(counterEntry, originalScroll);
 975:             } else if (entry.isResponse || scrollDef?.isResponse) {
 976:                 // This is a response scroll (like Unbidden Lamplight)
 977:                 // It executes but does NOT cancel the original
 978:                 const resolvedEntry = {
 979:                     ...entry,
 980:                     result: 'response-resolved'
 981:                 };
 982:                 results.push(resolvedEntry);
 983: 
 984:                 // AP was already spent when the response was played (line ~439)
 985:                 // Do NOT spend again here — spendPlayerAP ignores playerIndex
 986:                 // and would charge the original caster's AP instead
 987: 
 988:                 if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.logScrollEvent) {
 989:                     window.logScrollEvent('response_resolved', {
 990:                         casterIndex: entry.casterIndex,
 991:                         scrollName: entry.scrollData?.name,
 992:                         triggeringScroll: originalScroll?.scrollData?.name || null
 993:                     });
 994:                 }
 995: 
 996:                 // Execute the response scroll's effect, passing the original scroll info
 997:                 this.executeScrollEffect(resolvedEntry, originalScroll);
 998:             }
 999:         }
1000: 
1001:         // Now resolve the original scroll (if not cancelled)
1002:         if (originalScroll) {
1003:             if (cancelled) {
1004:                 if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.logScrollEvent) {
1005:                     window.logScrollEvent('original_countered', {
1006:                         casterIndex: originalScroll.casterIndex,
1007:                         scrollName: originalScroll.scrollData?.name
1008:                     });
1009:                 }
1010:                 results.push({
1011:                     ...originalScroll,
1012:                     result: 'countered'
1013:                 });
1014:             } else {
1015:                 if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.logScrollEvent) {
1016:                     window.logScrollEvent('original_resolved', {
1017:                         casterIndex: originalScroll.casterIndex,
1018:                         scrollName: originalScroll.scrollData?.name
1019:                     });
1020:                 }
1021:                 const originalResolvedEntry = { ...originalScroll, result: 'resolved' };
1022:                 results.push(originalResolvedEntry);
1023:                 this.executeScrollEffect(originalResolvedEntry, null);
1024:             }
1025:         }
1026: 
1027:         // Close response window state
1028:         this.isResponseWindowOpen = false;
1029:         this.pendingScrollData = null;
1030:         this.currentCaster = null;
1031: 
1032:         // Broadcast resolution to all clients so they close their windows
1033:         if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer) {
1034:             this.broadcastResponseResolved(results, originalScroll);
1035:         }
1036: 
1037:         // Call completion callback
1038:         if (this.onCompleteCallback) {
1039:             this.onCompleteCallback({
1040:                 skipped: false,
1041:                 responses: results
1042:             });
1043:         }
1044:     }
1045: 
1046:     /**
1047:      * Execute a scroll's effect
1048:      * @param {object} entry - The scroll entry to execute
1049:      * @param {object} triggeringScroll - For response scrolls, the original scroll that triggered this response
1050:      */
1051:     executeScrollEffect(entry, triggeringScroll = null) {
1052:         // This delegates back to the main spell system
1053:         // The actual effect execution is handled there
1054:         if (this.spellSystem && typeof this.spellSystem.executeSpell === 'function') {
1055:             // Note: We don't call executeSpell directly here because that would
1056:             // open another response window. Instead, we'll emit an event that
1057:             // the main game loop handles to apply effects without re-triggering responses.
1058:             if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
1059:                 // Resolve the scroll definition from scrollData: it may be stored
1060:                 // as .definition OR .spell depending on the source.
1061:                 const trigDef = triggeringScroll
1062:                     ? (triggeringScroll.scrollData?.definition
1063:                        || triggeringScroll.scrollData?.spell
1064:                        || this.spellSystem.patterns?.[triggeringScroll.scrollData?.name])
1065:                     : null;
1066: 
1067:                 window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('scroll-resolved', {
1068:                     detail: {
1069:                         ...entry,
1070:                         // Promote fromCommonArea to top-level so the listener can access it directly
1071:                         fromCommonArea: entry.fromCommonArea ?? entry.scrollData?.fromCommonArea ?? false,
1072:                         triggeringScroll: triggeringScroll ? {
1073:                             name: triggeringScroll.scrollData?.name,
1074:                             casterIndex: triggeringScroll.casterIndex,
1075:                             definition: trigDef
1076:                         } : null
1077:                     }
1078:                 }));
1079:             }
1080:         }
1081:     }
1082: 
1083:     /**
1084:      * Close the response modal
1085:      */
1086:     closeResponseModal() {
1087:         if (this.responseModalElement) {
1088:             this.responseModalElement.remove();
1089:             this.responseModalElement = null;
1090:         }
1091:     }
1092: 
1093:     /**
1094:      * Start the response timeout timer
1095:      */
1096:     startResponseTimeout() {
1097:         this.clearResponseTimeout();
1098: 
1099:         let remaining = this.RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS;
1100:         const timerEl = document.getElementById('response-timer');
1101: 
1102:         this.responseTimeout = setInterval(() => {
1103:             remaining -= 1000;
1104:             if (timerEl) {
1105:                 timerEl.textContent = `${Math.ceil(remaining / 1000)}s`;
1106:                 if (remaining <= 5000) {
1107:                     timerEl.style.color = '#e74c3c';
1108:                 }
1109:             }
1110: 
1111:             if (remaining <= 0) {
1112:                 this.clearResponseTimeout();
1113:                 // Time's up - force resolve
1114:                 const myIndex = typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' ? myPlayerIndex : activePlayerIndex;
1115:                 const isCasterClient = !(typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer) || myIndex === this.currentCaster;
1116:                 if (isCasterClient) {
1117:                     // Caster: all remaining players are treated as passes — force resolve
1118:                     console.log('⏰ Response timeout on caster client — force resolving');
1119:                     this.resolveResponseStack();
1120:                 } else {
1121:                     // Non-caster: auto-pass
1122:                     this.playerPasses(myIndex);
1123:                 }
1124:             }
1125:         }, 1000);
1126:     }
1127: 
1128:     /**
1129:      * Clear the response timeout
1130:      */
1131:     clearResponseTimeout() {
1132:         if (this.responseTimeout) {
1133:             clearInterval(this.responseTimeout);
1134:             this.responseTimeout = null;
1135:         }
1136:     }

1138:     /**
1139:      * Show error message in response modal
1140:      */
1141:     showResponseError(message) {
1142:         const modal = document.getElementById('response-window-modal');
1143:         if (!modal) return;
1144: 
1145:         const errorDiv = document.createElement('div');
1146:         Object.assign(errorDiv.style, {
1147:             backgroundColor: '#e74c3c',
1148:             color: 'white',
1149:             padding: '10px',
1150:             borderRadius: '5px',
1151:             textAlign: 'center',
1152:             marginBottom: '10px'
1153:         });
1154:         errorDiv.textContent = message;
1155:         modal.insertBefore(errorDiv, modal.firstChild);
1156: 
1157:         setTimeout(() => errorDiv.remove(), 3000);
1158:     }
1159: 
1160:     // Helper methods that interface with the game state
1161:     getPlayerAP(playerIndex) {
1162:         // For the local player, currentAP is always the live authoritative value.
1163:         // playerAPs[myPlayerIndex] can be a stale snapshot (e.g. from the start of their
1164:         // last turn), which would let the affordability check pass even when currentAP is 0
1165:         // and cause spendAP to drive AP negative.
1166:         if (typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' && playerIndex === myPlayerIndex
1167:                 && typeof currentAP !== 'undefined') {
1168:             const localVoidAP = typeof voidAP !== 'undefined' ? voidAP : 0;
1169:             return currentAP + localVoidAP;
1170:         }
1171:         // For other players, use the synced playerAPs snapshot
1172:         if (typeof playerAPs !== 'undefined' && playerAPs[playerIndex]) {
1173:             const ap = playerAPs[playerIndex];
1174:             return (ap.currentAP || 0) + (ap.voidAP || 0);

1178:             return currentAP;

1180:         return 0;

1218:             return this.spellSystem.checkPatternForPlayer(scrollName, playerIndex);

1228:     broadcastResponseWindowOpened(scrollData, casterIndex) {

1231:             // before checking canPlayerRespond — avoids a race condition where
1232:             // common-area-update (e.g. Psychic moving there) hasn't arrived yet.
1233:             const commonAreaSnapshot = this.spellSystem?.commonArea
1234:                 ? { ...this.spellSystem.commonArea }
1235:                 : null;
1236:             broadcastGameAction('response-window-opened', {
1237:                 scrollName: scrollData.name,
1238:                 casterIndex: casterIndex,
1239:                 commonArea: commonAreaSnapshot
1240:             });
1241:         }
1242:     }

1244:     broadcastResponse(scrollInfo, playerIndex) {
1245:         if (typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
1246:             broadcastGameAction('scroll-response', {
1247:                 scrollName: scrollInfo.name,
1248:                 playerIndex: playerIndex,
1249:                 isCounter: scrollInfo.isCounter,
1250:                 fromHand: scrollInfo.fromHand ?? false
1251:             });
1252:         }
1253:     }

1255:     broadcastPass(playerIndex) {
1256:         if (typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
1257:             broadcastGameAction('response-pass', {
1258:                 playerIndex: playerIndex
1259:             });
1260:         }
1261:     }
1262: 
1263:     broadcastResponseResolved(results, originalScroll = null) {
1264:         if (typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
1265:             // Resolve the original scroll's definition for the broadcast so remote
1266:             // clients can store it (e.g. for Reflect's deferred activation).
1267:             let trigDef = null;
1268:             if (originalScroll) {
1269:                 trigDef = originalScroll.scrollData?.definition
1270:                     || originalScroll.scrollData?.spell
1271:                     || this.spellSystem?.patterns?.[originalScroll.scrollData?.name]
1272:                     || null;
1273:             }
1274:             broadcastGameAction('response-resolved', {
1275:                 results: results.map(r => ({
1276:                     scrollName: r.scrollData?.name,
1277:                     casterIndex: r.casterIndex,
1278:                     result: r.result,
1279:                     isResponse: r.isResponse
1280:                 })),
1281:                 triggeringScroll: originalScroll ? {
1282:                     name: originalScroll.scrollData?.name,
1283:                     casterIndex: originalScroll.casterIndex,
1284:                     definition: trigDef,
1285:                     fromCommonArea: originalScroll.scrollData?.fromCommonArea ?? originalScroll.fromCommonArea ?? false
1286:                 } : null
1287:             });
1288:         }
1289:     }
1290: 
1291:     /**
1292:      * Handle remote response resolution - close window on all clients
1293:      */
1294:     handleRemoteResolved() {
1295:         console.log('Remote response window resolved');
1296:         this.clearResponseTimeout();
1297:         this.closeResponseModal();
1298:         this.isResponseWindowOpen = false;
1299:         this.pendingScrollData = null;
1300:         this.currentCaster = null;
1301:         this.respondingPlayers.clear();

1306:     /**
1307:      * Show response modal for a non-casting player (called when receiving broadcast)
1308:      */
1309:     showResponseModalForOtherPlayer(scrollData, casterIndex) {
1310:         this.isResponseWindowOpen = true;
1311:         this.currentCaster = casterIndex;
1312:         this.pendingScrollData = scrollData;
1313:         this.respondingPlayers.clear();
1314:         // The caster is already considered to have "responded" (they cast the spell)
1315:         this.respondingPlayers.add(casterIndex);
1316:         this.responseStack = [{
1317:             scrollData,
1318:             casterIndex,
1319:             isOriginal: true
1320:         }];
1321: 
1322:         // Determine what this player can do:
1323:         //   canRespond → show the real response window with scroll options
1324:         //   canBluff   → show a minimal window (no scroll options) so they can pass
1325:         //                at their leisure without leaking that they have nothing to play
1326:         //   neither    → auto-pass instantly
1327:         const myIndex = typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' ? myPlayerIndex : activePlayerIndex;
1328:         const responseCheck = this.canPlayerRespond(myIndex);
1329:         if (responseCheck.canRespond) {
1330:             this.showResponseModal();
1331:             this.startResponseTimeout();
1332:         } else if (this.canPlayerBluff(myIndex)) {
1333:             // Player has a hand scroll with a matching formation and enough AP to appear
1334:             // threatening — show the window so they can maintain the bluff
1335:             this.showBluffModal();
1336:             this.startResponseTimeout();
1337:         } else {
1338:             if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer) {
1339:                 this.broadcastPass(myIndex);
1340:             }
1341:             // Mark as responded locally so caster can resolve
1342:             this.respondingPlayers.add(myIndex);
1343:             this.checkAllPlayersResponded();
1344:         }
1345:     }

1347:     /**
1348:      * Handle a remote player passing
1349:      */
1350:     handleRemotePass(playerIndex) {
1351:         console.log(`Remote player ${playerIndex} passed`);
1352:         this.respondingPlayers.add(playerIndex);
1353: 
1354:         // Check if all non-caster players have responded
1355:         this.checkAllPlayersResponded();
1356:     }
1357: 
1358:     /**
1359:      * Handle a remote player responding with a scroll.
1360:      * Defers resolution until all eligible players have submitted.
1361:      * @param {string} scrollName
1362:      * @param {number} playerIndex
1363:      * @param {boolean} isCounter
1364:      * @param {boolean} fromHand - if true, move scroll from hand to active on this client
1365:      */
1366:     handleRemoteResponse(scrollName, playerIndex, isCounter, fromHand = false) {
1367:         console.log(`Remote player ${playerIndex} responded with ${scrollName} (fromHand=${fromHand})`);
1368: 
1369:         // If scroll came from hand, sync the hand→active move on this client
1370:         if (fromHand && this.spellSystem) {
1371:             const pScrolls = this.spellSystem.playerScrolls[playerIndex];
1372:             if (pScrolls) {
1373:                 pScrolls.hand.delete(scrollName);
1374:                 pScrolls.active.add(scrollName);
1375:                 this.spellSystem.updateScrollCount();
1376:                 if (typeof updateCommonAreaUI === 'function') updateCommonAreaUI();
1377:             }
1378:         }
1379: 
1380:         const scrollDef = this.spellSystem.patterns[scrollName];
1381:         this.responseStack.push({
1382:             scrollData: { name: scrollName, definition: scrollDef },
1383:             casterIndex: playerIndex,
1384:             isCounter: isCounter,
1385:             isResponse: scrollDef?.isResponse || false,
1386:             fromCommonArea: false,
1387:             isOriginal: false
1388:         });
1389: 
1390:         // Mark this player as submitted
1391:         this.respondingPlayers.add(playerIndex);
1392: 
1393:         // Only the caster's client arbitrates. Non-caster clients wait for 'response-resolved'.
1394:         const myIndex = typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' ? myPlayerIndex : null;
1395:         const isCasterClient = !(typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer) || myIndex === this.currentCaster;
1396:         if (isCasterClient) {
1397:             // Wait for all other eligible players before resolving
1398:             console.log(`  Response from player ${playerIndex} received (caster client) — checking all submitted`);
1399:             this.checkAllPlayersResponded();
1400:         } else {
1401:             console.log(`  Response received, waiting for caster to resolve`);
1402:             this.clearResponseTimeout();
1403:         }
1404:     }
1405: 
1406:     /**
1407:      * Check if all non-caster players have submitted (responded or passed).
1408:      * Only the caster's client calls this; non-casters wait for 'response-resolved'.
1409:      * When all have submitted, arbitrates by element rank and resolves.
1410:      */
1411:     checkAllPlayersResponded() {
1412:         const myIndex = typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' ? myPlayerIndex : null;
1413:         const isCasterClient = !(typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer) || myIndex === this.currentCaster;
1414:         if (!isCasterClient) {
1415:             return; // Non-caster: do nothing, wait for broadcast
1416:         }
1417: 
1418:         const numPlayers = typeof playerPositions !== 'undefined' ? playerPositions.length : 1;
1419: 
1420:         // All non-caster players must submit (respond or pass) before we arbitrate
1421:         let expectedResponders = 0;
1422:         for (let i = 0; i < numPlayers; i++) {
1423:             if (i !== this.currentCaster) expectedResponders++;
1424:         }
1425:         const requiredResponders = expectedResponders + 1; // +1 for caster (already in set)
1426:         console.log(`Response check: ${this.respondingPlayers.size} submitted, ${requiredResponders} expected`);
1427: 
1428:         if (this.respondingPlayers.size >= requiredResponders) {
1429:             // All players have submitted — arbitrate by element rank
1430:             this._arbitrateAndResolve();
1431:         } else {
1432:             // Still waiting — show the waiting screen if we're not already
1433:             this.showWaitingForOthers();
1434:         }
1435:     }
1436: 
1437:     /**
1438:      * Sort submitted responses by element rank (Void > Wind > Fire > Water > Earth).
1439:      * Only the highest-ranked response executes; others' AP is already spent.
1440:      * Then delegates to resolveResponseStack() for effect execution and broadcast.
1441:      */
1442:     _arbitrateAndResolve() {
1443:         // Separate responses from original
1444:         const responses = this.responseStack.filter(e => !e.isOriginal);
1445:         const original  = this.responseStack.find(e => e.isOriginal);
1446: 
1447:         if (responses.length > 1) {
1448:             // Sort descending by element rank
1449:             responses.sort((a, b) =>
1450:                 getScrollElementRank(b.scrollData?.name) - getScrollElementRank(a.scrollData?.name)
1451:             );
1452:             const winner  = responses[0];
1453:             const losers  = responses.slice(1);
1454:             console.log(`⚖️ Arbitration: winner = ${winner.scrollData?.name} (rank ${getScrollElementRank(winner.scrollData?.name)})`);
1455:             losers.forEach(l => console.log(`  ✗ Loser (AP spent, no effect): ${l.scrollData?.name}`));
1456:             // Rebuild stack: original first, then winner (pop() is LIFO → winner resolved first)
1457:             this.responseStack = [];
1458:             if (original) this.responseStack.push(original);
1459:             this.responseStack.push(winner);
1460:         }
1461:         // If 0 or 1 responses, stack is already correct — just resolve
1462:         this.resolveResponseStack();
1463:     }
1464: }
1465: 
1466: // Export for use
1467: if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
1468:     window.ResponseWindowSystem = ResponseWindowSystem;
1469: }

 307: 
 308:                 // When cast as a response: defer effect to beginning of caster's next turn
 309:                 const triggeringScroll = context?.triggeringScroll;
 310:                 if (triggeringScroll && triggeringScroll.name) {
 311:                     if (triggeringScroll.name === 'WATER_SCROLL_1') {
 312:                         updateStatus('Reflect failed: Cannot reflect Reflect!');
 313:                         return { success: false, reason: 'Cannot reflect Reflect' };
 314:                     }
 315:                     // Initialize array if needed, then push this reflect to the stack
 316:                     if (!Array.isArray(system.activeBuffs.reflectPending)) {
 317:                         system.activeBuffs.reflectPending = [];
 318:                     }
 319:                     system.activeBuffs.reflectPending.push({
 320:                         playerIndex: casterIndex,
 321:                         scrollName: triggeringScroll.name,
 322:                         definition: triggeringScroll.definition
 323:                     });
 324:                     updateStatus(`Reflect: At the beginning of your next turn, you will activate ${triggeringScroll.definition?.name || triggeringScroll.name}.`);
 325:

 327:                     if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer && typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
 328:                         broadcastGameAction('reflect-buff-applied', {
 329:                             playerIndex: casterIndex,
 330:                             scrollName: triggeringScroll.name,
 331:                             scrollDefinition: triggeringScroll.definition
 332:                         });
 333:                     }
 334: 
 335:                     return { success: true, deferred: true };
 336:                 }
 337:

 339:                 const lastScroll = system.lastScrollCastThisTurn;
 340:                 if (!lastScroll || !lastScroll.name) {
 341:                     updateStatus('Reflect failed: No scroll was cast this turn!');
 342:                     return { success: false, reason: 'No scroll cast this turn' };
 343:                 }
 344: 
 345:                 // Cannot reflect itself
 346:                 if (lastScroll.name === 'WATER_SCROLL_1') {
 347:                     updateStatus('Reflect failed: Cannot reflect Reflect!');
 348:                     return { success: false, reason: 'Cannot reflect Reflect' };
 349:                 }
 350: 
 351:                 const scrollDef = lastScroll.definition;
 352:                 const scrollName = lastScroll.name;
 353: 
 354:                 // Execute the reflected scroll's effect
 355:                 const displayName = scrollDef?.name || scrollName;
 356:                 updateStatus(`Reflecting ${displayName}!`);
 357: 
 358:                 // Check if the reflected scroll has a special effect
 359:                 const effect = system.getEffect(scrollName);
 360:                 if (effect) {
 361:                     console.log(`🪞 Reflecting special effect: ${effect.name}`);
 362:                     // Determine if we are the Reflect caster on this client.
 363:                     // If not, interactive scrolls should skip their UI (same as Psychic remote client behavior).
 364:                     const isReflectCaster = (typeof myPlayerIndex === 'undefined' || myPlayerIndex === null || myPlayerIndex === casterIndex);
 365:                     // Execute the reflected scroll's special effect
 366:                     const result = system.execute(scrollName, casterIndex, {
 367:                         ...context,
 368:                         psychicRemoteClient: context?.psychicRemoteClient || !isReflectCaster
 369:                     });
 370:                     return {
 371:                         success: true,
 372:                         reflected: scrollName,
 373:                         message: `Reflected ${displayName}!`,
 374:                         ...result
 375:                     };
 376:                 }
 377: 
 378:                 // No special effect - give base stone rewards
 379:                 if (scrollDef) {
 380:                     const level = scrollDef.level || 1;
 381:                     const element = scrollDef.element;
 382: 
 383:                     if (element && element !== 'catacomb') {
 384:                         // Give stones based on scroll level
 385:                         if (typeof stonePools !== 'undefined') {
 386:                             const currentPlayerStones = typeof playerStoneCounts !== 'undefined'
 387:                                 ? playerStoneCounts[casterIndex]
 388:                                 : null;
 389: 
 390:                             if (currentPlayerStones) {
 391:                                 currentPlayerStones[element] = (currentPlayerStones[element] || 0) + level;
 392:                                 updateStatus(`Reflect! Gained +${level} ${element} stones from ${displayName}!`);
 393: 
 394:                                 // Update UI
 395:                                 if (typeof updateStoneCountsUI === 'function') {
 396:                                     updateStoneCountsUI();
 397:                                 }
 398:                             }
 399:                         }
 400:                     } else if (element === 'catacomb' && scrollDef.patterns && scrollDef.patterns[0]) {
 401:                         // Catacomb scroll - give +2 of each element in pattern
 402:                         const elementCounts = {};
 403:                         scrollDef.patterns[0].forEach(pos => {
 404:                             elementCounts[pos.type] = (elementCounts[pos.type] || 0) + 1;
 405:                         });
 406: 
 407:                         const currentPlayerStones = typeof playerStoneCounts !== 'undefined'
 408:                             ? playerStoneCounts[casterIndex]
 409:                             : null;
 410: 
 411:                         if (currentPlayerStones) {
 412:                             Object.entries(elementCounts).forEach(([elem, count]) => {
 413:                                 currentPlayerStones[elem] = (currentPlayerStones[elem] || 0) + 2;
 414:                             });
 415:                             updateStatus(`Reflect! Gained catacomb scroll stones from ${displayName}!`);
 416: 
 417:                             if (typeof updateStoneCountsUI === 'function') {
 418:                                 updateStoneCountsUI();
 419:                             }
 420:                         }
 421:                     }
 422:                 }
 423: 
 424:                 return {
 425:                     success: true,
 426:                     reflected: scrollName,
 427:                     message: `Reflected ${displayName}!`
 428:                 };

 895:                     }
 896:                 } else {
 897:                     console.log(`🌬️ No scrolls left in ${deckElement} deck to draw`);
 898:                 }
 899: 
 900:                 // --- Draw stone(s) based on activated element ---
 901:                 let stonesDrawn = {};
 902:                 if (activatedElement === 'catacomb' && activatedDef.patterns?.[0]) {
 903:                     // Catacomb: draw 1 stone of each unique element in the pattern
 904:                     const uniqueElements = [...new Set(activatedDef.patterns[0].map(p => p.type))];
 905:                     uniqueElements.forEach(el => {
 906:                         const drawn = system.drawStonesToPool(el, 1, casterIndex);
 907:                         if (drawn > 0) stonesDrawn[el] = drawn;
 908:                     });
 909:                 } else if (activatedElement) {
 910:                     // Regular element: draw 1 stone of that type
 911:                     const drawn = system.drawStonesToPool(activatedElement, 1, casterIndex);
 912:                     if (drawn > 0) stonesDrawn[activatedElement] = drawn;
 913:                 }
 914: 
 915:                 // Build status message
 916:                 const parts = [];
 917:                 if (drawnScrollName) {
 918:                     const drawnDef = system.spellSystem?.patterns?.[drawnScrollName];
 919:                     parts.push(`drew ${drawnDef?.name || drawnScrollName}`);
 920:                 }
 921:                 const stoneList = Object.entries(stonesDrawn).map(([el, n]) => `${n} ${el}`).join(', ');
 922:                 if (stoneList) {
 923:                     parts.push(`+${stoneList} stone${Object.values(stonesDrawn).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) > 1 ? 's' : ''}`);
 924:                 }
 925:                 if (parts.length === 0) {
 926:                     parts.push('nothing available to draw');
 927:                 }
 928: 
 929:                 const message = `Sigh of Recollection (${displayName}): ${parts.join(', ')}!`;
 930:                 updateStatus(message);
 931: 
 932:                 return {
 933:                     success: true,
 934:                     scrollDrawn: drawnScrollName,
 935:                     stonesDrawn: stonesDrawn,
 936:                     message: message
 937:                 };
 938:             }
 939:         },

1575:     enterTelekinesisMode(casterIndex, completionPayload) {
1576:         const self = this;
1577:         const MAX_MOVES = 1;
1578: 
1579:         console.log(`🔮 Entering Telekinesis mode for player ${casterIndex}`);
1580:

1582:         if (!document.getElementById('telekinesis-style')) {

1585:             style.textContent = `

1587:                     0%,  100% { opacity: 1; }
1588:                     30%       { opacity: 0.75; }
1589:                     70%       { opacity: 0.85; }
1590:                 }
1591:             `;
1592:             document.head.appendChild(style);
1593:         }
1594: 
1595:         // Highlight all eligible (draggable) tiles in wind yellow so it's clear which can move
1596:         const eligibleTiles = this.getEligibleTilesForSwap();
1597:         eligibleTiles.forEach(tile => {
1598:             this.highlightTile(tile, '#e8c84d', 3);
1599:             if (tile.element) tile.element.style.animation = 'telekinesisFloat 2.2s ease-in-out infinite';
1600:         });
1601: 
1602:         // Set up the telekinesis state so game-core/game-ui know about the rules
1603:         window.telekinesisState = {
1604:             active: true,
1605:             movesLeft: MAX_MOVES,
1606:             maxMoves: MAX_MOVES,
1607:             casterIndex: casterIndex,
1608:             movedTiles: []
1609:         };
1610: 
1611:         // Enable tile dragging
1612:         window.tileMoveMode = true;
1613: 
1614:         const unhighlightAll = () => eligibleTiles.forEach(tile => self.unhighlightTile(tile));
1615: 
1616:         // Finish handler — turn off tile move mode and clean up
1617:         const finishTelekinesis = () => {
1618:             window.tileMoveMode = false;
1619:             const movesDone = MAX_MOVES - (window.telekinesisState?.movesLeft ?? 0);
1620:             window.telekinesisState = null;
1621: 
1622:             unhighlightAll();
1623: 
1624:             // Remove buttons
1625:             const doneEl = document.getElementById('telekinesis-done-btn');
1626:             if (doneEl && doneEl.parentNode) doneEl.parentNode.removeChild(doneEl);
1627:             const cancelEl = document.getElementById('scroll-cancel-btn');
1628:             if (cancelEl && cancelEl.parentNode) cancelEl.parentNode.removeChild(cancelEl);
1629: 
1630:             self.selectionMode = null;
1631: 
1632:             updateStatus(`Telekinesis complete! Moved ${movesDone} tile${movesDone === 1 ? '' : 's'}.`);
1633: 
1634:             // Signal that selection effect is complete
1635:             if (completionPayload && self.spellSystem && typeof self.spellSystem.onSelectionEffectComplete === 'function') {
1636:                 self.spellSystem.onSelectionEffectComplete(completionPayload.scrollName, completionPayload.effectName, completionPayload.spell);
1637:             }
1638:         };
1639:

1641:         window.finishTelekinesis = finishTelekinesis;
1642:

1644:         const cancelBtn = this.createCancelButton('Cancel', () => {
1645:             window.tileMoveMode = false;
1646:             window.telekinesisState = null;
1647:             window.finishTelekinesis = null;

1650:             if (doneEl && doneEl.parentNode) doneEl.parentNode.removeChild(doneEl);
1651:             self.cancelSelectionMode();
1652:         });

1657:         doneBtn.textContent = `Done (0/${MAX_MOVES})`;
1658:         Object.assign(doneBtn.style, {
1659:             position: 'fixed',

1671:             fontWeight: 'bold',
1672:             boxShadow: '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'
1673:         });
1674:         doneBtn.onclick = () => finishTelekinesis();
1675:         document.body.appendChild(doneBtn);
1676: 
1677:         // Minimal selection mode — just for cleanup if cancelSelectionMode is called
1678:         this.selectionMode = {
1679:             type: 'telekinesis',
1680:             casterIndex: casterIndex,
1681:             completionPayload: completionPayload,
1682:             cleanup() {
1683:                 window.tileMoveMode = false;
1684:                 window.telekinesisState = null;
1685:                 window.finishTelekinesis = null;
1686:                 unhighlightAll();
1687:                 const d = document.getElementById('telekinesis-done-btn');

1689:                 const c = document.getElementById('scroll-cancel-btn');

1969:             const scrollInfo = sp.patterns?.[scrollName];
1970: 
1971:             // Always add to hand — end-of-turn overflow handles cascade if needed
1972:             scrolls.hand.add(scrollName);
1973:             sp.updateScrollCount();
1974: 
1975:             if (typeof updateScrollDeckUI === 'function') updateScrollDeckUI();
1976:             if (typeof updateHUD === 'function') updateHUD();

1978:             // Open Hand panel + show toast (same as finding a scroll on a shrine)
1979:             if (typeof sp.showScrollNotification === 'function') {
1980:                 sp.showScrollNotification(scrollInfo, element, scrollName);
1981:             }
1982: 
1983:             const displayName = scrollInfo?.name || scrollName;
1984:             updateStatus(`Scholar's Insight: added "${displayName}" to your hand!`);
1985: 
1986:             // Broadcast in multiplayer
1987:             if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer && typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
1988:                 broadcastGameAction('scholars-insight', {
1989:                     playerIndex: casterIndex,
1990:                     element: element,
1991:                     scrollName: scrollName
1992:                 });
1993:             }
1994: 
1995:             // Clean up selection mode
1996:             self.selectionMode = null;

2418:     getEligibleTilesForSwap() {
2419:         if (typeof placedTiles === 'undefined') return [];
2420: 
2421:         return placedTiles.filter(tile => {
2422:             // Not a player tile
2423:             if (tile.isPlayerTile) return false;
2424: 
2425:             // No stones on tile
2426:             if (this.tileHasStones(tile)) return false;
2427: 
2428:             // No players on tile
2429:             if (this.tileHasPlayers(tile)) return false;
2430: 
2431:             return true;
2432:         });
2433:     },

2435:     getEligibleTilesForFlip() {
2436:         // Same criteria as swap
2437:         return this.getEligibleTilesForSwap();
2438:     },

2440:     // Wandering River: any non-player tile (revealed or unrevealed) can be transformed
2441:     getEligibleTilesForWanderingRiver() {
2442:         if (typeof placedTiles === 'undefined') return [];
2443:         return placedTiles.filter(tile => {
2444:             if (tile.isPlayerTile || tile.shrineType === 'player') return false;
2445:             return true;
2446:         });
2447:     },
2448: 
2449:     tileHasStones(tile) {
2450:         if (typeof placedStones === 'undefined') return false;
2451: 
2452:         // Use same radius as findTileAtPosition (game-core): TILE_SIZE * 4 covers full tile
2453:         // TILE_SIZE * 2.5 was too small and missed stones on outer hexes
2454:         const tileRadius = typeof TILE_SIZE !== 'undefined' ? TILE_SIZE * 4 : 80;
2455: 
2456:         return placedStones.some(stone => {
2457:             const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(stone.x - tile.x, 2) + Math.pow(stone.y - tile.y, 2));
2458:             return dist < tileRadius;
2459:         });
2460:     },
2461: 
2462:     tileHasPlayers(tile) {
2463:         if (typeof playerPositions === 'undefined') return false;
2464: 
2465:         // Match tileHasStones / findTileAtPosition radius
2466:         const tileRadius = typeof TILE_SIZE !== 'undefined' ? TILE_SIZE * 4 : 80;
2467: 
2468:         return playerPositions.some(pos => {
2469:             if (!pos) return false;
2470:             const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(pos.x - tile.x, 2) + Math.pow(pos.y - tile.y, 2));
2471:             return dist < tileRadius;
2472:         });
2473:     },

2554:     drawStonesToPool(stoneType, count, playerIndex) {
2555:         // Draw stones from source pool to player pool
2556:         if (typeof stonePools === 'undefined') {
2557:             console.warn('Stone pools not available');
2558:             return 0;
2559:         }
2560: 
2561:         // Determine the target player pool.
2562:         // If an explicit playerIndex is given, use playerPools[playerIndex] directly
2563:         // so that response scrolls (cast by a non-active player) modify the correct pool.
2564:         let targetPool = null;
2565:         const pools = typeof playerPools !== 'undefined' ? playerPools : (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.playerPools);
2566:         if (playerIndex !== undefined && playerIndex !== null && pools && pools[playerIndex]) {
2567:             targetPool = pools[playerIndex];
2568:         } else if (typeof stoneCounts !== 'undefined') {
2569:             targetPool = stoneCounts;
2570:         }
2571: 
2572:         if (!targetPool) {
2573:             console.warn('No target player pool available');
2574:             return 0;
2575:         }
2576: 
2577:         // Get player pool capacity (default 5)
2578:         const capacity = (typeof playerPoolCapacity !== 'undefined' && playerPoolCapacity[stoneType])
2579:             ? playerPoolCapacity[stoneType]
2580:             : 5;
2581:         const currentCount = targetPool[stoneType] || 0;
2582:         const roomInPool = capacity - currentCount;
2583: 
2584:         // Can only draw up to: min(requested, available in source, room in player pool)
2585:         const sourceAvailable = stonePools[stoneType] || 0;
2586:         const toDraw = Math.min(count, sourceAvailable, roomInPool);
2587: 
2588:         if (toDraw > 0) {
2589:             stonePools[stoneType] -= toDraw;
2590:             targetPool[stoneType] += toDraw;
2591: 
2592:             // Update UI
2593:             if (typeof updateStoneCount === 'function') {
2594:                 updateStoneCount(stoneType);
2595:             }
2596: 
2597:             console.log(`📜 Drew ${toDraw} ${stoneType} stones to player ${playerIndex ?? 'active'} pool (had ${currentCount}/${capacity})`);
2598:         } else if (roomInPool <= 0) {
2599:             console.log(`📜 Cannot draw ${stoneType} stones - pool is full (${currentCount}/${capacity})`);
2600:         }
2601: 
2602:         return toDraw;
2603:     },

2922:     // Use this to chain processPsychicPending after all reflects finish.
2923:     processReflectPending(playerIndex, onAllComplete) {
2924:         const pendingArray = this.activeBuffs.reflectPending;

2931:         const myReflects = pendingArray.filter(p => p.playerIndex === playerIndex);

2990:                     if (originalActivePlayer !== null && typeof activePlayerIndex !== 'undefined') {
2991:                         activePlayerIndex = originalActivePlayer;
2992:                     }
2993:                     if (typeof syncPlayerState === 'function') syncPlayerState();

2999:             if (!result?.requiresSelection) {

3213:     // Get water stones adjacent to player (same rule as break/place: exactly one hex step away)
3214:     getAdjacentWaterStones(playerPos, playerIndex) {
3215:         if (typeof placedStones === 'undefined') return [];
3216:

3220:         });

3223:     // Same hex-adjacency logic as game-core isAdjacentToPlayer (one hex step only)
3224:     isStoneAdjacentToPosition(stoneX, stoneY, playerX, playerY) {
3225:         const tileSize = typeof TILE_SIZE !== 'undefined' ? TILE_SIZE : 20;
3226:         const playerHex = this.pixelToHex(playerX, playerY, tileSize);
3227:         const targetHex = this.pixelToHex(stoneX, stoneY, tileSize);
3228:         const dq = Math.abs(playerHex.q - targetHex.q);
3229:         const dr = Math.abs(playerHex.r - targetHex.r);
3230:         const ds = Math.abs((-playerHex.q - playerHex.r) - (-targetHex.q - targetHex.r));
3231:         const hexDistance = Math.max(dq, dr, ds);
3232:         return hexDistance === 1;
3233:     },
3234: 
3235:     pixelToHex(x, y, s) {
3236:         const q = (x * Math.sqrt(3) / 3 - y / 3) / s;
3237:         const r = (y * 2 / 3) / s;
3238:         return this.hexRound(q, r);
3239:     },
3240: 
3241:     hexRound(q, r) {
3242:         const s = -q - r;
3243:         let rq = Math.round(q);
3244:         let rr = Math.round(r);
3245:         const rs = Math.round(s);
3246:         const qDiff = Math.abs(rq - q);
3247:         const rDiff = Math.abs(rr - r);
3248:         const sDiff = Math.abs(rs - s);
3249:         if (qDiff > rDiff && qDiff > sDiff) rq = -rr - rs;
3250:         else if (rDiff > sDiff) rr = -rq - rs;
3251:         return { q: rq, r: rr };
3252:     },

3600:                     if (spellSystem.updateScrollCount) spellSystem.updateScrollCount();

4461:     // Fire V - Arson: Destroy stone from opponent pool
4462:     enterArsonMode(casterIndex, completionPayload = null) {
4463:         const self = this;
4464: 
4465:         // Get opponents (exclude Excavate-immune players)
4466:         const numPlayers = typeof playerPositions !== 'undefined' ? playerPositions.length : 1;
4467:         const opponents = [];
4468:         for (let i = 0; i < numPlayers; i++) {
4469:             if (i !== casterIndex && !this.hasExcavateImmunity(i)) {
4470:                 opponents.push(i);
4471:             }
4472:         }
4473: 
4474:         if (opponents.length === 0) {
4475:             updateStatus('No opponents to target!');
4476:             return;
4477:         }
4478: 
4479:         // Show opponent selection modal
4480:         this.showOpponentSelectionModal(opponents, (selectedOpponent) => {
4481:             // Get the stone types this opponent actually has (playerPools is per-player pool from game-core)
4482:             const pools = typeof playerPools !== 'undefined' ? playerPools : (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.playerPools);
4483:             const opponentStones = pools && pools[selectedOpponent] ? pools[selectedOpponent] : null;
4484:             if (!opponentStones) {
4485:                 updateStatus('Cannot access opponent stone pool!');
4486:                 return;
4487:             }
4488: 
4489:             // Filter to only elements the opponent has > 0 stones
4490:             const availableElements = ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void'].filter(element =>
4491:                 opponentStones[element] && opponentStones[element] > 0
4492:             );
4493: 
4494:             if (availableElements.length === 0) {
4495:                 const name = (typeof playerPositions !== 'undefined' && playerPositions[selectedOpponent]?.username)
4496:                     ? playerPositions[selectedOpponent].username
4497:                     : `Player ${selectedOpponent + 1}`;
4498:                 updateStatus(`${name} has no stones in their pool to destroy!`);
4499:                 return;
4500:             }
4501: 
4502:             // Show element selection with only available elements
4503:             self.showArsonElementModal(availableElements, opponentStones, (selectedElement) => {
4504:                 // Destroy one stone from opponent's pool
4505:                 self.destroyOpponentStone(selectedOpponent, selectedElement, completionPayload);
4506:             });
4507:         });
4508:     },

4909:     destroyStonesOnTile(tile) {
4910:         if (typeof placedStones === 'undefined') return;
4911: 
4912:         // Use same radius as tileHasStones and findTileAtPosition: TILE_SIZE * 4
4913:         const tileRadius = typeof TILE_SIZE !== 'undefined' ? TILE_SIZE * 4 : 80;
4914: 
4915:         // Track which stones we're removing for multiplayer sync
4916:         const removedStoneIds = [];
4917: 
4918:         // Find and remove ALL stones on this tile (iterate backwards for safe splice)
4919:         for (let i = placedStones.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
4920:             const stone = placedStones[i];
4921:             const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(stone.x - tile.x, 2) + Math.pow(stone.y - tile.y, 2));
4922:             if (dist < tileRadius) {
4923:                 // Track stone ID for broadcast
4924:                 removedStoneIds.push(stone.id);
4925: 
4926:                 // Remove stone from DOM
4927:                 if (stone.element && stone.element.parentNode) {
4928:                     stone.element.parentNode.removeChild(stone.element);
4929:                 }
4930:                 // Remove from array
4931:                 placedStones.splice(i, 1);
4932:             }
4933:         }
4934: 
4935:         // Broadcast in multiplayer
4936:         if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer && typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
4937:             broadcastGameAction('stones-destroyed', {
4938:                 tileId: tile.id,
4939:                 stoneIds: removedStoneIds
4940:             });
4941:         }
4942:     },
4943: 
4944:     destroyOpponentStone(opponentIndex, stoneType, completionPayload = null) {
4945:         const pools = typeof playerPools !== 'undefined' ? playerPools : (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.playerPools);
4946:         const opponentStones = pools && pools[opponentIndex] ? pools[opponentIndex] : null;
4947:         if (!opponentStones) {
4948:             updateStatus('Cannot access opponent stone pools.');
4949:             return;
4950:         }
4951:         if (opponentStones[stoneType] > 0) {
4952:             opponentStones[stoneType]--;
4953:             const name = (typeof playerPositions !== 'undefined' && playerPositions[opponentIndex]?.username)
4954:                 ? playerPositions[opponentIndex].username
4955:                 : `Player ${opponentIndex + 1}`;
4956:             updateStatus(`Arson! Destroyed 1 ${stoneType} stone from ${name}'s pool.`);
4957: 
4958:             if (typeof updateOpponentPanel === 'function') updateOpponentPanel();
4959: 
4960:             if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer && typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
4961:                 broadcastGameAction('opponent-stone-destroyed', {
4962:                     opponentIndex,
4963:                     stoneType
4964:                 });
4965:             }
4966: 
4967:             // Send Arson to common area after use
4968:             if (completionPayload && this.spellSystem) {
4969:                 const scrollName = completionPayload.scrollName || 'FIRE_SCROLL_5';
4970:                 this.spellSystem.handleScrollDisposition(scrollName, false, true);
4971:             }
4972: 
4973:             // Signal selection effect complete (triggers win check, broadcast)
4974:             if (completionPayload && this.spellSystem && typeof this.spellSystem.onSelectionEffectComplete === 'function') {
4975:                 this.spellSystem.onSelectionEffectComplete(completionPayload.scrollName, completionPayload.effectName, completionPayload.spell);
4976:             }
4977:         } else {
4978:             updateStatus(`${stoneType} pool is empty!`);
4979:         }
4980:     },

4982:     // Catacomb Scroll 8 - Plunder: Discard a target player's active scroll to common area
4983:     enterPlunderMode(casterIndex, completionPayload = null) {
4984:         const self = this;
4985:         // The scroll currently being cast — exclude it from plunderable lists
4986:         // (it's still in the caster's active set until handleScrollDisposition runs)
4987:         const castingScrollName = completionPayload?.scrollName || null;
4988: 
4989:         // Get all players (including self, but exclude Excavate-immune opponents)
4990:         const numPlayers = typeof playerPositions !== 'undefined' ? playerPositions.length : 1;
4991:         const targets = [];
4992:         for (let i = 0; i < numPlayers; i++) {
4993:             // Allow self-targeting, but skip immune opponents
4994:             if (i !== casterIndex && this.hasExcavateImmunity(i)) continue;
4995:             targets.push(i);
4996:         }
4997: 
4998:         if (targets.length === 0) {
4999:             updateStatus('No players to target!');
5000:             return;
5001:         }
5002: 
5003:         // Step 1: Select target player
5004:         this.showPlunderPlayerModal(targets, casterIndex, castingScrollName, (targetPlayerIndex) => {
5005:             // Step 2: Get target's active scrolls
5006:             if (!self.spellSystem) {
5007:                 updateStatus('Plunder: spell system unavailable.');
5008:                 return;
5009:             }
5010:             self.spellSystem.ensurePlayerScrollsStructure(targetPlayerIndex);
5011:             const targetScrolls = self.spellSystem.playerScrolls[targetPlayerIndex];
5012: 
5013:             // Build plunderable list, excluding the scroll being cast if targeting self
5014:             let activeScrollArray = targetScrolls ? Array.from(targetScrolls.active) : [];
5015:             if (targetPlayerIndex === casterIndex && castingScrollName) {
5016:                 activeScrollArray = activeScrollArray.filter(s => s !== castingScrollName);
5017:             }
5018: 
5019:             if (activeScrollArray.length === 0) {
5020:                 const name = (typeof playerPositions !== 'undefined' && playerPositions[targetPlayerIndex]?.username)
5021:                     ? playerPositions[targetPlayerIndex].username
5022:                     : `Player ${targetPlayerIndex + 1}`;
5023:                 updateStatus(`${name} has no active scrolls to plunder!`);
5024:                 // Still signal completion so scroll disposition happens
5025:                 if (completionPayload && self.spellSystem && typeof self.spellSystem.onSelectionEffectComplete === 'function') {
5026:                     self.spellSystem.onSelectionEffectComplete(completionPayload.scrollName, completionPayload.effectName, completionPayload.spell);
5027:                 }
5028:                 return;
5029:             }
5030: 
5031:             // Step 3: Show target's active scrolls for caster to choose
5032:             self.showScrollSelectionModal(activeScrollArray, 'Select an active scroll to plunder:', (selectedScroll) => {
5033:                 // Remove from target's active area
5034:                 targetScrolls.active.delete(selectedScroll);
5035:

5037:                 if (self.spellSystem.discardToCommonArea) {
5038:                     self.spellSystem.discardToCommonArea(selectedScroll);
5039:                 }

5041:                 const scrollDef = self.spellSystem?.patterns?.[selectedScroll];
5042:                 const scrollDisplayName = scrollDef?.name || selectedScroll;
5043:                 const targetName = (typeof playerPositions !== 'undefined' && playerPositions[targetPlayerIndex]?.username)
5044:                     ? playerPositions[targetPlayerIndex].username
5045:                     : `Player ${targetPlayerIndex + 1}`;
5046:                 updateStatus(`Plunder! Sent ${scrollDisplayName} from ${targetName}'s active area to the common area.`);
5047:                 console.log(`🏴‍☠️ Plunder: moved ${selectedScroll} from player ${targetPlayerIndex}'s active to common area`);
5048: 
5049:                 // Update UI
5050:                 if (self.spellSystem?.updateScrollCount) {
5051:                     self.spellSystem.updateScrollCount();
5052:                 }
5053:                 if (typeof updateOpponentPanel === 'function') updateOpponentPanel();
5054: 
5055:                 // Broadcast in multiplayer
5056:                 if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer && typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
5057:                     broadcastGameAction('scroll-plundered', {
5058:                         casterIndex: casterIndex,
5059:                         targetIndex: targetPlayerIndex,
5060:                         scrollName: selectedScroll
5061:                     });
5062:                 }
5063: 
5064:                 if (typeof syncPlayerState === 'function') syncPlayerState();
5065: 
5066:                 // Signal selection effect complete
5067:                 if (completionPayload && self.spellSystem && typeof self.spellSystem.onSelectionEffectComplete === 'function') {
5068:                     self.spellSystem.onSelectionEffectComplete(completionPayload.scrollName, completionPayload.effectName, completionPayload.spell);
5069:                 }
