5341:     // Excavate: hex selection for teleport at start of turn
5342:     enterExcavateTeleportMode(playerIndex) {
5343:         const self = this;
5344: 
5345:         updateStatus('Excavate: Click any unoccupied hex on a revealed tile to teleport there.');
5346: 
5347:         this.selectionMode = {
5348:             type: 'excavate-teleport',
5349:             casterIndex: playerIndex,
5350: 
5351:             handleHexClick(hexPos) {
5352:                 const destX = hexPos.x;
5353:                 const destY = hexPos.y;
5354: 
5355:                 // Check hex is on at least one revealed (non-player) tile
5356:                 const hasRevealedTile = hexPos.tiles && hexPos.tiles.some(t => !t.flipped && !t.isPlayerTile);
5357:                 if (!hasRevealedTile) {
5358:                     updateStatus('Cannot teleport there - not on a revealed tile!');
5359:                     return;
5360:                 }
5361: 
5362:                 // Check not occupied by a stone
5363:                 const hasStone = (typeof placedStones !== 'undefined') && placedStones.some(s => {
5364:                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(s.x - destX, 2) + Math.pow(s.y - destY, 2));
5365:                     return dist < 5;
5366:                 });
5367:                 if (hasStone) {
5368:                     updateStatus('Cannot teleport there - a stone is on that space!');
5369:                     return;
5370:                 }
5371: 
5372:                 // Check not occupied by a player
5373:                 const hasPlayer = (typeof playerPositions !== 'undefined') && playerPositions.some(p => {
5374:                     if (!p) return false;
5375:                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(p.x - destX, 2) + Math.pow(p.y - destY, 2));
5376:                     return dist < 5;
5377:                 });
5378:                 if (hasPlayer) {
5379:                     updateStatus('Cannot teleport there - a player is on that space!');
5380:                     return;
5381:                 }
5382: 
5383:                 // Teleport the player
5384:                 if (typeof placePlayer === 'function') {
5385:                     placePlayer(destX, destY);
5386:                 }
5387: 
5388:                 updateStatus(`Excavate: Teleported! Your turn begins.`);
5389:                 console.log(`⛏️ Excavate teleport: player ${playerIndex} to (${destX.toFixed(1)}, ${destY.toFixed(1)})`);
5390: 
5391:                 // Broadcast in multiplayer
5392:                 if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer && typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
5393:                     broadcastGameAction('excavate-teleport', {
5394:                         playerIndex: playerIndex,
5395:                         x: destX,
5396:                         y: destY
5397:                     });
5398:                 }
5399: 
5400:                 if (typeof syncPlayerState === 'function') syncPlayerState();
5401:

615:     (function() {
616:         const _clickSnd = new Audio('sounds/clicksounds.mp3');
617:         _clickSnd.volume = 0.25;
618:         window.uiSoundEnabled   = localStorage.getItem('godaigo_ui_sound')   !== 'false';
619:         window.gameSoundEnabled = localStorage.getItem('godaigo_game_sound') !== 'false';
620:         window.musicEnabled     = localStorage.getItem('godaigo_music')       !== 'false';
621:         // Buttons that play zipclick instead of the normal click sound
622:         const ZIPCLICK_BTN = '#undo-move, .fsp-close-btn, .fsp-collapse-btn, .scroll-browse-close, .btn-close';
623:         document.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
624:             if (!window.uiSoundEnabled) return;
625:             const btn = e.target.closest('button');
626:             if (!btn) return;
627:             if (btn.matches(ZIPCLICK_BTN) || btn.closest(ZIPCLICK_BTN)) {
628:                 window.SoundSystem?.play('zipclick');
629:             } else {
630:                 _clickSnd.currentTime = 0;
631:                 _clickSnd.play().catch(() => {});
632:             }
633:         });
634:     })();
635:     </script>

  13:         async function authLogin() {
  14:             const username = document.getElementById('auth-username').value.trim();
  15:             const password = document.getElementById('auth-password').value;
  16:             if (!username || !password) { showAuthError('Please enter a username and password.'); return; }
  17: 
  18:             setAuthLoading(true);
  19:             const email = username.toLowerCase() + '@godaigo.game';
  20:             const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
  21:             setAuthLoading(false);
  22: 
  23:             if (error) { showAuthError(error.message); return; }
  24:             onAuthSuccess(data.user);
  25:         }

  27:         async function authRegister() {
  28:             const username = document.getElementById('auth-username').value.trim();
  29:             const password = document.getElementById('auth-password').value;
  30:             if (!username) { showAuthError('Please enter a username.'); return; }
  31:             if (password.length < 6) { showAuthError('Password must be at least 6 characters.'); return; }
  32:             if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+$/.test(username)) {
  33:                 showAuthError('Username may only contain letters, numbers, _, -, .');
  34:                 return;
  35:             }
  36: 
  37:             setAuthLoading(true);
  38:             const email = username.toLowerCase() + '@godaigo.game';
  39:             const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
  40:                 email,
  41:                 password,
  42:                 options: { data: { username } }
  43:             });
  44:             setAuthLoading(false);
  45: 
  46:             if (error) {
  47:                 // Replace the internal fake email with just the username in error messages
  48:                 showAuthError(error.message.replace(email, username));
  49:                 return;
  50:             }
  51:             if (data.session) {
  52:                 onAuthSuccess(data.user);
  53:             } else {
  54:                 // Email confirmation is still enabled in Supabase dashboard
  55:                 showAuthError('Registration failed: email confirmation is required. Please disable it in your Supabase Authentication settings.');
  56:             }
  57:         }

 205:         async function createRoom(isPrivate) {
 206:             const username = lobbyUsername;
 207:             if (!username) { alert('Not signed in — please sign in first'); return; }
 208: 
 209:             // Read custom room name; fall back to "<username>'s Game" if left blank
 210:             const roomNameRaw = document.getElementById('room-name-input')?.value.trim();
 211:             const roomName = roomNameRaw || (username + "'s Game");
 212: 
 213:             // --- Auto-clean stale player entries for this username ---
 214:             const twoMinutesAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
 215:             const { data: existingPlayers } = await supabase
 216:                 .from('players')
 217:                 .select('id, game_id, created_at')
 218:                 .eq('username', username);
 219:             if (existingPlayers?.length) {
 220:                 const gameIds = existingPlayers.map(p => p.game_id).filter(Boolean);
 221:                 if (gameIds.length) {
 222:                     const { data: waitingRooms } = await supabase
 223:                         .from('game_room')
 224:                         .select('id')
 225:                         .in('id', gameIds)
 226:                         .eq('status', 'waiting');
 227:                     if (waitingRooms?.length) {
 228:                         // Only auto-clean entries older than 2 minutes (stale sessions)
 229:                         const staleIds = existingPlayers
 230:                             .filter(p => p.created_at < twoMinutesAgo)
 231:                             .map(p => p.id);
 232:                         if (staleIds.length) {
 233:                             await supabase.rpc('remove_players', { p_player_ids: staleIds });
 234:                             console.log('🧹 Auto-cleaned stale player entries:', staleIds);
 235:                         } else {
 236:                             setBrowserStatus('You\'re already in a waiting room. Leave it first before creating a new one.');
 237:                             return;
 238:                         }
 239:                     }
 240:                 }
 241:             }
 242: 
 243:             setBrowserStatus('Creating room…');
 244:             await supabase.rpc('cleanup_stale_rooms');
 245:             const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('create_game_room',
 246:                 { p_is_private: isPrivate, p_host_name: roomName });
 247:             if (error || !data?.length) {
 248:                 console.error('❌ create_game_room RPC failed:', error);
 249:                 setBrowserStatus('Error creating room: ' + (error?.message || 'no data returned — see Supabase SQL Editor'));
 250:                 return;
 251:             }
 252:             const { room_id, join_code } = data[0];
 253: 
 254:             // Lock the room-name input — can't rename mid-game; unlocked again on leaveRoom()
 255:             const roomNameInput = document.getElementById('room-name-input');
 256:             if (roomNameInput) {
 257:                 roomNameInput.disabled = true;
 258:                 roomNameInput.style.opacity = '0.5';
 259:             }
 260: 
 261:             const ok = await joinRoomAsPlayer(room_id, username);
 262:             if (!ok) return;
 263:             isHost = true;
 264:             showWaitingRoom(room_id, join_code, isPrivate, roomName);
 265:         }

 269:         async function joinByCode() {
 270:             const code = document.getElementById('join-code-input').value.trim().toUpperCase();
 271:             if (code.length !== 6) { setBrowserStatus('Enter a 6-character room code'); return; }
 272:             setBrowserStatus('Looking up room…');
 273:             const { data: room } = await supabase
 274:                 .from('game_room')
 275:                 .select('id,status,is_private,join_code,host_name')
 276:                 .eq('join_code', code)
 277:                 .single();
 278:             if (!room) { setBrowserStatus('Room not found — check the code and try again'); return; }
 279:             if (room.status !== 'waiting') { setBrowserStatus('That game has already started'); return; }
 280:             const username = lobbyUsername;
 281:             if (!username) { alert('Not signed in — please sign in first'); return; }
 282:             const ok = await joinRoomAsPlayer(room.id, username);
 283:             if (!ok) return;
 284:             showWaitingRoom(room.id, room.join_code, room.is_private, room.host_name);
 285:         }

 289:         async function joinPublicGame(gameId) {
 290:             const username = lobbyUsername;
 291:             if (!username) { alert('Not signed in — please sign in first'); return; }
 292:             const { data: room } = await supabase
 293:                 .from('game_room')
 294:                 .select('id,status,is_private,join_code,host_name')
 295:                 .eq('id', gameId)
 296:                 .single();
 297:             if (!room || room.status !== 'waiting') { refreshGameBrowser(); return; }
 298:             const ok = await joinRoomAsPlayer(gameId, username);
 299:             if (!ok) return;
 300:             showWaitingRoom(gameId, null, false, room.host_name);
 301:         }
 302: 
 303:         // --- Shared join helper ---
 304: 
 305:         async function joinRoomAsPlayer(gameId, username) {
 306:             // Auto-clean stale entries for this username; block only if last_seen is recent (active session)
 307:             // A player is considered active if their heartbeat fired within the last 90 seconds.
 308:             // last_seen may be NULL for a brand-new row that hasn't heartbeated yet — treat NULL as stale
 309:             // unless the row was created within the last 30 seconds (to avoid stomping a fresh join).
 310:             const ninetySecondsAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 90 * 1000).toISOString();
 311:             const thirtySecondsAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 1000).toISOString();
 312:             const { data: existing } = await supabase
 313:                 .from('players')
 314:                 .select('id, username, created_at, last_seen')
 315:                 .eq('game_id', gameId);
 316:             const match = existing?.filter(p => p.username === username) || [];
 317:             if (match.length) {
 318:                 const stale = match.filter(p => {
 319:                     // Active = last_seen is recent, OR row is brand-new (< 30s) with no last_seen yet
 320:                     if (p.last_seen && p.last_seen > ninetySecondsAgo) return false; // active
 321:                     if (!p.last_seen && p.created_at > thirtySecondsAgo) return false; // brand-new
 322:                     return true; // stale
 323:                 });
 324:                 const active = match.filter(p => !stale.includes(p));
 325:                 if (stale.length) {
 326:                     await supabase.rpc('remove_players', { p_player_ids: stale.map(p => p.id) });
 327:                     console.log('🧹 Auto-cleaned stale entry for', username);
 328:                 }
 329:                 if (active.length) {
 330:                     setBrowserStatus('That username is already in this room');
 331:                     return false;
 332:                 }
 333:             }
 334:             const { data, error } = await supabase
 335:                 .from('players')
 336:                 .insert([{ username, is_ready: false, game_id: gameId }])
 337:                 .select()
 338:                 .single();
 339:             if (error) { setBrowserStatus('Could not join: ' + error.message); return false; }
 340:             myPlayerId = data.id;
 341:             localReadyState = false;
 342:             updateReadyButton(false);
 343:             currentGameId = gameId;  // must be set BEFORE subscribeToLobby so filters use the correct room ID
 344:             isMultiplayer = true;
 345:             // Determine host: first player by creation time
 346:             const { data: all } = await supabase
 347:                 .from('players')
 348:                 .select('*')
 349:                 .eq('game_id', gameId)
 350:                 .order('created_at', { ascending: true });
 351:             isHost = all?.[0]?.id === myPlayerId;
 352:             // Host is implicitly ready — their action is clicking Start, not toggling ready
 353:             if (isHost) {
 354:                 localReadyState = true;
 355:                 await supabase.from('players').update({ is_ready: true }).eq('id', myPlayerId);
 356:             }
 357:             document.getElementById('ready-controls').style.display = 'block';
 358:             updateReadyButton(localReadyState);
 359:             subscribeToLobby();
 360:             updateHeartbeat();
 361:             startLobbyPoll();
 362:             updatePlayerList();
 363:             console.log('✅ Joined room', gameId, 'as', username, isHost ? '(HOST)' : '');
 364:             return true;
 365:         }
 366: 
 367:         // --- Leave room (return to game browser) ---
 368: 
 369:         async function leaveRoom() {
 370:             const leavingRoomId = currentGameId; // capture before we null it out
 371:             const leavingAsHost = isHost;
 372: 
 373:             // If we're mid-game, reset game state first before returning to lobby
 374:             const gameContainer = document.querySelector('.game-container');
 375:             const inGame = gameContainer && gameContainer.style.display !== 'none';
 376:             if (inGame && typeof resetToLobby === 'function') {
 377:                 resetToLobby();
 378:             }
 379: 
 380:             if (myPlayerId) {
 381:                 await supabase.rpc('remove_player', { p_player_id: myPlayerId });
 382:             }
 383: 
 384:             // If the host leaves, delete the game_room entirely so it disappears from
 385:             // other players' browser lists immediately rather than lingering as an empty room.
 386:             if (leavingAsHost && leavingRoomId) {
 387:                 const { error: roomDeleteErr } = await supabase
 388:                     .from('game_room')
 389:                     .delete()
 390:                     .eq('id', leavingRoomId);
 391:                 if (roomDeleteErr) {
 392:                     console.warn('⚠️ Could not delete game_room on host leave:', roomDeleteErr.message);
 393:                 } else {
 394:                     console.log('🗑️ Deleted game_room', leavingRoomId, '(host left waiting room)');
 395:                 }
 396:             }
 397: 
 398:             myPlayerId = null;
 399:             currentGameId = null;
 400:             currentJoinCode = null;
 401:             isHost = false;
 402:             isMultiplayer = false;
 403:             isJoining = false;
 404:             stopLobbyPoll();
 405:             if (playersSubscription) { playersSubscription.unsubscribe(); playersSubscription = null; }
 406:             if (gameRoomSubscription) { gameRoomSubscription.unsubscribe(); gameRoomSubscription = null; }
 407:             if (gameChannel) { gameChannel.unsubscribe(); gameChannel = null; }
 408:             document.getElementById('ready-controls').style.display = 'none';
 409:             showGameBrowser();
 410:         }
 411: 
 412:         // --- Public game browser ---
 413: 
 414:         let browserRefreshInterval = null;
 415: 
 416:         async function refreshGameBrowser() {
 417:             const refreshBtn = document.getElementById('refresh-browser-btn');
 418:             if (refreshBtn) refreshBtn.textContent = '…';
 419: 
 420:             // Sweep stale players via server-side RPC (client DELETE is blocked by RLS)
 421:             await supabase.rpc('cleanup_inactive_players');
 422: 
 423:             const { data: rooms } = await supabase
 424:                 .from('game_room')
 425:                 .select('id,host_name,created_at')
 426:                 .eq('status', 'waiting')
 427:                 .eq('is_private', false)
 428:                 .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
 429: 
 430:             if (refreshBtn) refreshBtn.textContent = 'Refresh';
 431: 
 432:             const list = document.getElementById('public-games-list');
 433:             if (!list) return;
 434: 
 435:             if (!rooms?.length) {
 436:                 list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#ccc;font-style:italic;text-align:center;padding:20px 0;margin:0;">No public games open. Host one!</p>';
 437:                 return;
 438:             }
 439: 
 440:             // Fetch player counts for each room in one query
 441:             const ids = rooms.map(r => r.id);
 442:             const { data: players } = await supabase
 443:                 .from('players')
 444:                 .select('game_id')
 445:                 .in('game_id', ids);
 446:             const counts = {};
 447:             (players || []).forEach(p => { counts[p.game_id] = (counts[p.game_id] || 0) + 1; });
 448: 
 449:             // Auto-delete ghost rooms via RPC (client DELETE blocked by RLS)
 450:             supabase.rpc('cleanup_ghost_rooms').then(() => {
 451:                 const ghostCount = rooms.filter(r => !counts[r.id]).length;
 452:                 if (ghostCount) console.log('🗑️ Cleaned up', ghostCount, 'empty ghost room(s)');
 453:             });
 454: 
 455:             // Only show rooms that actually have players in them
 456:             const liveRooms = rooms.filter(r => (counts[r.id] || 0) > 0);
 457:             if (!liveRooms.length) {
 458:                 list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#ccc;font-style:italic;text-align:center;padding:20px 0;margin:0;">No public games open. Host one!</p>';
 459:                 return;
 460:             }
 461: 
 462:             list.innerHTML = liveRooms.map(r => `
 463:                 <div class="game-room-card" onclick="joinPublicGame(${r.id})">
 464:                     <div class="game-room-host">${_esc(r.host_name || 'Unnamed Game')}</div>
 465:                     <div class="game-room-count">${counts[r.id]} / 5</div>
 466:                     <button class="game-room-join-btn">Join</button>
 467:                 </div>`).join('');
 468:         }
 469: 
 470:         function startBrowserRefresh() {
 471:             stopBrowserRefresh();
 472:             browserRefreshInterval = setInterval(refreshGameBrowser, 5000);
 473:         }
 474:         function stopBrowserRefresh() {
 475:             clearInterval(browserRefreshInterval);
 476:             browserRefreshInterval = null;
 477:         }
 478: 
 479:         // Simple HTML escape helper
 480:         function _esc(str) {
 481:             return String(str)
 482:                 .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
 483:                 .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
 484:                 .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
 485:                 .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
 486:         }

 488:         // ── Retro dialog helpers ──────────────────────────────────
 489:         /**
 490:          * Show a retro-styled confirm dialog.
 491:          * onOk is called if the player clicks OK; nothing happens on Cancel.
 492:          */
 493:         function showRetroConfirm(title, lines, onOk) {
 494:             const id = 'retro-confirm-overlay';
 495:             if (document.getElementById(id)) return; // prevent duplicates
 496: 
 497:             const bodyLines = lines.map(l => `<div class="retro-dlg-line">${l}</div>`).join('');
 498:             const el = document.createElement('div');
 499:             el.id        = id;
 500:             el.className = 'retro-dlg-overlay';
 501:             el.innerHTML = `
 502:                 <div class="retro-dlg-box">
 503:                     <div class="retro-dlg-title">${title}</div>
 504:                     <div class="retro-dlg-body">${bodyLines}</div>
 505:                     <div class="retro-dlg-btns">
 506:                         <button class="retro-dlg-btn ok"     id="retro-confirm-ok">OK</button>
 507:                         <button class="retro-dlg-btn cancel" id="retro-confirm-cancel">Cancel</button>
 508:                     </div>
 509:                 </div>`;
 510: 
 511:             document.body.appendChild(el);
 512: 
 513:             document.getElementById('retro-confirm-ok').onclick = () => {
 514:                 el.remove();
 515:                 onOk();
 516:             };
 517:             document.getElementById('retro-confirm-cancel').onclick = () => el.remove();
 518:         }
 519:

 524:         // Sequence tracking for detecting out-of-order messages and deduplication
 525:         let scrollEventSequence = 0;
 526:         const receivedSequences = new Set();
 527: 
 528:         // Periodically clean old sequence IDs (keep last 1000 to prevent memory leak)
 529:         setInterval(() => {
 530:             if (receivedSequences.size > 1000) {
 531:                 const arr = Array.from(receivedSequences);
 532:                 receivedSequences.clear();
 533:                 // Keep most recent 500
 534:                 arr.slice(-500).forEach(id => receivedSequences.add(id));
 535:                 console.log('🧹 Cleaned old event IDs from deduplication cache');
 536:             }
 537:         }, 30000); // Every 30 seconds

 539:         // Join the lobby
 540:         async function joinLobby() {
 541:             // Prevent double-joins
 542:             if (isJoining) {
 543:                 console.log('Already joining, please wait...');
 544:                 return;
 545:             }
 546: 
 547:             const username = lobbyUsername;
 548: 
 549:             if (!username) {
 550:                 alert('Not signed in — please sign in first');
 551:                 return;
 552:             }
 553: 
 554:             // Disable input and button, show loading spinner
 555:             isJoining = true;
 556:             const joinButton = document.getElementById('join-button');
 557:             const loadingDiv = document.getElementById('join-loading');
 558:             joinButton.disabled = true;
 559:             usernameInput.disabled = true;
 560:             loadingDiv.style.display = 'block';
 561: 
 562:             try {
 563:                 // First, clean up any stale players (older than 10 minutes)
 564:                 // Increased timeout for development - players won't be kicked while debugging
 565:                 await supabase
 566:                     .from('players')
 567:                     .delete()
 568:                     .lt('last_seen', new Date(Date.now() - 600000).toISOString());
 569: 
 570:                 // Check game room status — only reset if truly abandoned (no players left)
 571:                 const { data: room } = await supabase
 572:                     .from('game_room')
 573:                     .select('status')
 574:                     .eq('id', 1)
 575:                     .single();
 576: 
 577:                 if (room && (room.status === 'playing' || room.status === 'finished')) {
 578:                     // Count how many players are still in the DB
 579:                     const { data: activePlayers } = await supabase
 580:                         .from('players')
 581:                         .select('id');
 582: 
 583:                     if (activePlayers && activePlayers.length > 0) {
 584:                         // Game is in progress with real players — don't nuke it
 585:                         alert('A game is currently in progress with other players.\n\nPlease wait for it to finish, or use "Reset Lobby" to force-clear.');
 586:                         isJoining = false;
 587:                         joinButton.disabled = false;
 588:                         usernameInput.disabled = false;
 589:                         loadingDiv.style.display = 'none';
 590:                         return;
 591:                     }
 592: 
 593:                     // No players left — safe to reset this abandoned game
 594:                     await supabase
 595:                         .from('game_room')
 596:                         .update({ status: 'waiting', current_turn_index: 0 })
 597:                         .eq('id', 1);
 598:                 }
 599: 
 600:                 // Check if username is already taken
 601:                 const { data: existingPlayers } = await supabase
 602:                     .from('players')
 603:                     .select('*')
 604:                     .order('created_at', { ascending: true });
 605: 
 606:                 const usernameTaken = existingPlayers && existingPlayers.some(p => p.username === username);
 607:                 if (usernameTaken) {
 608:                     alert('Username already taken! Please choose a different name.');
 609:                     // Re-enable inputs
 610:                     isJoining = false;
 611:                     joinButton.disabled = false;
 612:                     usernameInput.disabled = false;
 613:                     loadingDiv.style.display = 'none';
 614:                     return;
 615:                 }
 616: 
 617:                 // Insert player into database
 618:                 const { data, error } = await supabase
 619:                     .from('players')
 620:                     .insert([{ username, is_ready: false }])
 621:                     .select()
 622:                     .single();
 623: 
 624:                 if (error) throw error;
 625: 
 626:                 myPlayerId = data.id;
 627:                 isMultiplayer = true;
 628:                 localReadyState = false;
 629:                 updateReadyButton(false);
 630: 
 631:                 // After insertion, check if we're the first player (host)
 632:                 // The host is simply the player with the oldest created_at timestamp
 633:                 const { data: allPlayersAfterInsert } = await supabase
 634:                     .from('players')
 635:                     .select('*')
 636:                     .order('created_at', { ascending: true });
 637: 
 638:                 // We're host if we're the first player (by creation time)
 639:                 isHost = allPlayersAfterInsert && allPlayersAfterInsert[0].id === myPlayerId;
 640: 
 641:                 // Host is implicitly ready — their action is clicking Start, not toggling ready
 642:                 if (isHost) {
 643:                     localReadyState = true;
 644:                     await supabase.from('players').update({ is_ready: true }).eq('id', myPlayerId);
 645:                 }
 646: 
 647:                 console.log('✅ Joined lobby as:', username, 'ID:', myPlayerId, isHost ? '(HOST)' : '');
 648: 
 649:                 // Hide join form, show ready controls
 650:                 document.getElementById('join-form').style.display = 'none';
 651:                 document.getElementById('ready-controls').style.display = 'block';
 652:                 updateReadyButton(localReadyState);
 653: 
 654:                 // Start listening for updates
 655:                 subscribeToLobby();
 656:                 updateHeartbeat();
 657:                 startLobbyPoll(); // Auto-refresh player list every 10s while in lobby
 658:                 updatePlayerList(); // Initial update to show host controls
 659: 
 660:             } catch (error) {
 661:                 console.error('Error joining lobby:', error);
 662:                 alert('Failed to join lobby: ' + error.message);
 663: 
 664:                 // Re-enable inputs on error
 665:                 isJoining = false;
 666:                 joinButton.disabled = false;
 667:                 usernameInput.disabled = false;
 668:                 loadingDiv.style.display = 'none';
 669:             }
 670:         }

 677:                 'Leave Game?',
 678:                 ['You will be removed from this game', 'and cannot rejoin.'],

 683:         async function _doLeaveGame() {
 684:             try {
 685:                 console.log('👋 Leaving game...');
 686: 
 687:                 // Delete myself from players table via RPC (direct DELETE blocked by RLS)
 688:                 const { error } = await supabase
 689:                     .rpc('remove_player', { p_player_id: myPlayerId });
 690: 
 691:                 if (error) throw error;
 692: 
 693:                 // Reset local state
 694:                 myPlayerId = null;
 695:                 myPlayerIndex = null;
 696:                 isHost = false;
 697:                 isMultiplayer = false;
 698: 
 699:                 // Stop polling and subscriptions
 700:                 stopLobbyPoll();
 701:                 stopLastManStandingPoll();
 702: 
 703:                 // Unsubscribe from channels
 704:                 if (playersSubscription) {
 705:                     playersSubscription.unsubscribe();
 706:                     playersSubscription = null;
 707:                 }
 708:                 if (gameRoomSubscription) {
 709:                     gameRoomSubscription.unsubscribe();
 710:                     gameRoomSubscription = null;
 711:                 }
 712:                 if (gameChannel) {
 713:                     gameChannel.unsubscribe();
 714:                     gameChannel = null;
 715:                 }
 716: 
 717:                 // Reset UI state
 718:                 const readyCtrl = document.getElementById('ready-controls');
 719:                 if (readyCtrl) readyCtrl.style.display = 'none';
 720:                 currentGameId = null;
 721:                 currentJoinCode = null;
 722: 
 723:                 // resetToLobby handles: clearBoard, stopTurnTimerMonitoring,
 724:                 // hiding game-layout, showing lobby-wrapper, hiding leave/end-turn buttons
 725:                 resetToLobby();
 726: 
 727:                 // Return to game browser panel
 728:                 showGameBrowser();
 729: 
 730:                 console.log('✅ Left game successfully');
 731: 
 732:             } catch (error) {
 733:                 console.error('Error leaving game:', error);
 734:                 showRetroConfirm('Leave Failed', [error.message], () => {});
 735:             }
 736:         }

 738:         // Reset the entire lobby (clear all players and reset game room)
 739:         function resetLobby() {
 740:             showRetroConfirm(
 741:                 'Reset Lobby?',
 742:                 ['Remove all players', 'Reset room to waiting state', 'Clear the board'],
 743:                 _doResetLobby
 744:             );

 747:         async function _doResetLobby() {
 748:             try {
 749:                 console.log('📄 Resetting lobby...');
 750: 
 751:                 // Delete all players in the current room
 752:                 const { data: allPlayers } = await supabase
 753:                     .from('players')
 754:                     .select('id')
 755:                     .eq('game_id', currentGameId);
 756: 
 757:                 if (allPlayers && allPlayers.length > 0) {
 758:                     const { error: playersError } = await supabase
 759:                         .from('players')
 760:                         .delete()
 761:                         .in('id', allPlayers.map(p => p.id));
 762: 
 763:                     if (playersError) throw playersError;
 764:                 }
 765: 
 766:                 // Reset game room status
 767:                 const { error: roomError } = await supabase
 768:                     .from('game_room')
 769:                     .update({ status: 'waiting', current_turn_index: 0 })
 770:                     .eq('id', currentGameId);
 771: 
 772:                 if (roomError) throw roomError;
 773: 
 774:                 // Reset local state
 775:                 myPlayerId = null;
 776:                 currentGameId = null;
 777:                 currentJoinCode = null;
 778:                 isHost = false;
 779:                 isJoining = false;
 780:                 isMultiplayer = false;
 781: 
 782:                 // Stop lobby polling
 783:                 stopLobbyPoll();
 784: 
 785:                 // Unsubscribe from channels
 786:                 if (playersSubscription) {
 787:                     playersSubscription.unsubscribe();
 788:                     playersSubscription = null;
 789:                 }
 790:                 if (gameRoomSubscription) {
 791:                     gameRoomSubscription.unsubscribe();
 792:                     gameRoomSubscription = null;
 793:                 }
 794: 
 795:                 // Reset UI — return to game browser
 796:                 document.getElementById('ready-controls').style.display = 'none';
 797: 
 798:                 // Hide game, show lobby
 799:                 document.querySelector('.game-container').style.display = 'none';
 800:                 document.getElementById('multiplayer-lobby').style.display = 'block';
 801: 
 802:                 // Clear the board if it was started
 803:                 clearBoard(true);
 804: 
 805:                 // Return to the game browser
 806:                 showGameBrowser();
 807: 
 808:                 console.log('✅ Lobby reset complete!');
 809:                 alert('Lobby has been reset! You can now host or join again.');
 810: 
 811:             } catch (error) {
 812:                 console.error('Error resetting lobby:', error);
 813:                 alert('Failed to reset lobby: ' + error.message);
 814:             }
 815:         }

 817:         // Guard: XP is awarded once per game session — prevents double-award from
 818:         // multiple handleGameOver calls (game-core direct + broadcast echo + DB subscription)
 819:         let _gameOverXpAwarded = false;
 820: 
 821:         // Handle game over - mark game as finished and show win screen
 822:         async function handleGameOver(winnerPlayerIndex, winType = 'scrolls') {
 823:             if (!isMultiplayer) return;
 824: 
 825:             try {
 826:                 console.log('🏆 Game Over! Winner:', winnerPlayerIndex, 'Type:', winType);
 827:                 stopLastManStandingPoll();
 828: 
 829:                 // Award gamification XP FIRST — before showing the overlay — so the async RPC
 830:                 // completes before any page reload triggered by "Return to Lobby" can cancel it
 831:                 if (!_gameOverXpAwarded) {
 832:                     _gameOverXpAwarded = true;
 833:                     const isWinner = (winnerPlayerIndex === myPlayerIndex);
 834:                     console.log(`[XP] Attempting to award XP — isWinner=${isWinner}, userId=${window.gami?.userId}, totalPlayers=${totalPlayers}`);
 835:                     if (window.gami?.userId) {
 836:                         await window.gami.onGameComplete(isWinner, totalPlayers);
 837:                     } else {
 838:                         console.warn('[XP] gami.userId not set — XP skipped. gami object:', window.gami);
 839:                     }
 840:                 } else {
 841:                     console.log('[XP] handleGameOver called again — XP already awarded this session, skipping.');
 842:                 }
 843: 
 844:                 // Show win screen after XP is secured
 845:                 showGameOverToAll(winnerPlayerIndex, winType);
 846: 
 847:                 // Broadcast win type so other clients show the correct message
 848:                 broadcastGameAction('game-over', { winnerIndex: winnerPlayerIndex, winType });
 849: 
 850:                 // Update game room status to 'finished' and store winner index
 851:                 const { error } = await supabase
 852:                     .from('game_room')
 853:                     .update({
 854:                         status: 'finished',
 855:                         current_turn_index: winnerPlayerIndex
 856:                     })
 857:                     .eq('id', currentGameId);
 858: 
 859:                 if (error) {
 860:                     console.error('Error updating game over state:', error);
 861:                 }
 862:             } catch (error) {
 863:                 console.error('Error handling game over:', error);
 864:             }
 865:         }

 999:         // Subscribe to lobby updates
1000:         function subscribeToLobby() {
1001:             // Unsubscribe from any existing channels first
1002:             if (playersSubscription) {
1003:                 playersSubscription.unsubscribe();
1004:             }
1005:             if (gameRoomSubscription) {
1006:                 gameRoomSubscription.unsubscribe();
1007:             }
1008:             
1009:             // Subscribe to players table (scoped to this room)
1010:             playersSubscription = supabase
1011:                 .channel('players-' + currentGameId + '-' + Math.random())
1012:                 .on('postgres_changes',
1013:                     { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'players',
1014:                       filter: `game_id=eq.${currentGameId}` },
1015:                     async (payload) => {
1016:                         console.log('Players update:', payload);
1017: 
1018:                         // Handle our own player being deleted (kicked or lobby reset)
1019:                         if (payload.eventType === 'DELETE' && payload.old.id === myPlayerId) {
1020:                             console.log('📄 You were removed from the lobby (kicked or reset detected)');
1021: 
1022:                             // Check if we're in a game - if so, need to reset game state first
1023:                             const gameContainer = document.querySelector('.game-container');
1024:                             const inGame = gameContainer && gameContainer.style.display !== 'none';
1025: 
1026:                             if (inGame) {
1027:                                 console.log('⏰ Kicked during game - resetting to lobby');
1028:                                 // Call resetToLobby to properly clean up game state
1029:                                 if (typeof resetToLobby === 'function') {
1030:                                     resetToLobby();
1031:                                 }
1032:                             }
1033: 
1034:                             // Reset local state
1035:                             myPlayerId = null;
1036:                             myPlayerIndex = null;
1037:                             isHost = false;
1038:                             isMultiplayer = false;
1039: 
1040:                             // Unsubscribe from channels
1041:                             if (playersSubscription) {
1042:                                 playersSubscription.unsubscribe();
1043:                                 playersSubscription = null;
1044:                             }
1045:                             if (gameRoomSubscription) {
1046:                                 gameRoomSubscription.unsubscribe();
1047:                                 gameRoomSubscription = null;
1048:                             }
1049:                             if (gameChannel) {
1050:                                 gameChannel.unsubscribe();
1051:                                 gameChannel = null;
1052:                             }
1053: 
1054:                             // Show alert and reload the page to fully reset
1055:                             alert('You were kicked from the game (timeout). The page will refresh.');
1056: 
1057:                             // Reload the page to return to a clean state
1058:                             setTimeout(() => {
1059:                                 window.location.reload();
1060:                             }, 500);
1061: 
1062:                             return; // Don't update player list since we're no longer in lobby
1063:                         }
1064: 
1065:                         // Handle other players leaving during game
1066:                         if (payload.eventType === 'DELETE' && payload.old.id !== myPlayerId) {
1067:                             console.log('👋 Another player left:', payload.old);
1068: 
1069:                             // Show notification if game is in progress
1070:                             const { data: room } = await supabase
1071:                                 .from('game_room')
1072:                                 .select('status')
1073:                                 .eq('id', currentGameId)
1074:                                 .single();
1075: 
1076:                             if (room && room.status === 'playing') {
1077:                                 const leftPlayer = allPlayersData.find(p => p.id === payload.old.id);
1078:                                 const playerName = leftPlayer ? getPlayerColorName(leftPlayer.player_index) : 'A player';
1079:                                 updateStatus(`${playerName} left the game`);
1080: 
1081:                                 // Check if I'm the only player left (scoped to this room)
1082:                             const { data: remainingPlayers } = await supabase
1083:                                 .from('players')
1084:                                 .select('id, username, player_index, color')
1085:                                 .eq('game_id', currentGameId);
1086: 
1087:                                 console.log('💥 Remaining players after deletion:', remainingPlayers);
1088:                                 console.log('📍 My player ID:', myPlayerId);
1089: 
1090:                                 if (remainingPlayers && remainingPlayers.length === 1 && remainingPlayers[0].id === myPlayerId) {
1091:                                     console.log('I am the last player remaining - win by default!');
1092:                                     console.log('My player index:', myPlayerIndex);
1093: 
1094:                                     // Mark game as finished with me as winner
1095:                                     if (myPlayerIndex !== null && myPlayerIndex !== undefined) {
1096:                                         console.log('Calling handleGameOver with index:', myPlayerIndex);
1097:                                         await handleGameOver(myPlayerIndex, 'last_standing');
1098:                                     } else {
1099:                                         console.error('Cannot win - myPlayerIndex is null/undefined');
1100:                                     }
1101:                                 } else {
1102:                                     console.log('Still', remainingPlayers?.length || 0, 'players in game');
1103:                                 }
1104: 
1105:                                 // Update placement-phase tracking if a player was kicked/left
1106:                                 if (remainingPlayers) {
1107:                                     totalPlayers = remainingPlayers.length;
1108:                                     allPlayersData = remainingPlayers;
1109: 
1110:                                     if (isPlacementPhase) {
1111:                                         const remainingIndices = new Set(
1112:                                             remainingPlayers
1113:                                                 .map(p => p.player_index)
1114:                                                 .filter(i => i !== null && i !== undefined)
1115:                                         );
1116: 
1117:                                         // Drop placements for players that left
1118:                                         playerTilesPlaced = new Set(
1119:                                             Array.from(playerTilesPlaced).filter(idx => remainingIndices.has(idx))
1120:                                         );
1121: 
1122:                                         // If all remaining players have placed, complete placement phase (host only)
1123:                                         if (isHost && playerTilesPlaced.size >= totalPlayers && totalPlayers > 0) {
1124:                                             isPlacementPhase = false;
1125:                                             const sorted = Array.from(remainingIndices).sort((a, b) => a - b);
1126:                                             activePlayerIndex = sorted[0];
1127:                                             const startedAt = Date.now();
1128:                                             turnStartedAtMs = startedAt;
1129:                                             broadcastGameAction('placement-complete', {
1130:                                                 playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
1131:                                                 turnStartedAt: startedAt
1132:                                             });
1133:                                             updateTurnDisplay();
1134:                                         }
1135:                                     }
1136:                                 }
1137:                             }
1138:                         }
1139: 
1140:                         // Update our local isHost status when players change
1141:                         // Check if we're now the first player (host) within this room
1142:                         if (myPlayerId) {
1143:                             const { data: allPlayers } = await supabase
1144:                                 .from('players')
1145:                                 .select('*')
1146:                                 .eq('game_id', currentGameId)
1147:                                 .order('created_at', { ascending: true });
1148: 
1149:                             if (allPlayers && allPlayers.length > 0) {
1150:                                 const wasHost = isHost;
1151:                                 isHost = allPlayers[0].id === myPlayerId;
1152: 
1153:                                 // Notify if we became host
1154:                                 if (!wasHost && isHost) {
1155:                                     console.log('You are now the host.');
1156:                                     startDisconnectMonitor();
1157:                                 }
1158:                             }
1159:                         }
1160: 
1161:                         updatePlayerList();
1162:                     }
1163:                 )
1164:                 .subscribe();
1165:             
1166:             // Subscribe to game_room table (scoped to this room)
1167:             gameRoomSubscription = supabase
1168:                 .channel('game-room-sub-' + currentGameId + '-' + Math.random())
1169:                 .on('postgres_changes',
1170:                     { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'game_room',
1171:                       filter: `id=eq.${currentGameId}` },
1172:                     (payload) => {
1173:                         console.log('Game room update:', payload);
1174:                         if (payload.new && payload.new.status === 'playing') {
1175:                             handleGameStart();
1176:                         } else if (payload.new && payload.new.status === 'finished') {
1177:                             // Game ended - show win screen to all players who didn't trigger it themselves
1178:                             console.log('🏁 Game finished!');
1179:                             const winnerIndex = payload.new.current_turn_index ?? 0;
1180:                             // Only show if we're not the winner (winner already saw it via handleGameOver)
1181:                             if (winnerIndex !== myPlayerIndex) {
1182:                                 showGameOverToAll(winnerIndex, 'scrolls');
1183:                             }
1184:                         }
1185:                     }
1186:                 )
1187:                 .subscribe();
1188: 
1189:             // Initial update
1190:             updatePlayerList();
1191: 
1192:             // Fallback: poll once after subscription is established in case we missed
1193:             // the status='playing' update while the Realtime channel was connecting
1194:             setTimeout(async () => {
1195:                 if (!currentGameId) return;
1196:                 if (document.getElementById('game-layout')?.classList.contains('active')) return;
1197:                 const { data: room } = await supabase
1198:                     .from('game_room')
1199:                     .select('status')
1200:                     .eq('id', currentGameId)
1201:                     .single();
1202:                 if (room?.status === 'playing') {
1203:                     console.log('🔄 Fallback poll: detected game already started — joining now');
1204:                     handleGameStart();
1205:                 }
1206:             }, 2000);
1207:         }

1283:                     statusDiv.style.color = '#4CAF50';
1284:                 } else {

1286:                     statusDiv.style.color = '#4CAF50';

1294:         // ── Bot players (host-only) ──────────────────────────────────
1295:         // A bot is a plain `players` row whose username carries the bot
1296:         // prefix (window.BOT_USERNAME_PREFIX, set by js/bot-driver.js).
1297:         // It has no client of its own: the HOST's browser drives its
1298:         // placement and turns (see js/bot-driver.js). From the lobby's
1299:         // perspective it counts as a player for everything — player count,
1300:         // colors, turn order, start conditions.
1301:         async function toggleBotPlayer() {
1302:             if (!isHost || !currentGameId) return;
1303:             try {
1304:                 const { data: players, error } = await supabase
1305:                     .from('players')
1306:                     .select('id, username')
1307:                     .eq('game_id', currentGameId);
1308:                 if (error) throw error;
1309: 
1310:                 const bots = (players || []).filter(p => window.isBotUsername?.(p.username));
1311:                 if (bots.length > 0) {
1312:                     // Remove the most recently added bot (direct DELETE is blocked by RLS)
1313:                     await supabase.rpc('remove_player', { p_player_id: bots[bots.length - 1].id });
1314:                     console.log('🤖 Bot removed from lobby');
1315:                 } else {
1316:                     if ((players || []).length >= 5) { alert('Room is full!'); return; }
1317:                     await supabase.from('players').insert([{
1318:                         username: (window.BOT_USERNAME_PREFIX || '🤖') + ' Bot',
1319:                         is_ready: true, // bots are always ready
1320:                         game_id: currentGameId
1321:                     }]);
1322:                     console.log('🤖 Bot added to lobby');
1323:                 }
1324:                 updatePlayerList();
1325:             } catch (e) {
1326:                 console.error('Bot toggle failed:', e);
1327:                 alert('Could not add/remove bot: ' + e.message);
1328:             }
1329:         }
1330:         window.toggleBotPlayer = toggleBotPlayer;

1332:         // Host starts the game manually
1333:         async function hostStartGame() {
1334:             if (!isHost) {
1335:                 alert('Only the host can start the game!');
1336:                 return;
1337:             }
1338: 
1339:             // Disable the button immediately to prevent double-clicks
1340:             const startBtn = document.getElementById('host-start-button');
1341:             if (startBtn) startBtn.disabled = true;
1342: 
1343:             try {
1344:                 const { data: players, error } = await supabase
1345:                     .from('players')
1346:                     .select('*')
1347:                     .eq('game_id', currentGameId);
1348: 
1349:                 if (error) throw error;
1350: 
1351:                 // Validate player count
1352:                 if (players.length < 2) {
1353:                     if (startBtn) startBtn.disabled = false;
1354:                     alert('Need at least 2 players to start!');
1355:                     return;
1356:                 }
1357: 
1358:                 if (players.length > 5) {
1359:                     if (startBtn) startBtn.disabled = false;
1360:                     alert('Too many players! Maximum is 5.');
1361:                     return;
1362:                 }
1363: 
1364:                 console.log('🎮 Host starting game with', players.length, 'players...');
1365: 
1366:                 // Get turn timer settings
1367:                 const timeoutSelect = document.getElementById('timeout-setting');
1368:                 const turnTimeLimit = parseInt(timeoutSelect.value, 10) * 1000; // seconds -> ms
1369:                 const kickCheckbox = document.getElementById('kick-on-timeout');
1370:                 const kickMode = !!(kickCheckbox && kickCheckbox.checked);
1371: 
1372:                 console.log('⚠️ Turn time limit set to:', turnTimeLimit / 1000, 'seconds');
1373:                 console.log('👢 Kick on turn timeout:', kickMode);
1374: 
1375:                 // Randomly assign player indices and colors
1376:                 const colorRankOrder = ['purple', 'yellow', 'red', 'blue', 'green'];
1377:                 const shuffledIndices = [...Array(players.length).keys()].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
1378: 
1379:                 // Update game room status to trigger game start and store turn-timer settings
1380:                 const startedAtIso = new Date().toISOString();
1381: 
1382:                 // Try writing extended fields; if the DB schema doesn't have them, fall back gracefully.
1383:                 let { error: roomError } = await supabase
1384:                     .from('game_room')
1385:                     .update({
1386:                         status: 'playing',
1387:                         current_turn_index: 0,
1388:                         inactivity_timeout: turnTimeLimit,        // reused as turn time limit (ms)
1389:                         kick_on_turn_timeout: kickMode,
1390:                         turn_started_at: startedAtIso
1391:                     })
1392:                     .eq('id', currentGameId);
1393: 
1394:                 if (roomError) {
1395:                     console.warn('⚠️ Failed to write extended turn timer fields to game_room. Trying without optional fields...', roomError);
1396:                     // Try without kick_on_turn_timeout and turn_started_at
1397:                     let fallback = await supabase
1398:                         .from('game_room')
1399:                         .update({
1400:                             status: 'playing',
1401:                             current_turn_index: 0,
1402:                             inactivity_timeout: turnTimeLimit
1403:                         })
1404:                         .eq('id', currentGameId);
1405: 
1406:                     if (fallback.error) {
1407:                         console.warn('⚠️ Second fallback failed, trying minimal update...', fallback.error);
1408:                         // Minimal fallback - just status and turn index
1409:                         fallback = await supabase
1410:                             .from('game_room')
1411:                             .update({
1412:                                 status: 'playing',
1413:                                 current_turn_index: 0
1414:                             })
1415:                             .eq('id', currentGameId);
1416:                     }
1417: 
1418:                     roomError = fallback.error;
1419:                 }
1420: 
1421:                 if (roomError) throw roomError;
1422: 
1423:                 // Also set local host timer baseline immediately
1424:                 gameInactivityTimeout = turnTimeLimit;
1425:                 kickOnTurnTimeout = kickMode;
1426:                 turnStartedAtMs = Date.now();
1427: 
1428:                 // Assign colors and indices to players
1429:                 for (let i = 0; i < players.length; i++) {
1430:                     const player = players[i];
1431:                     const assignedIndex = shuffledIndices[i];
1432:                     const assignedColor = colorRankOrder[assignedIndex];
1433: 
1434:                     await supabase
1435:                         .from('players')
1436:                         .update({
1437:                             player_index: assignedIndex,
1438:                             color: assignedColor
1439:                         })
1440:                         .eq('id', player.id);
1441:                 }
1442: 
1443:                 console.log('✅ Game started by host!');
1444: 
1445:                 // Host transitions immediately; non-host players receive the trigger via Realtime
1446:                 await handleGameStart();
1447: 
1448:             } catch (error) {
1449:                 console.error('Error starting game:', error);
1450:                 if (startBtn) startBtn.disabled = false; // allow retry
1451:                 alert('Failed to start game: ' + error.message);
1452:             }
1453:         }
1454: 
1455:         // Handle game start
1456:         async function handleGameStart() {
1457:             // Guard against duplicate calls (host's direct call + Realtime subscription racing)
1458:             if (document.getElementById('game-layout').classList.contains('active')) {
1459:                 console.log('🔁 handleGameStart: game already active — skipping duplicate call');
1460:                 return;
1461:             }
1462:             try {
1463:                 // Wait for player_index to be assigned (retry up to 10 times)
1464:                 let myPlayer = null;
1465:                 let attempts = 0;
1466:                 
1467:                 while (attempts < 10) {
1468:                     const { data, error } = await supabase
1469:                         .from('players')
1470:                         .select('*')
1471:                         .eq('id', myPlayerId)
1472:                         .single();
1473:                     
1474:                     if (error) throw error;
1475:                     
1476:                     if (data.player_index !== null && data.player_index !== undefined) {
1477:                         myPlayer = data;
1478:                         break;
1479:                     }
1480:                     
1481:                     console.log(`⏳ Waiting for player index assignment (attempt ${attempts + 1}/10)...`);
1482:                     await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
1483:                     attempts++;
1484:                 }
1485:                 
1486:                 if (!myPlayer || myPlayer.player_index === null) {
1487:                     throw new Error('Player index was not assigned');
1488:                 }
1489:                 
1490:                 myPlayerIndex = myPlayer.player_index;
1491:                 
1492:                 // Get all players in this room
1493:                 const { data: allPlayers } = await supabase
1494:                     .from('players')
1495:                     .select('*')
1496:                     .eq('game_id', currentGameId)
1497:                     .order('player_index', { ascending: true });
1498:                 
1499:                 console.log('🎮 Starting multiplayer game!');
1500:                 console.log('My index:', myPlayerIndex);
1501:                 console.log('My color:', myPlayer.color);
1502:                 console.log('All players:', allPlayers);
1503:                 
1504:                 // Get game room settings (turn timer)
1505:                 // We select '*' for forward/backward compatibility if columns are missing.
1506:                 const { data: room } = await supabase
1507:                     .from('game_room')
1508:                     .select('*')
1509:                     .eq('id', currentGameId)
1510:                     .single();
1511: 
1512:                 if (room && room.inactivity_timeout !== null && room.inactivity_timeout !== undefined) {
1513:                     gameInactivityTimeout = room.inactivity_timeout; // reused as turn time limit (ms)
1514:                     console.log('⚠️ Loaded turn time limit:', gameInactivityTimeout / 1000, 'seconds');
1515:                 }
1516: 
1517:                 if (room && room.kick_on_turn_timeout !== null && room.kick_on_turn_timeout !== undefined) {
1518:                     kickOnTurnTimeout = !!room.kick_on_turn_timeout;
1519:                     console.log('👢 kickOnTurnTimeout:', kickOnTurnTimeout);
1520:                 }
1521: 
1522:                 // Set turn started time
1523:                 if (room && room.turn_started_at) {
1524:                     const ts = new Date(room.turn_started_at).getTime();
1525:                     if (!Number.isNaN(ts)) {
1526:                         turnStartedAtMs = ts;
1527:                     } else {
1528:                         turnStartedAtMs = Date.now();
1529:                     }
1530:                 } else {
1531:                     turnStartedAtMs = Date.now();
1532:                 }
1533: 
1534:                 // Derive deck seed from player IDs - this is deterministic and shared
1535:                 // Sort player IDs and hash them to get a consistent seed
1536:                 const sortedPlayerIds = allPlayers.map(p => p.id).sort().join('');
1537:                 let gameDeckSeed = 0;
1538:                 for (let i = 0; i < sortedPlayerIds.length; i++) {
1539:                     gameDeckSeed = ((gameDeckSeed << 5) - gameDeckSeed + sortedPlayerIds.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
1540:                 }
1541:                 gameDeckSeed = Math.abs(gameDeckSeed);
1542:                 console.log('🎴 Derived deck seed from player IDs:', gameDeckSeed);
1543: 
1544:                 // Hide lobby, show new game layout
1545:                 document.getElementById('lobby-wrapper').style.display = 'none';
1546:                 document.getElementById('game-layout').classList.add('active');
1547:                 updateDeckIndicatorVisibility();
1548: 
1549:                 // Show leave game and end turn buttons in multiplayer
1550:                 document.getElementById('leave-game').style.display = 'inline-block';
1551:                 document.getElementById('end-turn').style.display = 'inline-block';
1552: 
1553:                 // Show timer HUD element
1554:                 document.getElementById('hud-timer').style.display = 'flex';
1555: 
1556:                 // Initialize new UI elements
1557:                 initializeNewUI();
1558: 
1559:                 // Start turn timer monitoring (turn-based timeout)
1560:                 startTurnTimerMonitoring();
1561: 
1562:                 // Host monitors for disconnected players (stale last_seen)
1563:                 if (isHost) startDisconnectMonitor();
1564: 
1565:                 // All players poll every 5 s — bulletproof fallback for last-man-standing
1566:                 startLastManStandingPoll();
1567: 
1568:                 // Initialize game with multiplayer players and shared deck seed
1569:                 startMultiplayerGame(allPlayers, gameDeckSeed);
1570:                 
1571:             } catch (error) {
1572:                 console.error('Error handling game start:', error);
1573:                 alert('Failed to start game: ' + error.message);
1574:             }
1575:         }
1576: 
1577:         // Update heartbeat — keeps last_seen current in both lobby and active game
1578:         let _heartbeatInterval = null;
1579:         function updateHeartbeat() {
1580:             if (!myPlayerId) return;
1581:             if (_heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(_heartbeatInterval);
1582:             const beat = async () => {
1583:                 if (!myPlayerId) { clearInterval(_heartbeatInterval); return; }
1584:                 try {
1585:                     await supabase
1586:                         .from('players')
1587:                         .update({ last_seen: new Date().toISOString() })
1588:                         .eq('id', myPlayerId);
1589:                     // Bots have no client — the host heartbeats them so cleanup
1590:                     // sweeps never mistake them for disconnected players.
1591:                     if (isHost && currentGameId && typeof window.BOT_USERNAME_PREFIX === 'string') {
1592:                         await supabase
1593:                             .from('players')
1594:                             .update({ last_seen: new Date().toISOString() })
1595:                             .eq('game_id', currentGameId)
1596:                             .like('username', window.BOT_USERNAME_PREFIX + '%');
1597:                     }
1598:                 } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
1599:             };
1600:             beat(); // Fire immediately so last_seen is never NULL
1601:             _heartbeatInterval = setInterval(beat, 15000); // Every 15 seconds
1602:         }
1603: 
1604:         // Host-only: periodically sweep disconnected players (stale last_seen).
1605:         // Deletion triggers the existing players DELETE handler on all clients,
1606:         // which shows "player left" notifications and handles turn skipping.
1607:         // During an active game (status=playing) we do NOT evict — the last-man-standing
1608:         // poll handles genuine disconnects, and idle-but-present players must not be removed.
1609:         let _disconnectMonitorInterval = null;
1610:         function startDisconnectMonitor() {
1611:             if (_disconnectMonitorInterval) clearInterval(_disconnectMonitorInterval);
1612:             _disconnectMonitorInterval = setInterval(async () => {
1613:                 if (!isHost || !currentGameId) return;
1614:                 try {
1615:                     // Check current room status — never evict from an active game
1616:                     const { data: room } = await supabase
1617:                         .from('game_room')
1618:                         .select('status')
1619:                         .eq('id', currentGameId)
1620:                         .single();
1621:                     if (!room || room.status === 'playing') return;
1622: 
1623:                     const staleThreshold = new Date(Date.now() - 45 * 1000).toISOString();
1624:                     const { data: allPlayers } = await supabase
1625:                         .from('players')
1626:                         .select('id, username, last_seen, created_at')
1627:                         .eq('game_id', currentGameId)
1628:                         .neq('id', myPlayerId); // never self-evict
1629:                     const stalePlayers = (allPlayers || []).filter(p => {
1630:                         // Bots have no client of their own — never evict them
1631:                         if (window.isBotUsername?.(p.username)) return false;
1632:                         // Use last_seen if available, fall back to created_at
1633:                         const ref = p.last_seen || p.created_at;
1634:                         return ref < staleThreshold;
1635:                     });
1636:                     for (const p of stalePlayers) {
1637:                         console.log(`⚠️ Disconnect: ${p.username} (last_seen=${p.last_seen}) — removing`);
1638:                         await supabase.rpc('remove_player', { p_player_id: p.id });
1639:                     }
1640:                 } catch (e) { /* ignore network errors */ }
1641:             }, 15000); // Check every 15 seconds
1642:         }
1643:         function stopDisconnectMonitor() {
1644:             if (_disconnectMonitorInterval) {
1645:                 clearInterval(_disconnectMonitorInterval);
1646:                 _disconnectMonitorInterval = null;
1647:             }
1648:         }
1649: 
1650:         // Clean up on page unload — call remove_player RPC (direct DELETE is blocked by RLS)
1651:         window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
1652:             if (!myPlayerId) return;
1653:             fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/rpc/remove_player`, {
1654:                 method: 'POST',
1655:                 headers: {
1656:                     'apikey': SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
1657:                     'Authorization': `Bearer ${SUPABASE_ANON_KEY}`,
1658:                     'Content-Type': 'application/json'
1659:                 },
1660:                 body: JSON.stringify({ p_player_id: myPlayerId }),
1661:                 keepalive: true
1662:             });
1663:         });
1664: 
1665:         // Auto-refresh player list when tab becomes visible again

1680:                 if (!myPlayerId) {
1681:                     stopLobbyPoll();

1684:                 // Only poll while in lobby phase (not during an active game)
1685:                 const lobbyVisible = document.getElementById('multiplayer-lobby').style.display !== 'none';
1686:                 if (lobbyVisible) {
1687:                     updatePlayerList();

1689:                     // Game started — stop polling
1690:                     stopLobbyPoll();
1691:                 }

1696:             if (lobbyPollInterval) {

1703:         // Secret keyboard sequence "reset" to reveal the Reset Lobby button
1704:         // Secret keyboard sequence "nuke" to wipe ALL rooms from the DB
1705:         (function() {
1706:             const SECRET = 'reset';
1707:             const NUKE = 'nuke';
1708:             let buffer = '';
1709:             document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
1710:                 // Only listen while lobby is visible
1711:                 const lobbyEl = document.getElementById('multiplayer-lobby');
1712:                 if (!lobbyEl || lobbyEl.style.display === 'none') return;
1713:                 // Ignore if user is typing in an input field
1714:                 if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') return;
1715: 
1716:                 buffer += e.key.toLowerCase();
1717:                 const maxLen = Math.max(SECRET.length, NUKE.length);
1718:                 if (buffer.length > maxLen) buffer = buffer.slice(-maxLen);
1719: 
1720:                 if (buffer.endsWith(SECRET)) {
1721:                     const btn = document.getElementById('reset-lobby-btn');
1722:                     if (btn) {
1723:                         btn.style.display = btn.style.display === 'none' ? '' : 'none';
1724:                         buffer = '';
1725:                     }
1726:                 }
1727: 
1728:                 if (buffer.endsWith(NUKE)) {
1729:                     buffer = '';
1730:                     if (!confirm('Nuke ALL rooms and players from the database?')) return;
1731:                     supabase.rpc('nuke_all_rooms').then(() => {
1732:                         console.log('💥 All rooms nuked.');
1733:                         window.location.reload();
1734:                     });
1735:                 }
1736:             });

1759:                 const tile = document.querySelector(`[data-tile-id="${tileId}"]`);

1766:                     if (typeof placedTiles !== 'undefined' && spellSystem && spellSystem.scrollEffects) {
1767:                         const tileObj = placedTiles.find(t => Number(t.id) === Number(tileId));
1768:                         const wr = spellSystem.scrollEffects.activeBuffs.wanderingRiver;
1769:                         const entry = Array.isArray(wr) ? wr.find(e => Number(e.tileId) === Number(tileId)) : null;
1770:                         if (tileObj && entry && entry.newElement) {
1771:                             spellSystem.scrollEffects.applyWanderingRiverIndicator(tileObj, entry.newElement);
1772:                         }
1773:                     }

1776:                 }

2673:                                 if (!trigScroll.definition && trigScroll.name) {
2674:                                     trigScroll.definition = spellSystem.patterns?.[trigScroll.name];
2675:                                 }

2678:                                 // like Lamplight set pendingHandRedirect which must be set before we
2679:                                 // call handleScrollDisposition for the triggering scroll below.
2680:                                 spellSystem.scrollEffects.execute(result.scrollName, result.casterIndex, {
2681:                                     spell: scrollDef,
2682:                                     triggeringScroll: trigScroll
2683:                                 });
