2685:                                 // Element tracking + broadcast only on the responder's own client
2686:                                 if (result.casterIndex === myPlayerIndex) {
2687:                                     // Track activated element for win condition (response scrolls count too!)
2688:                                     spellSystem.ensurePlayerScrollsStructure(result.casterIndex);
2689:                                     const activatedEls = (scrollDef?.element === 'catacomb' && scrollDef?.patterns?.[0])
2690:                                         ? [...new Set(scrollDef.patterns[0].map(pos => pos.type))]
2691:                                         : scrollDef?.element ? [scrollDef.element] : [];
2692:                                     activatedEls.forEach(el => {
2693:                                         spellSystem.playerScrolls[result.casterIndex].activated.add(el);
2694:                                     });
2695:                                     if (typeof updatePlayerElementSymbols === 'function') {
2696:                                         updatePlayerElementSymbols(result.casterIndex);
2697:                                     }
2698: 
2699:                                     // Broadcast activation so the caster's client (and any others)
2700:                                     // updates this player's shrine win-condition symbols
2701:                                     if (activatedEls.length > 0 && typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
2702:                                         broadcastGameAction('scroll-effect', {
2703:                                             playerIndex: result.casterIndex,
2704:                                             scrollName: result.scrollName,
2705:                                             effectName: scrollDef?.name || result.scrollName,
2706:                                             element: scrollDef?.element,
2707:                                             activatedElements: activatedEls
2708:                                         });
2709:                                     }
2710:                                 }
2711:                             }
2712:                         } else if (result.result === 'countered-original') {
2713:                             // Counter scroll (like Psychic or Iron Stance) resolved on the non-caster client.
2714:                             //
2715:                             // DO NOT re-execute the counter scroll's effect here.
2716:                             // The flow is:
2717:                             //   1. Caster's client runs resolveResponseStack() → fires scroll-resolved event
2718:                             //   2. multiplayer-state.js listener executes the counter effect (e.g. Psychic)
2719:                             //      and broadcasts psychic-buff-applied / scroll-effect
2720:                             //   3. Non-caster clients receive those broadcasts and apply state (psychicPending, etc.)
2721:                             //
2722:                             // Re-executing here caused a double psychicPending entry for the counter-caster,
2723:                             // which made the stolen scroll fire TWICE on the counter-caster's next turn —
2724:                             // appearing as if the original caster's scroll ability was still activating.
2725:                             console.log(`ℹ️ Processing remote counter scroll: ${result.scrollName}, counter-caster: ${result.casterIndex}`);
2726: 
2727:                             // If this is MY counter scroll, remove it from my active scrolls.
2728:                             // Psychic goes to common area (arrives via common-area-update broadcast from caster).
2729:                             // Iron Stance stays in active (nothing to remove).
2730:                             if (result.casterIndex === myPlayerIndex) {
2731:                                 spellSystem.ensurePlayerScrollsStructure(myPlayerIndex);
2732:                                 const myScrolls = spellSystem.playerScrolls[myPlayerIndex];
2733:                                 if (myScrolls.active.has(result.scrollName)) {
2734:                                     myScrolls.active.delete(result.scrollName);
2735:                                     console.log(`📜 Removed ${result.scrollName} from my active scrolls (counter sent to common area)`);
2736:                                 }
2737:                                 spellSystem.updateScrollCount();
2738:                             }
2739:                         }
2740:                     }
2741: 
2742:                     // Consume any pending hand redirect (e.g. set by Unbidden Lamplight above).
2743:                     // On non-caster clients, the original scroll's handleScrollDisposition never
2744:                     // fires via the CustomEvent chain, so we call it explicitly here to redirect
2745:                     // the triggering scroll to the Lamplight caster's hand.
2746:                     const rd = spellSystem.scrollEffects?.pendingHandRedirect;
2747:                     if (rd && payload.triggeringScroll?.name && rd.scrollName === payload.triggeringScroll.name) {
2748:                         console.log(`🔀 Consuming pendingHandRedirect: ${rd.scrollName} → player ${rd.redirectToPlayerIndex}'s hand`);
2749:                         spellSystem.handleScrollDisposition(
2750:                             payload.triggeringScroll.name,
2751:                             payload.triggeringScroll.fromCommonArea ?? false
2752:                         );
2753:                     }
2754:                 }
2755:             });

3193:                     const othersStillConnected = connectedIndices.filter(i => i !== myPlayerIndex);
3194:                     if (othersStillConnected.length === 0 && myPlayerIndex !== null && myPlayerIndex !== undefined) {
3195:                         handleGameOver(myPlayerIndex, 'last_standing');

  18:             catacomb: { color: '#c8a870', symbol: '✦', img: 'images/Catacomb.png'       + IMG_V }
  19:         };

  21:         // Spell System for pattern-based stone generation
  22:         class SpellSystem {
  23:             constructor() {
  24:                 this.SPELL_AP_COST = 2;
  25: 
  26:                 // Per-player scroll inventories: { hand: Set, active: Set, activated: Set }
  27:                 // hand = scrolls in player's hand (private, max 4)
  28:                 // active = scrolls in active area (visible to opponents: name + element only, max 2)
  29:                 // activated = elements that have been used for win condition tracking
  30:                 this.playerScrolls = [];
  31:                 this.MAX_HAND_SIZE = 2;
  32:                 this.MAX_ACTIVE_SIZE = 2;
  33: 
  34:                 // Common area - shared scrolls any player can activate
  35:                 // Max 1 scroll per element type. When a new scroll of same element enters,
  36:                 // the old one goes to bottom of deck
  37:                 this.commonArea = {
  38:                     earth: null,
  39:                     water: null,
  40:                     fire: null,
  41:                     wind: null,
  42:                     void: null,
  43:                     catacomb: null
  44:                 };
  45: 
  46:                 // Scroll decks - use external definitions if available, otherwise use defaults
  47:                 if (typeof SCROLL_DECKS !== 'undefined') {
  48:                     // Deep copy the external deck definitions
  49:                     this.scrollDecks = {};
  50:                     Object.keys(SCROLL_DECKS).forEach(element => {
  51:                         this.scrollDecks[element] = [...SCROLL_DECKS[element]];
  52:                     });
  53:                 } else {
  54:                     // Fallback to inline definitions
  55:                     this.scrollDecks = {
  56:                         earth: ['EARTH_SCROLL_1', 'EARTH_SCROLL_2', 'EARTH_SCROLL_3', 'EARTH_SCROLL_4', 'EARTH_SCROLL_5'],
  57:                         water: ['WATER_SCROLL_1', 'WATER_SCROLL_2', 'WATER_SCROLL_3', 'WATER_SCROLL_4', 'WATER_SCROLL_5'],
  58:                         fire: ['FIRE_SCROLL_1', 'FIRE_SCROLL_2', 'FIRE_SCROLL_3', 'FIRE_SCROLL_4', 'FIRE_SCROLL_5'],
  59:                         wind: ['WIND_SCROLL_1', 'WIND_SCROLL_2', 'WIND_SCROLL_3', 'WIND_SCROLL_4', 'WIND_SCROLL_5'],
  60:                         void: ['VOID_SCROLL_1', 'VOID_SCROLL_2', 'VOID_SCROLL_3', 'VOID_SCROLL_4', 'VOID_SCROLL_5'],
  61:                         catacomb: ['CATACOMB_SCROLL_1', 'CATACOMB_SCROLL_2', 'CATACOMB_SCROLL_3', 'CATACOMB_SCROLL_4', 'CATACOMB_SCROLL_5', 'CATACOMB_SCROLL_6', 'CATACOMB_SCROLL_7', 'CATACOMB_SCROLL_8', 'CATACOMB_SCROLL_9', 'CATACOMB_SCROLL_10']
  62:                     };
  63:                 }
  64: 
  65:                 // Shuffle all decks at initialization
  66:                 this.shuffleAllDecks();
  67: 
  68:                 this.initializePatterns();
  69:                 this.updateScrollCount();
  70: 
  71:                 // Initialize response window system
  72:                 this.responseWindow = null;
  73:                 if (typeof ResponseWindowSystem !== 'undefined') {
  74:                     this.responseWindow = new ResponseWindowSystem(this);
  75:                     console.log('Response window system initialized');
  76:                 }
  77: 
  78:                 // Initialize scroll effects system (use window.ScrollEffects – set by scroll-effects.js)
  79:                 this.scrollEffects = null;
  80:                 const SE = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.ScrollEffects) || (typeof ScrollEffects !== 'undefined' && ScrollEffects);
  81:                 if (SE) {
  82:                     SE.init(this);
  83:                     this.scrollEffects = SE;
  84:                     console.log('Scroll effects system initialized');
  85:                 }
  86: 
  87:                 // Pending cascade state - blocks all actions until resolved
  88:                 // Stored per player: { playerIndex: { scrollName, scrollInfo, shrineType, canCascadeToActive } }
  89:                 this.pendingCascades = {};
  90:             }
  91: 
  92:             // Check if a player has a pending cascade that must be resolved
  93:             hasPendingCascade(playerIndex) {
  94:                 return !!this.pendingCascades[playerIndex];
  95:             }
  96: 
  97:             // Get the pending cascade for a player
  98:             getPendingCascade(playerIndex) {
  99:                 return this.pendingCascades[playerIndex] || null;
 100:             }
 101: 
 102:             // Set a pending cascade for a player
 103:             setPendingCascade(playerIndex, cascadeData) {
 104:                 this.pendingCascades[playerIndex] = cascadeData;
 105:                 console.log(`📜 Pending cascade set for player ${playerIndex}:`, cascadeData?.scrollName);
 106:             }

 109:             clearPendingCascade(playerIndex) {
 110:                 delete this.pendingCascades[playerIndex];
 111:                 console.log(`📜 Pending cascade cleared for player ${playerIndex}`);
 112:             }

 114:             // Show the cascade prompt for a player (used when they try to take an action with pending cascade)
 115:             showPendingCascadePrompt(playerIndex) {
 116:                 const cascade = this.pendingCascades[playerIndex];
 117:                 if (!cascade) return false;
 118:

 120:                     cascade.scrollName,
 121:                     cascade.scrollInfo,
 122:                     cascade.shrineType,
 123:                     cascade.canCascadeToActive
 124:                 );

 127: 
 128:             // Fisher-Yates shuffle algorithm
 129:             shuffleDeck(deck) {
 130:                 for (let i = deck.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 131:                     const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 132:                     [deck[i], deck[j]] = [deck[j], deck[i]];
 133:                 }
 134:                 return deck;
 135:             }
 136: 
 137:             shuffleAllDecks() {
 138:                 Object.keys(this.scrollDecks).forEach(element => {
 139:                     this.shuffleDeck(this.scrollDecks[element]);
 140:                 });
 141:                 console.log('🎴 All scroll decks shuffled');
 142:             }
 143: 
 144:             // Draw a scroll from the top of a specific element's deck
 145:             drawFromDeck(element) {
 146:                 if (!this.scrollDecks[element] || this.scrollDecks[element].length === 0) {
 147:                     return null;
 148:                 }
 149:                 return this.scrollDecks[element].shift(); // Remove and return first element
 150:             }
 151: 
 152:             // Discard a scroll to the common area
 153:             // If a scroll of the same element is already there, it goes to bottom of deck
 154:             discardToCommonArea(scrollName) {
 155:                 const element = this.getScrollElement(scrollName);
 156:                 if (!element) return;
 157: 
 158:                 let replacedScroll = null;
 159: 
 160:                 // If there's already a scroll of this element in common area, send it to deck
 161:                 // Guard: don't push to deck if it's the same scroll being discarded (avoids duplicates)
 162:                 if (this.commonArea[element] && this.commonArea[element] !== scrollName) {
 163:                     replacedScroll = this.commonArea[element];
 164:                     this.scrollDecks[element].push(replacedScroll); // Add old scroll to bottom of deck
 165:                     console.log(`📜 Common area: Replaced ${replacedScroll} with ${scrollName} (old scroll to deck)`);
 166:                 } else {
 167:                     console.log(`📜 Common area: Added ${scrollName}`);
 168:                 }
 169: 
 170:                 // Place new scroll in common area
 171:                 this.commonArea[element] = scrollName;
 172: 
 173:                 // Update the scroll deck UI
 174:                 try {
 175:                     if (typeof updateScrollDeckUI === 'function') updateScrollDeckUI();
 176:                 } catch (e) {}
 177: 
 178:                 // Broadcast in multiplayer
 179:                 if (isMultiplayer) {
 180:                     broadcastGameAction('common-area-update', {
 181:                         element: element,
 182:                         scrollName: scrollName,
 183:                         replacedScroll: replacedScroll
 184:                     });
 185:                 }
 186:             }
 187: 
 188:             // Direct discard to deck (used internally, not for player discards)
 189:             discardToDeck(scrollName) {
 190:                 const element = this.getScrollElement(scrollName);
 191:                 if (element && this.scrollDecks[element]) {
 192:                     this.scrollDecks[element].push(scrollName); // Add to end of deck
 193:                     console.log(`📜 Discarded ${scrollName} to bottom of ${element} deck`);
 194: 
 195:                     // Update the scroll deck UI
 196:                     try {
 197:                         if (typeof updateScrollDeckUI === 'function') updateScrollDeckUI();
 198:                     } catch (e) {}
 199:                 }
 200:             }

 202:             // Get all scrolls in common area (returns array of scroll names)
 203:             getCommonAreaScrolls() {
 204:                 return Object.values(this.commonArea).filter(scroll => scroll !== null);
 205:             }

 207:             // Get the element type from a scroll name
 208:             getScrollElement(scrollName) {
 209:                 if (scrollName.startsWith('EARTH')) return 'earth';
 210:                 if (scrollName.startsWith('WATER')) return 'water';
 211:                 if (scrollName.startsWith('FIRE')) return 'fire';
 212:                 if (scrollName.startsWith('WIND')) return 'wind';
 213:                 if (scrollName.startsWith('VOID')) return 'void';
 214:                 if (scrollName.startsWith('CATACOMB')) return 'catacomb';
 215:                 return null;
 216:             }

 218:             // Get active player's scroll collection
 219:             // In multiplayer, show MY scrolls for display, but use activePlayerIndex for game logic
 220:             getPlayerScrolls(forDisplay = false) {
 221:                 // For display in multiplayer, show my own scrolls
 222:                 const displayIndex = (forDisplay && isMultiplayer && myPlayerIndex !== null) ? myPlayerIndex : activePlayerIndex;
 223: 
 224:                 this.ensurePlayerScrollsStructure(displayIndex);
 225:                 return this.playerScrolls[displayIndex];
 226:             }
 227: 
 228:             // Reinforce scroll state: ensure hand/active/activated are Sets (prevents "disappearing" from bad state)
 229:             ensurePlayerScrollsStructure(playerIndex) {
 230:                 if (playerIndex == null || playerIndex < 0) return;
 231:                 if (!this.playerScrolls[playerIndex]) {
 232:                     this.playerScrolls[playerIndex] = {
 233:                         hand: new Set(),
 234:                         active: new Set(),
 235:                         activated: new Set()
 236:                     };
 237:                     return;
 238:                 }
 239:                 const p = this.playerScrolls[playerIndex];
 240:                 if (!(p.hand instanceof Set)) p.hand = new Set(Array.isArray(p.hand) ? p.hand : []);
 241:                 if (!(p.active instanceof Set)) p.active = new Set(Array.isArray(p.active) ? p.active : []);
 242:                 if (!(p.activated instanceof Set)) p.activated = new Set(Array.isArray(p.activated) ? p.activated : []);
 243:             }
 244: 
 245:             // Validate scroll state and log warnings (helps catch sync bugs)
 246:             validateScrollState() {
 247:                 const n = typeof totalPlayers !== 'undefined' ? totalPlayers : Math.max(2, (this.playerScrolls && this.playerScrolls.length) || 0);
 248:                 for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
 249:                     this.ensurePlayerScrollsStructure(i);
 250:                 }
 251:                 const inHand = new Map();
 252:                 const inActive = new Map();
 253:                 let errorsFound = false;
 254: 
 255:                 for (let i = 0; i < (this.playerScrolls && this.playerScrolls.length) || 0; i++) {
 256:                     const p = this.playerScrolls[i];
 257:                     if (!p || !p.hand || !p.active) continue;
 258:                     p.hand.forEach(name => {
 259:                         if (inHand.has(name)) {
 260:                             console.warn('[Scroll state] ⚠️ DUPLICATE:', name, 'in hand of both player', inHand.get(name), 'and', i);
 261:                             errorsFound = true;
 262:                         }
 263:                         inHand.set(name, i);
 264:                     });
 265:                     p.active.forEach(name => {
 266:                         if (inActive.has(name)) {
 267:                             console.warn('[Scroll state] ⚠️ DUPLICATE:', name, 'in active of both player', inActive.get(name), 'and', i);
 268:                             errorsFound = true;
 269:                         }
 270:                         if (inHand.has(name)) {
 271:                             console.warn('[Scroll state] ⚠️ DUPLICATE:', name, 'in both hand and active areas');
 272:                             errorsFound = true;
 273:                         }
 274:                         inActive.set(name, i);
 275:                     });
 276:                 }
 277:                 const commonElements = ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void', 'catacomb'];
 278:                 commonElements.forEach(element => {
 279:                     const name = this.commonArea[element];
 280:                     if (!name) return;
 281:                     if (inHand.has(name)) {
 282:                         console.warn('[Scroll state] ⚠️ DUPLICATE:', name, 'in common area (' + element + ') and in hand of player', inHand.get(name));
 283:                         errorsFound = true;
 284:                     }
 285:                     if (inActive.has(name)) {
 286:                         console.warn('[Scroll state] ⚠️ DUPLICATE:', name, 'in common area (' + element + ') and in active of player', inActive.get(name));
 287:                         errorsFound = true;
 288:                     }
 289:                 });
 290: 
 291:                 // If errors found in multiplayer and we're not the host, request sync
 292:                 if (errorsFound && typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer) {
 293:                     console.warn('⚠️ Scroll state errors detected! Requesting sync from host...');
 294:                     if (typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function' && typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' && myPlayerIndex !== 0) {
 295:                         broadcastGameAction('scroll-state-sync-request', { playerIndex: myPlayerIndex });
 296:                     }
 297:                 }
 298: 
 299:                 return errorsFound;
 300:             }
 301: 
 302:             // Generate complete scroll state snapshot for syncing
 303:             getScrollStateSnapshot() {
 304:                 const snapshot = {
 305:                     players: [],
 306:                     commonArea: {},
 307:                     decks: {}
 308:                 };
 309: 
 310:                 // Capture each player's scrolls
 311:                 for (let i = 0; i < this.playerScrolls.length; i++) {
 312:                     const p = this.playerScrolls[i];
 313:                     if (!p) continue;
 314:                     snapshot.players[i] = {
 315:                         hand: Array.from(p.hand || []),
 316:                         active: Array.from(p.active || []),
 317:                         activated: Array.from(p.activated || [])
 318:                     };
 319:                 }
 320: 
 321:                 // Capture common area
 322:                 ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void', 'catacomb'].forEach(element => {
 323:                     snapshot.commonArea[element] = this.commonArea[element] || null;
 324:                 });
 325: 
 326:                 // Capture full decks (host is authoritative, clients should match exactly)
 327:                 Object.keys(this.scrollDecks || {}).forEach(element => {
 328:                     snapshot.decks[element] = [...(this.scrollDecks[element] || [])];
 329:                 });
 330: 
 331:                 return snapshot;
 332:             }
 333: 
 334:             // Apply scroll state snapshot from authoritative source
 335:             applyScrollStateSnapshot(snapshot) {
 336:                 let corrected = false;
 337:                 const activatedChangedPlayers = [];
 338: 
 339:                 // Apply player scrolls
 340:                 if (snapshot.players) {
 341:                     for (let i = 0; i < snapshot.players.length; i++) {
 342:                         if (!snapshot.players[i]) continue;
 343:                         this.ensurePlayerScrollsStructure(i);
 344:                         const p = this.playerScrolls[i];
 345:                         const snap = snapshot.players[i];
 346: 
 347:                         // Sync hand
 348:                         const newHand = new Set(snap.hand || []);
 349:                         if (!this.setsEqual(p.hand, newHand)) {
 350:                             console.log(`🔄 Player ${i} hand corrected:`, Array.from(p.hand), '→', Array.from(newHand));
 351:                             p.hand = newHand;
 352:                             corrected = true;
 353:                         }
 354: 
 355:                         // Sync active
 356:                         const newActive = new Set(snap.active || []);
 357:                         if (!this.setsEqual(p.active, newActive)) {
 358:                             console.log(`🔄 Player ${i} active corrected:`, Array.from(p.active), '→', Array.from(newActive));
 359:                             p.active = newActive;
 360:                             corrected = true;
 361:                         }
 362: 
 363:                         // Sync activated (win condition tracking) - additive only.
 364:                         // Never remove locally-tracked activations: a non-host player may have
 365:                         // pre-tracked an element during an interactive scroll (e.g. Take Flight)
 366:                         // before the host's periodic sync fires, which would otherwise wipe it.
 367:                         const newActivated = new Set(snap.activated || []);
 368:                         const prevActivatedSize = p.activated.size;
 369:                         newActivated.forEach(el => p.activated.add(el));
 370:                         if (p.activated.size !== prevActivatedSize) {
 371:                             console.log(`🔄 Player ${i} activated updated (additive):`, Array.from(newActivated), '→', Array.from(p.activated));
 372:                             corrected = true;
 373:                             activatedChangedPlayers.push(i);
 374:                         }
 375:                     }
 376:                 }
 377: 
 378:                 // Apply common area
 379:                 if (snapshot.commonArea) {
 380:                     // Build a set of scrolls already in players' hands/active areas locally.
 381:                     // If a scroll is here, the player just drew/played it and the host's
 382:                     // periodic broadcast is stale — don't put it back in the common area.
 383:                     const inLocalPlay = new Set();
 384:                     for (const p of this.playerScrolls) {
 385:                         if (!p) continue;
 386:                         p.hand.forEach(s => inLocalPlay.add(s));
 387:                         p.active.forEach(s => inLocalPlay.add(s));
 388:                     }
 389: 
 390:                     ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void', 'catacomb'].forEach(element => {
 391:                         const newScroll = snapshot.commonArea[element] || null;
 392:                         if (newScroll && inLocalPlay.has(newScroll)) {
 393:                             // Host state is stale — this scroll was already drawn by a player
 394:                             console.log(`[sync] Skipping common area restore for ${element}: ${newScroll} is already in local play`);
 395:                             return;
 396:                         }
 397:                         if (this.commonArea[element] !== newScroll) {
 398:                             console.log(`🔄 Common area ${element} corrected:`, this.commonArea[element], '→', newScroll);
 399:                             this.commonArea[element] = newScroll;
 400:                             corrected = true;
 401:                         }
 402:                     });
 403:                 }
 404: 
 405:                 // Apply decks (sync full deck contents from host)
 406:                 if (snapshot.decks) {
 407:                     Object.keys(snapshot.decks).forEach(element => {
 408:                         const newDeck = snapshot.decks[element] || [];
 409:                         const currentDeck = this.scrollDecks[element] || [];
 410: 
 411:                         // Compare deck contents (order matters for deck draw)
 412:                         if (!this.arraysEqual(currentDeck, newDeck)) {
 413:                             console.log(`🔄 ${element} deck corrected: ${currentDeck.length} scrolls → ${newDeck.length} scrolls`);
 414:                             this.scrollDecks[element] = [...newDeck];
 415:                             corrected = true;
 416:                         }
 417:                     });
 418:                 }
 419: 
 420:                 if (corrected) {
 421:                     // Only update UI and validate, no console spam
 422:                     this.validateScrollState();
 423:                     this.updateScrollCount();
 424:                     if (typeof updateCommonAreaUI === 'function') updateCommonAreaUI();
 425:                     if (typeof updateScrollDeckUI === 'function') updateScrollDeckUI();
 426:                     // Refresh win-condition markers and check win condition for any player
 427:                     // whose activated set gained elements via this sync
 428:                     if (typeof updatePlayerElementSymbols === 'function') {
 429:                         activatedChangedPlayers.forEach(playerIdx => {
 430:                             updatePlayerElementSymbols(playerIdx);
 431:                             // Win condition: all 5 elements activated
 432:                             if (this.playerScrolls?.[playerIdx]?.activated?.size === 5) {
 433:                                 console.log(`🏆 Win condition met for player ${playerIdx} (detected via state sync)`);
 434:                                 this.showLevelComplete(playerIdx);
 435:                                 if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer &&
 436:                                     typeof handleGameOver === 'function') {
 437:                                     handleGameOver(playerIdx);
 438:                                 }
 439:                             }
 440:                         });
 441:                     }
 442:                 }
 443: 
 444:                 return corrected;
 445:             }
 446: 
 447:             // Helper: compare two sets for equality
 448:             setsEqual(set1, set2) {
 449:                 if (set1.size !== set2.size) return false;
 450:                 for (const item of set1) {
 451:                     if (!set2.has(item)) return false;
 452:                 }
 453:                 return true;
 454:             }
 455: 
 456:             // Helper: compare two arrays for equality (order matters)
 457:             arraysEqual(arr1, arr2) {
 458:                 if (arr1.length !== arr2.length) return false;
 459:                 for (let i = 0; i < arr1.length; i++) {
 460:                     if (arr1[i] !== arr2[i]) return false;
 461:                 }
 462:                 return true;
 463:             }
 464: 
 465:             // Comprehensive scroll audit - finds ALL scrolls and reports discrepancies
 466:             auditScrolls() {
 467:                 const allScrolls = new Map(); // scrollName -> locations[]
 468:                 const issues = [];
 469: 
 470:                 // Count scrolls in each location
 471:                 const countScroll = (scrollName, location) => {
 472:                     if (!scrollName) return;
 473:                     if (!allScrolls.has(scrollName)) {
 474:                         allScrolls.set(scrollName, []);
 475:                     }
 476:                     allScrolls.get(scrollName).push(location);
 477:                 };
 478: 
 479:                 // Check player hands and active areas
 480:                 for (let i = 0; i < (this.playerScrolls?.length || 0); i++) {
 481:                     const p = this.playerScrolls[i];
 482:                     if (!p) continue;
 483:                     const playerName = typeof getPlayerColorName === 'function' ? getPlayerColorName(i) : `Player ${i}`;
 484: 
 485:                     (p.hand || new Set()).forEach(scroll => countScroll(scroll, `${playerName} hand`));
 486:                     (p.active || new Set()).forEach(scroll => countScroll(scroll, `${playerName} active`));
 487:                 }
 488: 
 489:                 // Check common area
 490:                 ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void', 'catacomb'].forEach(element => {
 491:                     const scroll = this.commonArea[element];
 492:                     if (scroll) countScroll(scroll, `Common (${element})`);
 493:                 });
 494: 
 495:                 // Check decks
 496:                 Object.keys(this.scrollDecks || {}).forEach(element => {
 497:                     (this.scrollDecks[element] || []).forEach(scroll => {
 498:                         countScroll(scroll, `${element} deck`);
 499:                     });
 500:                 });
 501: 
 502:                 // Analyze results
 503:                 console.log('\n🔍 SCROLL AUDIT REPORT\n');
 504: 
 505:                 let duplicates = 0;
 506:                 allScrolls.forEach((locations, scrollName) => {
 507:                     if (locations.length > 1) {
 508:                         console.warn(`⚠️  DUPLICATE: ${scrollName} exists in ${locations.length} locations:`, locations);
 509:                         issues.push({ scroll: scrollName, issue: 'duplicate', locations });
 510:                         duplicates++;
 511:                     }
 512:                 });
 513: 
 514:                 if (duplicates === 0) {
 515:                     console.log('✅ No duplicates found');
 516:                 } else {
 517:                     console.warn(`⚠️  Found ${duplicates} duplicated scrolls!`);
 518:                 }
 519: 
 520:                 // Count total scrolls by element
 521:                 const elementCounts = { earth: 0, water: 0, fire: 0, wind: 0, void: 0, catacomb: 0 };
 522:                 allScrolls.forEach((locations, scrollName) => {
 523:                     const element = this.getScrollElement(scrollName);
 524:                     if (element && elementCounts.hasOwnProperty(element)) {
 525:                         elementCounts[element] += locations.length; // Count all instances (including duplicates)
 526:                     }
 527:                 });
 528: 
 529:                 console.log('\n📊 Total Scroll Counts (across all locations):');
 530:                 Object.entries(elementCounts).forEach(([element, count]) => {
 531:                     console.log(`  ${element}: ${count} scrolls found`);
 532:                 });
 533: 
 534:                 console.log('\n');
 535: 
 536:                 return { issues, elementCounts, allScrolls };
 537:             }

 540:             // collectedScrolls now returns both hand AND active scrolls combined
 541:             get collectedScrolls() {
 542:                 const scrolls = this.getPlayerScrolls(true);
 543:                 const combined = new Set([...scrolls.hand, ...scrolls.active]);
 544:                 return combined;
 545:             }

 549:             }

 553:                 return this.getPlayerScrolls(true).hand;
 554:             }

 557:             get activeScrolls() {
 558:                 return this.getPlayerScrolls(true).active;
 559:             }
 560: 
 561:             // Move scroll from hand to active area (0 AP cost)
 562:             moveToActive(scrollName) {
 563:                 const scrolls = this.getPlayerScrolls(false); // Use active player for game logic
 564: 
 565:                 // Check active area limit
 566:                 if (scrolls.active.size >= this.MAX_ACTIVE_SIZE) {
 567:                     updateStatus(`Active area full! Max ${this.MAX_ACTIVE_SIZE} scrolls. Move one to hand or common area first.`);
 568:                     window.SoundSystem?.play('error');
 569:                     return false;
 570:                 }
 571: 
 572:                 if (scrolls.hand.has(scrollName)) {
 573:                     scrolls.hand.delete(scrollName);
 574:                     scrolls.active.add(scrollName);
 575:                     console.log(`📜 Moved ${scrollName} to active area`);
 576:                     this.updateScrollCount();
 577: 
 578:                     // Broadcast in multiplayer
 579:                     if (isMultiplayer) {
 580:                         broadcastGameAction('scroll-move', {
 581:                             playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
 582:                             scrollName: scrollName,
 583:                             toLocation: 'active'
 584:                         });
 585:                     }
 586:                     return true;
 587:                 }
 588:                 return false;
 589:             }
 590: 
 591:             // Move scroll from active area back to hand - DISABLED
 592:             // Scrolls cannot be returned to hand once placed in active area
 593:             moveToHand(scrollName) {
 594:                 // Per game rules, scrolls cannot be moved back to hand once in active area
 595:                 updateStatus(`Scrolls cannot be returned to hand! Discard to Common Area instead.`);
 596:                 return false;
 597:             }
 598: 
 599:             // Internal undo helper — reverses a scroll move without broadcast or rule checks.
 600:             // 'from' and 'to' are the ORIGINAL move's from/to; this reverses it.
 601:             _undoScrollMove(scrollName, from, to, displacedScroll) {
 602:                 const scrolls = this.getPlayerScrolls(false);
 603:                 const element = this.getScrollElement(scrollName);
 604: 
 605:                 if (to === 'active') {
 606:                     // Undo hand → active: move back to hand
 607:                     if (scrolls.active.has(scrollName)) {
 608:                         scrolls.active.delete(scrollName);
 609:                         scrolls.hand.add(scrollName);
 610:                     }
 611:                 } else if (to === 'common') {
 612:                     // Undo hand/active → common
 613:                     if (element && this.commonArea[element] === scrollName) {
 614:                         this.commonArea[element] = null;
 615:                         // If a scroll was displaced to deck, restore it to common area
 616:                         if (displacedScroll && element) {
 617:                             const deck = this.scrollDecks[element];
 618:                             const idx = deck ? deck.lastIndexOf(displacedScroll) : -1;
 619:                             if (idx !== -1) deck.splice(idx, 1);
 620:                             this.commonArea[element] = displacedScroll;
 621:                         }
 622:                     }
 623:                     // Restore scroll to its original area
 624:                     if (from === 'hand') scrolls.hand.add(scrollName);
 625:                     else if (from === 'active') scrolls.active.add(scrollName);
 626:                 }
 627: 
 628:                 this.updateScrollCount();
 629:                 if (typeof updateScrollDeckUI === 'function') try { updateScrollDeckUI(); } catch(e) {}
 630:             }
 631: 
 632:             // Discard a scroll from hand or active area to common area
 633:             discardScroll(scrollName) {
 634:                 const scrolls = this.getPlayerScrolls(false);
 635:                 let removed = false;
 636: 
 637:                 if (scrolls.hand.has(scrollName)) {
 638:                     scrolls.hand.delete(scrollName);
 639:                     removed = true;
 640:                 } else if (scrolls.active.has(scrollName)) {
 641:                     scrolls.active.delete(scrollName);
 642:                     removed = true;
 643:                 }
 644: 
 645:                 if (removed) {
 646:                     // Send to common area instead of deck
 647:                     this.discardToCommonArea(scrollName);
 648:                     this.updateScrollCount();
 649:                     try {
 650:                         if (typeof updateCommonAreaUI === 'function') updateCommonAreaUI();
 651:                     } catch (e) {}
 652: 
 653:                     // Broadcast in multiplayer
 654:                     if (isMultiplayer) {
 655:                         broadcastGameAction('scroll-discard', {
 656:                             playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
 657:                             scrollName: scrollName
 658:                         });
 659:                     }
 660:                     return true;
 661:                 }
 662:                 return false;
 663:             }
 664: 
 665:             initializePatterns() {
 666:                 // Use external scroll definitions if available
 667:                 if (typeof SCROLL_DEFINITIONS !== 'undefined') {
 668:                     this.patterns = SCROLL_DEFINITIONS;
 669:                     console.log('📜 Loaded scroll definitions from external file');
 670:                     return;
 671:                 }
 672: 
 673:                 // Fallback to inline definitions
 674:                 console.log('📜 Using inline scroll definitions (external file not loaded)');
 675: 
 676:                 // Corrected patterns from user's visual editor
 677:                 const level1Patterns = [
 678:                     [{ q: 0, r: -1 }, { q: 0, r: 1 }],
 679:                     [{ q: 1, r: -1 }, { q: -1, r: 1 }],
 680:                     [{ q: 1, r: 0 }, { q: -1, r: 0 }]
 681:                 ];
 682: 
 683:                 const level2Patterns = [
 684:                     [{ q: -1, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: 1 }],
 685:                     [{ q: 1, r: -2 }, { q: -1, r: 2 }],
 686:                     [{ q: 2, r: -1 }, { q: -2, r: 1 }]
 687:                 ];
 688: 
 689:                 const level3Patterns = [
 690:                     [{ q: 1, r: -1 }, { q: -1, r: 0 }, { q: 0, r: 1 }],
 691:                     [{ q: 0, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: 0 }, { q: -1, r: 1 }]
 692:                 ];
 693: 
 694:                 const level4Patterns = [
 695:                     [{ q: 1, r: -2 }, { q: -2, r: 1 }, { q: 1, r: 1 }],
 696:                     [{ q: -1, r: -1 }, { q: 2, r: -1 }, { q: -1, r: 2 }]
 697:                 ];
 698: 
 699:                 const level5Patterns = [
 700:                     [{ q: 0, r: -1 }, { q: 0, r: 1 }, { q: 2, r: -1 }, { q: -2, r: 1 }],
 701:                     [{ q: 1, r: -1 }, { q: -1, r: 1 }, { q: -1, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: 1 }],
 702:                     [{ q: 1, r: 0 }, { q: -1, r: 0 }, { q: 1, r: -2 }, { q: -1, r: 2 }]
 703:                 ];
 704: 
 705:                 this.patterns = {};
 706:                 const elementTypes = ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void'];
 707: 
 708:                 elementTypes.forEach(element => {
 709:                     [level1Patterns, level2Patterns, level3Patterns, level4Patterns, level5Patterns].forEach((patterns, level) => {
 710:                         const scrollName = `${element.toUpperCase()}_SCROLL_${level + 1}`;
 711:                         this.patterns[scrollName] = {
 712:                             name: `${element.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + element.slice(1)} Scroll ${toRoman(level + 1)}`,
 713:                             description: `Stand in pattern to gain +${level + 1} ${element} stones (2 AP)`,
 714:                             level: level + 1,
 715:                             element: element,
 716:                             patterns: patterns.map(pattern =>
 717:                                 pattern.map(pos => ({ ...pos, type: element }))
 718:                             ),
 719:                             // Earth II can counter any scroll
 720:                             canCounter: (element === 'earth' && level === 1) ? 'any' : null
 721:                         };
 722:                     });
 723:                 });
 724: 
 725:                 // Add catacomb scrolls (multi-element patterns)
 726:                 // Each gets 3 rotational variations like level 2 scrolls
 727:                 const catacombBase = {
 728:                     CATACOMB_SCROLL_1: [
 729:                         { q: -1, r: -1, type: "water" },
 730:                         { q: 1, r: 1, type: "water" },
 731:                         { q: 1, r: -2, type: "earth" },
 732:                         { q: -1, r: 2, type: "earth" }
 733:                     ],
 734:                     CATACOMB_SCROLL_2: [
 735:                         { q: -1, r: -1, type: "earth" },
 736:                         { q: 1, r: 1, type: "earth" },
 737:                         { q: 1, r: -2, type: "fire" },
 738:                         { q: -1, r: 2, type: "fire" }
 739:                     ],
 740:                     CATACOMB_SCROLL_3: [
 741:                         { q: -1, r: -1, type: "wind" },
 742:                         { q: 1, r: 1, type: "wind" },
 743:                         { q: 1, r: -2, type: "earth" },
 744:                         { q: -1, r: 2, type: "earth" }
 745:                     ],
 746:                     CATACOMB_SCROLL_4: [
 747:                         { q: -1, r: -1, type: "void" },
 748:                         { q: 1, r: 1, type: "void" },
 749:                         { q: 1, r: -2, type: "earth" },
 750:                         { q: -1, r: 2, type: "earth" }
 751:                     ],
 752:                     CATACOMB_SCROLL_5: [
 753:                         { q: -1, r: -1, type: "water" },
 754:                         { q: 1, r: 1, type: "water" },
 755:                         { q: 1, r: -2, type: "fire" },
 756:                         { q: -1, r: 2, type: "fire" }
 757:                     ],
 758:                     CATACOMB_SCROLL_6: [
 759:                         { q: -1, r: -1, type: "wind" },
 760:                         { q: 1, r: 1, type: "wind" },
 761:                         { q: 1, r: -2, type: "water" },
 762:                         { q: -1, r: 2, type: "water" }
 763:                     ],
 764:                     CATACOMB_SCROLL_7: [
 765:                         { q: -1, r: -1, type: "void" },
 766:                         { q: 1, r: 1, type: "void" },
 767:                         { q: 1, r: -2, type: "water" },
 768:                         { q: -1, r: 2, type: "water" }
 769:                     ],
 770:                     CATACOMB_SCROLL_8: [
 771:                         { q: -1, r: -1, type: "fire" },
 772:                         { q: 1, r: 1, type: "fire" },
 773:                         { q: 1, r: -2, type: "wind" },
 774:                         { q: -1, r: 2, type: "wind" }
 775:                     ],
 776:                     CATACOMB_SCROLL_9: [
 777:                         { q: -1, r: -1, type: "void" },
 778:                         { q: 1, r: 1, type: "void" },
 779:                         { q: 1, r: -2, type: "wind" },
 780:                         { q: -1, r: 2, type: "wind" }
 781:                     ],
 782:                     CATACOMB_SCROLL_10: [
 783:                         { q: -1, r: -1, type: "fire" },
 784:                         { q: 1, r: 1, type: "fire" },
 785:                         { q: 1, r: -2, type: "void" },
 786:                         { q: -1, r: 2, type: "void" }
 787:                     ]
 788:                 };
 789: 
 790:                 // Generate 3 rotational variations for each catacomb scroll
 791:                 Object.entries(catacombBase).forEach(([scrollName, basePattern]) => {
 792:                     const scrollNum = parseInt(scrollName.split('_')[2]);
 793: 
 794:                     // Helper function to rotate hex coordinate by 60 degrees
 795:                     const rotateHex = (q, r, steps) => {
 796:                         // Rotate counter-clockwise by steps * 60 degrees
 797:                         let nq = q, nr = r;
 798:                         for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
 799:                             const tempQ = nq;
 800:                             nq = -nr;
 801:                             nr = -(-tempQ - nr);
 802:                         }
 803:                         return { q: nq, r: nr };
 804:                     };
 805: 
 806:                     // Create 3 rotational variations (0°, 120°, 240°)
 807:                     const variations = [
 808:                         basePattern, // 0° rotation
 809:                         basePattern.map(pos => ({ // 120° rotation (2 steps)
 810:                             ...rotateHex(pos.q, pos.r, 2),
 811:                             type: pos.type
 812:                         })),
 813:                         basePattern.map(pos => ({ // 240° rotation (4 steps)
 814:                             ...rotateHex(pos.q, pos.r, 4),
 815:                             type: pos.type
 816:                         }))
 817:                     ];
 818: 
 819:                     this.patterns[scrollName] = {
 820:                         name: `Catacomb Scroll ${scrollNum}`,
 821:                         description: `Multi-element pattern: gain +2 of each stone type (2 AP)`,
 822:                         level: 2,
 823:                         element: 'catacomb',
 824:                         patterns: variations
 825:                     };
 826:                 });
 827:             }

 829:             onTileRevealed(shrineType) {
 830:                 if (shrineType === 'player') return null;
 831:                 if (!this.scrollDecks[shrineType] || this.scrollDecks[shrineType].length === 0) {
 832:                     return null;
 833:                 }
 834: 
 835:                 // Draw from top of the element's deck
 836:                 const selected = this.drawFromDeck(shrineType);
 837:                 if (!selected) return null;
 838: 
 839:                 const scrolls = this.getPlayerScrolls(false);
 840:                 const scrollInfo = this.patterns[selected];
 841: 
 842:                 // Always add to hand immediately so the player can still act this turn.
 843:                 // If the hand now exceeds the limit the end-of-turn overflow modal will
 844:                 // prompt for a cascade before the turn advances.
 845:                 scrolls.hand.add(selected);
 846:                 this.updateScrollCount();
 847: 
 848:                 // Broadcast scroll collection in multiplayer
 849:                 if (isMultiplayer) {
 850:                     broadcastGameAction('scroll-collected', {
 851:                         playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
 852:                         scrollName: selected,
 853:                         shrineType: shrineType
 854:                     });
 855:                 }
 856: 
 857:                 if (scrolls.hand.size > this.MAX_HAND_SIZE) {
 858:                     // Over limit — remind the player they must cascade before ending their turn
 859:                     updateStatus(`Picked up "${scrollInfo?.name || selected}" — hand is over the limit. Cascade a scroll before ending your turn!`);
 860:                 } else {
 861:                     this.showScrollNotification(scrollInfo, shrineType, selected);
 862:                 }
 863: 
 864:                 return scrollInfo;
 865:             }

1097:             // End-of-turn overflow: hand or active over capacity.

1099:             showEndTurnOverflowModal(onResolved) {
1100:                 const self = this;
1101: 
1102:                 // Open Hand + Active panels so the player can manage scrolls
1103:                 if (window.ScrollPanelSystem) {
1104:                     window.ScrollPanelSystem.openPanel('hand');
1105:                     window.ScrollPanelSystem.openPanel('active');
1106:                     window.ScrollPanelSystem.refresh();
1107:                 }
1108: 
1109:                 // Remove any stale banner from a previous call
1110:                 const old = document.getElementById('scroll-overflow-banner');
1111:                 if (old) old.remove();
1112: 
1113:                 // Build the banner
1114:                 const banner = document.createElement('div');
1115:                 banner.id = 'scroll-overflow-banner';
1116: 
1117:                 const statusEl = document.createElement('span');
1118:                 statusEl.className = 'overflow-banner-status';
1119:                 banner.appendChild(statusEl);
1120: 
1121:                 const endTurnBtn = document.createElement('button');
1122:                 endTurnBtn.className = 'overflow-banner-btn';
1123:                 endTurnBtn.textContent = 'End Turn';
1124:                 endTurnBtn.disabled = true;
1125:                 banner.appendChild(endTurnBtn);
1126: 
1127:                 document.body.appendChild(banner);
1128: 
1129:                 function updateBanner() {
1130:                     if (!document.getElementById('scroll-overflow-banner')) {
1131:                         clearInterval(pollInterval);
1132:                         return;
1133:                     }
1134:                     const scrolls = self.getPlayerScrolls(false);
1135:                     const handOver   = scrolls.hand.size   > self.MAX_HAND_SIZE;
1136:                     const activeOver = scrolls.active.size > self.MAX_ACTIVE_SIZE;
1137:                     const stillOver  = handOver || activeOver;
1138: 
1139:                     if (stillOver) {
1140:                         let msg = `⚠ Scroll Overflow — `;
1141:                         if (handOver)   msg += `Hand: ${scrolls.hand.size}/${self.MAX_HAND_SIZE}  `;
1142:                         if (activeOver) msg += `Active: ${scrolls.active.size}/${self.MAX_ACTIVE_SIZE}`;
1143:                         statusEl.textContent = msg.trimEnd();
1144:                         banner.classList.remove('overflow-resolved');
1145:                         endTurnBtn.disabled = true;
1146:                     } else {
1147:                         statusEl.textContent = `✓ Resolved — Hand: ${scrolls.hand.size}/${self.MAX_HAND_SIZE}  Active: ${scrolls.active.size}/${self.MAX_ACTIVE_SIZE}`;
1148:                         banner.classList.add('overflow-resolved');
1149:                         endTurnBtn.disabled = false;
1150:                     }
1151: 
1152:                     // Do NOT call ScrollPanelSystem.refresh() here — rebuilding the card DOM
1153:                     // every 300ms destroys elements mid-hover and mid-click, which:
1154:                     //   • resets the 500ms hover-preview timer (spinner never resolves)
1155:                     //   • destroys the card element the user is about to click
1156:                     // The move buttons in the panels already call refresh() after each move.
1157:                 }
1158: 
1159:                 endTurnBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
1160:                     const scrolls = self.getPlayerScrolls(false);
1161:                     const handOver   = scrolls.hand.size   > self.MAX_HAND_SIZE;
1162:                     const activeOver = scrolls.active.size > self.MAX_ACTIVE_SIZE;
1163:                     if (handOver || activeOver) return;
1164:                     clearInterval(pollInterval);
1165:                     banner.remove();
1166:                     onResolved();
1167:                 });
1168: 
1169:                 updateBanner();
1170:                 const pollInterval = setInterval(updateBanner, 300);
1171:             }

1221:             checkPattern(patternName) {
1222:                 // Use the active player's position by default
1223:                 return this.checkPatternForPlayer(patternName, activePlayerIndex);
1224:             }
1225: 
1226:             // Check pattern for a specific player (used by response window)
1227:             checkPatternForPlayer(patternName, playerIndex) {
1228:                 const pattern = this.patterns[patternName];
1229:                 if (!pattern) return false;
1230: 
1231:                 // Get the player's position
1232:                 let pos;
1233:                 if (playerIndex === activePlayerIndex && playerPosition) {
1234:                     // Use global playerPosition for active player
1235:                     pos = playerPosition;
1236:                 } else if (playerPositions && playerPositions[playerIndex]) {
1237:                     // Use playerPositions array for other players
1238:                     pos = playerPositions[playerIndex];
1239:                 } else {
1240:                     return false;
1241:                 }
1242: 
1243:                 const playerHex = pixelToHex(pos.x, pos.y, TILE_SIZE);
1244: 
1245:                 console.log(`  Checking ${patternName} for player ${playerIndex}...`);
1246: 
1247:                 return pattern.patterns.some((patternVariant, variantIdx) => {
1248:                     const allMatch = patternVariant.every((req, reqIdx) => {
1249:                         const checkHex = hexToPixel(playerHex.q + req.q, playerHex.r + req.r, TILE_SIZE);
1250:                         const stone = placedStones.find(s => {
1251:                             const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(s.x - checkHex.x, 2) + Math.pow(s.y - checkHex.y, 2));
1252:                             const matches = dist < 5 && s.type === req.type;
1253:                             if (matches) {
1254:                                 console.log(`    ✓ Found ${s.type} stone at (${req.q}, ${req.r})`);
1255:                             }
1256:                             return matches;
1257:                         });
1258:                         if (!stone) {
1259:                             console.log(`    ✗ Missing ${req.type} stone at (${req.q}, ${req.r})`);
1260:                         }
1261:                         return !!stone;
1262:                     });
1263: 
1264:                     if (allMatch) {
1265:                         console.log(`    ✓✓✓ PATTERN VARIANT ${variantIdx + 1} MATCHED!`);
1266:                     }
1267:                     return allMatch;
1268:                 });
1269:             }
1270: 
1271:             // Get current spell AP cost (may be reduced by buffs)
1272:             getSpellCost(spell = null, playerIndex = activePlayerIndex) {
1273:                 // Quick Reflexes: level 1 scrolls cost 0 until caster's next turn
1274:                 if (spell && spell.level === 1 && this.scrollEffects?.activeBuffs?.quickReflexes) {
1275:                     const qr = this.scrollEffects.activeBuffs.quickReflexes;
1276:                     if (qr.playerIndex === playerIndex) {
1277:                         return 0;
1278:                     }
1279:                 }
1280:                 // Simplify: scrolls cost 1 for the caster this turn
1281:                 if (this.scrollEffects?.activeBuffs?.simplify) {
1282:                     const buff = this.scrollEffects.activeBuffs.simplify;
1283:                     if (buff.playerIndex === playerIndex) {
1284:                         return 1;
1285:                     }
1286:                 }
1287:                 return this.SPELL_AP_COST;
1288:             }

1290:             castSpell() {
1291:                 // Scrolls in Active Area OR Common Area can be activated
1292:                 const activeScrollsList = Array.from(this.getPlayerScrolls(false).active);
1293:                 const commonAreaScrolls = this.getCommonAreaScrolls();
1294:                 const allCastableScrolls = [...activeScrollsList, ...commonAreaScrolls];
1295:                 if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.logScrollEvent) {
1296:                     window.logScrollEvent('cast_attempt', {
1297:                         playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
1298:                         active: activeScrollsList,
1299:                         common: commonAreaScrolls
1300:                     });
1301:                 }
1302: 
1303:                 if (allCastableScrolls.length === 0) {
1304:                     window.SoundSystem?.play('error');
1305:                     updateStatus("No scrolls available! Move scrolls to Active Area or use Common Area scrolls.");
1306:                     return false;
1307:                 }
1308: 
1309:                 // Debug: Log player position and nearby stones (throttled)
1310:                 if (shouldDebugLog('castSpellDebug', 1000)) {
1311:                     console.log('✨ Attempting to cast spell...');
1312:                     console.log(`Player position: (${playerPosition.x.toFixed(1)}, ${playerPosition.y.toFixed(1)})`);
1313:                     console.log(`Active scrolls: ${activeScrollsList.join(', ')}`);
1314:                     console.log(`Common area scrolls: ${commonAreaScrolls.join(', ')}`);
1315: 
1316:                     if (playerPosition) {
1317:                         const playerHex = pixelToHex(playerPosition.x, playerPosition.y, TILE_SIZE);
1318:                         console.log(`Player hex: q=${playerHex.q}, r=${playerHex.r}`);
1319: 
1320:                         // Log nearby stones
1321:                         console.log('Nearby stones:');
1322:                         const nearbyStones = [];
1323:                         placedStones.forEach(stone => {
1324:                             const stoneHex = pixelToHex(stone.x, stone.y, TILE_SIZE);
1325:                             const relQ = stoneHex.q - playerHex.q;
1326:                             const relR = stoneHex.r - playerHex.r;
1327:                             nearbyStones.push({ type: stone.type, q: relQ, r: relR });
1328:                             console.log(`  ${stone.type} at relative (${relQ}, ${relR})`);
1329:                         });
1330: 
1331:                         // Check each castable scroll and show why it doesn't match
1332:                         console.log('\nChecking castable scrolls (Active + Common Area):');
1333:                         for (const scrollName of allCastableScrolls) {
1334:                             const pattern = this.patterns[scrollName];
1335:                             console.log(`\n${scrollName} requires:`);
1336:                             pattern.patterns.forEach((patternVariant, idx) => {
1337:                                 const coords = patternVariant.map(p => `(${p.q},${p.r}) ${p.type}`).join(' + ');
1338:                                 const matches = patternVariant.every(req => {
1339:                                     return nearbyStones.some(s => s.q === req.q && s.r === req.r && s.type === req.type);
1340:                                 });
1341:                                 console.log(`  Pattern ${idx + 1}: ${coords} - ${matches ? '✓ MATCH' : '✗ no match'}`);
1342:                             });
1343:                         }
1344:                     }
1345:                 }
1346: 
1347:                 const matchingSpells = [];
1348:                 // Check scrolls in Active Area AND Common Area
1349:                 for (const scrollName of allCastableScrolls) {
1350:                     if (this.checkPattern(scrollName)) {
1351:                         console.log(`\n✓ Pattern match found: ${scrollName}`);
1352:                         const isFromCommonArea = commonAreaScrolls.includes(scrollName);
1353:                         matchingSpells.push({ name: scrollName, spell: this.patterns[scrollName], fromCommonArea: isFromCommonArea });
1354:                     }
1355:                 }
1356: 
1357:                 if (matchingSpells.length === 0) {
1358:                     window.SoundSystem?.play('error');
1359:                     updateStatus("No valid spell pattern found! Check console for details.");
1360:                     console.log('\n✗ No matching patterns');
1361:                     return false;
1362:                 }
1363: 
1364:                 matchingSpells.sort((a, b) => b.spell.level - a.spell.level);
1365: 
1366:                 // Level 1 scrolls can only be used during the response window
1367:                 const mainPhaseSpells = matchingSpells.filter(s => s.spell.level !== 1);
1368:                 if (mainPhaseSpells.length === 0) {
1369:                     window.SoundSystem?.play('error');
1370:                     updateStatus('Level 1 scrolls can only be used as responses.');
1371:                     return false;
1372:                 }
1373: 
1374:                 // Filter by affordability based on each spell's actual cost
1375:                 const affordableSpells = mainPhaseSpells.filter(({ spell }) => {
1376:                     const cost = this.getSpellCost(spell, activePlayerIndex);
1377:                     return canAfford(cost);
1378:                 });
1379: 
1380:                 if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.logScrollEvent) {
1381:                     window.logScrollEvent('cast_matches', {
1382:                         playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
1383:                         matches: matchingSpells.map(m => ({ name: m.name, level: m.spell.level, element: m.spell.element })),
1384:                         affordable: affordableSpells.map(m => ({ name: m.name, level: m.spell.level, element: m.spell.element }))
1385:                     });
1386:                 }
1387: 
1388:                 if (affordableSpells.length === 0) {
1389:                     window.SoundSystem?.play('error');
1390:                     const minCost = Math.min(...matchingSpells.map(({ spell }) => this.getSpellCost(spell, activePlayerIndex)));
1391:                     updateStatus(`Not enough AP! Need ${minCost} AP to cast.`);
1392:                     return false;
1393:                 }
1394: 
1395:                 if (affordableSpells.length > 1) {
1396:                     // Always show selection when multiple scrolls match
1397:                     this.showSpellSelection(affordableSpells);
1398:                 } else {
1399:                     this.executeSpell(affordableSpells[0]);
1400:                 }
1401:                 return true;
1402:             }

1409:                     backgroundColor: '#2c3e50', padding: '20px',
1410:                     borderRadius: '10px', boxShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
1411:                     zIndex: '1000', color: 'white', minWidth: '300px'
1412:                 });
1413:

1415:                 header.style.display = 'flex';
