1452:             executeSpell({name, spell, fromCommonArea = false}) {
1453:                 const cost = this.getSpellCost(spell, activePlayerIndex);
1454:                 if (!canAfford(cost)) {
1455:                     updateStatus(`Not enough AP! Need ${cost} AP to cast.`);
1456:                     return false;
1457:                 }
1458:                 // Spend AP first (may be reduced by buffs)
1459:                 spendAP(cost);
1460:                 if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.logScrollEvent) {
1461:                     window.logScrollEvent('cast_execute', {
1462:                         playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
1463:                         scrollName: name,
1464:                         element: spell.element,
1465:                         level: spell.level,
1466:                         cost,
1467:                         fromCommonArea
1468:                     });
1469:                 }
1470: 
1471:                 // Tutorial hook — fires when a spell is successfully cast
1472:                 if (window.isTutorialMode && window.TutorialMode?.onSpellCast) {
1473:                     window.TutorialMode.onSpellCast(name);
1474:                 }
1475: 
1476:                 const scrollData = { name, spell, fromCommonArea, casterIndex: activePlayerIndex };
1477: 
1478:                 // Open response window when 2+ players so the react phase always runs (others can respond or pass)
1479:                 const numPlayers = typeof playerPositions !== 'undefined' ? playerPositions.length : 0;
1480:                 if (this.responseWindow && numPlayers > 1) {
1481:                     console.log('Opening response window (react phase)');
1482:                     this.responseWindow.openResponseWindow(scrollData, activePlayerIndex, (result) => {
1483:                         this.handleResponseWindowComplete(scrollData, result);
1484:                     });
1485:                     return; // Don't apply effects yet
1486:                 }
1487: 
1488:                 // No response window needed - apply effects immediately
1489:                 console.log('Response window skipped - no valid responses available');
1490:                 this.applyScrollEffects(name, spell, fromCommonArea);
1491:             }
1492: 
1493:             // Handle the completion of response window
1494:             handleResponseWindowComplete(originalScrollData, result) {
1495:                 if (result.skipped) {
1496:                     // No responses - apply original scroll effects
1497:                     this.applyScrollEffects(originalScrollData.name, originalScrollData.spell, originalScrollData.fromCommonArea);
1498:                     return;
1499:                 }
1500: 
1501:                 // Process resolved scrolls from the stack
1502:                 // The response window already handles the LIFO resolution
1503:                 // We just need to check if the original scroll was countered
1504:                 const wasCountered = result.responses.some(r =>
1505:                     r.isOriginal && r.result === 'countered'
1506:                 );
1507: 
1508:                 if (wasCountered) {
1509:                     updateStatus(`Your ${originalScrollData.spell.name} was countered!`);
1510:                     // Broadcast the counter in multiplayer
1511:                     if (isMultiplayer) {
1512:                         broadcastGameAction('scroll-countered', {
1513:                             scrollName: originalScrollData.name,
1514:                             casterIndex: originalScrollData.casterIndex
1515:                         });
1516:                     }
1517:                     // Still need to handle scroll disposition for countered scroll
1518:                     this.handleScrollDisposition(originalScrollData.name, originalScrollData.fromCommonArea);
1519:                 } else {
1520:                     // Original not countered: already applied by scroll-resolved listener when event fired.
1521:                     // Nothing to do here (avoids double-apply).
1522:                 }
1523:             }
1524: 
1525:             // Apply the actual scroll effects (separated from executeSpell for response window support)
1526:             applyScrollEffects(name, spell, fromCommonArea = false) {
1527:                 // Sound — play before effects so it feels immediate
1528:                 window.SoundSystem?.play('activatescroll');
1529: 
1530:                 // Handle scroll disposition (remove from player and decide where it goes)
1531:                 this.handleScrollDisposition(name, fromCommonArea);
1532: 
1533:                 // Save the previous scroll cast (before recording this one) for effects like Sigh of Recollection
1534:                 const previousScrollCast = this.scrollEffects ? this.scrollEffects.lastScrollCastThisTurn : null;
1535: 
1536:                 // Track this scroll for Reflect (Water I) effect
1537:                 if (this.scrollEffects) {
1538:                     this.scrollEffects.recordScrollCast(name, spell);
1539:                 }
1540: 
1541:                 // Check if this scroll has a special effect (Earth scrolls, etc.)
1542:                 // Lazy-init: get ScrollEffects from window or global (in case load order / scope hid it at construction)
1543:                 if (!this.scrollEffects) {
1544:                     const SE = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.ScrollEffects) || (typeof ScrollEffects !== 'undefined' && ScrollEffects);
1545:                     if (SE) {
1546:                         SE.init(this);
1547:                         this.scrollEffects = SE;
1548:                         console.log('Scroll effects system initialized (lazy)');
1549:                     }
1550:                 }
1551:                 if (this.scrollEffects) {
1552:                     console.log(`📜 Looking up effect for: "${name}", effects keys:`, Object.keys(this.scrollEffects.effects));
1553:                     const effect = this.scrollEffects.getEffect(name);
1554:                     console.log(`📜 getEffect("${name}") returned:`, effect ? effect.name : null);
1555:                     if (effect) {
1556:                         console.log(`📜 Executing special effect for ${name}: ${effect.name}`);
1557:                         // Wrap execute in try/catch so win-condition tracking always runs even if the
1558:                         // effect throws (e.g. DOM error inside enterTransmuteMode or similar)
1559:                         let result = { success: false, requiresSelection: false };
1560:                         try {
1561:                             result = this.scrollEffects.execute(name, activePlayerIndex, { spell, scrollName: name, previousScrollCast }) || result;
1562:                         } catch (execErr) {
1563:                             console.error(`❌ Effect execute threw for "${name}":`, execErr);
1564:                             // Continue below to still track win condition and broadcast
1565:                         }
1566:                         if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.logScrollEvent) {
1567:                             window.logScrollEvent('effect_execute', {
1568:                                 playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
1569:                                 scrollName: name,
1570:                                 effectName: effect.name,
1571:                                 success: result?.success,
1572:                                 requiresSelection: !!result?.requiresSelection,
1573:                                 message: result?.message
1574:                             });
1575:                         }
1576: 
1577:                         // Refresh all stone count UI after scroll effect (effects may modify pools)
1578:                         ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void'].forEach(t => updateStoneCount(t));
1579: 
1580:                         // Track activated element(s) for win condition regardless of effect result
1581:                         // (but skip if the effect was cancelled, e.g. Sacrificial Pyre with empty hand)
1582:                         if (result.cancelled) {
1583:                             console.log(`📜 Effect cancelled — skipping win-condition tracking for ${name}`);
1584:                             return;
1585:                         }
1586:                         if (spell.element === 'catacomb' && spell.patterns && spell.patterns[0]) {
1587:                             // Catacomb scrolls activate each component element
1588:                             const elements = new Set(spell.patterns[0].map(pos => pos.type));
1589:                             elements.forEach(el => {
1590:                                 const ps = this.getPlayerScrolls(false);
1591:                                 const isNew = !ps.activated.has(el);
1592:                                 ps.activated.add(el);
1593:                                 if (isNew) window.SoundSystem?.onWinCondition(el);
1594:                                 if (typeof window.gami?.onElementActivated === 'function') {
1595:                                     window.gami.onElementActivated(el, Array.from(this.getPlayerScrolls(false).activated));
1596:                                 }
1597:                             });
1598:                         } else {
1599:                             // Source pool guard: if the shared element source pool is fully depleted,
1600:                             // the scroll fires but cannot count toward the win condition — there are
1601:                             // no remaining stones of this element for anyone to use.
1602:                             const elementSourcePool = window.stonePools?.[spell.element] ?? 1;
1603:                             if (elementSourcePool > 0) {
1604:                                 const ps = this.getPlayerScrolls(false);
1605:                                 const isNew = !ps.activated.has(spell.element);
1606:                                 ps.activated.add(spell.element);
1607:                                 if (isNew) window.SoundSystem?.onWinCondition(spell.element);
1608:                                 if (typeof window.gami?.onElementActivated === 'function') {
1609:                                     window.gami.onElementActivated(spell.element, Array.from(this.getPlayerScrolls(false).activated));
1610:                                 }
1611:                             } else {
1612:                                 updateStatus(`The ${spell.element} shrine source is depleted — scroll effect cast, but win condition not met.`);
1613:                                 console.warn(`📜 Win condition skipped for ${spell.element}: source pool is empty.`);
1614:                             }
1615:                         }
1616:                         updatePlayerElementSymbols(activePlayerIndex);
1617: 
1618:                         // If effect requires selection, don't continue with broadcast yet
1619:                         if (result.requiresSelection) {
1620:                             return; // Selection mode will call onSelectionEffectComplete when done
1621:                         }
1622: 
1623:                         // Broadcast the effect in multiplayer
1624:                         if (isMultiplayer) {
1625:                             // For catacomb scrolls, send component elements for win condition tracking
1626:                             const activatedElements = (spell.element === 'catacomb' && spell.patterns && spell.patterns[0])
1627:                                 ? [...new Set(spell.patterns[0].map(pos => pos.type))]
1628:                                 : [spell.element];
1629:                             broadcastGameAction('scroll-effect', {
1630:                                 playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
1631:                                 scrollName: name,
1632:                                 effectName: effect.name,
1633:                                 element: spell.element,
1634:                                 activatedElements: activatedElements
1635:                             });
1636:                             syncPlayerState();
1637:                         }
1638: 
1639:                         // Check win condition
1640:                         if (this.getPlayerScrolls(false).activated.size === 5) {
1641:                             this.showLevelComplete(activePlayerIndex);
1642:                             if (isMultiplayer) {
1643:                                 handleGameOver(activePlayerIndex);
1644:                             }
1645:                         }
1646:                         return;
1647:                     } else {
1648:                         console.warn(`📜 No effect defined for scroll "${name}" – using default (give stones). Add effect in scroll-effects.js for "${name}".`);
1649:                     }
1650:                 } else {
1651:                     console.warn('📜 Scroll effects not available – using default (give stones). Is js/scrolls/effects/scroll-effects.js loaded?');
1652:                 }
1653: 
1654:                 // Default behavior: give stones based on scroll level
1655:                 if (spell.element === 'catacomb') {
1656:                     // Catacomb scrolls give +2 of each element type in the pattern
1657:                     const elementCounts = {};
1658:                     spell.patterns[0].forEach(pos => {
1659:                         elementCounts[pos.type] = (elementCounts[pos.type] || 0) + 1;
1660:                     });
1661: 
1662:                     const rewards = [];
1663:                     Object.entries(elementCounts).forEach(([element, count]) => {
1664:                         playerPool[element] = Math.min(
1665:                             playerPoolCapacity[element],
1666:                             playerPool[element] + count
1667:                         );
1668:                         updateStoneCount(element);
1669: 
1670:                         // Track activated element for win condition (for active player)
1671:                         const ps0 = this.getPlayerScrolls(false);
1672:                         const isNew0 = !ps0.activated.has(element);
1673:                         ps0.activated.add(element);
1674:                         if (isNew0) window.SoundSystem?.onWinCondition(element);
1675:                         rewards.push(`+${count} ${element}`);
1676:                     });
1677: 
1678:                     updatePlayerElementSymbols(activePlayerIndex);
1679:                     updateStatus(`Catacomb spell cast! Added ${rewards.join(', ')} stones!`);
1680:                 } else {
1681:                     // Regular element scrolls
1682:                     playerPool[spell.element] = Math.min(
1683:                         playerPoolCapacity[spell.element],
1684:                         playerPool[spell.element] + spell.level
1685:                     );
1686:                     updateStoneCount(spell.element);
1687: 
1688:                     // Track activated element for win condition — source pool guard applies here too
1689:                     const elementSourcePoolDefault = window.stonePools?.[spell.element] ?? 1;
1690:                     if (elementSourcePoolDefault > 0) {
1691:                         const ps1 = this.getPlayerScrolls(false);
1692:                         const isNew1 = !ps1.activated.has(spell.element);
1693:                         ps1.activated.add(spell.element);
1694:                         if (isNew1) window.SoundSystem?.onWinCondition(spell.element);
1695:                         updateStatus(`Spell cast! Added +${spell.level} ${spell.element} stones!`);
1696:                     } else {
1697:                         updateStatus(`The ${spell.element} shrine source is depleted — scroll effect cast, but win condition not met.`);
1698:                         console.warn(`📜 Win condition skipped for ${spell.element}: source pool is empty (default path).`);
1699:                     }
1700:                     updatePlayerElementSymbols(activePlayerIndex);
1701:                 }
1702: 
1703:                 // Broadcast spell cast in multiplayer
1704:                 if (isMultiplayer) {
1705:                     if (spell.element === 'catacomb') {
1706:                         const elementCounts = {};
1707:                         spell.patterns[0].forEach(pos => {
1708:                             elementCounts[pos.type] = (elementCounts[pos.type] || 0) + 1;
1709:                         });
1710:                         broadcastGameAction('spell-cast', {
1711:                             playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
1712:                             spellName: name,
1713:                             elements: Object.keys(elementCounts),
1714:                             isCatacomb: true
1715:                         });
1716:                     } else {
1717:                         broadcastGameAction('spell-cast', {
1718:                             playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
1719:                             spellName: name,
1720:                             element: spell.element,
1721:                             level: spell.level,
1722:                             isCatacomb: false
1723:                         });
1724:                     }
1725: 
1726:                     // Sync resources after spell adds stones
1727:                     syncPlayerState();
1728:                 }
1729: 
1730:                 // Check if THIS player has won (activated all 5 elements)
1731:                 if (this.getPlayerScrolls(false).activated.size === 5) {
1732:                     this.showLevelComplete(activePlayerIndex);
1733: 
1734:                     // In multiplayer, mark game as finished in database
1735:                     if (isMultiplayer) {
1736:                         handleGameOver(activePlayerIndex);

1781:             // Handle scroll disposition after casting
1782:             // Scrolls normally stay in active area after being cast
1783:             // If Unbidden Lamplight was used in response, the scroll goes to common area
1784:             handleScrollDisposition(scrollName, fromCommonArea = false, forceToCommonArea = false) {
1785:                 const scrolls = this.getPlayerScrolls(false);
1786: 
1787:                 // Common area scrolls are permanent shared resources — casting them does NOT
1788:                 // remove them from the common area. They only leave when replaced by a new scroll
1789:                 // of the same element type. So fromCommonArea=true requires no action here.
1790: 
1791:                 // Check if Unbidden Lamplight has marked this scroll to go to caster's hand
1792:                 const redirect = this.scrollEffects?.pendingHandRedirect;
1793:                 if (redirect && redirect.scrollName === scrollName) {
1794:                     // Remove from the ORIGINAL CASTER's active area
1795:                     const originalCasterIndex = redirect.originalCasterIndex;
1796:                     if (originalCasterIndex !== undefined && this.playerScrolls[originalCasterIndex]) {
1797:                         const originalCasterScrolls = this.playerScrolls[originalCasterIndex];
1798:                         if (originalCasterScrolls.active.has(scrollName)) {
1799:                             originalCasterScrolls.active.delete(scrollName);
1800:                         }
1801:                     } else if (scrolls.active.has(scrollName)) {
1802:                         scrolls.active.delete(scrollName);
1803:                     }
1804: 
1805:                     // Add to lamplight caster's hand — bypasses hand size limit intentionally
1806:                     const lamplightCasterIndex = redirect.redirectToPlayerIndex;
1807:                     this.ensurePlayerScrollsStructure(lamplightCasterIndex);
1808:                     this.playerScrolls[lamplightCasterIndex].hand.add(scrollName);
1809: 
1810:                     // Clear the pending redirect
1811:                     this.scrollEffects.pendingHandRedirect = null;
1812: 
1813:                     // If hand is now over the limit, trigger cascade prompt so player resolves it
1814:                     const lamplightScrolls = this.playerScrolls[lamplightCasterIndex];
1815:                     if (lamplightScrolls.hand.size > this.MAX_HAND_SIZE) {
1816:                         const scrollInfo = this.getScrollInfo ? this.getScrollInfo(scrollName) : null;
1817:                         const canCascadeToActive = lamplightScrolls.active.size < this.MAX_ACTIVE_SIZE;
1818:                         updateStatus(`Unbidden Lamplight sent "${scrollName}" to your hand — hand is over the limit. Cascade a scroll before ending your turn!`);
1819:                         if (lamplightCasterIndex === (isMultiplayer ? myPlayerIndex : activePlayerIndex)) {
1820:                             this.showCascadePrompt(scrollName, scrollInfo, null, canCascadeToActive);
1821:                         }
1822:                     } else {
1823:                         updateStatus('Unbidden Lamplight sent the scroll to your hand!');
1824:                     }
1825:                 } else if (forceToCommonArea) {
1826:                     // Explicit request to send to common area.
1827:                     // Guard: only discard if the scroll is still in active — if Lamplight already
1828:                     // redirected it to hand, the scroll is gone from active and we must not override.
1829:                     if (scrolls.active.has(scrollName)) {
1830:                         scrolls.active.delete(scrollName);
1831:                         this.discardToCommonArea(scrollName);
1832:                     }
1833:                 }
1834:                 // Otherwise, scroll remains in player's active area - NO auto-discard!
1835: 
1836:                 // Update scroll UI
1837:                 this.updateScrollCount();
1838:                 updateCommonAreaUI();
1839: 
1840:                 // Broadcast in multiplayer
1841:                 if (isMultiplayer) {
1842:                     broadcastGameAction('scroll-used', {
1843:                         playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
1844:                         scrollName: scrollName,
1845:                         fromCommonArea: fromCommonArea,
1846:                         forceToCommonArea: forceToCommonArea
1847:                     });
1848:                 }
1849:             }

1929:             createPatternVisual(scroll, elementType) {
1930:                 const container = document.createElement('div');
1931:                 container.style.display = 'flex';
1932:                 container.style.justifyContent = 'center';
1933:                 container.style.alignItems = 'center';
1934:                 container.style.padding = '15px';
1935:                 container.style.backgroundColor = '#2c3e50';
1936:                 container.style.borderRadius = '5px';
1937:                 container.style.marginTop = '10px';
1938:                 container.style.position = 'relative';
1939: 
1940:                 // Create SVG
1941:                 const svg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg');
1942:                 svg.setAttribute('width', '200');
1943:                 svg.setAttribute('height', '200');
1944:                 svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '-100 -100 200 200');
1945: 
1946:                 const hexSize = 15;
1947: 
1948:                 // Helper to create hex points
1949:                 const createHexPoints = (cx, cy, size) => {
1950:                     const points = [];
1951:                     for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
1952:                         const angle = (Math.PI / 3) * i - Math.PI / 6;
1953:                         points.push(`${cx + size * Math.cos(angle)},${cy + size * Math.sin(angle)}`);
1954:                     }
1955:                     return points.join(' ');
1956:                 };
1957: 
1958:                 // Helper to convert axial to pixel
1959:                 const axialToPixel = (q, r) => {
1960:                     const x = hexSize * (Math.sqrt(3) * q + Math.sqrt(3)/2 * r);
1961:                     const y = hexSize * (3/2 * r);
1962:                     return { x, y };
1963:                 };
1964: 
1965:                 // Draw background hexes in a grid (static layer)
1966:                 const backgroundGroup = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
1967:                 for (let q = -2; q <= 2; q++) {
1968:                     for (let r = -2; r <= 2; r++) {
1969:                         if (Math.abs(q + r) <= 2) {
1970:                             const pos = axialToPixel(q, r);
1971:                             const hex = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'polygon');
1972:                             hex.setAttribute('points', createHexPoints(pos.x, pos.y, hexSize));
1973:                             hex.setAttribute('fill', '#34495e');
1974:                             hex.setAttribute('stroke', '#2c3e50');
1975:                             hex.setAttribute('stroke-width', '2');
1976:                             backgroundGroup.appendChild(hex);
1977:                         }
1978:                     }
1979:                 }
1980:                 svg.appendChild(backgroundGroup);
1981: 
1982:                 // Draw player hex (static layer)
1983:                 const playerHex = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
1984:                 playerHex.setAttribute('cx', '0');
1985:                 playerHex.setAttribute('cy', '0');
1986:                 playerHex.setAttribute('r', hexSize * 0.5);
1987:                 playerHex.setAttribute('fill', '#fff');
1988:                 playerHex.setAttribute('stroke', '#333');
1989:                 playerHex.setAttribute('stroke-width', '2');
1990:                 svg.appendChild(playerHex);
1991: 
1992:                 // Create pattern groups for each variation (animated layers)
1993:                 const patternGroups = [];
1994:                 scroll.patterns.forEach((patternVariation, idx) => {
1995:                     const group = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
1996:                     group.style.opacity = idx === 0 ? '1' : '0';
1997:                     group.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease-in-out';
1998: 
1999:                     patternVariation.forEach(pos => {
2000:                         const pixelPos = axialToPixel(pos.q, pos.r);
2001:                         const stoneHex = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'polygon');
2002:                         stoneHex.setAttribute('points', createHexPoints(pixelPos.x, pixelPos.y, hexSize));
2003:                         // Use pos.type if available (for catacomb multi-element), otherwise use elementType
2004:                         const stoneType = pos.type || elementType;
2005:                         stoneHex.setAttribute('fill', darkenHex(STONE_TYPES[stoneType].color, 0.55));
2006:                         stoneHex.setAttribute('stroke', STONE_TYPES[stoneType].color);
2007:                         stoneHex.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.5');
2008:                         group.appendChild(stoneHex);
2009: 
2010:                         // Add element image
2011:                         const symbol = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'image');
2012:                         symbol.setAttribute('href', STONE_TYPES[stoneType].img);
2013:                         symbol.setAttribute('x', pixelPos.x - hexSize);
2014:                         symbol.setAttribute('y', pixelPos.y - hexSize);
2015:                         symbol.setAttribute('width', hexSize * 2);
2016:                         symbol.setAttribute('height', hexSize * 2);
2017:                         // No opacity reduction — symbol renders at full strength
2018:                         group.appendChild(symbol);
2019:                     });
2020: 
2021:                     patternGroups.push(group);
2022:                     svg.appendChild(group);
2023:                 });
2024: 
2025:                 // Add pattern indicator text
2026:                 const indicatorText = document.createElement('div');
2027:                 indicatorText.style.position = 'absolute';
2028:                 indicatorText.style.bottom = '5px';
2029:                 indicatorText.style.right = '10px';
2030:                 indicatorText.style.fontSize = '11px';
2031:                 indicatorText.style.color = '#95a5a6';
2032:                 indicatorText.style.fontStyle = 'italic';
2033:                 indicatorText.textContent = `Pattern 1/${patternGroups.length}`;
2034:                 container.appendChild(indicatorText);
2035: 
2036:                 // Cycle through patterns
2037:                 let currentPatternIdx = 0;
2038:                 const cycleInterval = setInterval(() => {
2039:                     // Fade out current
2040:                     patternGroups[currentPatternIdx].style.opacity = '0';
2041:                     
2042:                     // Move to next
2043:                     currentPatternIdx = (currentPatternIdx + 1) % patternGroups.length;
2044:                     
2045:                     // Fade in next
2046:                     patternGroups[currentPatternIdx].style.opacity = '1';
2047:                     
2048:                     // Update indicator
2049:                     indicatorText.textContent = `Pattern ${currentPatternIdx + 1}/${patternGroups.length}`;
2050:                 }, 2500); // Change pattern every 2.5 seconds
2051: 
2052:                 // Store interval ID so we can clean it up if needed
2053:                 container.dataset.intervalId = cycleInterval;
2054: 
2055:                 container.appendChild(svg);
2056:                 return container;
2057:             }

2530:         function spendAP(cost) {

2532:             // Spend void AP first, then regular AP
2533:             if (voidAP >= cost) {
2534:                 voidAP -= cost;
2535:             } else {
2536:                 const remainingCost = cost - voidAP;
2537:                 voidAP = 0;
2538:                 currentAP = Math.max(0, currentAP - remainingCost); // clamp — never go negative
2539:             }
2540:             console.log(`⚡ spendAP after: voidAP=${voidAP}, currentAP=${currentAP}, total=${getTotalAP()}`);
2541:             const apCountEl = document.getElementById('ap-count');
2542:             if (apCountEl) apCountEl.textContent = currentAP;

2546:             if (display) {
2547:                 if (voidAP > 0) {
2548:                     display.textContent = `(+${voidAP} Void AP)`;
2549:                     display.style.display = 'inline';
2550:                 } else {
2551:                     display.style.display = 'none';

2572:         function addAP(amount) {
2573:             if (amount <= 0) return;
2574:             const maxAP = 5;
2575:             const roomInCurrent = maxAP - currentAP;
2576:             const addToCurrent = Math.min(amount, roomInCurrent);
2577:             currentAP += addToCurrent;
2578:             const overflow = amount - addToCurrent;
2579:             // Overflow can only recharge void AP if the player has void stones (void AP cap = playerPool.void)
2580:             if (overflow > 0 && typeof playerPool !== 'undefined' && playerPool.void > 0) {
2581:                 const maxVoidAP = playerPool.void;
2582:                 const addToVoid = Math.min(overflow, maxVoidAP - voidAP);
2583:                 if (addToVoid > 0) voidAP += addToVoid;
2584:             }
2585:             const apCountEl = document.getElementById('ap-count');
2586:             if (apCountEl) apCountEl.textContent = currentAP;
2587:             const voidDisplay = document.getElementById('void-ap-display');
2588:             if (voidDisplay) {
2589:                 if (voidAP > 0) {
2590:                     voidDisplay.textContent = `(+${voidAP} Void AP)`;
2591:                     voidDisplay.style.display = 'inline';
2592:                 } else {
2593:                     voidDisplay.style.display = 'none';
2594:                 }
2595:             }
2596:             if (typeof updateHUD === 'function') updateHUD();
2597:             if (typeof syncPlayerState === 'function') syncPlayerState();
2598:         }
2599:         if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.addAP = addAP;

2605:         function attemptBreakStone(stoneId) {
2606:             // In multiplayer, only the active player can break stones
2607:             if (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer &&
2608:                 typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' && myPlayerIndex !== null &&
2609:                 myPlayerIndex !== activePlayerIndex) {
2610:                 updateStatus("It's not your turn!");
2611:                 window.SoundSystem?.play('error');
2612:                 return;
2613:             }
2614: 
2615:             const stone = placedStones.find(s => s.id === stoneId);
2616:             if (!stone) {
2617:                 console.log('❌ Stone not found');
2618:                 return;
2619:             }
2620: 
2621:             console.log(`🔨 attemptBreakStone called for stone id=${stoneId}, type=${stone.type}, position=(${stone.x.toFixed(1)}, ${stone.y.toFixed(1)})`);
2622: 
2623:             // Check if stone is adjacent to player
2624:             if (!playerPosition) {
2625:                 updateStatus('No player on board!');
2626:                 console.log('❌ No player on board!');
2627:                 return;
2628:             }
2629: 
2630:             const isAdj = isAdjacentToPlayer(stone.x, stone.y);
2631:             console.log(`🔨 Adjacency check: ${isAdj}`);
2632:             
2633:             if (!isAdj) {
2634:                 updateStatus('Stone must be adjacent to player to break!');
2635:                 console.log('❌ Stone must be adjacent to player to break!');
2636:                 return;
2637:             }
2638: 
2639:             // Calculate break cost based on stone rank
2640:             const STONE_RANK = {
2641:                 'void': 1,
2642:                 'wind': 2,
2643:                 'fire': 3,
2644:                 'water': 4,
2645:                 'earth': 5
2646:             };
2647: 
2648:             const breakCost = STONE_RANK[stone.type];
2649: 
2650:             if (!canAfford(breakCost)) {
2651:                 updateStatus(`Not enough AP! Need ${breakCost} AP to break ${stone.type} stone (have ${getTotalAP()} AP)`);
2652:                 return;
2653:             }
2654: 
2655:             // Snapshot undo state before spending AP / removing stone
2656:             lastMove = {
2657:                 type: 'stone-break',
2658:                 stoneId: stone.id,
2659:                 x: stone.x,
2660:                 y: stone.y,
2661:                 element: stone.type,
2662:                 prevCurrentAP: currentAP,
2663:                 prevVoidAP: voidAP
2664:             };
2665:             window.lastScrollAction = null; // a stone-break supersedes any pending scroll undo
2666: 
2667:             // Break the stone
2668:             window.SoundSystem?.play('breakstone');
2669:             spendAP(breakCost);
2670: 
2671:             // Broadcast stone break to other players
2672:             if (isMultiplayer) {
2673:                 broadcastGameAction('stone-break', {
2674:                     stoneId: stoneId

2676:             }

2738:         // Seeded random number generator (Mulberry32)
2739:         // This ensures all players get the same shuffle with the same seed
2740:         function seededRandom(seed) {
2741:             return function() {
2742:                 let t = seed += 0x6D2B79F5;
2743:                 t = Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 15, t | 1);
2744:                 t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, t | 61);
2745:                 return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
2746:             };
2747:         }

2749:         function initializeDeck(numPlayers = 1, seed = null) {
2750:             // Tutorial mode: use a fixed deck order so earth lands at the center position
2751:             if (window.tutorialDeckOverride) {
2752:                 tileDeck = [...window.tutorialDeckOverride];
2753:                 window.tutorialDeckOverride = null;
2754:                 deckIndex = 0;
2755:                 const countEl = document.getElementById('deck-count');
2756:                 if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `0/${tileDeck.length}`;
2757:                 console.log('🎓 Tutorial deck applied:', tileDeck.join(', '));
2758:                 return;
2759:             }
2760: 
2761:             const shrineTypes = ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void', 'catacomb'];
2762:             const tilesPerType = numPlayers; // 1 of each type per player
2763: 
2764:             tileDeck = [];
2765: 
2766:             shrineTypes.forEach(type => {
2767:                 for (let i = 0; i < tilesPerType; i++) {
2768:                     tileDeck.push(type);
2769:                 }
2770:             });
2771: 
2772:             // Use seeded shuffle if seed provided (multiplayer), otherwise random
2773:             if (seed !== null) {
2774:                 deckSeed = seed;
2775:                 const rng = seededRandom(seed);
2776:                 // Seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle
2777:                 for (let i = tileDeck.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
2778:                     const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
2779:                     [tileDeck[i], tileDeck[j]] = [tileDeck[j], tileDeck[i]];
2780:                 }
2781:                 console.log(`🎴 Deck initialized with seed ${seed}:`, tileDeck.join(', '));
2782:             } else {
2783:                 // Random shuffle for single player
2784:                 for (let i = tileDeck.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
2785:                     const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
2786:                     [tileDeck[i], tileDeck[j]] = [tileDeck[j], tileDeck[i]];
2787:                 }
2788:                 console.log(`🎴 Deck initialized (random):`, tileDeck.join(', '));
2789:             }
2790: 
2791:             deckIndex = 0;
2792:         }

2831:         // Fit all placed tiles into view, centered
2832:         function fitBoardToView() {
2833:             if (placedTiles.length === 0) return;
2834: 
2835:             // Calculate bounding box of all tiles
2836:             let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity;
2837:             let minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
2838: 
2839:             placedTiles.forEach(tile => {
2840:                 // Each tile is roughly TILE_SIZE * 2.5 in radius
2841:                 const tileRadius = TILE_SIZE * 2.5;
2842:                 minX = Math.min(minX, tile.x - tileRadius);
2843:                 maxX = Math.max(maxX, tile.x + tileRadius);
2844:                 minY = Math.min(minY, tile.y - tileRadius);
2845:                 maxY = Math.max(maxY, tile.y + tileRadius);
2846:             });
2847: 
2848:             const boardWidth = maxX - minX;
2849:             const boardHeight = maxY - minY;
2850:             const boardCenterX = (minX + maxX) / 2;
2851:             const boardCenterY = (minY + maxY) / 2;
2852: 
2853:             // Get available screen space
2854:             const svgRect = boardSvg.getBoundingClientRect();
2855:             const screenWidth = svgRect.width;
2856:             const screenHeight = svgRect.height;
2857: 
2858:             // Add padding (10% on each side)
2859:             const paddingFactor = 0.8;
2860:             const scaleX = (screenWidth * paddingFactor) / boardWidth;
2861:             const scaleY = (screenHeight * paddingFactor) / boardHeight;
2862:             const newScale = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY, 2); // Cap at 2x zoom
2863: 
2864:             // Center the board
2865:             const screenCenterX = screenWidth / 2;
2866:             const screenCenterY = screenHeight / 2;
2867: 
2868:             viewportScale = newScale;
2869:             viewportX = screenCenterX - boardCenterX * newScale;
2870:             viewportY = screenCenterY - boardCenterY * newScale;
2871: 
2872:             console.log(`📐 fitBoardToView: board=(${boardWidth.toFixed(0)}x${boardHeight.toFixed(0)}), screen=(${screenWidth.toFixed(0)}x${screenHeight.toFixed(0)}), scale=${newScale.toFixed(2)}`);
2873: 
2874:             updateViewport();
2875:         }

2877:         function screenToWorld(screenX, screenY) {
2878:             const centerX = boardSvg.clientWidth / 2;
2879:             const centerY = boardSvg.clientHeight / 2;
2880:             let x = screenX - centerX;
2881:             let y = screenY - centerY;
2882:             const rad = -viewportRotation * Math.PI / 180;
2883:             const cos = Math.cos(rad);
2884:             const sin = Math.sin(rad);
2885:             const rotatedX = x * cos - y * sin;
2886:             const rotatedY = x * sin + y * cos;
2887:             const scaledX = rotatedX / viewportScale;
2888:             const scaledY = rotatedY / viewportScale;
2889:             const worldX = scaledX - (viewportX - centerX) / viewportScale;
2890:             const worldY = scaledY - (viewportY - centerY) / viewportScale;
2891:             return { x: worldX, y: worldY };
2892:         }

2894:         function hexToPixel(q, r, s) {
2895:             const width = s * Math.sqrt(3);
2896:             const height = 2 * s;
2897:             const x = width * (q + r / 2);
2898:             const y = height * (3/4) * r;
2899:             return { x, y };
2900:         }
2901: 
2902:         function pixelToHex(x, y, s) {
2903:             const q = (x * Math.sqrt(3)/3 - y / 3) / s;
2904:             const r = (y * 2/3) / s;
2905:             return hexRound(q, r);
2906:         }
2907: 
2908:         function hexRound(q, r) {
2909:             let s = -q - r;
2910:             let rq = Math.round(q);
2911:             let rr = Math.round(r);
2912:             let rs = Math.round(s);
2913:             const qDiff = Math.abs(rq - q);
2914:             const rDiff = Math.abs(rr - r);
2915:             const sDiff = Math.abs(rs - s);
2916:             if (qDiff > rDiff && qDiff > sDiff) rq = -rr - rs;
2917:             else if (rDiff > sDiff) rr = -rq - rs;
2918:             return { q: rq, r: rr };
2919:         }
2920: 
2921:         function createHexagonPoints(cx, cy, s) {
2922:             const points = [];
2923:             for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
2924:                 const angle = (Math.PI / 3) * i - Math.PI / 6;
2925:                 const x = cx + s * Math.cos(angle);
2926:                 const y = cy + s * Math.sin(angle);
2927:                 points.push(`${x},${y}`);
2928:             }
2929:             return points.join(' ');
2930:         }
2931: 
2932:         function createTrapezoidPoints(cx, cy, s, direction) {
2933:             const hexVertices = [];
2934:             for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
2935:                 const angle = (Math.PI / 3) * i - Math.PI / 6;
2936:                 hexVertices.push({
2937:                     x: cx + s * Math.cos(angle),
2938:                     y: cy + s * Math.sin(angle)
2939:                 });
2940:             }
2941:             const indices = [
2942:                 [1, 2, 3, 4], [2, 3, 4, 5], [3, 4, 5, 0],
2943:                 [4, 5, 0, 1], [5, 0, 1, 2], [0, 1, 2, 3]
2944:             ][direction];
2945:             return indices.map(idx => `${hexVertices[idx].x},${hexVertices[idx].y}`).join(' ');
2946:         }

3160:         function getAllHexagonPositions() {
3161:             const positions = new Map();
3162:             const trapezoidMap = new Map();
3163: 
3164:             placedTiles.forEach(tile => {
3165:                 const s = TILE_SIZE;
3166: 
3167:                 // For flipped tiles, only include outer ring hexagons
3168:                 // For normal tiles and player tiles, include all hexagons
3169:                 // Player tiles look revealed but allow walking off them
3170:                 let hexagons;
3171:                 if (tile.flipped && !tile.isPlayerTile) {
3172:                     hexagons = [
3173:                         { q: 2, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: 1 }, { q: -1, r: 2 },
3174:                         { q: -2, r: 1 }, { q: -1, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: -2 }
3175:                     ];
3176:                 } else {
3177:                     hexagons = [
3178:                         { q: 0, r: 0 },
3179:                         { q: 1, r: 0 }, { q: 0, r: 1 }, { q: -1, r: 1 },
3180:                         { q: -1, r: 0 }, { q: 0, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: -1 },
3181:                         { q: 2, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: 1 }, { q: -1, r: 2 },
3182:                         { q: -2, r: 1 }, { q: -1, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: -2 }
3183:                     ];
3184:                 }
3185: 
3186:                 hexagons.forEach(hex => {
3187:                     const localPos = hexToPixel(hex.q, hex.r, s);
3188:                     const globalX = tile.x + localPos.x;
3189:                     const globalY = tile.y + localPos.y;
3190:                     const roundedX = Math.round(globalX * 100) / 100;
3191:                     const roundedY = Math.round(globalY * 100) / 100;
3192:                     const key = `${roundedX},${roundedY}`;
3193:                     if (!positions.has(key)) {
3194:                         positions.set(key, { x: globalX, y: globalY, key, tiles: [tile] });
3195:                     } else {
3196:                         // Track which tiles contribute to this position
3197:                         const existing = positions.get(key);
3198:                         if (!existing.tiles.includes(tile)) {
3199:                             existing.tiles.push(tile);
3200:                         }
3201:                     }
3202:                 });
3203: 
3204:                 const trapezoids = [
3205:                     { q: 2, r: 0 }, { q: 0, r: 2 }, { q: -2, r: 2 },
3206:                     { q: -2, r: 0 }, { q: 0, r: -2 }, { q: 2, r: -2 }
3207:                 ];
3208: 
3209:                 trapezoids.forEach(trap => {
3210:                     const localPos = hexToPixel(trap.q, trap.r, s);
3211:                     const globalX = tile.x + localPos.x;
3212:                     const globalY = tile.y + localPos.y;
3213:                     const roundedX = Math.round(globalX * 100) / 100;
3214:                     const roundedY = Math.round(globalY * 100) / 100;
3215:                     const key = `${roundedX},${roundedY}`;
3216:                     if (!trapezoidMap.has(key)) {
3217:                         trapezoidMap.set(key, { count: 1, x: globalX, y: globalY, key, tiles: [tile] });
3218:                     } else {
3219:                         const existing = trapezoidMap.get(key);
3220:                         existing.count += 1;
3221:                         if (!existing.tiles.includes(tile)) {
3222:                             existing.tiles.push(tile);
3223:                         }
3224:                         if (existing.count >= 2 && !positions.has(key)) {
3225:                             positions.set(key, { x: globalX, y: globalY, key, tiles: existing.tiles });
3226:                         }
3227:                     }
3228:                 });
3229:             });
3230: 
3231:             return Array.from(positions.values());
3232:         }

3234:         function isPositionOnFlippedTile(x, y, hexPositions) {
3235:             // Find the hex position that matches this x,y
3236:             const matchingPos = hexPositions.find(pos => {
3237:                 const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(pos.x - x, 2) + Math.pow(pos.y - y, 2));
3238:                 return dist < 5;
3239:             });
3240: 
3241:             if (!matchingPos || !matchingPos.tiles) return false;
3242: 
3243:             // Check if ANY of the tiles contributing to this position are flipped (and not player tile)
3244:             return matchingPos.tiles.some(tile => tile.flipped && !tile.isPlayerTile);
3245:         }

3247:         function findValidStonePosition(x, y) {
3248:             const hexPositions = getAllHexagonPositions();
3249:             let nearest = null;
3250:             let minDist = Infinity;
3251: 
3252:             hexPositions.forEach(pos => {
3253:                 const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(x - pos.x, 2) + Math.pow(y - pos.y, 2));
3254:                 if (dist < minDist) {
3255:                     minDist = dist;
3256:                     nearest = pos;
3257:                 }
3258:             });
3259: 
3260:             if (nearest && minDist < TILE_SIZE * 2) {
3261:                 const occupied = placedStones.some(stone => {
3262:                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(stone.x - nearest.x, 2) + Math.pow(stone.y - nearest.y, 2));
3263:                     return dist < 5;
3264:                 });
3265: 
3266:                 // Block placement on any player (active or other players)
3267:                 let anyPlayerHere = false;
3268:                 if (playerPosition) {
3269:                     const d = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(playerPosition.x - nearest.x, 2) + Math.pow(playerPosition.y - nearest.y, 2));
3270:                     if (d < 5) anyPlayerHere = true;
3271:                 }
3272:                 if (typeof playerPositions !== 'undefined' && playerPositions.length) {
3273:                     playerPositions.forEach(pos => {
3274:                         if (pos && pos.x != null && pos.y != null) {
3275:                             const d = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(pos.x - nearest.x, 2) + Math.pow(pos.y - nearest.y, 2));
3276:                             if (d < 5) anyPlayerHere = true;
3277:                         }
3278:                     });
3279:                 }
3280: 
3281:                 const onFlippedTile = isPositionOnFlippedTile(nearest.x, nearest.y, hexPositions);
3282: 
3283:                 // Check if position is valid for placement based on active buffs
3284:                 const inPlacementRange = playerPosition && isInPlacementRange(nearest.x, nearest.y, draggedStoneType);
3285: 
3286:                 if (!occupied && !anyPlayerHere && !onFlippedTile && inPlacementRange) {
3287:                     return { x: nearest.x, y: nearest.y, valid: true };
3288:                 }
3289:             }
3290: 
3291:             return { x: x, y: y, valid: false };
3292:         }

3697:         function isAdjacentToPlayer(x, y) {
3698:             if (!playerPosition) return false;
3699: 
3700:             // Get hex coordinates for both positions
3701:             const playerHex = pixelToHex(playerPosition.x, playerPosition.y, TILE_SIZE);
3702:             const targetHex = pixelToHex(x, y, TILE_SIZE);
3703: 
3704:             // Calculate axial distance
3705:             const dq = Math.abs(playerHex.q - targetHex.q);
3706:             const dr = Math.abs(playerHex.r - targetHex.r);
3707:             const ds = Math.abs((-playerHex.q - playerHex.r) - (-targetHex.q - targetHex.r));
3708: 
3709:             // Adjacent means distance = 1 in hex coordinates
3710:             const hexDistance = Math.max(dq, dr, ds);
3711: 
3712:             const isAdj = hexDistance === 1;
3713:             if (shouldDebugLog('isAdjacentToPlayer', 500)) {
3714:                 console.log(`📍 isAdjacentToPlayer: player=(${playerHex.q},${playerHex.r}), target=(${targetHex.q},${targetHex.r}), distance=${hexDistance}, adjacent=${isAdj}`);
3715:             }
3716: 
3717:             return isAdj;
3718:         }
3719: 
3720:         // Check if a position is within valid stone placement range (considering buffs)
3721:         function isInPlacementRange(x, y, stoneType) {
3722:             if (!playerPosition) return false;
3723: 
3724:             // Get current player index (use activePlayerIndex in single player, myPlayerIndex in multiplayer)
3725:             const currentPlayerIdx = (typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' && myPlayerIndex !== null) ? myPlayerIndex : activePlayerIndex;
3726: 
3727:             // Check for global placement buff (Avalanche - any stone anywhere)
3728:             if (spellSystem && spellSystem.scrollEffects && spellSystem.scrollEffects.hasGlobalPlacement(currentPlayerIdx)) {
3729:                 console.log(`ℹ️ Global placement active - allowing stone at any position`);
3730:                 return true;
3731:             }
3732: 
3733:             // Seed the Skies: allow water/wind stones anywhere this turn
3734:             if (stoneType && spellSystem && spellSystem.scrollEffects) {
3735:                 const buff = spellSystem.scrollEffects.activeBuffs?.waterWindGlobalPlacement;
3736:                 if (buff && buff.playerIndex === currentPlayerIdx && (stoneType === 'water' || stoneType === 'wind')) {
3737:                     console.log(`ℹ️ Seed the Skies active - allowing ${stoneType} stone at any position`);
3738:                     return true;
3739:                 }
3740:             }
3741: 
3742:             // Check for extended placement buff (Mason's Savvy - earth stones within 5 hexes)
3743:             if (stoneType && spellSystem && spellSystem.scrollEffects) {
3744:                 const extended = spellSystem.scrollEffects.hasExtendedPlacement(stoneType, currentPlayerIdx);
3745:                 if (extended.active) {
3746:                     // Calculate hex distance
3747:                     const playerHex = pixelToHex(playerPosition.x, playerPosition.y, TILE_SIZE);
3748:                     const targetHex = pixelToHex(x, y, TILE_SIZE);
3749: 
3750:                     const dq = Math.abs(playerHex.q - targetHex.q);
3751:                     const dr = Math.abs(playerHex.r - targetHex.r);
3752:                     const ds = Math.abs((-playerHex.q - playerHex.r) - (-targetHex.q - targetHex.r));
3753:                     const hexDistance = Math.max(dq, dr, ds);
3754: 
3755:                     if (hexDistance <= extended.range) {
3756:                         console.log(`🎯 Extended placement active - allowing ${stoneType} stone at distance ${hexDistance} (max ${extended.range})`);
3757:                         return true;
3758:                     }
3759:                 }
3760:             }
3761: 
3762:             // Default: must be adjacent to player
3763:             return isAdjacentToPlayer(x, y);
3764:         }

3766:         function findNearestHexPosition(x, y) {
3767:             // Similar to findValidStonePosition, but doesn't care about stones/player
3768:             // Used for player movement pathfinding
3769:             const hexPositions = getAllHexagonPositions();
3770:             let nearest = null;
3771:             let minDist = Infinity;
3772: 
3773:             hexPositions.forEach(pos => {
3774:                 const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(x - pos.x, 2) + Math.pow(y - pos.y, 2));
3775:                 if (dist < minDist) {
3776:                     minDist = dist;
3777:                     nearest = pos;
3778:                 }
3779:             });
3780: 
3781:             if (nearest && minDist < TILE_SIZE * 2) {
3782:                 return { x: nearest.x, y: nearest.y, valid: true };
3783:             }
3784: 
3785:             return { x: x, y: y, valid: false };
3786:         }

3788:         function findNearestSnapPoint(x, y, isPlayerTile = false) {
3789:             const largeHexSize = TILE_SIZE * 4;
3790:             const hexCoords = pixelToHex(x, y, largeHexSize);
3791:             const snapPos = hexToPixel(hexCoords.q, hexCoords.r, largeHexSize);
3792:             const distance = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(x - snapPos.x, 2) + Math.pow(y - snapPos.y, 2));
3793: 
3794:             if (distance < SNAP_THRESHOLD) {
3795:                 // Check if a tile already exists at this position
3796:                 const tileExists = placedTiles.some(tile => {
3797:                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(tile.x - snapPos.x, 2) + Math.pow(tile.y - snapPos.y, 2));
3798:                     return dist < TILE_SIZE; // Tiles are considered overlapping if centers are very close
3799:                 });
3800: 
3801:                 if (tileExists) {
3802:                     return { x: x, y: y, snapped: false }; // Don't snap if position is occupied
3803:                 }
3804: 
3805:                 // PLAYER TILE SPECIAL RULE: Must touch at least 2 unrevealed tiles
3806:                 if (isPlayerTile) {
3807:                     const touchingUnrevealedCount = countTouchingUnrevealedTiles(snapPos.x, snapPos.y);
3808:                     if (touchingUnrevealedCount < 2) {
3809:                         console.log(`❌ Player tile at (${snapPos.x.toFixed(1)}, ${snapPos.y.toFixed(1)}) only touches ${touchingUnrevealedCount} unrevealed tile(s), need 2+`);
3810:                         return { x: x, y: y, snapped: false }; // Don't allow placement
3811:                     }
3812:                     console.log(`✅ Player tile at (${snapPos.x.toFixed(1)}, ${snapPos.y.toFixed(1)}) touches ${touchingUnrevealedCount} unrevealed tiles`);
3813:                 }
3814: 
3815:                 // TELEKINESIS RULE: Must touch at least 1 other tile
3816:                 if (window.telekinesisState && window.telekinesisState.active) {
3817:                     const touchingCount = countTouchingTiles(snapPos.x, snapPos.y);
3818:                     if (touchingCount < 1) {
3819:                         console.log(`❌ Telekinesis: tile at (${snapPos.x.toFixed(1)}, ${snapPos.y.toFixed(1)}) touches ${touchingCount} tile(s), need 1+`);
3820:                         return { x: x, y: y, snapped: false };
3821:                     }
3822:                     console.log(`✅ Telekinesis: tile at (${snapPos.x.toFixed(1)}, ${snapPos.y.toFixed(1)}) touches ${touchingCount} tiles`);
3823:                 }
3824: 
3825:                 return { x: snapPos.x, y: snapPos.y, snapped: true };
3826:             }
3827:             return { x: x, y: y, snapped: false };
3828:         }
3829: 
3830:         function countTouchingUnrevealedTiles(tileX, tileY) {
3831:             // Get the 6 adjacent tile positions in the large hex grid
3832:             const largeHexSize = TILE_SIZE * 4;
3833:             const tileHex = pixelToHex(tileX, tileY, largeHexSize);
3834:             
3835:             const adjacentOffsets = [
3836:                 { q: 1, r: 0 },   // East
3837:                 { q: 0, r: 1 },   // Southeast
3838:                 { q: -1, r: 1 },  // Southwest
3839:                 { q: -1, r: 0 },  // West
3840:                 { q: 0, r: -1 },  // Northwest
3841:                 { q: 1, r: -1 }   // Northeast
3842:             ];
3843: 
3844:             let unrevealedCount = 0;
3845: 
3846:             adjacentOffsets.forEach(offset => {
3847:                 const adjQ = tileHex.q + offset.q;
3848:                 const adjR = tileHex.r + offset.r;
3849:                 const adjPos = hexToPixel(adjQ, adjR, largeHexSize);
3850: 
3851:                 // Check if there's an unrevealed (flipped) tile at this position
3852:                 const adjacentTile = placedTiles.find(tile => {
3853:                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(tile.x - adjPos.x, 2) + Math.pow(tile.y - adjPos.y, 2));
3854:                     return dist < TILE_SIZE;
3855:                 });
3856: 
3857:                 if (adjacentTile && adjacentTile.flipped) {
3858:                     unrevealedCount++;
3859:                 }
3860:             });
3861: 
3862:             return unrevealedCount;
3863:         }
3864: 
3865:         // Count ALL adjacent tiles (revealed or unrevealed) — used by Telekinesis
3866:         function countTouchingTiles(tileX, tileY) {
3867:             const largeHexSize = TILE_SIZE * 4;
3868:             const tileHex = pixelToHex(tileX, tileY, largeHexSize);
3869:             const adjacentOffsets = [
3870:                 { q: 1, r: 0 }, { q: 0, r: 1 }, { q: -1, r: 1 },
3871:                 { q: -1, r: 0 }, { q: 0, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: -1 }
3872:             ];
3873:             let count = 0;
3874:             adjacentOffsets.forEach(offset => {
3875:                 const adjPos = hexToPixel(tileHex.q + offset.q, tileHex.r + offset.r, largeHexSize);
3876:                 const found = placedTiles.find(t => {
3877:                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(t.x - adjPos.x, 2) + Math.pow(t.y - adjPos.y, 2));
3878:                     return dist < TILE_SIZE;
3879:                 });
3880:                 if (found) count++;
3881:             });
3882:             return count;
3883:         }

3885:         function tileHasStones(tileId) {
3886:             const tile = placedTiles.find(t => t.id === tileId);
3887:             if (!tile) return false;
3888: 
3889:             const s = TILE_SIZE;
3890:             const hexagons = [
3891:                 { q: 0, r: 0 },
3892:                 { q: 1, r: 0 }, { q: 0, r: 1 }, { q: -1, r: 1 },
3893:                 { q: -1, r: 0 }, { q: 0, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: -1 },
3894:                 { q: 2, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: 1 }, { q: -1, r: 2 },
3895:                 { q: -2, r: 1 }, { q: -1, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: -2 }
3896:             ];
3897: 
3898:             return hexagons.some(hex => {
3899:                 const localPos = hexToPixel(hex.q, hex.r, s);
3900:                 const globalX = tile.x + localPos.x;
3901:                 const globalY = tile.y + localPos.y;
3902: 
3903:                 return placedStones.some(stone => {
3904:                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(stone.x - globalX, 2) + Math.pow(stone.y - globalY, 2));
3905:                     return dist < 5;
3906:                 });
3907:             });
3908:         }

3910:         // Check if any player is standing on a tile (by tile id)
3911:         function tileHasPlayersById(tileId) {
3912:             const tile = placedTiles.find(t => t.id === tileId);
3913:             if (!tile || typeof playerPositions === 'undefined') return false;
3914:             const tileRadius = TILE_SIZE * 4;
3915:             return playerPositions.some(pos => {
3916:                 if (!pos) return false;
3917:                 const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(pos.x - tile.x, 2) + Math.pow(pos.y - tile.y, 2));
3918:                 return dist < tileRadius;
3919:             });
3920:         }
3921: 
3922:         // Bridge check: would removing this tile leave any of its neighbors with 0 neighbors?
3923:         // Used by Telekinesis to prevent stranding tiles (and players on them).
3924:         function tileIsBridge(tileId) {
3925:             const tile = placedTiles.find(t => t.id === tileId);
3926:             if (!tile) return false;
3927:             const largeHexSize = TILE_SIZE * 4;
3928:             const tileHex = pixelToHex(tile.x, tile.y, largeHexSize);
3929:             const adjacentOffsets = [
3930:                 { q: 1, r: 0 }, { q: 0, r: 1 }, { q: -1, r: 1 },
3931:                 { q: -1, r: 0 }, { q: 0, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: -1 }
3932:             ];
3933: 
3934:             // Find all neighbors of this tile
3935:             const neighbors = [];
3936:             adjacentOffsets.forEach(offset => {
3937:                 const adjPos = hexToPixel(tileHex.q + offset.q, tileHex.r + offset.r, largeHexSize);
3938:                 const found = placedTiles.find(t => {
3939:                     if (t.id === tileId) return false; // exclude self
3940:                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(t.x - adjPos.x, 2) + Math.pow(t.y - adjPos.y, 2));
3941:                     return dist < TILE_SIZE;
3942:                 });
3943:                 if (found) neighbors.push(found);
3944:             });
3945: 
3946:             // For each neighbor, count how many neighbors IT would have without this tile
3947:             for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
3948:                 const nHex = pixelToHex(neighbor.x, neighbor.y, largeHexSize);
3949:                 let otherNeighborCount = 0;
3950:                 adjacentOffsets.forEach(offset => {
3951:                     const adjPos = hexToPixel(nHex.q + offset.q, nHex.r + offset.r, largeHexSize);
3952:                     const found = placedTiles.find(t => {
3953:                         if (t.id === tileId) return false; // exclude the tile being removed
3954:                         if (t.id === neighbor.id) return false; // exclude self
3955:                         const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(t.x - adjPos.x, 2) + Math.pow(t.y - adjPos.y, 2));
3956:                         return dist < TILE_SIZE;
3957:                     });
3958:                     if (found) otherNeighborCount++;
3959:                 });
3960:                 if (otherNeighborCount === 0) return true; // This neighbor would be stranded
3961:             }
3962:             return false;
3963:         }

4129:                 const tkBlockBridge = tkActive && tileIsBridge(tileId);
4130: 
4131:                 if (e.button === 0 && !tileHasStones(tileId) && !tkBlockPlayer && !tkBlockBridge && !isPanning && !isDraggingStone && !isDraggingPlayer) {
4132:                     console.log(`   ✓ Starting drag for tile ${tileId} at (${x.toFixed(1)}, ${y.toFixed(1)})`);
4133:                     e.stopPropagation();
4134:                     e.preventDefault();
4135:                     startTileDrag(tileId, e);
4136:                 } else {
4137:                     if (tkBlockPlayer) {
4138:                         console.log(`   ✗ Cannot drag: tile has a player on it`);
4139:                         updateStatus('Cannot move a tile with a player on it!');
4140:                     } else if (tkBlockBridge) {
4141:                         console.log(`   ✗ Cannot drag: removing tile would strand a neighbor`);
4142:                         updateStatus('Cannot move this tile — it would strand an adjacent tile!');
4143:                     } else {
4144:                         console.log(`   ✗ Cannot drag: hasStones=${tileHasStones(tileId)}, isPanning=${isPanning}, isDraggingStone=${isDraggingStone}`);
4145:                     }
4146:                 }
4147:             });
4148: 
4149:             // Touch support: start tile drag on tap/drag
4150:             tileGroup.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
4151:                 // Don't interfere with player dragging
4152:                 if (isDraggingPlayer) return;
4153:                 // Player tiles cannot be dragged once placed
4154:                 if (isPlayerTile) return;
4155:                 // Only allow dragging if tileMoveMode is enabled
4156:                 if (!tileMoveMode) return;
4157:                 if (tileHasStones(tileId) || isPanning || isDraggingStone || isDraggingPlayer) return;
4158:                 // During Telekinesis, block tiles that have players on them or are bridges
4159:                 if (window.telekinesisState && window.telekinesisState.active) {
4160:                     if (tileHasPlayersById(tileId) || tileIsBridge(tileId)) return;
4161:                 }
4162: 
4163:                 if (e.touches && e.touches.length === 1) {
4164:                     e.stopPropagation();
4165:                     e.preventDefault();
4166:                     const t = e.touches[0];
4167:                     startTileDrag(tileId, {
4168:                         clientX: t.clientX,
4169:                         clientY: t.clientY,
4170:                         button: 0,
4171:                         preventDefault: () => {},
4172:                         stopPropagation: () => {}
4173:                     });
4174:                 }
4175:             }, { passive: false });
4176: 
4177: 
4178:             viewport.insertBefore(tileGroup, snapIndicator);
4179: 
4180:             placedTiles.push({
4181:                 id: tileId,
4182:                 x: x,
4183:                 y: y,
4184:                 rotation: rotation,
4185:                 flipped: flipped,
4186:                 element: tileGroup,
4187:                 shrineType: shrineType,
4188:                 isPlayerTile: isPlayerTile,
4189:                 playerIndex: isPlayerTile ? tilePlayerIndex : null // Track which player owns this tile
4190:             });
4191: 
4192:             updateTileClasses();
4193: 
4194:             // Place player marker on player tile
4195:             if (isPlayerTile) {
4196:                 // Create new player pawn at this tile's position.
4197:                 // playerColor is always hex by this point (normalised above for both
4198:                 // multiplayer and local paths), so playerPositions stores hex values
4199:                 // and COLOR_RANK lookups in game-ui.js work correctly.
4200:                 placePlayer(x, y, playerColor);
4201: 
4202:                 // In multiplayer, ensure this player's pawn ends up at playerPositions[myPlayerIndex]
4203:                 // regardless of simultaneous placements by other players.  placePlayer() always
4204:                 // push()es to the end; if another player's broadcast arrived first, the index is wrong.
4205:                 if (isMultiplayer && !skipMultiplayerLogic &&
4206:                         myPlayerIndex !== null && myPlayerIndex !== undefined) {
4207:                     const placed = playerPositions.pop();
4208:                     if (placed) {
4209:                         placed.index = myPlayerIndex;
4210:                         while (playerPositions.length < myPlayerIndex) playerPositions.push(null);
4211:                         playerPositions[myPlayerIndex] = placed;
4212:                         console.log(`🔧 Relocated local pawn to playerPositions[${myPlayerIndex}]`);
4213:                     }
4214:                 }
4215: 
4216:                 // In multiplayer, broadcast tile placement and track placement phase
4217:                 // Skip this logic if we're just placing visually from a broadcast
4218:                 if (isMultiplayer && !skipMultiplayerLogic) {
4219:                     console.log(`🎮 Player ${tilePlayerIndex} placed tile. Before: activePlayerIndex=${activePlayerIndex}, placed=${Array.from(playerTilesPlaced)}`);
4220:                     playerTilesPlaced.add(tilePlayerIndex);
4221: 
4222:                     // Broadcast that this player placed their tile
4223:                     broadcastGameAction('player-tile-placed', {
4224:                         playerIndex: tilePlayerIndex
4225:                     });
4226: 
4227:                     // Check if all players have placed tiles
4228:                     if (playerTilesPlaced.size === totalPlayers) {
4229:                         isPlacementPhase = false;
4230:                         activePlayerIndex = 0; // Reset to first player for normal gameplay
4231:                         console.log('✅ All players have placed their tiles. Game begins!');
4232: 
4233:                         // Broadcast placement phase end and turn reset
4234:                         const startedAt = Date.now();
4235:                         turnStartedAtMs = startedAt;
4236:                         broadcastGameAction('placement-complete', {
4237:                             playerIndex: 0,
4238:                             turnStartedAt: startedAt
4239:                         });
4240: 
4241:                         if (isMyTurn()) {
4242:                             updateStatus(`All tiles placed! It's your turn!`);
4243:                         } else {
4244:                             const nextColorName = getPlayerColorName(activePlayerIndex);
4245:                             updateStatus(`All tiles placed! Waiting for ${nextColorName}'s turn...`);
4246:                         }
4247:                     } else {
4248:                         // Advance to next player in turn order
4249:                         const oldIndex = activePlayerIndex;
4250:                         activePlayerIndex = (activePlayerIndex + 1) % totalPlayers;
4251:                         console.log(`📄 Advancing turn: ${oldIndex} -> ${activePlayerIndex} (total: ${totalPlayers})`);
4252: 
4253:                         // Broadcast turn change during placement phase
4254:                         const startedAt = Date.now();
4255:                     turnStartedAtMs = startedAt;
4256:                     currentTurnNumber++;
4257:                     broadcastGameAction('turn-change', {
4258:                         playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
4259:                         turnStartedAt: startedAt,
4260:                         turnNumber: currentTurnNumber,
4261:                         revealedTiles: placedTiles.filter(t => !t.flipped && !t.isPlayerTile).map(t => ({ id: t.id, shrineType: t.shrineType }))
4262:                     });
4263:                         console.log(`📡 Broadcasted turn-change to player ${activePlayerIndex}`);
4264: 
4265:                         if (canPlaceTile()) {
4266:                             updateStatus(`Your turn! Place your player tile (${playerTilesPlaced.size}/${totalPlayers} placed)`);
4267:                         setInventoryOpen(true);
4268:                             console.log(`✅ My turn to place (myPlayerIndex=${myPlayerIndex})`);
4269:                         } else {
4270:                             const nextColorName = getPlayerColorName(activePlayerIndex);
4271:                             updateStatus(`Waiting for ${nextColorName} to place their tile... (${playerTilesPlaced.size}/${totalPlayers})`);
4272:                             console.log(`⏳ Waiting for player ${activePlayerIndex} (myPlayerIndex=${myPlayerIndex})`);
4273:                         }
4274:                     }
4275:                 } else {
4276:                     updateStatus(`Player ${tilePlayerIndex + 1} tile placed!`);
4277:                 }
4278: 
4279:                 // Tutorial hook: advance when the local player places their tile on the board
4280:                 if (!skipMultiplayerLogic &&
4281:                         window.isTutorialMode && window.TutorialMode?.onPlayerTilePlaced) {
4282:                     window.TutorialMode.onPlayerTilePlaced();
4283:                 }
4284:             }
4285: 
4286:             return tileId;
4287:         }

4289:         // Find the tile at a given world position
4290:         function findTileAtPosition(worldX, worldY) {
4291:             // A tile covers 19 hexes; use a large radius so clicking anywhere on the tile counts
4292:             // TILE_SIZE * 5.5 ensures the whole tile (including edges) is clickable
4293:             const tileRadius = TILE_SIZE * 5.5;
4294:             let closestTile = null;
4295:             let closestDist = Infinity;
4296: 
4297:             for (const tile of placedTiles) {
4298:                 if (tile.isPlayerTile) continue; // Skip player tiles
4299:                 const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(tile.x - worldX, 2) + Math.pow(tile.y - worldY, 2));
4300:                 if (dist < tileRadius && dist < closestDist) {
4301:                     closestTile = tile;
4302:                     closestDist = dist;
4303:                 }
4304:             }
4305:             return closestTile;
4306:         }
4307: 
4308:         // Handle board clicks when in selection mode (for scroll effects like tile swap/flip)
4309:         function handleSelectionModeClick(worldX, worldY) {
4310:             if (!spellSystem || !spellSystem.scrollEffects) return false;
4311:             const selectionMode = spellSystem.scrollEffects.selectionMode;
4312:             if (!selectionMode) return false;
4313: 
4314:             // Check if this is a stone selection mode (e.g., Water V - Control the Current)
4315:             if (selectionMode.handleStoneClick) {
4316:                 // Find the stone at the click position
4317:                 const stone = findStoneAtPosition(worldX, worldY);
4318:                 if (stone) {
4319:                     selectionMode.handleStoneClick(stone);
4320:                     return true; // Click was handled
4321:                 }
4322:                 return false; // No stone at click — don't consume the event, allow panning
4323:             }
4324: 
4325:             // Check if this is a hex selection mode (e.g., Excavate teleport — any hex, not just tile center)
4326:             if (selectionMode.handleHexClick) {
4327:                 const allHexes = getAllHexagonPositions();
4328:                 let closestHex = null;
4329:                 let minDist = Infinity;
4330:                 allHexes.forEach(hexPos => {
4331:                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(hexPos.x - worldX, 2) + Math.pow(hexPos.y - worldY, 2));
4332:                     if (dist < minDist) {
4333:                         minDist = dist;
4334:                         closestHex = hexPos;
4335:                     }
4336:                 });
4337:                 if (closestHex && minDist < TILE_SIZE * 1.5) {
4338:                     selectionMode.handleHexClick(closestHex);
4339:                 } else {
4340:                     updateStatus('No hex at that position.');
4341:                 }
4342:                 return true;
4343:             }
4344: 
4345:             // Check if this is a tile selection mode
4346:             if (selectionMode.handleTileClick) {
4347:                 // Find the tile at the click position
4348:                 const tile = findTileAtPosition(worldX, worldY);
4349:                 if (!tile) {
4350:                     updateStatus('No tile at that position.');
4351:                     return true; // Still consumed the click
4352:                 }
4353: 
4354:                 // Pass to selection mode handler
4355:                 selectionMode.handleTileClick(tile);
4356:             }
4357:             return true; // Click was handled
4358:         }
4359: 
4360:         // Find a stone at a world position
4361:         function findStoneAtPosition(worldX, worldY) {
4362:             if (typeof placedStones === 'undefined') return null;
4363: 
4364:             // Increased radius for more permissive stone clicking
4365:             const stoneRadius = typeof HEX_SIZE !== 'undefined' ? HEX_SIZE * 2.5 : 50;
4366:             let closestStone = null;
4367:             let closestDist = Infinity;
4368: 
4369:             for (const stone of placedStones) {
4370:                 const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(stone.x - worldX, 2) + Math.pow(stone.y - worldY, 2));
4371:                 if (dist < stoneRadius && dist < closestDist) {
4372:                     closestStone = stone;
4373:                     closestDist = dist;
4374:                 }
4375:             }
4376:             return closestStone;
4377:         }

4384:             earth:    { src: 'images/Tiles/pixelearth.png',    x: 0, y: 0,   rotation: 60,  scale: 1.05, opacity: 0.41, tintOpacity: 0.22 },
4385:             fire:     { src: 'images/Tiles/pixelfire.png',     x: 0, y: 0,   rotation: 0,   scale: 1.2,  opacity: 0.6,  tintOpacity: 0.22 },

4392:         const ELEMENT_TINTS = {
4393:             earth: '#4a8a2a', fire: '#cc2200', water: '#1a6ab5',
4394:             wind:  '#c8a800', void: '#6a30b0', catacomb: '#888888'
4395:         };
