4397:         function makeTileHexPoints(R) {
4398:             const pts = [];
4399:             for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
4400:                 const a = (Math.PI / 3) * i - Math.PI / 6;
4401:                 pts.push(`${(R * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(2)},${(R * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(2)}`);
4402:             }
4403:             return pts.join(' ');
4404:         }
4405: 
4406:         function addTileOverlay(tileGroup, shrineType) {
4407:             if (!shrineType || !window.tileOverlaySettings) return;
4408:             const settings = window.tileOverlaySettings[shrineType];
4409:             if (!settings || !settings.src) return;
4410: 
4411:             const tileId = tileGroup.getAttribute('data-tile-id');
4412:             const clipId = `tile-overlay-clip-${tileId}`;
4413:             const R = TILE_SIZE * 4.0; // 80 units — matches tile boundary for clean hex crop
4414: 
4415:             // Per-tile clipPath inside the tile group — coordinates are unambiguously tile-local
4416:             const defs = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'defs');
4417:             const clip = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'clipPath');
4418:             clip.setAttribute('id', clipId);
4419:             const clipHex = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'polygon');
4420:             clipHex.setAttribute('points', makeTileHexPoints(R));
4421:             clip.appendChild(clipHex);
4422:             defs.appendChild(clip);
4423:             tileGroup.appendChild(defs);
4424: 
4425:             // Wrapper: clip acts as a fixed hex viewport; image moves freely inside it
4426:             const wrapper = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
4427:             wrapper.setAttribute('class', 'tile-overlay');
4428:             wrapper.setAttribute('data-element', shrineType);
4429:             wrapper.setAttribute('clip-path', `url(#${clipId})`);
4430: 
4431:             // Elemental tint layer (colored hex fill behind the image)
4432:             if (ELEMENT_TINTS[shrineType]) {
4433:                 const tint = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'polygon');
4434:                 tint.setAttribute('points', makeTileHexPoints(R));
4435:                 tint.setAttribute('fill', ELEMENT_TINTS[shrineType]);
4436:                 tint.setAttribute('opacity', settings.tintOpacity ?? 0.22);
4437:                 tint.setAttribute('stroke', 'none');
4438:                 wrapper.appendChild(tint);
4439:             }
4440: 
4441:             // Image layer — freely transforms within the clipped viewport
4442:             const img = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'image');
4443:             img.setAttributeNS('http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink', 'href', settings.src);
4444:             img.setAttribute('href', settings.src);
4445:             img.setAttribute('x', -R);
4446:             img.setAttribute('y', -R);
4447:             img.setAttribute('width', R * 2);
4448:             img.setAttribute('height', R * 2);
4449:             img.setAttribute('preserveAspectRatio', 'xMidYMid slice');
4450:             img.setAttribute('opacity', settings.opacity);
4451:             img.setAttribute('transform',
4452:                 `translate(${settings.x},${settings.y}) rotate(${settings.rotation}) scale(${settings.scale})`);
4453: 
4454:             wrapper.appendChild(img);
4455:             tileGroup.appendChild(wrapper);
4456:         }

4458:         // Clone a tileGraphic group with fills removed — used to render hex lines on top of overlay
4459:         function createStrokeOnlyClone(tileGraphic) {
4460:             const clone = tileGraphic.cloneNode(true);
4461:             clone.setAttribute('class', 'tile-overlay-lines');
4462:             clone.querySelectorAll('polygon').forEach(p => {
4463:                 p.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
4464:                 p.style.fill = 'none';
4465:             });
4466:             return clone;
4467:         }

4469:         function refreshAllTileOverlays() {
4470:             document.querySelectorAll('.tile-overlay, .tile-overlay-lines').forEach(el => el.remove());
4471:             document.querySelectorAll('[id^="tile-overlay-clip-"]').forEach(el => el.closest('defs')?.remove());
4472:             if (typeof placedTiles !== 'undefined') {
4473:                 placedTiles.forEach(tile => {
4474:                     if (!tile.flipped && tile.shrineType && tile.element) {
4475:                         const shrineMarker = tile.element.querySelector('.shrine-marker');
4476:                         const tileGraphic = tile.element.querySelector('g[transform^="rotate"]');
4477:                         // addTileOverlay appends to end; move overlay before shrineMarker to get correct order:
4478:                         // tileGraphic → overlay → strokeClone → shrineMarker
4479:                         addTileOverlay(tile.element, tile.shrineType);
4480:                         const overlay = tile.element.querySelector('.tile-overlay');
4481:                         if (overlay && shrineMarker) tile.element.insertBefore(overlay, shrineMarker);
4482:                         if (tileGraphic) {
4483:                             const strokeClone = createStrokeOnlyClone(tileGraphic);
4484:                             tile.element.insertBefore(strokeClone, shrineMarker);
4485:                         }
4486:                     }
4487:                 });
4488:             }
4489:         }

4491:         window.addTileOverlay = addTileOverlay;

4493:         function revealTile(tileId, silent = false) {
4494:             const tile = placedTiles.find(t => t.id === tileId);
4495:             if (!tile || !tile.flipped) {
4496:                 console.log(`⚠️ revealTile called for tile ${tileId}, but tile is ${tile ? 'already revealed' : 'not found'}`);
4497:                 return; // Already revealed or doesn't exist
4498:             }
4499: 
4500:             console.log(`📡 Broadcasting tile flip: tileId=${tileId}, shrineType=${tile.shrineType}`);
4501:             // Broadcast tile flip to other players
4502:             broadcastGameAction('tile-flip', {
4503:                 tileId: tileId,
4504:                 shrineType: tile.shrineType
4505:             });
4506: 
4507:             // Tutorial pre-reveal hook: runs BEFORE the visual is built so the
4508:             // tutorial can override tile.shrineType and the visual + scroll both reflect it.
4509:             if (window.isTutorialMode && window.TutorialMode?.onTilePreReveal) {
4510:                 window.TutorialMode.onTilePreReveal(tile);
4511:             }
4512: 
4513:             // Remove the old tile element
4514:             tile.element.remove();
4515: 
4516:             // Create new revealed tile group
4517:             const tileGroup = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
4518:             tileGroup.setAttribute('class', 'placed-tile');
4519:             tileGroup.setAttribute('data-tile-id', tileId);
4520:             tileGroup.setAttribute('data-shrine', tile.shrineType);
4521:             tileGroup.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${tile.x}, ${tile.y})`);
4522: 
4523:             const tileGraphic = createTileGroup(TILE_SIZE, tile.rotation, false);
4524:             tileGroup.appendChild(tileGraphic);
4525: 
4526:             // Layer order: base fills → overlay image → hex lines → shrine symbol
4527:             addTileOverlay(tileGroup, tile.shrineType);
4528:             tileGroup.appendChild(createStrokeOnlyClone(tileGraphic));
4529:             const shrineMarker = createShrineMarker(tile.shrineType);
4530:             tileGroup.appendChild(shrineMarker);
4531: 
4532:             tileGroup.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
4533:                 if (!tileMoveMode) return;
4534:                 if (e.button === 0 && !tileHasStones(tileId) && !isPanning && !isDraggingStone) {
4535:                     e.stopPropagation();
4536:                     e.preventDefault();
4537:                     startTileDrag(tileId, e);
4538:                 }
4539:             });
4540: 
4541:             viewport.insertBefore(tileGroup, snapIndicator);
4542: 
4543:             // Update tile data
4544:             tile.flipped = false;
4545:             tile.element = tileGroup;
4546: 
4547:             // Tile reveal is irreversible — clear undo history
4548:             lastMove = null;
4549:             window.lastScrollAction = null;
4550: 
4551:             // Sound
4552:             if (!silent) window.SoundSystem?.play('tilereveal');
4553: 
4554:             // Catacomb tile reveal: refund 1 AP
4555:             const isCatacombReveal = tile.shrineType === 'catacomb';
4556:             if (isCatacombReveal) {
4557:                 console.log(`⚡ Catacomb tile revealed — refunding 1 AP`);
4558:                 addAP(1);
4559:             }
4560: 
4561:             // Tutorial hook: let tutorial pre-arrange the scroll deck before we draw
4562:             if (window.isTutorialMode && window.TutorialMode?.onTileRevealed) {
4563:                 window.TutorialMode.onTileRevealed(tile, spellSystem);
4564:             }
4565: 
4566:             // Scroll discovery: use effective element (Wandering River) so transformed tiles give the chosen element's scroll
4567:             const effectiveType = spellSystem.scrollEffects?.getEffectiveTileElement?.(tile) ?? tile.shrineType;
4568:             const scrollInfo = spellSystem.onTileRevealed(effectiveType);
4569: 
4570:             // Adaptive music: grow the Joytone playlist with this element's theme.
4571:             // Uses the raw shrineType (not effectiveType) because that's what the
4572:             // tile-flip broadcast carries — keeps the sequence identical on all clients.
4573:             window.JoytoneBridge?.onTileRevealed(tile.shrineType, tile.id);
4574: 
4575:             // Call to Adventure: immediately draw shrine stones when revealing a tile
4576:             const ctaBuff = spellSystem.scrollEffects?.activeBuffs?.callToAdventure;
4577:             const elementalTypes = ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void'];
4578:             let ctaDrawn = 0;
4579:             if (ctaBuff && ctaBuff.playerIndex === activePlayerIndex && elementalTypes.includes(effectiveType)) {
4580:                 const STONE_RANK = { 'void': 1, 'wind': 2, 'fire': 3, 'water': 4, 'earth': 5 };
4581:                 const amount = STONE_RANK[effectiveType] || 0;
4582:                 ctaDrawn = spellSystem.scrollEffects.drawStonesToPool(effectiveType, amount, activePlayerIndex);
4583:                 if (ctaDrawn > 0) {
4584:                     syncPlayerState();
4585:                     console.log(`🗺️ Call to Adventure: drew ${ctaDrawn} ${effectiveType} stones on tile reveal`);
4586:                 }
4587:             }
4588: 
4589:             const apBonus = isCatacombReveal ? ' +1 AP!' : '';
4590:             if (scrollInfo && ctaDrawn > 0) {
4591:                 updateStatus(`Revealed ${effectiveType} shrine! Found ${scrollInfo.name}! Call to Adventure: +${ctaDrawn} ${effectiveType} stone${ctaDrawn > 1 ? 's' : ''}!${apBonus}`);
4592:             } else if (scrollInfo) {
4593:                 updateStatus(`Revealed ${effectiveType} shrine! Found ${scrollInfo.name}!${apBonus}`);
4594:             } else if (ctaDrawn > 0) {
4595:                 updateStatus(`Revealed ${effectiveType} shrine! Call to Adventure: +${ctaDrawn} ${effectiveType} stone${ctaDrawn > 1 ? 's' : ''}!${apBonus}`);
4596:             } else {
4597:                 updateStatus(`Revealed ${effectiveType} shrine!${apBonus}`);
4598:             }
4599: 
4600:             // Re-apply Wandering River indicator on the new element (reveal replaced tile.element)
4601:             const wr = spellSystem.scrollEffects?.activeBuffs?.wanderingRiver;
4602:             if (Array.isArray(wr)) {
4603:                 const entry = wr.find(e => Number(e.tileId) === Number(tile.id));
4604:                 if (entry && entry.newElement && typeof spellSystem.scrollEffects.applyWanderingRiverIndicator === 'function') {
4605:                     spellSystem.scrollEffects.applyWanderingRiverIndicator(tile, entry.newElement);
4606:                 }
4607:             }
4608:         }
4609:

4789:         // Finalize a pawn move based on the currently drawn playerPath (used by touch + mouse).
4790:         function movePlayerAlongPath() {
4791:             if (!isDraggingPlayer || !ghostPlayer || playerPath.length < 2) return;
4792: 
4793:             const activePlayer = playerPositions[activePlayerIndex];
4794:             if (!activePlayer) return;
4795: 
4796:             const finalPos = playerPath[playerPath.length - 1];
4797: 
4798:             // Basic legality check for destination (revealed/unrevealed rules are enforced in canPlayerMoveToHex)
4799:             const canMoveCheck = canPlayerMoveToHex(finalPos.x, finalPos.y, true);
4800:             if (!canMoveCheck.canMove) {
4801:                 console.log(`❌ Invalid move end: ${canMoveCheck.reason || 'cannot move there'}`);
4802:                 // cleanup happens below
4803:             } else {
4804:                 // Total cost for the selected path (Steam Vents discount applied inside)
4805:                 const totalCost = calculatePathCost();
4806: 
4807:                 // Make sure player has enough AP
4808:                 const availableAP = getCurrentAP ? getCurrentAP() : currentAP;
4809:                 if (totalCost > availableAP) {
4810:                     console.log(`❌ Not enough AP: need ${totalCost}, have ${availableAP}`);
4811:                 } else {
4812:                     // Update Steam Vents alternation state before spending AP
4813:                     commitSteamVentsState(playerPath);
4814:                     // Spend AP and apply the move
4815:                     if (typeof spendAP === 'function') spendAP(totalCost);
4816: 
4817:                     // Move pawn visually + state
4818:                     activePlayer.x = finalPos.x;
4819:                     activePlayer.y = finalPos.y;
4820:                     activePlayer.element.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${finalPos.x}, ${finalPos.y})`);
4821:                     if (ghostPlayer) ghostPlayer.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${finalPos.x}, ${finalPos.y})`);
4822: 
4823:                     console.log(`✅ Movement successful: ${playerPath.length - 1} hexes, cost ${totalCost} AP`);
4824: 
4825:                     // Record activity + broadcast movement (multiplayer)
4826:                     try {
4827:                         recordActivity && recordActivity('move', { x: finalPos.x, y: finalPos.y, apSpent: totalCost });
4828:                     } catch (e) {}
4829: 
4830:                     if (typeof broadcastPlayerMovement === 'function' && !isSpectator) {
4831:                         try {
4832:                             broadcastPlayerMovement(activePlayerIndex, finalPos.x, finalPos.y, totalCost);
4833:                         } catch (e) {}
4834:                     }
4835: 
4836:                     // Tile reveal / shrine resolution (reuse existing landing handler if present)
4837:                     try {
4838:                         if (typeof handlePlayerLanding === 'function') {
4839:                             handlePlayerLanding(finalPos.x, finalPos.y);
4840:                         } else if (typeof checkTileRevealsAtPosition === 'function') {
4841:                             checkTileRevealsAtPosition(finalPos.x, finalPos.y);
4842:                         }
4843:                     } catch (e) {
4844:                         console.warn('Landing/reveal handler error:', e);
4845:                     }
4846:                 }
4847:             }
4848: 
4849:             // Cleanup (match mouseup behavior)
4850:             isDraggingPlayer = false;
4851:             clearPlayerPath();
4852:             if (ghostPlayer) {
4853:                 ghostPlayer.remove();
4854:                 ghostPlayer = null;
4855:             }
4856:         }

5084:         function placePlayerTileVisually(x, y, playerIndex, colorName, cosmetics) {
5085:             // Normalize to hex so COLOR_RANK lookups never get a string name like 'purple'
5086:             const hexColor = colorName?.startsWith('#') ? colorName : (PLAYER_COLORS[colorName] || colorName);
5087:             console.log(`📄 Placing other player's tile: player ${playerIndex}, color ${hexColor}, at (${x.toFixed(1)}, ${y.toFixed(1)})`);
5088: 
5089:             // Temporarily set playerColor to the other player's color
5090:             const originalColor = playerColor;
5091:             playerColor = hexColor;
5092: 
5093:             // Place the player tile - skip multiplayer logic since this is visual-only
5094:             placeTile(x, y, 0, false, 'player', true, true);
5095: 
5096:             // Relocate the newly pushed pawn from the end of playerPositions to the
5097:             // correct slot.  placeTile → placePlayer always push()es, so simultaneous
5098:             // local placement means index .length is wrong.
5099:             const placed = playerPositions.pop();
5100:             if (placed) {
5101:                 placed.index = playerIndex;
5102:                 while (playerPositions.length < playerIndex) playerPositions.push(null);
5103:                 playerPositions[playerIndex] = placed;
5104:                 console.log(`🔧 Relocated remote pawn to playerPositions[${playerIndex}]`);
5105:             }
5106: 
5107:             // Fix placedTiles entry — placeTile captured playerPositions.length (wrong for
5108:             // remote tiles); patch it to the correct playerIndex so tooltips are right.
5109:             const lastTile = placedTiles[placedTiles.length - 1];
5110:             if (lastTile && lastTile.isPlayerTile) {
5111:                 lastTile.playerIndex = playerIndex;
5112:             }
5113: 
5114:             // Restore our color
5115:             playerColor = originalColor;
5116: 
5117:             console.log(`✅ Other player's tile placed successfully (visual only)`);
5118:         }

5270:         // Update turn timer display (shared by everyone; enforced by host)
5271:         function updateTimerDisplay() {
5272:             const timerElement = document.getElementById('inactivity-timer');
5273:             const hudTimer = document.getElementById('hud-timer');
5274:             const hudTimerValue = document.getElementById('hud-timer-value');
5275: 
5276:             if (!gameInactivityTimeout || gameInactivityTimeout === 0) {
5277:                 if (timerElement) timerElement.style.display = 'none';
5278:                 if (hudTimer) hudTimer.style.display = 'none';
5279:                 return;
5280:             }
5281: 
5282:             // Only show timer when it's my turn (during placement phase, this means "canPlaceTile()")
5283:             const isMyActiveTurn = isPlacementPhase ? canPlaceTile() : isMyTurn();
5284:             if (!isMyActiveTurn) {
5285:                 if (timerElement) timerElement.style.display = 'none';
5286:                 // Keep HUD timer visible but show waiting state
5287:                 if (hudTimerValue) hudTimerValue.textContent = '--:--';
5288:                 if (hudTimer) hudTimer.classList.remove('warning');
5289:                 return;
5290:             }
5291: 
5292:             const now = Date.now();
5293:             const elapsed = now - (turnStartedAtMs || now);
5294:             const timeRemaining = gameInactivityTimeout - elapsed;
5295: 
5296:             if (timeRemaining <= 0) {
5297:                 if (timerElement) timerElement.style.display = 'none';
5298:                 if (hudTimerValue) hudTimerValue.textContent = '0:00';
5299:                 return;
5300:             }
5301: 
5302:             // Show timer
5303:             if (timerElement) timerElement.style.display = 'inline-block';
5304: 
5305:             // Calculate percentage remaining
5306:             const percentRemaining = (timeRemaining / gameInactivityTimeout) * 100;
5307: 
5308:             // Format time
5309:             const secondsRemaining = Math.ceil(timeRemaining / 1000);
5310:             const minutes = Math.floor(secondsRemaining / 60);
5311:             const seconds = secondsRemaining % 60;
5312:             const timeText = minutes > 0 ? `${minutes}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}` : `${seconds}s`;
5313: 
5314:             // Update HUD timer
5315:             if (hudTimerValue) hudTimerValue.textContent = timeText;
5316:             if (hudTimer) {
5317:                 if (percentRemaining <= 25) {
5318:                     hudTimer.classList.add('warning');
5319:                 } else {
5320:                     hudTimer.classList.remove('warning');
5321:                 }
5322:             }
5323: 
5324:             // Color-code old timer based on time remaining
5325:             let color, bgColor, label;
5326:             if (percentRemaining > 75) {
5327:                 color = '#fff';
5328:                 bgColor = '#4CAF50';
5329:                 label = '⚠️';
5330:             } else if (percentRemaining > 50) {
5331:                 color = '#000';
5332:                 bgColor = '#FFEB3B';
5333:                 label = '⚠️';
5334:             } else if (percentRemaining > 25) {
5335:                 color = '#fff';
5336:                 bgColor = '#FF9800';
5337:                 label = '⚠️';
5338:             } else {
5339:                 color = '#fff';
5340:                 bgColor = '#f44336';
5341:                 label = '💎';
5342:             }
5343: 
5344:             if (timerElement) {
5345:                 timerElement.style.backgroundColor = bgColor;
5346:                 timerElement.style.color = color;
5347:                 timerElement.textContent = `${label} ${timeText}`;
5348:             }
5349:         }

5375:         // Turn timeout enforcement (host only)
5376:         async function checkTurnTimeout() {
5377:             if (!isMultiplayer) return;
5378:             if (!isHost) return;
5379:             if (!gameInactivityTimeout || gameInactivityTimeout === 0) return; // disabled
5380: 
5381:             // Only enforce during active game
5382:             const { data: room, error: roomErr } = await supabase
5383:                 .from('game_room')
5384:                 .select('status')
5385:                 .eq('id', currentGameId)
5386:                 .single();
5387: 
5388:             if (roomErr) {
5389:                 console.warn('⚠️ Turn timeout: failed to read room status', roomErr);
5390:                 return;
5391:             }
5392: 
5393:             if (!room || room.status !== 'playing') return;
5394: 
5395:             const now = Date.now();
5396:             const elapsed = now - (turnStartedAtMs || now);
5397:             if (elapsed < gameInactivityTimeout) return;
5398: 
5399:             // Time is up — either kick active player or auto-advance
5400:             console.log('⏰ Turn timer expired. kickOnTurnTimeout:', kickOnTurnTimeout, 'activePlayerIndex:', activePlayerIndex, 'isPlacementPhase:', isPlacementPhase);
5401: 
5402:             // SPECIAL CASE: During placement phase, timeout should kick all players back to lobby
5403:             if (isPlacementPhase) {
5404:                 console.log('⏰ Turn timeout during placement phase — resetting game to lobby');
5405:                 updateStatus('⏰ Player tile placement timed out — returning all players to lobby');
5406: 
5407:                 // First, kick the AFK player from the lobby
5408:                 const { data: allPlayers } = await supabase
5409:                     .from('players')
5410:                     .select('id, username, player_index');
5411: 
5412:                 const afkPlayer = allPlayers?.find(p => p.player_index === activePlayerIndex);
5413: 
5414:                 if (afkPlayer) {
5415:                     console.log(`👢 Kicking AFK player: ${afkPlayer.username} (index ${afkPlayer.player_index})`);
5416:                     const { error: kickErr } = await supabase
5417:                         .from('players')
5418:                         .delete()
5419:                         .eq('id', afkPlayer.id);
5420: 
5421:                     if (kickErr) {
5422:                         console.error('❌ Failed to kick AFK player:', kickErr);
5423:                     } else {
5424:                         console.log(`✅ AFK player ${afkPlayer.username} removed from lobby`);
5425:                     }
5426:                 }
5427: 
5428:                 // Reset game room to waiting status
5429:                 const { error: resetErr } = await supabase
5430:                     .from('game_room')
5431:                     .update({ status: 'waiting' })
5432:                     .eq('id', currentGameId);
5433: 
5434:                 if (resetErr) {
5435:                     console.error('❌ Failed to reset game room:', resetErr);
5436:                 }
5437: 
5438:                 // Wait a moment for DELETE event to propagate to all clients
5439:                 await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
5440: 
5441:                 // Broadcast game-reset event to all players
5442:                 if (typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
5443:                     broadcastGameAction('game-reset', {
5444:                         reason: 'placement-timeout',
5445:                         kickedPlayerIndex: activePlayerIndex
5446:                     });
5447:                 }
5448: 
5449:                 // Reset local game state (host)
5450:                 if (typeof resetToLobby === 'function') {
5451:                     resetToLobby();
5452:                 }
5453:                 return;
5454:             }
5455: 
5456:             // SPECIAL CASE: If the active player has an unresolved scroll cascade, they forfeit.
5457:             // (They must place the overflowing scroll before ending their turn; if time runs out, they lose.)
5458:             const hasCascade = typeof spellSystem !== 'undefined' && spellSystem.hasPendingCascade(activePlayerIndex);
5459:             if (hasCascade) {
5460:                 const forfeiterName = typeof getPlayerColorName === 'function'
5461:                     ? getPlayerColorName(activePlayerIndex) : `Player ${activePlayerIndex + 1}`;
5462:                 console.log(`⏰ Cascade forfeit: ${forfeiterName} ran out of time with unresolved cascade`);
5463:                 updateStatus(`⏰ ${forfeiterName} ran out of time with an unresolved scroll cascade — forfeiting!`);
5464:                 if (typeof broadcastGameAction === 'function') {
5465:                     broadcastGameAction('cascade-forfeit', { playerIndex: activePlayerIndex });
5466:                 }
5467:                 // Remove the forfeiting player from the game (same as kick path)
5468:                 const { data: forfeitPlayers } = await supabase
5469:                     .from('players')
5470:                     .select('id, username, player_index')
5471:                     .eq('game_id', currentGameId);
5472:                 const forfeitPlayer = forfeitPlayers?.find(p => p.player_index === activePlayerIndex);
5473:                 if (forfeitPlayer) {
5474:                     await supabase.rpc('remove_player', { p_player_id: forfeitPlayer.id });
5475:                 }
5476:                 await hostAdvanceToNextPlayerAndRestartTimer();
5477:                 return;
5478:             }
5479: 
5480:             // NORMAL GAME PHASE: Use existing kick/auto-advance logic
5481:             if (kickOnTurnTimeout) {
5482:                 // Kick active player
5483:                 const { data: allPlayers } = await supabase
5484:                     .from('players')
5485:                     .select('id, username, player_index')
5486:                     .eq('game_id', currentGameId);
5487: 
5488:                 const activePlayer = allPlayers?.find(p => p.player_index === activePlayerIndex);
5489: 
5490:                 if (activePlayer) {
5491:                     const { error: kickErr } = await supabase
5492:                         .rpc('remove_player', { p_player_id: activePlayer.id });
5493: 
5494:                     if (kickErr) {
5495:                         console.error('❌ Failed to kick player (turn timeout):', kickErr);
5496:                         return;
5497:                     }
5498: 
5499:                     updateStatus(`⏰ ${activePlayer.username} was kicked (turn timer expired)`);
5500:                 } else {
5501:                     console.warn('⚠️ Turn timeout expired but active player not found in DB');
5502:                 }
5503:             } else {
5504:                 updateStatus('⏰ Turn timer expired — auto-passing turn.');
5505:             }
5506: 
5507:             // Advance to next available player and restart the timer
5508:             await hostAdvanceToNextPlayerAndRestartTimer();
5509:         }
5510: 
5511:         async function hostAdvanceToNextPlayerAndRestartTimer() {
5512:             // Fetch remaining players and choose the next index based on player_index ordering
5513:             const { data: remainingPlayers, error } = await supabase
5514:                 .from('players')
5515:                 .select('player_index')
5516:                 .eq('game_id', currentGameId)
5517:                 .order('player_index', { ascending: true });
5518: 
5519:             if (error) {
5520:                 console.error('❌ Failed to read players to advance turn:', error);
5521:                 return;
5522:             }
5523: 
5524:             const indices = (remainingPlayers || [])
5525:                 .map(p => p.player_index)
5526:                 .filter(i => i !== null && i !== undefined)
5527:                 .sort((a, b) => a - b);
5528: 
5529:             if (indices.length === 0) return;
5530: 
5531:             // Last player standing — they win
5532:             if (indices.length === 1 && typeof handleGameOver === 'function') {
5533:                 console.log('🏆 Last player standing after kick/forfeit:', indices[0]);
5534:                 await handleGameOver(indices[0], 'last_standing');
5535:                 return;
5536:             }
5537: 
5538:             // Find next index after current; wrap around
5539:             let nextIndex = indices.find(i => i > activePlayerIndex);
5540:             if (nextIndex === undefined) nextIndex = indices[0];
5541: 
5542:             activePlayerIndex = nextIndex;
5543: 
5544:             // Restart timer anchored to host time
5545:             const started = Date.now();
5546:             turnStartedAtMs = started;
5547:             currentTurnNumber++;
5548: 
5549:             // Broadcast turn change with shared turn start timestamp and turn number
5550:             broadcastGameAction('turn-change', {
5551:                 playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
5552:                 turnStartedAt: started,
5553:                 turnNumber: currentTurnNumber,
5554:                 revealedTiles: placedTiles.filter(t => !t.flipped && !t.isPlayerTile).map(t => ({ id: t.id, shrineType: t.shrineType }))
5555:             });
5556: 
5557:             // Update local display as host
5558:             if (isPlacementPhase) {
5559:                 // During placement phase, turn display is handled in the turn-change receiver
5560:             } else {
5561:                 updateTurnDisplay();
5562:             }
5563:         }

5569:

5571:             if (!turnStartedAtMs) turnStartedAtMs = Date.now();
5572:

5608:

5630:         // Sync current player state (AP and resources) in multiplayer
5631:         function syncPlayerState() {
5632:             if (!isMultiplayer) return;
5633: 
5634:             // Record activity
5635:             recordActivity();
5636: 
5637:             // Use global currentAP/voidAP only when we ARE the active player;
5638:             // otherwise fall back to last-known stored values for that player.
5639:             const isMyTurn = (myPlayerIndex === activePlayerIndex);
5640:             const apToSend = isMyTurn ? currentAP : (playerAPs[activePlayerIndex]?.currentAP ?? 5);
5641:             const voidApToSend = isMyTurn ? voidAP : (playerAPs[activePlayerIndex]?.voidAP ?? 0);
5642: 
5643:             // Update local tracking
5644:             if (!playerAPs[activePlayerIndex]) {
5645:                 playerAPs[activePlayerIndex] = { currentAP: 5, voidAP: 0 };
5646:             }
5647:             if (isMyTurn) {
5648:                 playerAPs[activePlayerIndex].currentAP = currentAP;
5649:                 playerAPs[activePlayerIndex].voidAP = voidAP;
5650:             }
5651: 
5652:             // Only broadcast resources when it's our own turn.
5653:             // When it's not our turn, we must not broadcast the other player's
5654:             // resource pool — we may have modified it locally (e.g. during
5655:             // processPsychicPending), and broadcasting those values would cause
5656:             // the active player's client to double-apply pool changes (e.g.
5657:             // Respirate drawing wind stones twice).
5658:             const activeResources = isMyTurn
5659:                 ? (playerPools[activePlayerIndex] || { ...INITIAL_PLAYER_STONES })
5660:                 : null;
5661:             broadcastGameAction('player-state-update', {
5662:                 playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
5663:                 currentAP: apToSend,
5664:                 voidAP: voidApToSend,
5665:                 resources: activeResources
5666:             });
5667:         }

5669:         // Show tooltip with player's AP and resources
5670:         function updatePlayerElementSymbols(playerIndex = null) {
5671:             // If no player index specified, use active player
5672:             if (playerIndex === null) {
5673:                 playerIndex = activePlayerIndex;
5674:             }
5675:             
5676:             // Find THIS player's tile
5677:             const playerTile = placedTiles.find(t => t.isPlayerTile && t.playerIndex === playerIndex);
5678:             if (!playerTile) {
5679:                 console.log(`No player tile found for player ${playerIndex}`);
5680:                 return;
5681:             }
5682: 
5683:             const symbolsGroup = playerTile.element.querySelector('.player-tile-element-symbols');
5684:             if (!symbolsGroup) return;
5685: 
5686:             // Clear existing symbols
5687:             symbolsGroup.innerHTML = '';
5688: 
5689:             // Get activated elements for THIS specific player
5690:             const playerScrollData = spellSystem.playerScrolls[playerIndex];
5691:             if (!playerScrollData) return;
5692:             
5693:             const activatedElements = Array.from(playerScrollData.activated);
5694:             
5695:             if (activatedElements.length === 0) return;
5696: 
5697:             // Arrange symbols in a tight pentagon pattern inside the tile's center hex
5698:             // Keep radius well within TILE_SIZE (20) so symbols never bleed outside the tile
5699:             const radius = TILE_SIZE * 0.75; // ~15 units — inside the center hex (r=20)
5700:             const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / 5;
5701:             const elementOrder = ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void'];
5702: 
5703:             activatedElements.forEach(element => {
5704:                 const index = elementOrder.indexOf(element);
5705:                 const angle = angleStep * index - Math.PI / 2; // Start at top
5706:                 const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
5707:                 const y = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
5708: 
5709:                 // Outline ring so the pip is visible against any background
5710:                 const symbolBg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
5711:                 symbolBg.setAttribute('cx', x);

5794:         // Find if target is reachable through a chain of wind stones/water-with-wind
5795:         function findWindPath(startX, startY, targetX, targetY) {
5796:             // BFS to find path through wind stones
5797:             const queue = [{x: startX, y: startY, path: []}];
5798:             const visited = new Set();
5799:             visited.add(`${startX.toFixed(1)},${startY.toFixed(1)}`);
5800: 
5801:             while (queue.length > 0) {
5802:                 const current = queue.shift();
5803: 
5804:                 // Get all wind stones and water-with-wind adjacent to current position
5805:                 const windStones = getAdjacentWindStones(current.x, current.y);
5806: 
5807:                 // Also check water with chained wind
5808:                 const neighbors = getNeighborStones(current.x, current.y);
5809:                 const waterWithWind = neighbors.filter(n => {
5810:                     if (n.type !== 'water') return false;
5811:                     const chainedAbility = getChainedAbility(n.x, n.y);
5812:                     return chainedAbility === 'wind';
5813:                 });
5814: 
5815:                 const allWindSources = [...windStones, ...waterWithWind];
5816: 
5817:                 for (const windSource of allWindSources) {
5818:                     const key = `${windSource.x.toFixed(1)},${windSource.y.toFixed(1)}`;
5819: 
5820:                     // Skip if nullified by void
5821:                     const hasVoid = hasAdjacentStoneType(windSource.x, windSource.y, 'void');
5822:                     if (hasVoid) continue;
5823: 
5824:                     // Check if target is adjacent to this wind source
5825:                     const windNeighbors = getNeighborHexPositions(windSource.x, windSource.y);
5826:                     const canReachTarget = windNeighbors.some(n =>
5827:                         Math.sqrt(Math.pow(n.x - targetX, 2) + Math.pow(n.y - targetY, 2)) < 5
5828:                     );
5829: 
5830:                     if (canReachTarget) {
5831:                         // Found a path!
5832:                         return [...current.path, windSource];
5833:                     }
5834: 
5835:                     // Continue searching through this wind source
5836:                     if (!visited.has(key)) {
5837:                         visited.add(key);
5838:                         queue.push({
5839:                             x: windSource.x,
5840:                             y: windSource.y,
5841:                             path: [...current.path, windSource]
5842:                         });
5843:                     }
5844:                 }
5845:             }
5846: 
5847:             return null; // No path found
5848:         }

5850:         function findGeneralPath(startX, startY, targetX, targetY, maxCost) {
5851:             // A* pathfinding to find cheapest path through any hex
5852:             const openSet = [{x: startX, y: startY, path: [], cost: 0, priority: 0}];
5853:             const visited = new Map();
5854: 
5855:             while (openSet.length > 0) {
5856:                 // Get node with lowest priority (cost + heuristic)
5857:                 openSet.sort((a, b) => a.priority - b.priority);
5858:                 const current = openSet.shift();
5859: 
5860:                 const key = `${current.x.toFixed(1)},${current.y.toFixed(1)}`;
5861: 
5862:                 // Skip if we've visited this with lower cost
5863:                 if (visited.has(key) && visited.get(key) <= current.cost) continue;
5864:                 visited.set(key, current.cost);
5865: 
5866:                 // Check if we reached the target
5867:                 const distToTarget = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(current.x - targetX, 2) + Math.pow(current.y - targetY, 2));
5868:                 if (distToTarget < 5) {
5869:                     return { path: current.path, cost: current.cost };
5870:                 }
5871: 
5872:                 // Explore neighbors
5873:                 const neighbors = getNeighborHexPositions(current.x, current.y);
5874:                 for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
5875:                     const moveCheck = canPlayerMoveToHex(neighbor.x, neighbor.y);
5876: 
5877:                     if (moveCheck.canMove) {
5878:                         const newCost = current.cost + moveCheck.cost;
5879: 
5880:                         // Skip if would exceed max cost
5881:                         if (newCost > maxCost) continue;
5882: 
5883:                         const neighborKey = `${neighbor.x.toFixed(1)},${neighbor.y.toFixed(1)}`;
5884: 
5885:                         // Skip if already visited with lower cost
5886:                         if (visited.has(neighborKey) && visited.get(neighborKey) <= newCost) continue;
5887: 
5888:                         // Calculate heuristic (straight-line distance to target)
5889:                         const heuristic = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(neighbor.x - targetX, 2) + Math.pow(neighbor.y - targetY, 2)) / TILE_SIZE;
5890: 
5891:                         openSet.push({
5892:                             x: neighbor.x,
5893:                             y: neighbor.y,
5894:                             path: [...current.path, {x: neighbor.x, y: neighbor.y, cost: moveCheck.cost}],
5895:                             cost: newCost,
5896:                             priority: newCost + heuristic
5897:                         });
5898:                     }
5899:                 }
5900:             }
5901: 
5902:             return null; // No path found
5903:         }

5905:         function getAdjacentWindStones(x, y) {
5906:             const neighbors = getNeighborHexPositions(x, y);
5907:             const windStones = [];
5908: 
5909:             neighbors.forEach(neighborPos => {
5910:                 const stone = placedStones.find(s => {
5911:                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(s.x - neighborPos.x, 2) + Math.pow(s.y - neighborPos.y, 2));
5912:                     if (dist >= 5) return false;
5913: 
5914:                     // Check if it's wind or water mimicking wind
5915:                     const effectiveType = getEffectiveStoneType(s);
5916:                     return effectiveType === 'wind';
5917:                 });
5918:                 if (stone) {
5919:                     windStones.push(stone);
5920:                 }
5921:             });
5922: 
5923:             return windStones;
5924:         }

5926:         function getAdjacentEarthStones(x, y) {
5927:             const neighbors = getNeighborHexPositions(x, y);
5928:             const earthStones = [];
5929: 
5930:             neighbors.forEach(neighborPos => {
5931:                 const stone = placedStones.find(s => {
5932:                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(s.x - neighborPos.x, 2) + Math.pow(s.y - neighborPos.y, 2));
5933:                     if (dist >= 5) return false;
5934: 
5935:                     // Check if it's earth or water mimicking earth
5936:                     const effectiveType = getEffectiveStoneType(s);
5937:                     return effectiveType === 'earth';
5938:                 });
5939:                 if (stone) {
5940:                     earthStones.push(stone);
5941:                 }
5942:             });
5943: 
5944:             return earthStones;
5945:         }
5946: 
5947:         // Get the chained ability for a water stone by flood-filling through connected water
5948:         function getChainedAbility(x, y) {
5949:             // Only water stones can receive chained abilities
5950:             const stone = placedStones.find(s => {
5951:                 const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(s.x - x, 2) + Math.pow(s.y - y, 2));
5952:                 return dist < 5;
5953:             });
5954: 
5955:             if (!stone || stone.type !== 'water') {
5956:                 return null; // Not a water stone
5957:             }
5958: 
5959:             // Check if THIS water stone is nullified by void
5960:             const waterNullified = hasAdjacentStoneType(x, y, 'void');
5961:             if (waterNullified) {
5962:                 return null; // Water's chaining ability is nullified by adjacent void
5963:             }
5964: 
5965:             // Flood fill through connected water to find wind/earth sources
5966:             const visited = new Set();
5967:             const queue = [{x, y}];
5968:             visited.add(`${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`);
5969: 
5970:             let hasWind = false;
5971:             let hasEarth = false;
5972: 
5973:             while (queue.length > 0) {
5974:                 const current = queue.shift();
5975:                 const neighbors = getNeighborStones(current.x, current.y);
5976: 
5977:                 for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
5978:                     const key = `${neighbor.x.toFixed(1)},${neighbor.y.toFixed(1)}`;
5979: 
5980:                     // Check if this neighbor is a source stone (wind or earth, not nullified by void)
5981:                     if (neighbor.type === 'wind') {
5982:                         const voidNullified = hasAdjacentStoneType(neighbor.x, neighbor.y, 'void');
5983:                         if (!voidNullified) {
5984:                             hasWind = true;
5985:                         }
5986:                     } else if (neighbor.type === 'earth') {
5987:                         const voidNullified = hasAdjacentStoneType(neighbor.x, neighbor.y, 'void');
5988:                         if (!voidNullified) {
5989:                             hasEarth = true;
5990:                         }
5991:                     }
5992: 
5993:                     // If neighbor is water and not visited, add to queue to continue flood fill
5994:                     if (neighbor.type === 'water' && !visited.has(key)) {
5995:                         // Check if this water is nullified by void
5996:                         const neighborWaterNullified = hasAdjacentStoneType(neighbor.x, neighbor.y, 'void');
5997:                         if (!neighborWaterNullified) {
5998:                             visited.add(key);
5999:                             queue.push({x: neighbor.x, y: neighbor.y});
6000:                         }
6001:                     }
6002:                 }
6003:             }
6004: 
6005:             // Wind outranks earth
6006:             if (hasWind) return 'wind';
6007:             if (hasEarth) return 'earth';
6008:             return null; // No chained ability
6009:         }

6011:         function updatePlayerPath(x, y) {
6012:             const targetPos = findNearestHexPosition(x, y);
6013:             if (!targetPos.valid) return;
6014: 
6015:             const startPos = playerPath[0];
6016:             if (!startPos) return;
6017: 
6018:             const targetKey = `${Math.round(targetPos.x)},${Math.round(targetPos.y)}`;
6019: 
6020:             // No-op if cursor hasn't moved to a different hex
6021:             if (targetKey === lastAttemptedHex) return;
6022:             lastAttemptedHex = targetKey;
6023: 
6024:             // Cursor on start hex → reset path to just the origin
6025:             if (Math.hypot(targetPos.x - startPos.x, targetPos.y - startPos.y) < 5) {
6026:                 playerPath = [{ x: startPos.x, y: startPos.y, cost: 0 }];
6027:                 _applyPathToLine();
6028:                 updatePathLabels();
6029:                 return;
6030:             }
6031: 
6032:             // Cursor is on an existing path node → backtrack to that point
6033:             for (let i = playerPath.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
6034:                 if (Math.hypot(playerPath[i].x - targetPos.x, playerPath[i].y - targetPos.y) < 5) {
6035:                     playerPath = playerPath.slice(0, i + 1);
6036:                     _applyPathToLine();
6037:                     updatePathLabels();
6038:                     return;
6039:                 }
6040:             }
6041: 
6042:             // Cursor is already at the end of the path → nothing to do
6043:             const lastPos = playerPath[playerPath.length - 1];
6044:             if (Math.hypot(lastPos.x - targetPos.x, lastPos.y - targetPos.y) < 5) return;
6045: 
6046:             // Find the shortest affordable path from start to the cursor hex using Dijkstra
6047:             const newPath = _dijkstraPath(startPos, targetPos);
6048:             if (newPath) playerPath = newPath;
6049: 
6050:             _applyPathToLine();
6051:             updatePathLabels();
6052:         }
6053: 
6054:         /**
6055:          * Dijkstra shortest-path from startPos to targetPos across placed hexes.
6056:          * Returns a playerPath array [{x, y, cost}] or null if unreachable / unaffordable.
6057:          */
6058:         function _dijkstraPath(startPos, targetPos) {
6059:             const hexes = getAllHexagonPositions();
6060:             const SNAP_R = TILE_SIZE * 0.6;
6061:             const key = (x, y) => `${Math.round(x)},${Math.round(y)}`;
6062:             const startKey = key(startPos.x, startPos.y);
6063:             const targetKey = key(targetPos.x, targetPos.y);
6064:             const totalAP = getTotalAP();
6065: 
6066:             // Snap a theoretical neighbour position to the nearest actual placed hex
6067:             const snapNeighbor = (nx, ny) => {
6068:                 let best = null, bestD = SNAP_R;
6069:                 for (const h of hexes) {
6070:                     const d = Math.hypot(h.x - nx, h.y - ny);
6071:                     if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = h; }
6072:                 }
6073:                 return best;
6074:             };
6075: 
6076:             const dist     = new Map([[startKey, 0]]);
6077:             const prev     = new Map([[startKey, null]]);
6078:             const costMap  = new Map([[startKey, 0]]);
6079:             const posMap   = new Map([[startKey, startPos]]);
6080:             const queue    = [{ cost: 0, key: startKey }];
6081: 
6082:             while (queue.length) {
6083:                 // Simple priority queue — board is small so this is fast enough
6084:                 queue.sort((a, b) => a.cost - b.cost);
6085:                 const curr = queue.shift();
6086:                 if (curr.key === targetKey) break;
6087:                 if (curr.cost > (dist.get(curr.key) ?? Infinity)) continue;
6088: 
6089:                 const currPos = posMap.get(curr.key);
6090:                 for (const nb of getNeighborHexPositions(currPos.x, currPos.y)) {
6091:                     const snapped = snapNeighbor(nb.x, nb.y);
6092:                     if (!snapped) continue;
6093: 
6094:                     const nKey = key(snapped.x, snapped.y);
6095:                     const moveCheck = canPlayerMoveToHex(snapped.x, snapped.y);
6096:                     if (!moveCheck.canMove) continue;
6097: 
6098:                     const newDist = curr.cost + moveCheck.cost;
6099:                     if (newDist > totalAP) continue;
6100:                     if (newDist >= (dist.get(nKey) ?? Infinity)) continue;
6101: 
6102:                     dist.set(nKey, newDist);
6103:                     prev.set(nKey, curr.key);
6104:                     costMap.set(nKey, moveCheck.cost);
6105:                     posMap.set(nKey, snapped);
6106:                     queue.push({ cost: newDist, key: nKey });
6107:                 }
6108:             }
6109: 
6110:             if (!dist.has(targetKey)) return null;
6111: 
6112:             // Reconstruct path by following parent pointers
6113:             const path = [];
6114:             let k = targetKey;
6115:             while (k !== null) {
6116:                 const p = posMap.get(k);
6117:                 path.unshift({ x: p.x, y: p.y, cost: costMap.get(k) });
6118:                 k = prev.get(k);
6119:             }
6120:             return path;
6121:         }

6123:         /** Sync the SVG polyline to the current playerPath */
6124:         function _applyPathToLine() {
6125:             if (!pathLine) return;
6126:             if (playerPath.length > 1) {
6127:                 pathLine.setAttribute('points', playerPath.map(p => `${p.x},${p.y}`).join(' '));
6128:             } else {
6129:                 pathLine.setAttribute('points', '');
6130:             }
6131:         }

6133:         function updatePathLabels() {
6134:             // Remove old labels
6135:             pathCostLabels.forEach(label => label.remove());
6136:             pathCostLabels = [];
6137: 
6138:             if (playerPath.length < 2) return;
6139: 
6140:             // Calculate cumulative costs and remaining AP for each segment
6141:             const steamBuff = getSteamVentsBuff();
6142:             let cumulativeCost = 0;
6143:             let banked = steamBuff ? steamBuff.freeStepBanked : false;
6144: 
6145:             for (let i = 1; i < playerPath.length; i++) {
6146:                 const currentSegment = playerPath[i];
6147:                 const stepCost = currentSegment.cost;
6148:                 if (steamBuff && stepCost > 0 && banked) {
6149:                     banked = false; // free step
6150:                 } else {
6151:                     cumulativeCost += stepCost;
6152:                     if (steamBuff && stepCost > 0) banked = true;
6153:                 }
6154:                 const remainingAP = currentAP - cumulativeCost;
6155: 
6156:                 // Calculate midpoint between this segment and previous
6157:                 const prevSegment = playerPath[i - 1];
6158:                 const midX = (currentSegment.x + prevSegment.x) / 2;
6159:                 const midY = (currentSegment.y + prevSegment.y) / 2;
6160: 
6161:                 // Create label
6162:                 const label = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
6163:                 label.setAttribute('x', midX);
6164:                 label.setAttribute('y', midY - 8); // Offset above the line
6165:                 label.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
6166:                 label.setAttribute('fill', remainingAP >= 0 ? '#2ecc71' : '#e74c3c');
6167:                 label.setAttribute('font-size', '14');
6168:                 label.setAttribute('font-weight', 'bold');
6169:                 label.setAttribute('stroke', '#000');
6170:                 label.setAttribute('stroke-width', '0.5');
6171:                 label.setAttribute('paint-order', 'stroke');
6172:                 label.textContent = remainingAP;
6173: 
6174:                 viewport.appendChild(label);
6175:                 pathCostLabels.push(label);
6176:             }
6177:         }

6179:         function getNeighborHexPositions(x, y) {
6180:             const neighbors = [];
6181:             const s = TILE_SIZE;
6182:             const dirs = [
6183:                 { q: 1, r: 0 }, { q: 1, r: -1 }, { q: 0, r: -1 },
6184:                 { q: -1, r: 0 }, { q: -1, r: 1 }, { q: 0, r: 1 }
6185:             ];
6186: 
6187:             for (const dir of dirs) {
6188:                 const pos = hexToPixel(dir.q, dir.r, s);
6189:                 neighbors.push({ x: x + pos.x, y: y + pos.y });
6190:             }
6191:             return neighbors;
6192:         }
6193: 
6194:         function calculatePathCost() {
6195:             let totalCost = 0;
6196:             const steamBuff = getSteamVentsBuff();
6197:             if (steamBuff) {
6198:                 // Steam Vents: every other AP-costing step is free
6199:                 // Start from the buff's current banked state
6200:                 let banked = steamBuff.freeStepBanked;
6201:                 for (let i = 1; i < playerPath.length; i++) {
6202:                     const stepCost = playerPath[i].cost;
6203:                     if (stepCost > 0 && banked) {
6204:                         // This step is free (banked from previous paid step)
6205:                         banked = false;
6206:                     } else {
6207:                         totalCost += stepCost;
6208:                         if (stepCost > 0) banked = true; // Bank a free step for next
6209:                     }
6210:                 }
6211:             } else {
6212:                 for (let i = 1; i < playerPath.length; i++) {
6213:                     totalCost += playerPath[i].cost;
6214:                 }
6215:             }
6216:             return totalCost;
6217:         }
6218: 
6219:         function getSteamVentsBuff() {
6220:             const buff = spellSystem?.scrollEffects?.activeBuffs?.steamVents;
6221:             return (buff && buff.playerIndex === activePlayerIndex) ? buff : null;
6222:         }
6223: 
6224:         function hasSteamVentsBuff() {
6225:             return !!getSteamVentsBuff();
6226:         }
6227: 
6228:         // After committing movement, update the Steam Vents banked state
6229:         // so future moves in the same turn remember the alternation
6230:         function commitSteamVentsState(path) {
6231:             const buff = getSteamVentsBuff();
6232:             if (!buff) return;
6233:             let banked = buff.freeStepBanked;
6234:             for (let i = 1; i < path.length; i++) {
6235:                 const stepCost = path[i].cost;
6236:                 if (stepCost > 0 && banked) {
6237:                     banked = false;
6238:                 } else if (stepCost > 0) {
6239:                     banked = true;
6240:                 }
6241:             }
6242:             buff.freeStepBanked = banked;
6243:             console.log(`♨️ Steam Vents: freeStepBanked now = ${banked}`);
6244:         }
6245:         if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.commitSteamVentsState = commitSteamVentsState;
6246: 
6247:         // Calculate movement cost for tap-to-move (simple BFS pathfinding)
6248:         function calculateTapMoveCost(startPos, endPos) {
6249:             const allHexes = getAllHexagonPositions();
6250:             if (allHexes.length === 0) return -1;
6251: 
6252:             // Find start and end hexes
6253:             let startHex = null, endHex = null;
6254:             allHexes.forEach(hex => {
6255:                 const startDist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(hex.x - startPos.x, 2) + Math.pow(hex.y - startPos.y, 2));
6256:                 const endDist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(hex.x - endPos.x, 2) + Math.pow(hex.y - endPos.y, 2));
6257:                 if (startDist < 5) startHex = hex;
6258:                 if (endDist < 5) endHex = hex;
6259:             });
6260: 
6261:             if (!startHex || !endHex) return -1;
6262:             if (startHex.key === endHex.key) return 0;
6263: 
6264:             // BFS to find shortest path
6265:             const visited = new Set();
6266:             const steamBuff = getSteamVentsBuff();
6267:             const startBanked = steamBuff ? steamBuff.freeStepBanked : false;
6268:             const queue = [{ hex: startHex, cost: 0, banked: startBanked }];
6269:             visited.add(startHex.key);
6270: 
6271:             while (queue.length > 0) {
6272:                 const { hex, cost, banked } = queue.shift();
6273: 
6274:                 // Find adjacent hexes (within ~35 units - one hex step)
6275:                 const neighbors = allHexes.filter(h => {
6276:                     if (visited.has(h.key)) return false;
6277:                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(h.x - hex.x, 2) + Math.pow(h.y - hex.y, 2));
6278:                     return dist > 5 && dist < 40; // Adjacent hex distance
6279:                 });
6280: 
6281:                 for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
6282:                     const moveCheck = canPlayerMoveToHex(neighbor.x, neighbor.y, false);
6283:                     if (!moveCheck.canMove) continue;
6284: 
6285:                     let newCost = cost;
6286:                     let newBanked = banked;
6287:                     const stepCost = moveCheck.cost ?? 1;
6288:                     if (steamBuff && stepCost > 0 && newBanked) {
6289:                         newBanked = false; // free step
6290:                     } else {
6291:                         newCost += stepCost;
6292:                         if (steamBuff && stepCost > 0) newBanked = true;
6293:                     }
6294:                     visited.add(neighbor.key);
6295: 
6296:                     if (neighbor.key === endHex.key) {
6297:                         return newCost;
6298:                     }
6299: 
6300:                     queue.push({ hex: neighbor, cost: newCost, banked: newBanked });
6301:                 }
6302:             }
6303: 
6304:             return -1; // No path found
6305:         }
6306: 
6307:         let nextStoneId = 1; // Global counter for unique stone IDs
6308: 
6309:         // Returns a darkened version of a hex color (factor 0–1)
6310:         function darkenHex(hex, factor) {
6311:             const c = hex.replace('#', '');
6312:             const r = Math.round(parseInt(c.slice(0, 2), 16) * factor);
6313:             const g = Math.round(parseInt(c.slice(2, 4), 16) * factor);
6314:             const b = Math.round(parseInt(c.slice(4, 6), 16) * factor);
6315:             return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
6316:         }

6748:         function updateAllVoidNullificationVisuals() {
6749:             // Snapshot which stones already show a nullification indicator
6750:             const prevNullified = new Set();
6751:             placedStones.forEach(stone => {
6752:                 if (stone.element.querySelector('.void-nullification-indicator')) {
6753:                     prevNullified.add(stone.id);
6754:                 }
6755:             });
6756: 
6757:             // Update all stones to show if they're nullified by void
6758:             let anyNewNullification = false;
6759:             placedStones.forEach(stone => {
6760:                 // Remove any existing nullification indicator
6761:                 const existingNullIndicator = stone.element.querySelector('.void-nullification-indicator');
6762:                 if (existingNullIndicator) {
6763:                     existingNullIndicator.remove();
6764:                 }
6765: 
6766:                 // Check if this stone is nullified by adjacent void
6767:                 // (Only fire, wind, and earth have abilities that can be nullified)
6768:                 if (stone.type === 'fire' || stone.type === 'wind' || stone.type === 'earth') {
6769:                     const hasVoid = hasAdjacentStoneType(stone.x, stone.y, 'void');
6770:                     if (hasVoid) {
6771:                         // Add nullification indicator (X or crossed-out effect)
6772:                         const nullIndicator = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
6773:                         nullIndicator.setAttribute('cx', 0);
6774:                         nullIndicator.setAttribute('cy', 0);
6775:                         nullIndicator.setAttribute('r', STONE_SIZE + 7);
6776:                         nullIndicator.setAttribute('class', 'void-nullification-indicator');
6777:                         nullIndicator.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
6778:                         nullIndicator.setAttribute('stroke', STONE_TYPES['void'].color);
6779:                         nullIndicator.setAttribute('stroke-width', '2');
6780:                         nullIndicator.style.animation = `mimicryGlow 7s ease-in-out infinite`;
6781:                         nullIndicator.style.willChange = 'opacity';
6782: 
6783:                         // Append last so it renders on top of the stone circle
6784:                         stone.element.appendChild(nullIndicator);
6785: 
6786:                         // Track if this is a newly-nullified stone
6787:                         if (!prevNullified.has(stone.id)) {
6788:                             anyNewNullification = true;
6789:                         }
6790: 
6791:                         console.log(`✨ ${stone.type} at (${stone.x.toFixed(1)}, ${stone.y.toFixed(1)}) is nullified by void`);
6792:                     }
6793:                 }
6794:             });
6795: 
6796:             // Play sound once if any stone became newly nullified
6797:             if (anyNewNullification) {
6798:                 window.SoundSystem?.play('voidactivates');
6799:             }
6800:         }

6809:                 waterStone.element.querySelector('.chain-indicator')
6810:             );

6871:         function getNeighborStones(x, y) {
6872:             const neighbors = [];
6873:             const hexPositions = getAllHexagonPositions();
6874: 
6875:             hexPositions.forEach(pos => {
6876:                 const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(x - pos.x, 2) + Math.pow(y - pos.y, 2));
6877:                 if (dist > 5 && dist < TILE_SIZE * 2.5) {
6878:                     const stone = placedStones.find(s => {
6879:                         const stoneDist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(s.x - pos.x, 2) + Math.pow(s.y - pos.y, 2));
6880:                         return stoneDist < 5;
6881:                     });
6882:                     if (stone) {
6883:                         neighbors.push(stone);
6884:                     }
6885:                 }
6886:             });
6887: 
6888:             return neighbors;
6889:         }
6890: 
6891:         function hasAdjacentStoneType(x, y, type) {
6892:             const neighbors = getNeighborStones(x, y);
6893:             return neighbors.some(s => s.type === type);
6894:         }

6896:         // Stone rank for water mimicry priority (lower = higher priority)
6897:         const STONE_RANK = {
6898:             'void': 1,
6899:             'wind': 2,
6900:             'fire': 3,
6901:             'water': 4,
6902:             'earth': 5
6903:         };
6904: 
6905:         // Get the effective type of a stone (considering water mimicry)
6906:         function getEffectiveStoneType(stone) {
6907:             if (stone.type !== 'water') {
6908:                 return stone.type;
6909:             }
6910: 
6911:             // Water mimics adjacent stones
6912:             const neighbors = getNeighborStones(stone.x, stone.y);
6913:             if (neighbors.length === 0) {
6914:                 return 'water'; // No neighbors, just water
6915:             }
6916: 
6917:             // Find highest-ranked adjacent stone (lowest rank number)
6918:             let bestRank = Infinity;
6919:             let mimicType = 'water';
6920: 
6921:             neighbors.forEach(neighbor => {
6922:                 const rank = STONE_RANK[neighbor.type] || 999;
6923:                 if (rank < bestRank && neighbor.type !== 'water') {
6924:                     bestRank = rank;
6925:                     mimicType = neighbor.type;
6926:                 }
6927:             });
6928: 
6929:             return mimicType;
6930:         }
6931: 
6932:         function recheckAllStoneInteractions() {
6933:             // Re-check interactions for all fire stones on the board
6934:             // This ensures fire destroys adjacent stones when void is removed
6935:             const fireStones = placedStones.filter(s => s.type === 'fire');
6936: 
6937:             fireStones.forEach(stone => {
6938:                 const fireHasVoid = hasAdjacentStoneType(stone.x, stone.y, 'void');
6939:                 if (!fireHasVoid) {
6940:                     // Fire is not nullified, check what it should destroy
6941:                     const neighbors = getNeighborStones(stone.x, stone.y);
6942:                     const stonesToDestroy = [];
6943:                     neighbors.forEach(neighbor => {
6944:                         // Fire destroys ALL stones except void and fire
6945:                         // (Water is NOT protected - fire destroys water)
6946:                         if (neighbor.type !== 'void' && neighbor.type !== 'fire') {
6947:                             stonesToDestroy.push(neighbor.id);
6948:                         }
6949:                     });
6950: 
6951:                     // Destroy adjacent stones (using direct removal to avoid recursion)
6952:                     stonesToDestroy.forEach(targetId => {
6953:                         const target = placedStones.find(s => s.id === targetId);
6954:                         if (target) {
6955:                             window.effectsSystem?.play('fire_effect', target.x, target.y);
6956:                             target.element.remove();
6957:                             placedStones = placedStones.filter(s => s.id !== targetId);
6958:                             returnStoneToPool(target.type);
6959:                             updateStatus(`Fire destroyed ${target.type} stone!`);
6960:                         }
6961:                     });
6962:                 }
6963:             });
6964:         }
6965: 
6966:         function processStoneInteractions(x, y, type) {
6967:             const neighbors = getNeighborStones(x, y);
6968: 
6969:             // Special case: water stone placed with both fire and a higher-priority stone
6970:             // Water mimics the higher-priority stone, then gets destroyed by fire
6971:             if (type === 'water') {
6972:                 const hasActiveFire = neighbors.some(n => n.type === 'fire' && !hasAdjacentStoneType(n.x, n.y, 'void'));
6973:                 if (hasActiveFire) {
6974:                     // Check what the water would mimic
6975:                     const effectiveType = getEffectiveStoneType({ x, y, type: 'water' });
6976:                     // If water is mimicking something other than water or fire, it gets destroyed
6977:                     if (effectiveType !== 'water' && effectiveType !== 'fire') {
6978:                         const stoneToRemove = placedStones.find(s => s.x === x && s.y === y);
6979:                         if (stoneToRemove) {
6980:                             setTimeout(() => {
6981:                                 removeStone(stoneToRemove.id);
6982:                                 updateStatus(`Water mimicked ${effectiveType}, then was destroyed by fire!`);
6983:                             }, 100);
6984:                         }
6985:                         return; // Stop processing other interactions
6986:                     }
6987:                 }
6988:             }
6989: 
6990:             // Fire destroys adjacent non-void, non-fire stones
6991:             // But only if fire itself is not nullified by an adjacent void
6992:             if (type === 'fire') {
6993:                 const fireHasVoid = hasAdjacentStoneType(x, y, 'void');
6994: 
6995:                 if (!fireHasVoid) {
6996:                     const stonesToDestroy = [];
6997:                     neighbors.forEach(neighbor => {
6998:                         // Don't destroy void or fire
6999:                         // Fire destroys ALL other stones, even if they're voided
7000:                         if (neighbor.type !== 'void' && neighbor.type !== 'fire') {
7001:                             stonesToDestroy.push(neighbor);
7002:                         }
7003:                     });
7004: 
7005:                     // Destroy all adjacent stones (voided or not)
7006:                     if (stonesToDestroy.length > 0) {
7007:                         window.SoundSystem?.play('fireactivates');
7008:                     }
7009:                     stonesToDestroy.forEach(stone => {
7010:                         // Collect for undo (game-ui.js attaches this to lastMove after placeStone returns)
7011:                         if (Array.isArray(window._pendingFireDestroys)) {
7012:                             window._pendingFireDestroys.push({ x: stone.x, y: stone.y, type: stone.type });
7013:                         }
7014:                         window.effectsSystem?.play('fire_effect', stone.x, stone.y);
7015:                         removeStone(stone.id);
7016:                         updateStatus(`Fire destroyed ${stone.type} stone!`);
7017:                     });
7018:                 }
7019:             }
7020: 
7021:             // Fire also checks incoming threats
7022:             neighbors.forEach(neighbor => {
7023:                 if (neighbor.type === 'fire' && type !== 'void' && type !== 'fire') {
7024:                     const hasVoid = hasAdjacentStoneType(neighbor.x, neighbor.y, 'void');
7025:                     if (!hasVoid) {
7026:                         const stoneToRemove = placedStones.find(s => s.x === x && s.y === y);
7027:                         if (stoneToRemove) {
7028:                             window.effectsSystem?.play('fire_effect', x, y);
7029:                             removeStone(stoneToRemove.id);
7030:                             updateStatus(`Fire destroyed ${type} stone!`);
7031:                         }
7032:                     }
7033:                 }
7034:             });
7035:         }
7036: 
7037:         function removeStone(stoneId) {
7038:             const stone = placedStones.find(s => s.id === stoneId);
7039:             if (stone) {
7040:                 stone.element.remove();
7041:                 placedStones = placedStones.filter(s => s.id !== stoneId);
7042:                 returnStoneToPool(stone.type);
7043:                 updateTileClasses();
7044: 
7045:                 // Re-check all fire stones to see if they should activate
7046:                 recheckAllStoneInteractions();
7047: 
7048:                 // Update all water stone visuals since chaining may have changed
7049:                 updateAllWaterStoneVisuals();
7050: 
7051:                 // Update void nullification indicators
7052:                 updateAllVoidNullificationVisuals();
7053:             }
7054:         }

7057:         function isHexOccupiedByOtherPlayer(x, y) {
7058:             if (!Array.isArray(playerPositions) || typeof activePlayerIndex !== 'number') return false;
7059:             return playerPositions.some((p, idx) => {
7060:                 if (!p) return false;
7061:                 if (idx === activePlayerIndex) return false; // ignore self
7062:                 const dist = Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.y - y);
7063:                 return dist < 5; // same positional threshold used elsewhere
7064:             });
7065:         }
7066: 
7067:         function canPlayerMoveToHex(x, y, logBlocked = false) {
7068:             // Block movement onto hexes occupied by other players (prevents moving "through" players as pathing is step-wise)
7069:             if (isHexOccupiedByOtherPlayer(x, y)) {
7070:                 if (logBlocked) console.log(`❌ Cannot move to (${x.toFixed(1)}, ${y.toFixed(1)}): occupied by another player`);
7071:                 return { canMove: false, cost: Infinity };
7072:             }
7073: 
7074:             const stone = placedStones.find(s => {
7075:                 const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(s.x - x, 2) + Math.pow(s.y - y, 2));
7076:                 return dist < 5;
7077:             });
7078: 
7079:             if (!stone) return { canMove: true, cost: 1 };
7080: 
7081:             // Mudslide buff: earth and water stones act as wind stones (free movement)
7082:             const mudslideBuff = spellSystem?.scrollEffects?.activeBuffs?.mudslide;
7083:             if (mudslideBuff && mudslideBuff.playerIndex === activePlayerIndex) {
7084:                 if (stone.type === 'earth' || stone.type === 'water') {
7085:                     // Treat as wind stone — free movement, unless nullified by void
7086:                     const hasVoid = hasAdjacentStoneType(x, y, 'void');
7087:                     if (hasVoid) return { canMove: true, cost: 1 };
7088:                     console.log(`🌊 Mudslide: ${stone.type} stone at (${x.toFixed(1)}, ${y.toFixed(1)}) acts as wind (free movement)`);
7089:                     return { canMove: true, cost: 0 };
7090:                 }
7091:             }
7092: 
7093:             // Handle water stones with chaining
7094:             if (stone.type === 'water') {
7095:                 const chainedAbility = getChainedAbility(x, y);
7096:                 console.log(`💧 Water at (${x.toFixed(1)}, ${y.toFixed(1)}) has chained ability: ${chainedAbility || 'none'}`);
7097: 
7098:                 if (chainedAbility === 'wind') {
7099:                     // Wind chains through water - free movement
7100:                     console.log(`✓ Wind chaining active - water becomes free movement`);
7101:                     return { canMove: true, cost: 0 };
7102:                 } else if (chainedAbility === 'earth') {
7103:                     // Earth chains through water - blocks movement
7104:                     console.log(`✓ Earth chaining active - water blocks movement`);
7105:                     if (logBlocked) console.log(`❌ Cannot move to (${x.toFixed(1)}, ${y.toFixed(1)}): Water has chained Earth ability (blocks movement)`);
7106:                     return { canMove: false, cost: Infinity };
7107:                 }
7108: 
7109:                 // No chaining effects, normal water cost
7110:                 console.log(`💧 No chaining - normal water cost (2 AP)`);
7111:                 return { canMove: true, cost: 2 };
7112:             }
7113: 
7114:             // Handle non-water stones based on their ACTUAL type, not mimicry
7115:             // (Mimicry is visual only, doesn't affect movement)
7116: 
7117:             // Earth blocks movement (unless nullified by void)
7118:             if (stone.type === 'earth') {
7119:                 const hasVoid = hasAdjacentStoneType(x, y, 'void');
7120:                 if (hasVoid) return { canMove: true, cost: 1 }; // Nullified by void, reverts to baseline
7121:                 if (logBlocked) console.log(`❌ Cannot move to (${x.toFixed(1)}, ${y.toFixed(1)}): Earth stone blocks movement (needs adjacent Void to nullify)`);
7122:                 return { canMove: false, cost: Infinity };
7123:             }
7124: 
7125:             // Wind is free (0 cost) - ability overrides baseline
7126:             if (stone.type === 'wind') {
7127:                 const hasVoid = hasAdjacentStoneType(x, y, 'void');
7128:                 if (hasVoid) return { canMove: true, cost: 1 }; // Nullified by void, reverts to baseline
7129:                 return { canMove: true, cost: 0 }; // Wind ability: free movement
7130:             }
7131: 
7132:             // All other stones (void, fire, etc.) cost 1 AP (baseline)
7133:             return { canMove: true, cost: 1 };
7134:         }

  82:         // Play n footstep sounds spaced ~160ms apart (for multi-hex moves).
  83:         // Wind steps (cost 0) are excluded by the caller — only pass non-wind steps.
  84:         function playFootsteps(n) {
  85:             if (!n || n <= 0) return;
  86:             window.SoundSystem?.playFootstep();
  87:             for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
  88:                 setTimeout(() => window.SoundSystem?.playFootstep(), i * 160);
  89:             }
  90:         }
