 142:         // Update common area UI
 143:         function updateCommonAreaUI() {
 144:             if (!spellSystem) return;
 145: 
 146:             const container = document.getElementById('common-area-container');
 147:             if (!container) return;
 148:             if (container.dataset.expanded === undefined) container.dataset.expanded = 'false';
 149: 
 150:             const commonScrolls = spellSystem.getCommonAreaScrolls();
 151: 
 152:             if (commonScrolls.length === 0) {
 153:                 container.innerHTML = '<div class="common-area-empty">No scrolls in common area</div>';
 154:                 return;
 155:             }
 156: 
 157:             container.innerHTML = '';
 158:             commonScrolls.forEach(scrollName => {
 159:                 const scrollInfo = spellSystem.patterns?.[scrollName] || SCROLL_DEFINITIONS?.[scrollName];
 160:                 if (!scrollInfo) return;
 161: 
 162:                 const element = spellSystem.getScrollElement(scrollName);
 163:                 const scrollEl = document.createElement('div');
 164:                 scrollEl.className = `common-area-scroll ${element}`;
 165:                 scrollEl.title = scrollInfo.description || '';
 166: 
 167:                 const nameEl = document.createElement('div');
 168:                 nameEl.className = 'common-area-scroll-name';
 169:                 nameEl.textContent = scrollInfo.name || scrollName;
 170:                 scrollEl.appendChild(nameEl);
 171: 
 172:                 // Stone formation / pattern display only when common area is expanded (popout mode)
 173:                 const isExpanded = container.dataset.expanded === 'true';
 174:                 if (isExpanded && scrollInfo.patterns && typeof spellSystem.createPatternVisual === 'function') {
 175:                     const patternVisual = spellSystem.createPatternVisual(scrollInfo, element);
 176:                     patternVisual.classList?.add?.('common-area-pattern');
 177:                     patternVisual.style.marginTop = '6px';
 178:                     patternVisual.style.padding = '8px';
 179:                     if (patternVisual.style) patternVisual.style.maxWidth = '100%';
 180:                     scrollEl.appendChild(patternVisual);
 181:                 }
 182: 
 183:                 // Click to view details
 184:                 scrollEl.addEventListener('click', () => {
 185:                     showScrollInfoPopup(scrollName, scrollInfo, element);
 186:                 });
 187: 
 188:                 container.appendChild(scrollEl);
 189:             });
 190:         }

 362:         // Show scroll deck browser modal
 363:         function showScrollDeckBrowser(element) {
 364:             if (!spellSystem || !spellSystem.scrollDecks) return;
 365: 
 366:             const deck = spellSystem.scrollDecks[element];
 367:             if (!deck || deck.length === 0) {
 368:                 updateStatus(`The ${element} scroll deck is empty!`);
 369:                 return;
 370:             }
 371: 
 372:             const modal = document.createElement('div');
 373:             modal.className = 'scroll-browse-modal';
 374:             modal.innerHTML = `
 375:                 <div class="scroll-browse-content">
 376:                     <div class="scroll-browse-header">
 377:                         <h3>${element.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + element.slice(1)} Scroll Deck (${deck.length})</h3>
 378:                         <button class="scroll-browse-close">&times;</button>
 379:                     </div>
 380:                     <div class="scroll-browse-list" id="scroll-browse-list">
 381:                         <!-- Scrolls will be added here -->
 382:                     </div>
 383:                     <div class="scroll-browse-footer">
 384:                         <button class="btn-shuffle">Shuffle Deck</button>
 385:                         <button class="btn-close">Close</button>
 386:                     </div>
 387:                 </div>
 388:             `;
 389: 
 390:             const listEl = modal.querySelector('#scroll-browse-list');
 391: 
 392:             // Add each scroll in the deck
 393:             deck.forEach((scrollName, index) => {
 394:                 const scrollInfo = spellSystem.patterns?.[scrollName] || SCROLL_DEFINITIONS?.[scrollName];
 395:                 if (!scrollInfo) return;
 396: 
 397:                 const item = document.createElement('div');
 398:                 item.className = 'scroll-browse-item';
 399:                 item.innerHTML = `
 400:                     <div class="scroll-name">${scrollInfo.name || scrollName}</div>
 401:                     <div class="scroll-desc">${scrollInfo.description || 'No description'}</div>
 402:                     <div class="scroll-level">Level ${scrollInfo.level || '?'} • Position ${index + 1} in deck</div>
 403:                 `;
 404: 
 405:                 // Click to draw this scroll
 406:                 item.addEventListener('click', () => {
 407:                     drawScrollFromDeck(element, scrollName, index);
 408:                     modal.remove();
 409:                 });
 410: 
 411:                 listEl.appendChild(item);
 412:             });
 413: 
 414:             document.body.appendChild(modal);
 415: 
 416:             // Close handlers
 417:             modal.querySelector('.scroll-browse-close').addEventListener('click', () => modal.remove());
 418:             modal.querySelector('.btn-close').addEventListener('click', () => modal.remove());
 419:             modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 420:                 if (e.target === modal) modal.remove();
 421:             });
 422: 
 423:             // Shuffle handler
 424:             modal.querySelector('.btn-shuffle').addEventListener('click', () => {
 425:                 if (spellSystem.shuffleDeck && spellSystem.scrollDecks[element]) {
 426:                     spellSystem.shuffleDeck(spellSystem.scrollDecks[element]);
 427:                     updateStatus(`${element.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + element.slice(1)} scroll deck shuffled!`);
 428:                     modal.remove();
 429:                     // Reopen to show new order
 430:                     showScrollDeckBrowser(element);
 431:                 }
 432:             });
 433:         }

 435:         // Draw a specific scroll from a deck (for testing)
 436:         function drawScrollFromDeck(element, scrollName, index) {
 437:             if (!spellSystem || !spellSystem.scrollDecks) return;
 438: 
 439:             const deck = spellSystem.scrollDecks[element];
 440:             if (!deck || index >= deck.length) return;
 441: 
 442:             // Remove scroll from deck at specified index
 443:             deck.splice(index, 1);
 444: 
 445:             // Add to player's hand
 446:             const scrolls = spellSystem.getPlayerScrolls(false);
 447: 
 448:             // Check hand limit
 449:             if (scrolls.hand.size >= 4) {
 450:                 updateStatus(`Your hand is full (4 scrolls max)! Discard or use a scroll first.`);
 451:                 // Put scroll back
 452:                 deck.splice(index, 0, scrollName);
 453:                 return;
 454:             }
 455: 
 456:             scrolls.hand.add(scrollName);
 457:             spellSystem.updateScrollCount();
 458:             updateScrollDeckUI();
 459:             updateHUD();
 460: 
 461:             const scrollInfo = spellSystem.patterns?.[scrollName] || SCROLL_DEFINITIONS?.[scrollName];
 462:             updateStatus(`Drew ${scrollInfo?.name || scrollName} from the ${element} deck!`);
 463: 
 464:             // Shuffle the deck after drawing (as requested)
 465:             if (spellSystem.shuffleDeck) {
 466:                 spellSystem.shuffleDeck(deck);
 467:                 console.log(`📜 ${element} deck shuffled after drawing`);
 468:             }
 469: 
 470:             // Broadcast so other clients update their deck/hand state
 471:             if (isMultiplayer) {
 472:                 broadcastGameAction('scroll-collected', {
 473:                     playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
 474:                     scrollName: scrollName,
 475:                     shrineType: element
 476:                 });
 477:                 if (typeof syncPlayerState === 'function') syncPlayerState();
 478:             }
 479:         }
 480: 
 481:         function updateHUD() {
 482:             // Guard: Don't update if game variables aren't initialized yet
 483:             try {
 484:                 if (typeof currentAP === 'undefined' || typeof voidAP === 'undefined') {
 485:                     return;
 486:                 }
 487:             } catch (e) {
 488:                 return; // Variables not ready yet
 489:             }
 490: 
 491:             // Update AP
 492:             const hudApValue = document.getElementById('hud-ap-value');
 493:             if (hudApValue) hudApValue.textContent = currentAP;
 494:             updateApPips(currentAP);
 495: 
 496:             // Update Void AP display
 497:             const hudVoidAp = document.getElementById('hud-void-ap');
 498:             if (hudVoidAp) {
 499:                 hudVoidAp.textContent = voidAP > 0 ? `+${voidAP}` : '';
 500:             }
 501: 
 502:             // Update scroll counts - only if spellSystem is fully initialized
 503:             try {
 504:                 if (typeof spellSystem !== 'undefined' && spellSystem && spellSystem.handScrolls) {
 505:                     const hudHandCount = document.getElementById('hud-hand-count');
 506:                     const hudActiveCount = document.getElementById('hud-active-count');
 507:                     const hudCommonCount = document.getElementById('hud-common-count');
 508: 
 509:                     if (hudHandCount) hudHandCount.textContent = spellSystem.handScrolls.size || 0;
 510:                     if (hudActiveCount) hudActiveCount.textContent = spellSystem.activeScrolls ? spellSystem.activeScrolls.size : 0;
 511:                     if (hudCommonCount && spellSystem.getCommonAreaScrolls) hudCommonCount.textContent = spellSystem.getCommonAreaScrolls().length;
 512:                 }
 513:             } catch (e) {
 514:                 // spellSystem not ready yet
 515:             }
 516: 
 517:             // Update player name/turn indicator
 518:             try {
 519:                 const hudPlayerName = document.getElementById('hud-player-name');
 520:                 const hudPlayerDot  = document.getElementById('hud-player-dot');
 521:                 const hudPlayer     = hudPlayerName?.closest('.hud-player');
 522:                 if (hudPlayerName && typeof activePlayerIndex !== 'undefined') {
 523:                     const isMyTurnNow = typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer
 524:                         && myPlayerIndex === activePlayerIndex;
 525:                     if (isMyTurnNow) {
 526:                         hudPlayerName.textContent = 'Your Turn';
 527:                     } else {
 528:                         const name = typeof getPlayerColorName === 'function'
 529:                             ? getPlayerColorName(activePlayerIndex)
 530:                             : `Player ${activePlayerIndex + 1}`;
 531:                         hudPlayerName.textContent = `${name}'s Turn`;
 532:                     }
 533:                     if (hudPlayer) hudPlayer.classList.toggle('your-turn', isMyTurnNow);
 534:                 }
 535: 
 536:                 // Update player dot color — must reflect the ACTIVE player, not the local player
 537:                 if (hudPlayerDot) {
 538:                     const colorMap = {
 539:                         'purple': '#9458f4',
 540:                         'yellow': '#ffce00',
 541:                         'red': '#ed1b43',
 542:                         'blue': '#5894f4',
 543:                         'green': '#69d83a'
 544:                     };
 545:                     // Prefer the active player's colour from allPlayersData
 546:                     const activePlayerData = typeof allPlayersData !== 'undefined'
 547:                         ? allPlayersData.find(p => p.player_index === activePlayerIndex)
 548:                         : null;
 549:                     const activeColorKey = activePlayerData?.color
 550:                         || (typeof playerColor !== 'undefined' ? playerColor : null);
 551:                     hudPlayerDot.style.background = (activeColorKey && colorMap[activeColorKey])
 552:                         ? colorMap[activeColorKey]
 553:                         : '#d9b08c';
 554:                 }
 555:                 // Update shrine dots — always show the LOCAL player's win progress
 556:                 const shrineIndex = (typeof isMultiplayer !== 'undefined' && isMultiplayer && typeof myPlayerIndex !== 'undefined' && myPlayerIndex !== null)
 557:                     ? myPlayerIndex
 558:                     : (typeof activePlayerIndex !== 'undefined' ? activePlayerIndex : 0);
 559:                 updateShrineDots(shrineIndex);
 560:                 // Update dock
 561:                 updateDockPlayers();
 562:             } catch (e) {
 563:                 // Variables not ready yet
 564:             }
 565:         }
 566:

 569:         function updateShrineDots(playerIndex) {
 570:             try {
 571:                 const scrollData = window.spellSystem?.playerScrolls?.[playerIndex];
 572:                 const activated = scrollData?.activated ?? new Set();
 573:                 ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void'].forEach(el => {
 574:                     const dot = document.getElementById('shrine-dot-' + el);
 575:                     if (!dot) return;
 576:                     dot.classList.toggle('complete', activated.has(el));
 577:                 });
 578:             } catch (e) { /* spellSystem not ready */ }
 579:         }

 582:             document.querySelectorAll('.ap-pip').forEach(pip => {
 583:                 const n = parseInt(pip.dataset.pip, 10);
 584:                 pip.classList.toggle('filled', n <= apValue);
 585:             });
 586:         }

 588:         function setupStoneDragFromCard(card, element) {
 589:             card.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
 590:                 if (stoneCounts[element] <= 0) {
 591:                     updateStatus(`No ${element} stones available!`);
 592:                     return;
 593:                 }
 594:                 // Start dragging a new stone from the deck
 595:                 startStoneDragFromDeck(e, element);
 596:             });
 597:         }
 598: 
 599:         function startStoneDragFromDeck(e, type) {
 600:             // Check if it's this player's turn and no pending cascade
 601:             if (!canTakeAction()) {
 602:                 notYourTurn();
 603:                 return;
 604:             }
 605: 
 606:             if (stoneCounts[type] <= 0) {
 607:                 updateStatus(`No ${type} stones available!`);
 608:                 return;
 609:             }
 610: 
 611:             e.preventDefault();
 612: 
 613:             // Clean up any pre-existing ghost (prevents orphaned stamps if drag starts mid-drag)
 614:             if (ghostStone) {
 615:                 ghostStone.remove();
 616:                 ghostStone = null;
 617:             }
 618: 
 619:             isDraggingFromDeck = true;
 620:             isDraggingStone = true;
 621:             draggedStoneId = null;
 622:             draggedStoneType = type;
 623: 
 624:             // Create ghost stone at cursor position
 625:             const rect = boardSvg.getBoundingClientRect();
 626:             const coords = getEventCoords(e);
 627:             const screenX = coords.x - rect.left;
 628:             const screenY = coords.y - rect.top;
 629:             const world = screenToWorld(screenX, screenY);
 630: 
 631:             ghostStone = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
 632:             ghostStone.setAttribute('class', 'stone stone-ghost');
 633:             ghostStone.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${world.x}, ${world.y})`);
 634: 
 635:             const circle = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
 636:             circle.setAttribute('cx', 0);
 637:             circle.setAttribute('cy', 0);
 638:             circle.setAttribute('r', STONE_SIZE);
 639:             circle.setAttribute('class', 'stone-piece');
 640:             circle.setAttribute('fill', STONE_TYPES[type].color);
 641: 
 642:             const ghostImg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'image');
 643:             ghostImg.setAttribute('href', STONE_TYPES[type].img);
 644:             ghostImg.setAttribute('x', -STONE_SIZE);
 645:             ghostImg.setAttribute('y', -STONE_SIZE);
 646:             ghostImg.setAttribute('width', STONE_SIZE * 2);
 647:             ghostImg.setAttribute('height', STONE_SIZE * 2);
 648:             ghostImg.style.mixBlendMode = 'screen';
 649: 
 650:             ghostStone.appendChild(circle);
 651:             ghostStone.appendChild(ghostImg);
 652:             viewport.appendChild(ghostStone);
 653:         }
 654: 
 655:         function updateSourceCount(type) {
 656:             document.getElementById(type + '-source').textContent = 'Source: ' + sourcePool[type] + '/' + sourcePoolCapacity[type];
 657:         }
 658: 
 659:         function returnStoneToPool(type) {
 660:             // Return a stone to the SOURCE pool (not player pool)
 661:             // This happens when stones are removed from board or destroyed
 662:             const maxStones = sourcePoolCapacity[type];
 663:             if (sourcePool[type] < maxStones) {
 664:                 sourcePool[type]++;
 665:                 updateSourceCount(type);
 666:                 console.log(`♻️ Returned ${type} stone to source pool (${sourcePool[type]}/${maxStones})`);
 667:             } else {
 668:                 console.log(`⚠️ Cannot return ${type} stone to source pool: already at maximum (${maxStones})`);
 669:             }
 670:         }

 672:         let lastStatusMessage = null;
 673:         let _statusFlashTimer = null;
 674:         function updateStatus(msg) {
 675:             if (msg === lastStatusMessage) return;
 676:             lastStatusMessage = msg;
 677:             const el = document.getElementById('status');
 678:             if (!el) return;
 679:             el.textContent = msg;
 680:             // Brief gold flash to draw attention to new messages
 681:             el.style.color = '#d9b08c';
 682:             clearTimeout(_statusFlashTimer);
 683:             _statusFlashTimer = setTimeout(() => { el.style.color = ''; }, 1800);
 684:         }

 739:         // Update the opponent panel with current game state
 740:         function updateOpponentPanel() {
 741:             const panel = document.getElementById('opponent-panel');
 742:             const rightPanelEl = document.getElementById('right-panel');
 743:             const cardsContainer = document.getElementById('opponent-cards');
 744:             const newCardsContainer = document.getElementById('new-opponent-cards');
 745:             if (rightPanelEl && rightPanelEl.dataset.opponentPatternsExpanded === undefined) {
 746:                 rightPanelEl.dataset.opponentPatternsExpanded = 'false';
 747:             }
 748: 
 749:             // Only show in multiplayer with more than 1 player
 750:             if (!isMultiplayer || totalPlayers <= 1) {
 751:                 if (panel) panel.classList.remove('visible');
 752:                 return;
 753:             }
 754: 
 755:             if (panel) {
 756:                 panel.classList.add('visible');
 757:             }
 758:             if (cardsContainer) cardsContainer.innerHTML = '';
 759:             if (newCardsContainer) newCardsContainer.innerHTML = '';
 760: 
 761:             // Delegated click handler for scroll card popups — added once per container.
 762:             // innerHTML = '' only clears children, not listeners on the container itself,
 763:             // so we guard with a data flag to avoid stacking listeners on re-calls.
 764:             const attachScrollDelegate = (container) => {
 765:                 if (!container || container.dataset.scrollDelegated) return;
 766:                 container.dataset.scrollDelegated = 'true';
 767:                 container.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 768:                     const sc = e.target.closest('.opponent-scroll-card[data-scroll-name]');
 769:                     if (!sc) return;
 770:                     const sName = sc.dataset.scrollName;
 771:                     showScrollInfoPopup(sName, spellSystem.patterns[sName], spellSystem.getScrollElement(sName));
 772:                 });
 773:             };
 774:             attachScrollDelegate(cardsContainer);
 775:             attachScrollDelegate(newCardsContainer);
 776: 
 777:             // Build ordered list: self first, then others
 778:             const playerOrder = [];
 779:             playerOrder.push(myPlayerIndex);
 780:             for (let i = 0; i < totalPlayers; i++) {
 781:                 if (i !== myPlayerIndex) playerOrder.push(i);
 782:             }
 783: 
 784:             for (const i of playerOrder) {
 785:                 const isSelf = (i === myPlayerIndex);
 786:                 const playerData = allPlayersData.find(p => p.player_index === i);
 787:                 const playerName = getPlayerColorName(i);
 788:                 const playerColor = playerData ? PLAYER_COLORS[playerData.color] : '#666';
 789:                 const isActiveTurn = (i === activePlayerIndex);
 790: 
 791:                 // Get player resources
 792:                 const pool = playerPools[i] || { earth: 0, water: 0, fire: 0, wind: 0, void: 0 };
 793:                 const ap = playerAPs[i] || { currentAP: 5, voidAP: 0 };
 794:                 const scrollData = spellSystem.playerScrolls[i] || { hand: new Set(), active: new Set(), activated: new Set() };
 795: 
 796:                 const card = document.createElement('div');
 797:                 card.className = 'opponent-card' + (isActiveTurn ? ' active-turn' : '') + (isSelf ? ' self-card' : '');
 798:                 card.style.borderLeftColor = playerColor;
 799: 
 800:                 // Header with name and AP
 801:                 const header = document.createElement('div');
 802:                 header.className = 'opponent-header';
 803:                 header.innerHTML = `
 804:                     <span class="opponent-name" style="color: ${playerColor};">${playerName}${isSelf ? ' (you)' : ''}</span>
 805:                     <span class="opponent-ap">AP: ${ap.currentAP}${ap.voidAP > 0 ? ` +${ap.voidAP}<img src="images/voidsymbol.png${IMG_V}" class="element-icon-sm" alt="void" style="vertical-align:middle;">` : ''}</span>
 806:                 `;
 807:                 card.appendChild(header);
 808: 
 809:                 // Stones
 810:                 const stonesDiv = document.createElement('div');
 811:                 stonesDiv.className = 'opponent-stones';
 812:                 const stoneElements = ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void'];
 813:                 let hasStones = false;
 814:                 stoneElements.forEach(element => {
 815:                     if (pool[element] > 0) {
 816:                         hasStones = true;
 817:                         const stoneSpan = document.createElement('span');
 818:                         stoneSpan.className = 'opponent-stone';
 819:                         stoneSpan.style.color = STONE_TYPES[element].color;
 820:                         stoneSpan.innerHTML = `<img src="${STONE_TYPES[element].img}" class="element-icon-sm" alt="${element}"> ${element}: ${pool[element]}/5`;
 821:                         stonesDiv.appendChild(stoneSpan);
 822:                     }
 823:                 });
 824:                 if (!hasStones) {
 825:                     stonesDiv.innerHTML = '<span class="opponent-no-stones">No stones</span>';
 826:                 }
 827:                 card.appendChild(stonesDiv);
 828: 
 829: 
 830:                 // Scrolls summary (hand count only - hand contents are private)
 831:                 const handSize = scrollData.hand ? scrollData.hand.size : 0;
 832:                 const activeSize = scrollData.active ? scrollData.active.size : 0;
 833: 
 834:                 const scrollsSummary = document.createElement('div');
 835:                 scrollsSummary.className = 'opponent-scrolls-summary';
 836:                 scrollsSummary.textContent = `Hand: ${handSize} scroll${handSize !== 1 ? 's' : ''} (hidden)`;
 837:                 card.appendChild(scrollsSummary);
 838: 
 839:                 // Active scrolls (visible to opponents)
 840:                 if (activeSize > 0) {
 841:                     const activeScrollsDiv = document.createElement('div');
 842:                     activeScrollsDiv.className = 'opponent-active-scrolls';
 843: 
 844:                     const activeTitle = document.createElement('div');
 845:                     activeTitle.className = 'opponent-active-scrolls-title';
 846:                     activeTitle.textContent = `Active Area (${activeSize}):`;
 847:                     activeScrollsDiv.appendChild(activeTitle);
 848: 
 849:                     scrollData.active.forEach(scrollName => {
 850:                         const pattern = spellSystem.patterns[scrollName];
 851:                         const element = spellSystem.getScrollElement(scrollName);
 852:                         const elementColor = element === 'catacomb' ? '#9b59b6' : STONE_TYPES[element]?.color || '#666';
 853:                         const elementIconHTML = `<img src="${STONE_TYPES[element]?.img || ''}" class="element-icon-sm" alt="${element}" style="vertical-align:middle;">`;
 854: 
 855:                         const scrollCard = document.createElement('div');
 856:                         scrollCard.className = 'opponent-scroll-card';
 857:                         scrollCard.style.cursor = 'pointer';
 858:                         scrollCard.title = 'Click to view scroll details';
 859:                         scrollCard.dataset.scrollName = scrollName; // stored for clone re-wiring
 860:                         scrollCard.innerHTML = `
 861:                             <div class="opponent-scroll-name">${pattern ? pattern.name : scrollName}</div>
 862:                             <div class="opponent-scroll-element" style="color: ${elementColor};">
 863:                                 ${elementIconHTML} ${element ? element.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + element.slice(1) : 'Unknown'}
 864:                             </div>
 865:                             <div class="opponent-scroll-pattern-wrap"></div>
 866:                         `;
 867:                         const patternWrap = scrollCard.querySelector('.opponent-scroll-pattern-wrap');
 868:                         const showPatterns = (document.getElementById('right-panel')?.dataset.opponentPatternsExpanded === 'true');
 869:                         if (showPatterns && pattern?.patterns && typeof spellSystem.createPatternVisual === 'function' && patternWrap) {
 870:                             const patternVisual = spellSystem.createPatternVisual(pattern, element);
 871:                             patternVisual.classList?.add?.('opponent-scroll-pattern');
 872:                             patternWrap.appendChild(patternVisual);
 873:                         }
 874:                         // Click handled by delegated listener on the container (see attachScrollDelegate above)
 875:                         activeScrollsDiv.appendChild(scrollCard);
 876:                     });
 877: 
 878:                     card.appendChild(activeScrollsDiv);
 879:                 }
 880: 
 881:                 if (cardsContainer) cardsContainer.appendChild(card);
 882:                 // Clone into new UI container — delegation listener on the container
 883:                 // handles clicks so no per-card event wiring is needed on the clone.
 884:                 if (newCardsContainer) newCardsContainer.appendChild(card.cloneNode(true));
 885:             }
 886: 
 887:             // If no opponents to show
 888:             if (cardsContainer && cardsContainer.children.length === 0) {
 889:                 cardsContainer.innerHTML = '<div style="color: #ccc; font-size: 12px; text-align: center;">Waiting for opponents...</div>';
 890:             }
 891:             if (newCardsContainer && newCardsContainer.children.length === 0) {
 892:                 newCardsContainer.innerHTML = '<div style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; text-align: center; padding: 20px;">Waiting for opponents...</div>';
 893:             }
 894: 
 895:             // Update HUD
 896:             if (typeof updateHUD === 'function') updateHUD();
 897:         }

 899:         function clearBoard(skipConfirm = false) {
 900:             if (!skipConfirm && !confirm('Clear all tiles and stones from the board?')) {
 901:                 return;
 902:             }
 903:             
 904:             placedTiles.forEach(tile => tile.element.remove());
 905:             placedStones.forEach(stone => stone.element.remove());
 906:             
 907:             // Clear all player pawns
 908:             playerPositions.forEach(player => {
 909:                 if (player && player.element) player.element.remove();
 910:             });
 911:             
 912:             placedTiles = [];
 913:             placedStones = [];
 914:             playerPositions = [];
 915:             activePlayerIndex = 0;
 916:             // Reset ID counters so each new game starts from 1 (prevents cross-game ID drift).
 917:             // Both clients must reset in sync — clearBoard is called from startMultiplayerGame
 918:             // before any tile/stone placement, so this is safe.
 919:             if (typeof nextTileId !== 'undefined') nextTileId = 1;
 920:             if (typeof nextStoneId !== 'undefined') nextStoneId = 1;
 921:             updateStatus('Board cleared');
 922:         }

1040:         // Event Handlers - Board (throttled to animation frames)
1041:         let pendingBoardMove = false;
1042:         let lastBoardMove = null;
1043:         boardSvg.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
1044:             lastBoardMove = { clientX: e.clientX, clientY: e.clientY };
1045:             if (pendingBoardMove) return;
1046:             pendingBoardMove = true;
1047:             requestAnimationFrame(() => {
1048:                 pendingBoardMove = false;
1049:                 if (!lastBoardMove) return;
1050: 
1051:                 const rect = boardSvg.getBoundingClientRect();
1052:                 const screenX = lastBoardMove.clientX - rect.left;
1053:                 const screenY = lastBoardMove.clientY - rect.top;
1054:                 const world = screenToWorld(screenX, screenY);
1055: 
1056:                 if (isDraggingTile && ghostTile) {
1057:                     const isPlayerTile = (draggedTileShrineType === 'player');
1058:                     const snapResult = findNearestSnapPoint(world.x, world.y, isPlayerTile);
1059:                     ghostTile.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${snapResult.x}, ${snapResult.y})`);
1060: 
1061:                     if (snapResult.snapped) {
1062:                         snapIndicator.setAttribute('cx', snapResult.x);
1063:                         snapIndicator.setAttribute('cy', snapResult.y);
1064:                         snapIndicator.classList.add('active');
1065:                     } else {
1066:                         snapIndicator.classList.remove('active');
1067:                     }
1068:                 } else if (isDraggingStone && ghostStone) {
1069:                     const stonePos = findValidStonePosition(world.x, world.y);
1070:                     ghostStone.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${stonePos.x}, ${stonePos.y})`);
1071: 
1072:                     if (stonePos.valid) {
1073:                         snapIndicator.setAttribute('cx', stonePos.x);
1074:                         snapIndicator.setAttribute('cy', stonePos.y);
1075:                         snapIndicator.classList.add('active');
1076:                     } else {
1077:                         snapIndicator.classList.remove('active');
1078:                     }
1079:                 } else if (isDraggingPlayer && ghostPlayer) {
1080:                     const tf = (typeof window !== 'undefined') ? window.takeFlightState : null;
1081:                     const playerPos = findNearestHexPosition(world.x, world.y);
1082: 
1083:                     if (tf && tf.active) {
1084:                         if (playerPos.valid) {
1085:                             ghostPlayer.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${playerPos.x}, ${playerPos.y})`);
1086:                             snapIndicator.setAttribute('cx', playerPos.x);
1087:                             snapIndicator.setAttribute('cy', playerPos.y);
1088:                             snapIndicator.classList.add('active');
1089:                         } else {
1090:                             snapIndicator.classList.remove('active');
1091:                         }
1092:                         tf.hoverPos = playerPos;
1093:                         return;
1094:                     }
1095: 
1096:                     // Prevent the ghost and path preview from moving "through" other players.
1097:                     // If the nearest hex is occupied, clamp the ghost to the last valid path node.
1098:                     if (playerPos.valid && isHexOccupiedByOtherPlayer(playerPos.x, playerPos.y)) {
1099:                         const last = (playerPath && playerPath.length) ? playerPath[playerPath.length - 1] : playerPosition;
1100:                         ghostPlayer.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${last.x}, ${last.y})`);
1101:                         snapIndicator.classList.remove('active');
1102:                         updateStatus('Blocked by another player');
1103:                         return;

1549:             if (e.touches.length === 1 && !isDraggingTile && !isDraggingStone && !isDraggingPlayer) {
1550:                 const targetClass = e.target?.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute('class');
1551:                 const isStone = targetClass && (targetClass.includes('stone') || e.target.closest('.stone'));
1552:                 const isPlayer = targetClass && (targetClass.includes('player') || e.target.closest('.player'));
1553:                 const isTile = e.target && (e.target.closest('.placed-tile') || e.target.closest('.tile'));
1554:                 if (!isStone && !isPlayer && !isTile) {
1555:                     e.preventDefault();
1556:                     isPanning = true;

1562:                 }
1563:             }
1564:

1567:                 // Two-finger pinch zoom / pan (board)
1568:                 e.preventDefault();
1569:                 isPinching = true;
1570:                 isGestureRotating = false;
1571: 
1572:                 const dx = e.touches[1].clientX - e.touches[0].clientX;
1573:                 const dy = e.touches[1].clientY - e.touches[0].clientY;
1574:                 pinchStartDist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;

1576:

1579:                 pinchStartMid = { x: midX, y: midY };

1588:             if (e.touches.length === 2 && isPinching) {
1589:                 // Pinch zoom / pan board
1590:                 const dx = e.touches[1].clientX - e.touches[0].clientX;
1591:                 const dy = e.touches[1].clientY - e.touches[0].clientY;
1592:                 const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
1593: 
1594:                 // Midpoint pan
1595:                 const midX = (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2;
1596:                 const midY = (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2;
1597:                 const midDeltaX = midX - pinchLastMid.x;
1598:                 const midDeltaY = midY - pinchLastMid.y;
1599:                 pinchLastMid = { x: midX, y: midY };
1600: 
1601:                 // Apply pan in world space
1602:                 viewportX += midDeltaX / viewportScale;
1603:                 viewportY += midDeltaY / viewportScale;
1604: 
1605:                 // Apply zoom anchored near screen midpoint (approx)
1606:                 let newScale = pinchStartScale * (dist / pinchStartDist);
1607:                 newScale = Math.max(0.25, Math.min(3.0, newScale));
1608: 
1609:                 const centerX = boardSvg.clientWidth / 2;
1610:                 const centerY = boardSvg.clientHeight / 2;
1611: 
1612:                 // Keep pinch midpoint roughly stable during zoom
1613:                 const k = (1 / viewportScale) - (1 / newScale);
1614:                 viewportX += (midX - centerX) * k;
1615:                 viewportY += (midY - centerY) * k;
1616: 
1617:                 viewportScale = newScale;
1618:                 updateViewport();
1619:                 return;
1620:             }
1621: 
1622:             else if (e.touches.length === 1) {
1623:                 // Single touch - pan or drag
1624:                 if (isPanning && !isDraggingTile && !isDraggingStone && !isDraggingPlayer) {
1625:                     const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - panStartX;
1626:                     const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - panStartY;
1627:                     const rad = -viewportRotation * Math.PI / 180;
1628:                     const cos = Math.cos(rad);
1629:                     const sin = Math.sin(rad);
1630:                     const rotatedDx = dx * cos - dy * sin;
1631:                     const rotatedDy = dx * sin + dy * cos;
1632:                     viewportX = lastPanX + rotatedDx;
1633:                     viewportY = lastPanY + rotatedDy;
1634:                     updateViewport();
1635:                     return;
1636:                 }
1637:                 // Single touch - handle drag
1638:                 const rect = boardSvg.getBoundingClientRect();
1639:                 const screenX = e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left;
1640:                 const screenY = e.touches[0].clientY - rect.top;
1641:                 const world = screenToWorld(screenX, screenY);
1642: 
1643:                 if (isDraggingTile && ghostTile) {
1644:                     const isPlayerTile = (draggedTileShrineType === 'player');
1645:                     const snapResult = findNearestSnapPoint(world.x, world.y, isPlayerTile);
1646:                     ghostTile.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${snapResult.x}, ${snapResult.y})`);
1647: 
1648:                     if (snapResult.snapped) {
1649:                         snapIndicator.setAttribute('cx', snapResult.x);
1650:                         snapIndicator.setAttribute('cy', snapResult.y);
1651:                         snapIndicator.classList.add('active');
1652:                     } else {
1653:                         snapIndicator.classList.remove('active');
1654:                     }
1655:                 } else if (isDraggingStone && ghostStone) {
1656:                     const stonePos = findValidStonePosition(world.x, world.y);
1657:                     ghostStone.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${stonePos.x}, ${stonePos.y})`);
1658: 
1659:                     if (stonePos.valid) {
1660:                         snapIndicator.setAttribute('cx', stonePos.x);
1661:                         snapIndicator.setAttribute('cy', stonePos.y);
1662:                         snapIndicator.classList.add('active');
1663:                     } else {
1664:                         snapIndicator.classList.remove('active');
1665:                     }
1666:                 } else if (isDraggingPlayer && ghostPlayer) {
1667:                     const tf = (typeof window !== 'undefined') ? window.takeFlightState : null;
1668:                     const playerPos = findNearestHexPosition(world.x, world.y);
1669: 
1670:                     if (tf && tf.active) {
1671:                         if (playerPos.valid) {
1672:                             ghostPlayer.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${playerPos.x}, ${playerPos.y})`);
1673:                             snapIndicator.setAttribute('cx', playerPos.x);
1674:                             snapIndicator.setAttribute('cy', playerPos.y);
1675:                             snapIndicator.classList.add('active');
1676:                         } else {
1677:                             snapIndicator.classList.remove('active');
1678:                         }
1679:                         tf.hoverPos = playerPos;
1680:                         return;
1681:                     }
1682: 
1683:                     ghostPlayer.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${playerPos.x}, ${playerPos.y})`);
1684: 
1685:                     if (playerPos.valid) {
1686:                         updatePlayerPath(playerPos.x, playerPos.y);
1687: 
1688:                         const totalCost = calculatePathCost();
1689:                         const moveCheck = canPlayerMoveToHex(playerPos.x, playerPos.y);
1690: 
1691:                         if (moveCheck.canMove && totalCost <= getTotalAP()) {
1692:                             snapIndicator.setAttribute('cx', playerPos.x);
1693:                             snapIndicator.setAttribute('cy', playerPos.y);
1694:                             snapIndicator.classList.add('active');
1695:                         } else {
1696:                             snapIndicator.classList.remove('active');
1697:                         }
1698: 
1699:                         updateStatus(`Path cost: ${totalCost} AP (${getTotalAP() - totalCost} remaining)`);
1700:                     } else {
1701:                         snapIndicator.classList.remove('active');
1702:                     }
1703:                 }
1704:             }
1705:         
1706:         }

1708:         function handleBoardTouchEnd(e) {
1709:             const touchDuration = Date.now() - touchStartTime;
1710:             const coords = e.changedTouches[0];
1711:             const rect = boardSvg.getBoundingClientRect();
1712:             const screenX = coords.clientX - rect.left;
1713:             const screenY = coords.clientY - rect.top;
1714: 
1715:             // Check if this was a tap (short touch without much movement)
1716:             const distMoved = Math.sqrt(
1717:                 Math.pow(coords.clientX - touchStartPos.x, 2) +
1718:                 Math.pow(coords.clientY - touchStartPos.y, 2)
1719:             );
1720:             const isTap = touchDuration < 300 && distMoved < 10;
1721: 
1722:             if (isPanning) {
1723:                 isPanning = false;
1724:                 boardSvg.style.cursor = 'grab';
1725:             }
1726: 
1727:             // TAP-TO-MOVE: If tapped on a valid hex and not doing anything else, move player there
1728:             console.log(`📱 Tap-to-move check: isTap=${isTap}, isDraggingTile=${isDraggingTile}, isDraggingStone=${isDraggingStone}, isDraggingPlayer=${isDraggingPlayer}, ghostTile=${!!ghostTile}, ghostStone=${!!ghostStone}, playerPosition=${!!playerPosition}, canTakeAction=${canTakeAction()}`);
1729:             if (isTap && !isDraggingTile && !isDraggingStone && !isDraggingPlayer && !ghostTile && !ghostStone && playerPosition && canTakeAction()) {
1730:                 const world = screenToWorld(screenX, screenY);
1731:                 const targetHex = findNearestHexPosition(world.x, world.y);
1732:                 console.log(`📱 Tap target: world=(${world.x.toFixed(1)}, ${world.y.toFixed(1)}), targetHex valid=${targetHex.valid}`);
1733: 
1734:                 if (targetHex.valid) {
1735:                     // Check if we tapped on the player's current position (within small radius)
1736:                     const distFromPlayer = Math.sqrt(
1737:                         Math.pow(targetHex.x - playerPosition.x, 2) +
1738:                         Math.pow(targetHex.y - playerPosition.y, 2)
1739:                     );
1740: 
1741:                     if (distFromPlayer > 5) { // Not tapping on current position
1742:                         // Calculate path cost using simple distance (1 AP per hex)
1743:                         const hexDist = Math.round(distFromPlayer / 17.3); // Approximate hex distance
1744:                         const pathCost = Math.max(1, hexDist);
1745: 
1746:                         // Check if move is valid
1747:                         const moveCheck = canPlayerMoveToHex(targetHex.x, targetHex.y, true);
1748: 
1749:                         // Check for stone at destination
1750:                         const stoneAtTarget = placedStones.find(s => {
1751:                             const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(s.x - targetHex.x, 2) + Math.pow(s.y - targetHex.y, 2));
1752:                             return dist < 5;
1753:                         });
1754:                         const cannotEndTurnHere = stoneAtTarget && stoneAtTarget.type !== 'void';
1755: 
1756:                         if (cannotEndTurnHere) {
1757:                             updateStatus('Cannot end movement on a ' + stoneAtTarget.type + ' stone!');
1758:                         } else if (!moveCheck.canMove) {
1759:                             updateStatus(moveCheck.reason || 'Cannot move there');
1760:                         } else if (pathCost > getTotalAP()) {
1761:                             updateStatus(`Not enough AP (need ~${pathCost}, have ${getTotalAP()})`);
1762:                         } else {
1763:                             // Calculate actual path cost by building path
1764:                             const startPos = { x: playerPosition.x, y: playerPosition.y };
1765:                             const actualCost = calculateTapMoveCost(startPos, targetHex);
1766: 
1767:                             if (actualCost > 0 && actualCost <= getTotalAP()) {
1768:                                 console.log(`📱 Tap-to-move: from (${startPos.x.toFixed(1)}, ${startPos.y.toFixed(1)}) to (${targetHex.x.toFixed(1)}, ${targetHex.y.toFixed(1)}), cost=${actualCost}`);
1769: 
1770:                                 // Store for undo (snapshot AP before spending)
1771:                                 lastMove = {
1772:                                     type: 'move',
1773:                                     prevPos: { x: startPos.x, y: startPos.y },
1774:                                     prevCurrentAP: currentAP,
1775:                                     prevVoidAP: voidAP
1776:                                 };
1777:                                 window.lastScrollAction = null;
1778:                                 window.SoundSystem?.playFootstep();
1779:                                 placePlayer(targetHex.x, targetHex.y);
1780:                                 spendAP(actualCost);
1781: 
1782:                                 // Broadcast in multiplayer
1783:                                 if (isMultiplayer) {
1784:                                     broadcastGameAction('player-move', {
1785:                                         playerIndex: activePlayerIndex,
1786:                                         x: targetHex.x,
1787:                                         y: targetHex.y,
1788:                                         apSpent: actualCost
1789:                                     });
1790:                                 }
1791: 
1792:                                 // Check for hidden tile reveal
1793:                                 const allHexes = getAllHexagonPositions();
1794:                                 let playerHex = null;
1795:                                 let minDist = Infinity;
1796:                                 allHexes.forEach(hexPos => {
1797:                                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(hexPos.x - targetHex.x, 2) + Math.pow(hexPos.y - targetHex.y, 2));
1798:                                     if (dist < minDist) {
1799:                                         minDist = dist;
1800:                                         playerHex = hexPos;
1801:                                     }
1802:                                 });
1803: 
1804:                                 if (playerHex && minDist < 5 && playerHex.tiles) {
1805:                                     const flippedTiles = playerHex.tiles.filter(t => t.flipped && !t.isPlayerTile);
1806:                                     flippedTiles.forEach(tileInfo => {
1807:                                         revealTile(tileInfo.id);
1808:                                     });
1809:                                 }
1810: 
1811:                                 updateStatus(`Moved (cost: ${actualCost} AP, ${getTotalAP()} AP remaining)`);
1812:                             } else if (actualCost <= 0) {
1813:                                 updateStatus('No valid path to that hex');
1814:                             } else {
1815:                                 updateStatus(`Not enough AP (need ${actualCost}, have ${getTotalAP()})`);
1816:                             }
1817:                         }
1818:                     }
1819:                 }
1820:             }
1821: 
1822:             if (isTap && isDraggingTile && ghostTile) {
1823:                 // Tap to flip
1824:                 draggedTileFlipped = !draggedTileFlipped;
1825:

1827:                 const oldTransform = ghostTile.getAttribute('transform');
1828:                 const translateMatch = oldTransform?.match(/translate\(([^,]+),\s*([^)]+)\)/);

1830:                 const currentY = translateMatch ? parseFloat(translateMatch[2]) : 0;

2280:         function buildValidPlayerTilePositions() {
2281:             const largeHexSize = TILE_SIZE * 4;
2282:             const offsets = [
2283:                 { q: 1, r: 0 }, { q: 0, r: 1 }, { q: -1, r: 1 },
2284:                 { q: -1, r: 0 }, { q: 0, r: -1 }, { q: 1, r: -1 }
2285:             ];
2286:             const valid = [];
2287:             const seen = new Set();
2288:             for (const tile of placedTiles) {
2289:                 const th = pixelToHex(tile.x, tile.y, largeHexSize);
2290:                 for (const off of offsets) {
2291:                     const key = `${th.q + off.q},${th.r + off.r}`;
2292:                     if (seen.has(key)) continue;
2293:                     seen.add(key);
2294:                     const pos = hexToPixel(th.q + off.q, th.r + off.r, largeHexSize);
2295:                     const occupied = placedTiles.some(t =>
2296:                         Math.sqrt(Math.pow(t.x - pos.x, 2) + Math.pow(t.y - pos.y, 2)) < TILE_SIZE
2297:                     );
2298:                     if (!occupied && countTouchingUnrevealedTiles(pos.x, pos.y) >= 2) {
2299:                         valid.push(pos);
2300:                     }
2301:                 }
2302:             }
2303:             // Sort clockwise by angle from board centre so ←/→ feel spatial
2304:             valid.sort((a, b) => Math.atan2(a.y, a.x) - Math.atan2(b.y, b.x));
2305:             return valid;
2306:         }

2341:         function buildValidMovePositions() {
2342:             if (!playerPosition) return [];
2343:             const allHexes = getAllHexagonPositions();
2344: 
2345:             return allHexes
2346:                 .filter(h => {
2347:                     const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(h.x - playerPosition.x, 2) + Math.pow(h.y - playerPosition.y, 2));
2348:                     return dist > 5 && dist < 40; // immediately adjacent only
2349:                 })
2350:                 .filter(h => {
2351:                     // Tutorial gate
2352:                     if (window.isTutorialMode && window.tutorialAllowedHexes) {
2353:                         return [...window.tutorialAllowedHexes].some(key => {
2354:                             const [ax, ay] = key.split(',').map(Number);
2355:                             return Math.abs(ax - h.x) < 70 && Math.abs(ay - h.y) < 70;
2356:                         });
2357:                     }
2358:                     return true;
2359:                 })
2360:                 .filter(h => {
2361:                     const moveCheck = canPlayerMoveToHex(h.x, h.y, false);
2362:                     if (!moveCheck.canMove) return false;
2363:                     if (moveCheck.cost > getTotalAP()) return false;
2364:                     // Can't end turn on a non-void stone
2365:                     const stone = placedStones.find(s =>
2366:                         Math.sqrt(Math.pow(s.x - h.x, 2) + Math.pow(s.y - h.y, 2)) < 5
2367:                     );
2368:                     if (stone && stone.type !== 'void') return false;
2369:                     return true;
2370:                 })
2371:                 .sort((a, b) => {
2372:                     const angleA = Math.atan2(a.y - playerPosition.y, a.x - playerPosition.x);
2373:                     const angleB = Math.atan2(b.y - playerPosition.y, b.x - playerPosition.x);
2374:                     return angleA - angleB;
2375:                 });
2376:         }

2404:         function buildCatacombDestinations() {
2405:             if (!playerPosition) return [];
2406:             const currentShrine = findShrineAtPosition(playerPosition.x, playerPosition.y);
2407:             const freedomActive = spellSystem && spellSystem.scrollEffects
2408:                 && typeof spellSystem.scrollEffects.hasFreedomActive === 'function'
2409:                 && spellSystem.scrollEffects.hasFreedomActive(myPlayerIndex);
2410:             const elementalTypes = ['earth', 'water', 'fire', 'wind', 'void'];
2411:             const isCatacombLike = (tile) => {
2412:                 if (!tile) return false;
2413:                 if (tile.shrineType === 'catacomb') return true;
2414:                 if (freedomActive && elementalTypes.includes(tile.shrineType)) return true;
2415:                 return false;
2416:             };
2417:             if (!currentShrine || !isCatacombLike(currentShrine)) return [];
2418:             return placedTiles.filter(tile => {
2419:                 if (!isCatacombLike(tile)) return false;
2420:                 if (tile.flipped) return false;
2421:                 if (Math.abs(tile.x - currentShrine.x) <= 5 && Math.abs(tile.y - currentShrine.y) <= 5) return false;
2422:                 const hasStone = placedStones.some(s => Math.sqrt(Math.pow(s.x - tile.x, 2) + Math.pow(s.y - tile.y, 2)) < 5);
2423:                 const hasPlayer = playerPositions.some(p => p && Math.sqrt(Math.pow(p.x - tile.x, 2) + Math.pow(p.y - tile.y, 2)) < 5);
2424:                 return !hasStone && !hasPlayer;
2425:             });
2426:         }

2572:                 const stoneHere = placedStones.some(s =>
2573:                     Math.sqrt(Math.pow(s.x - pos.x, 2) + Math.pow(s.y - pos.y, 2)) < 5
2574:                 );
2575:                 if (stoneHere) return false;
2576: 
2577:                 let playerHere = false;
2578:                 if (playerPosition) {
2579:                     playerHere = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(playerPosition.x - pos.x, 2) + Math.pow(playerPosition.y - pos.y, 2)) < 5;
2580:                 }
2581:                 if (!playerHere && typeof playerPositions !== 'undefined') {
2582:                     playerPositions.forEach(p => {
2583:                         if (p && p.x != null) {
2584:                             if (Math.sqrt(Math.pow(p.x - pos.x, 2) + Math.pow(p.y - pos.y, 2)) < 5) playerHere = true;
2585:                         }
2586:                     });
2587:                 }
2588:                 if (playerHere) return false;
2589: 
2590:                 if (isPositionOnFlippedTile(pos.x, pos.y, hexPositions)) return false;
2591:                 if (!isInPlacementRange(pos.x, pos.y, type)) return false;
2592:                 return true;
2593:             });
2594: 
2595:             draggedStoneType = prevType;
2596: 
2597:             // Sort by clockwise angle around the player so ←/→ sweeps in a circle
2598:             if (playerPosition) {
2599:                 valid.sort((a, b) => {
2600:                     const angleA = Math.atan2(a.y - playerPosition.y, a.x - playerPosition.x);
2601:                     const angleB = Math.atan2(b.y - playerPosition.y, b.x - playerPosition.x);
2602:                     return angleA - angleB;
2603:                 });
2604:             }
2605:             return valid;
2606:         }

3017:         boardSvg.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
3018:             e.preventDefault();
3019:             const rect = boardSvg.getBoundingClientRect();
3020:             const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
3021:             const mouseY = e.clientY - rect.top;
3022:             const worldBefore = screenToWorld(mouseX, mouseY);
3023:             const zoomFactor = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9;
3024:             viewportScale = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(10, viewportScale * zoomFactor));
3025:             const worldAfter = screenToWorld(mouseX, mouseY);
3026:             viewportX += (worldAfter.x - worldBefore.x) * viewportScale;
3027:             viewportY += (worldAfter.y - worldBefore.y) * viewportScale;
3028:             updateViewport();
3029:         });

3444:         function findShrineAtPosition(x, y) {
3445:             // Check each tile to see if player is on the center hex (shrine location)
3446:             // Skip player tiles - we want the actual shrine tile
3447:             for (const tile of placedTiles) {
3448:                 // Skip player tiles (shrineType === 'player')
3449:                 if (tile.shrineType === 'player') continue;
3450: 
3451:                 const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(tile.x - x, 2) + Math.pow(tile.y - y, 2));
3452:                 // Center hex is at the tile's position (0,0 offset)
3453:                 if (dist < 5) {
3454:                     console.log(`🔍 findShrineAtPosition(${x.toFixed(1)}, ${y.toFixed(1)}): Found ${tile.shrineType} shrine at tile ${tile.id}`);
3455:                     return tile;
3456:                 }
3457:             }
3458:             console.log(`🔍 findShrineAtPosition(${x.toFixed(1)}, ${y.toFixed(1)}): No shrine found`);
3459:             return null;
3460:         }

3462:         function replenishShrineStones(shrineType) {
3463:             // Stone rank determines replenishment amount
3464:             const STONE_RANK = {
3465:                 'void': 1,
3466:                 'wind': 2,
3467:                 'fire': 3,
3468:                 'water': 4,
3469:                 'earth': 5
3470:             };
3471: 
3472:             let replenishAmount = STONE_RANK[shrineType];
3473: 
3474:             // Mine buff: double output for the buffed shrine type
3475:             const mineBuff = spellSystem?.scrollEffects?.activeBuffs?.mine;
3476:             if (mineBuff && mineBuff.playerIndex === activePlayerIndex && mineBuff.shrineType === shrineType) {
3477:                 replenishAmount *= 2;
3478:                 console.log(`⛏️ Mine: doubling ${shrineType} shrine output to ${replenishAmount}`);
3479:             }
3480: 
3481:             // Calculate how many stones we can actually transfer
3482:             // Limited by: source pool availability, player pool capacity, and replenish amount
3483:             const availableInSource = sourcePool[shrineType];
3484:             const spaceInPlayer = playerPoolCapacity[shrineType] - playerPool[shrineType];
3485:             const actualReplenished = Math.min(replenishAmount, availableInSource, spaceInPlayer);
3486: 
3487:             if (actualReplenished > 0) {
3488:                 // Transfer from source pool to player pool
3489:                 sourcePool[shrineType] -= actualReplenished;
3490:                 playerPool[shrineType] += actualReplenished;
3491:                 updateStoneCount(shrineType);
3492:                 window.SoundSystem?.play('collectstones');
3493: 
3494:                 // Sync resources in multiplayer
3495:                 syncPlayerState();
3496: 
3497:                 updateStatus(`Shrine activated! Transferred ${actualReplenished} ${shrineType} stone${actualReplenished > 1 ? 's' : ''} from source to player pool. (Source: ${sourcePool[shrineType]}/${sourcePoolCapacity[shrineType]}, Player: ${playerPool[shrineType]}/${playerPoolCapacity[shrineType]}). AP restored.`);
3498:             } else if (spaceInPlayer === 0) {
3499:                 updateStatus(`Shrine activated but player pool is full! (${playerPool[shrineType]}/${playerPoolCapacity[shrineType]}). AP restored.`);
3500:             } else if (availableInSource === 0) {
3501:                 updateStatus(`Shrine activated but source pool is empty! (${sourcePool[shrineType]}/${sourcePoolCapacity[shrineType]}). AP restored.`);
3502:             }
3503:         }

3858:         // Generate spiral tile positions starting from center
3859:         // Based on the spiral pattern from the image: 1(center), 2(SE), 3(SW), 4(W), 5(NW), 6(NE), 7(E), then ring 2...
3860:         function generateSpiralPositions(numTiles) {
3861:             const positions = [];
3862:             const largeHexSize = TILE_SIZE * 4; // Grid size for tile snapping
3863: 
3864:             // Predefined spiral path in axial coordinates (q, r)
3865:             // 6 tiles per player (one of each shrine type)
3866:             const spiralPath = [
3867:                 { q: 0, r: 0 },    // 1 - Center
3868:                 { q: 0, r: 1 },    // 2 - SE
3869:                 { q: -1, r: 1 },   // 3 - SW
3870:                 { q: -1, r: 0 },   // 4 - W
3871:                 { q: 0, r: -1 },   // 5 - NW
3872:                 { q: 1, r: -1 },   // 6 - NE (1 player complete - 6 tiles)
3873:                 { q: 1, r: 0 },    // 7 - E
3874:                 { q: 1, r: 1 },    // 8 - SE (ring 2)
3875:                 { q: 0, r: 2 },    // 9
3876:                 { q: -1, r: 2 },   // 10
3877:                 { q: -2, r: 2 },   // 11
3878:                 { q: -2, r: 1 },   // 12 (2 players complete - 12 tiles)
3879:                 { q: -2, r: 0 },   // 13
3880:                 { q: -1, r: -1 },  // 14
3881:                 { q: 0, r: -2 },   // 15
3882:                 { q: 1, r: -2 },   // 16
3883:                 { q: 2, r: -2 },   // 17
3884:                 { q: 2, r: -1 },   // 18 (3 players complete - 18 tiles)
3885:                 { q: 2, r: 0 },    // 19
3886:                 { q: 2, r: 1 },    // 20
3887:                 { q: 1, r: 2 },    // 21 (ring 3)
3888:                 { q: 0, r: 3 },    // 22
3889:                 { q: -1, r: 3 },   // 23
3890:                 { q: -2, r: 3 },   // 24 (4 players complete - 24 tiles)
3891:                 { q: -3, r: 3 },   // 25
3892:                 { q: -3, r: 2 },   // 26
3893:                 { q: -3, r: 1 },   // 27
3894:                 { q: -3, r: 0 },   // 28
3895:                 { q: -2, r: -1 },  // 29
3896:                 { q: -1, r: -2 },  // 30 (5 players complete - 30 tiles)
3897:                 { q: 0, r: -3 },   // 31 (extra positions for future)
3898:                 { q: 1, r: -3 },   // 32
3899:                 { q: 2, r: -3 },   // 33
3900:                 { q: 3, r: -3 },   // 34
3901:                 { q: 3, r: -2 },   // 35
3902:                 { q: 3, r: -1 },   // 36
3903:             ];
3904: 
3905:             // Convert to pixel positions
3906:             for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(numTiles, spiralPath.length); i++) {
3907:                 const pos = hexToPixel(spiralPath[i].q, spiralPath[i].r, largeHexSize);
3908:                 positions.push({ x: pos.x, y: pos.y });
3909:             }
3910: 
3911:             return positions;
3912:         }
